Home /About Us

Established in 2007, MSC
Technology is the IT division of MSC Mediterranean Shipping Company: a global leader in
shipping and logistics. With offices in Belgium, India, Italy, Switzerland and the USA, we develop and
deploy innovative IT solutions for MSC.

MSC was founded in 1970 by Captain
Gianluigi Aponte and is now present in 155 countries. Headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, this
privately owned company connects and facilitates international trade between the world’s major economies
and emerging markets across all seven continents.

At the forefront of innovation

With a team of 1450+ employees, MSC Technology is behind some of the most interactive
maritime software solutions available today. Following Agile software development practices, we work
collaboratively with our counterparts worldwide, offering a dynamic, cross-cultural working environment.

Under the leadership of highly accomplished and experienced technology professionals,
we deliver customer-centric solutions aligned with global trends and business
expectations. Our services include visualising, conceptualising and developing applications from scratch,
as well as deploying applications and providing 24/7 support. With an emphasis on equal
opportunities and collaboration, we are a reliable strategic partner with a
great journey ahead of us.

“We are a family company with a family spirit and our people are the key to our success.”

Captain Gianluigi Aponte, MSC Group Chairman and Founder

Join the MSC family Are you interested in working for a global
leader in transport & logistics? Would you like to be part of a fast-growing team that is shaping the
future of the industry with cutting-edge technology?

Contact us to find out more about our exciting range of career opportunities all
over the world.

BUSINESS PROCESS DEPARTMENT

BUSINESS PROCESS DEPARTMENT

The Business process management (BPM) is an approach making an organization's
workflow more effective, more efficient and more capable of adapting to an
ever-changing environment. A business process is an activity or set of activities
that will accomplish a specific organizational goal.

The BPD team is the backbone of the organization, providing invaluable inputs to
the other teams to achieve business applications as per the Shipping norms and
Agency requirements.
The team comprises of Domain specialists who have valuable
experience in the shipping industry and/or are trained on the Business Domain.

They receive the requirements or pain points from the offices globally. The
department then conceptualizes, develops and deploys the solution for them. Not
just that the department is also responsible for training the users and for giving
support 24x7 365 days a year. BPD has a deep understanding & expertise of its
domain. Over the span of 8 years, they have successfully done implementation in 70
odd locations.

CUSTOMER SUPPORT DEPARTMENT

Home /CUSTOMER SUPPORT DEPARTMENT

As a service provider, the CSD team provides support to over 60 agencies across
the globe. They interacts with the agency users in order to provide timely support
and offer services 24 x 7 to meet the demanding deadlines of the shipping business
& principal requirements.

They are vigilant and constantly keep an eagle’s eye on the helpdesk tracking
system to attend to the users instantly. They work in three shifts so that all the
region agencies are being provided superior support and do not face any crises.
Internal tool has been created to monitor number of ticket raised in each shift
and to ensure co-ordination between the shifts. Each shift consists of lead and
senior people to support the executives to handle agency query without any
difficulty. Similarly Agencies are provided with a tool to report their
queries/clarification. If any technical assistance is required to provide solution
for user query, then technical team will be approached. If any functional
assistance is required, then respective functional team will be approached. Based
on that, this team ensures the respective ticket will be closed.

Home / Fabio CATASSI

Fabio CATASSI

Global Chief Information Officer

Mr. Catassi has been with MSC Mediterranean Shipping Company since 1995.

In his role as Global Chief Information Officer for MSC, Mr. Catassi has overall
responsibility of the IT organization including Infrastructure, Development and
Security both for MSC headquarters in Geneva and the network of its Agencies.

As part of the Digital Transformation of the MSC Cargo Division, Mr. Catassi
leads the OneVision project whose goal is to create an advanced set of solutions aimed
to the MSC organization and its Customers.

Formerly President and CEO of MSC Technology (North America) based in Warren NJ, Mr.
Catassi is now one of its Board Members and supervises the OneVision team in MSC
Technology (India).

From 2014 to 2016, Mr. Catassi was a Board Member Advisor for INTTRA, a provider of
software solutions and services to a variety of shippers and carriers in the maritime
industry.

Prior to joining MSC, Mr. Catassi worked as Managing Director of CSI Technology, a
company in Italy that, among other projects, developed software for National Railway
Co. for them to use in the transportation of goods over their system.

Originally from Italy, Mr. Catassi holds a degree in Classical Languages and
Philosophy and studied for a Law Degree prior to changing course to pursue his career
in computer technology and information systems.

In 2013 Mr. Catassi was named by Information Management Magazine as one of the Top 25
IT Managers in the USA.

Formerly President of the Italian-American Chamber of Commerce in New York, Mr.
Catassi is also a Knight and Officer of the Italian Republic.

MSC TECHNOLOGY ITALY, SWITZERLAND & USA - ISO CERTIFICATION

Home / MSC TECHNOLOGY ITALY, SWITZERLAND & USA - ISO CERTIFICATION

Three teams from MSC Technology in Italy (Turin), Switzerland (Geneva) and
the US (Warren) have successfully obtained ISO 22301:2019 and ISO/IEC 27001:2013 certifications after a
month-long joint certification audit undertaken with DNV, the certifying body.
What do ISO 22301 and 27001 certify?
ISO 22301 certifies a company's
security and resilience and, specifically, its business continuity management systems (BCMS), which are
critical for protecting against and reducing the impact of any business disruption. This latest ISO 22301
certification (a recertification) reflects MSC's work to increase the functional coverage of our BCMS.

Meanwhile, ISO 27001 relates to information security and, in particular, how an organisation establishes,
implements, maintains and continually improves its information security management systems (ISMS) and
processes. As such, it is an essential standard for any company that takes cyber and data security and
privacy seriously in our digital age.

"The certifications represent a highly visible, internationally recognised, stamp of approval of how we
work," explains Fabio Catassi, MSC's CTO. "Our customers are continually seeking reassurance that our
IT-enabled services are resilient, confidential and available, and the ISO certifications provide a proof
that our company meets the high standards."

Fabio adds that the risks of being uncertified are linked more to MSC's reputation than any technical
concerns "as our MSC technology entities already rely on best practices". However, these certifications
enable us to save "a lot of time explaining to our customer's auditors how we do things".

Achieving certification: a team effort
To achieve certification
with both standards, DNV audited a range of subjects, from the security of operations and communications
to human resources, risk management and application support. It also assessed physical and environmental
security across all three sites.

The MSC ISO teams would like to thank everyone that participated in the audit interviews and pass on the
compliments of the auditors. Not only did DNV highlight three noteworthy BCMS and ISMS activities and
projects in the closing report, the company also commended the interviewed staff for demonstrating "good
sensitivity to information security risks and excellent IT skills".

The Development team plays a very important role in translating the business

Several groups are involved in the development cycle:

plan and assign the various tasks to the software developers in their teams.

Software developer, using the appropriate coding language tools, develop the final
product for QA testing. Software developers also maintain existing code for new
and revised specifications.

At a more extended level, EDI systems are deployed through the group to improve
connectivity and the development of new connectable applications. Intersystems
Ensemble is a platform to develop, configure, deploy, and manage real time
productions.
It includes the comprehensive range of technologies needed for any
connectivity task, in a unified “single stack” architecture that provides
ease-of-use and enables rapid project completion. Ensemble users typically
complete projects twice as fast compared to previous generations of integration
products. Ensemble is used by enterprises that want advanced integration
technology to overcome the limitations of traditional interface software and
time-consuming point-to-point methods. By establishing enterprise service bus and
service-oriented architecture infrastructures, Ensemble enables the creation of
composite applications that preserve and extend previous software investments.

Based on business requirements, EDI Specialists use industry standard software
translators for mapping between the various subsystems and the EDI transmissions.
For all the EDI format already supported, the EDI team monitors and troubleshoots
the EDI communication as well as configure any new EDI partners.

Your Shipping Needs Met

At MSC we pride ourselves on being a global container shipping company that delivers tailored solutions designed to meet the specific needs of each of our customers. Regardless of your cargo type, or final destination, we offer versatile solutions that cover air, land, and sea.

Thanks to the extensive capacity of our container fleet, MSC is the trusted transportation partner and shipping company for numerous companies the world over. Combining this with our global port coverage and extensive equipment availability means, we are able to deliver a professional, efficient shipping service, tailored to the specific needs of your business.

Agriculture

With global sourcing an everyday reality, MSC connects the growers, farmers and producers of agricultural products around the world with their key markets.

Read more

Fruit

Whether you’re shipping apples or avocados, our world-leading reefer fleet is equipped with the technology you need to keep your fruit in perfect condition. We use the Cold Treatment process as a chemical-free way to disinfect your fruit and protect it from pests.

Read more

Pharmaceuticals

More and more pharmaceutical companies are turning to sea transport to deliver medicines and other essential goods quickly and safely to the places where they are needed.
When shipping with MSC you benefit not only from our GDP compliant practices but also from our vast global network, which connects all of the world’s major trading centres. We can provide reliable and cost-effective deliveries to any destination.

Read more

Car Parts

Whether you are shipping production or service parts, a reliable and experienced shipping partner is a vital link in your uninterruptible supply chain. As the automotive industry gradually moves into a new, greener era, MSC will be here to provide the fast, flexible and transparent supply chain solution you need.

Read more

Mining & Minerals

For decades MSC has been successfully connecting the minerals extraction industries with
customer markets around the world – offering fast transit times across all key trade lanes.

Read more

Plastics & Rubber Products

Transported to and from every major trade lane, plastic and rubber goods are at the very centre of most modern global supply chains. Plastic and rubber comes in all shapes and sizes, from raw materials to finished items. MSC ship plastics, natural rubber and rubber products all around the world.

Read more

MSC provides careful, precise and robust processes to safely transport hazardous and dangerous goods, such as chemicals and petrochemicals. As experts in the transportation of dangerous cargoes, MSC can ensure your cargo is shipped safely and in compliance with relevant regulations. We can also help you to deal with any contingency wherever you are shipping around the globe.

Captain Gianluigi Aponte

Captain Gianluigi Aponte, Group Chairman

" Our staff are the lifeblood of the company, they have commitment, passion and loyalty, which, alongside unrivalled expertise makes MSC a shipping line of the people. "

Captain Gianluigi Aponte, Group Chairman

" Our staff are the lifeblood of the company, they have commitment, passion and loyalty, which, alongside unrivalled expertise makes MSC a shipping line of the people. "

Captain Gianluigi Aponte is the Founder and Group Chairman of MSC Mediterranean Shipping Company SA.

Born in Sorrento, Italy, Mr Aponte started his career as a captain operating passenger ferries in the Mediterranean for his family’s business after graduating from the Italian Maritime Academy.

In 1970, following a break from the world of maritime transport to work as a banker for a number of years, Captain Aponte returned to the industry to start his own business, MSC Mediterranean Shipping Company. Inspired by his vision that “where the customer goes, MSC goes”, Captain Aponte has since grown MSC from a single vessel operation to become one of the largest container shipping lines in the world, while remaining true to his core family values of caring for employees and customers.

Diego Aponte

Diego Aponte, Group President

" MSC inspires passion, dedication and entrepreneurialism wherever you look. "

Diego Aponte, Group President

" MSC inspires passion, dedication and entrepreneurialism wherever you look. "

Diego Aponte is Group President of MSC Mediterranean Shipping Company SA.

Diego graduated in Maritime Studies with a particular focus on shipping. He joined MSC in 1997, first training on-board vessels as a junior engineer to gain first-hand technical experience, then increasing his breadth of maritime knowledge at MSC Ship Management in Sorrento. Upon joining MSC Headquarters in Geneva, Diego worked across all departments, including Latin American and USA trade lanes.

In the late 1990s, Diego identified an opportunity for MSC to invest in terminal infrastructure, to facilitate the long-term growth of the container industry. In 2000, Diego created Terminal Investment Limited S.A. (TiL), which has become one of the largest terminal operators in the world. Today, Diego is the Chairman of TiL.

From 2006, Diego worked closely with his father, Captain Gianluigi Aponte, as Vice President of the business, becoming Group President and CEO of MSC Mediterranean Shipping Company SA in 2014.

Soren Toft

Soren Toft, CEO

" Helping to preserve the MSC DNA and lead such a successful company into the future is a great honour and a privilege. "

Soren Toft, CEO

" Helping to preserve the MSC DNA and lead such a successful company into the future is a great honour and a privilege. "

Soren Toft joined MSC as Chief Executive Officer (CEO) in December 2020, reporting to Group President Diego Aponte.

In the role, Soren oversees MSC's global cargo businesses, including all ocean liner and logistics businesses, and is also a member of the Board of Directors of Terminal Investment Ltd (TiL).

Soren has more than 25 years of experience in the shipping industry. Before joining MSC, he was Chief Operating Officer and a Member of the Executive Board at Maersk, previously holding various leadership positions in Europe and Asia after joining Maersk in 1994. Soren was also Chairman of Hamburg Süd, Maersk Oil Trading, Maersk Container Industry and A.P. Moller Singapore, and Board Member at Maersk Line, Limited. He holds an executive MBA from the International Institute for Management Development (IMD) in Lausanne, Switzerland.

MSC Foundation

"
We all have the duty to leave a better world for future generations
"

Captain Gianluigi Aponte
Chairman of MSC Foundation

The MSC Foundation is an independent not-for-profit organization that was established by the Aponte family to lead, focus and advance the MSC Group's conservation and humanitarian commitments. Its vision is to restore the critical balance between people and nature within a generation. Its mission is to utilize MSC's global reach and unique knowledge of the sea to take immediate action that contributes to protecting and nurturing the blue planet and all its people.

What we do

The MSC Foundation is motivated by our deep sense of responsibility for the planet and its resources, particularly the oceans, and driven by our shared duty to leave a better world for the future generations.

Through it, we are able to assist disaster-struck populations toward recovery and support vulnerable communities around the world to realize their full potential through education, sustainable development and medical humanitarian programs.

The Foundation works both independently and in conjunction with trusted partners that have a strong innovative vision or track record for effective action.

Examples of Projects Supported by the MSC Foundation and MSC Group

Humanitarian Relief

MSC works hand-in-hand with the MSC Foundation to offer support for humanitarian relief efforts in affected communities.

Mercy Ships

MSC has been supporting Mercy Ships since 2011, helping it to bring hope and healing to thousands of people without access to safe, modern healthcare or surgery. The MSC Group provides logistical support to Mercy Ships, enabling it to concentrate more of its resources on healthcare, while the MSC Foundation provides direct funding.

Behind every vessel, every route, every delivery, there are names. And behind every name, there are people.

At MSC, we don’t just move cargo. We move dreams, hope and ambitions. Because it is people — our employees and our customers — who truly power global trade.

"
We not only transport goods, we connect people and continents.
"

Diego Aponte
Group President

Even as the world has transformed and MSC has grown, the essence of who we are has never changed, our DNA remains intact, and our values continue to guide every step we take.

The Value of a Name

Every vessel we operate carries a name. A name that tells a story, rooted in the people who are part of our family.

From the very beginning, our ships have been named after our employees and their loved ones. Because everything starts with who we are: a global network built on meaningful human connections.

People at the Core

Behind the steel, beyond logistics, there is something more. There are hands guiding our vessels, minds planning every route, and hearts committed to every journey.

It is people who make it happen, every single day:

Together with Our Customers

Every shipment is more than cargo. It is a goal, a challenge, an opportunity.

When you choose MSC, your needs become our own: we listen, we adapt, we find the best way forward.

With our standalone network, flexibility, and fast decision-making, we keep your business moving seamlessly. But what truly sets us apart is something deeper: a human approach, tailored to you, built over time.

Relationships That Last

What differentiates us is not only what we do, but how we do it. We build strong, long-term relationships based on trust and understanding. Every customer is unique, and every partnership is personal. For us, success is not only measured in miles travelled, but in the connections, we create along the way.

"
A customer for us is a customer forever.
"

Capt. Gianluigi Aponte
Group Chairman

MSC, Moving the World, Together.

We cross oceans, connect continents, and support global economies. But in the end, our destinations are not ports or cities.

They are people.

From our family to yours, we keep the world moving — together.

Our Values

MSC Values

Our values are the beating heart of our business. They are the cornerstone of our Company, supporting our vision, shaping our culture and establishing our future direction. These values are our guiding light. They set a clear path for us to follow, they help us grow together and they provide us all with the spirit of success.

We are a Family Company

Sharing the family’s entrepreneurial spirit leads us to act proactively, courageously and responsibly in the best interest of our customers and our Company.

We have Passion

We are passionate about what we do, we challenge ourselves to achieve excellence and we are tenacious in overcoming obstacles. Working together with passion and enthusiasm, we provide a unique experience for our customers.

We are in Continuous Evolution

Our tradition, expertise, professionalism and ambition drive the Company’s fast and sustainable growth. We strive for the most innovative solutions to embrace change, always respecting safety and the environment.

We Care for People

We believe that each person brings unique value. We develop authentic relationship built on ethics, respect and team spirit. We truly care about the satisfaction and loyalty of our customers and employees.

We believe in Equal Opportunities

Our mission is to provide our people with personal fulfilment and enrichment. We are committed to sharing our knowledge, delivering training and support enabling our people’s professional growth. We ensure fair opportunities providing long-term career development, embracing diversity and valuing all cultures.

Working at MSC

Working at MSC

At MSC, we move careers forward. As a global leader rooted in family values, we believe that our greatest asset is our people. When you join the MSC family, you enter a collaborative environment where your growth is prioritized, your achievements are celebrated, and your daily work shapes the future of global logistics.

Continuous Learning & Development

We believe continuous learning is key to success. Through specialized MSC training programmes, tailored on-the-job training, and mentorship, we provide the resources and opportunities you need to build your skills, grow your career, and reach your full potential.

A Positive Global Impact

Joining MSC means contributing to something larger than any single role. Our teams do more than manage supply chains; they keep global trade flowing smoothly.

Your Impact is Recognized

Great work never goes unnoticed or unrewarded at MSC. We actively cultivate a culture of appreciation where we celebrate milestones, recognize individual and team contributions, and ensure that your dedication is met with genuine reward and advancement.

Our Recruitment Process:
Your Journey to MSC

We want your application experience to be as transparent and seamless as your career path with us.

How do I apply for a job at MSC?

Whether you’re highly experienced or taking your first steps in your career, we have job opportunities to suit everyone.

Please apply online by checking our vacancies.

Important fraud warning: MSC never charges job application or processing fees. In case of any doubt please contact us at CH001-scam.alert@msc.com. Please note that this address is only dedicated to fraud detection and not job applications.

I just submitted my application. What can I expect?

We appreciate your application, and we thank you for your time. We review every application carefully and if we consider your profile a good match for the position, we will contact you to arrange an interview. After the interview process, we will notify the successful candidate(s) by phone or email and finalize the contractual conditions.

Does MSC accept open applications?

No, unfortunately we cannot accept unsolicited job applications. However, you can find a full list of our current vacancies on our LinkedIn job portal.

Do I need to have work experience in the container shipping industry to apply for a job at MSC?

Not necessarily – it depends on the role. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and experience levels, as we value diversity and different perspectives.

Will I receive a response to my application if I am not successful?

Regrettably we cannot reply to every candidate individually due to the volume of applications we receive.

Can I apply for a job in a country where I don’t currently live?

In general, we only consider applicants who are already legally able to work in the country in which the job is offered. However, we occasionally make exceptions for specialized positions.

Cookie Policy

Information about our use of cookies

This is a website operated by MSC Mediterranean Shipping Company S.A. (hereinafter “MSC,”
“we,” “our,” or “us”). MSC is registered in Switzerland at 12-14 Chemin Rieu
1208, Geneva.

MSC is committed to protecting your privacy. This Cookie Policy accounts for the Cookies used via the
https://www.msc.com website (including the myMSC.com portal) (hereinafter “Website”).

Our Website uses cookies to distinguish you from other visitors of our Website. This helps us to provide you with a
good experience when you browse our Website.

WHAT ARE COOKIES?

Cookies are small text files assigned to your browser to collect internet log on and visitor tracking information
(including IP address, browsing history, and geolocation data, where and as allowed by applicable law).

Cookies helps us track your use and provide the best possible user experience by allowing us to know how to improve
our Website. We also may use cookies to provide you with information on our services that may be of interest to you,
where and as allowed by law.

Cookies can be identified as "persistent" or "session", and “first-party” or “third-party”.
Our Website notifies you when you are receiving cookies, giving you the choice to accept them or not.

THE COOKIES WE USE

We use cookies that are strictly necessary for the correct functioning of our Website. These cookies are always
activated and do not require your consent.

We also use cookies that are still reasonably necessary or important, but they are non-essential and, therefore,
require your consent.

For these cookies (i.e., performance, targeting, functional & analytic cookies), we request your consent (by the
“accept all cookies” button in our cookie banner or through our cookies settings or your browser cookie
settings) before placing them on your device.

More specifically, this Website uses the following types of cookies, as listed below:

1. STRICTLY NECESSARY COOKIES

These cookies are necessary for the website to function and cannot be switched off in our systems. They are usually
only set in response to actions made by you which amount to a request for services, such as setting your privacy
preferences, logging in, or filling in forms. You can set your browser to block or alert you about these cookies,
but some parts of the Website may consequently not work. These cookies do not store any personally identifiable
information.

Cookie Storage

Data concerning Website visitors will not be stored for a longer
period than the above-mentioned expiry period for each cookie type. Moreover, no information
coming from our Website will ever be either communicated or disseminated to unspecified
recipients.

How do I change my Cookie Settings

If you agree with MSC’s cookies policy click ACCEPT on
the banner or pop-up that appears when you enter our Website.

Should your cookie preferences change at a later stage, and you wish to withdraw your
consent to any non-essential cookies, you will need to modify your preferences in the
cookies settings or delete, block or disable cookies via your web browser settings.

Please note that disabling or blocking some or all of the categories of cookies will
affect the functionality of our Website and may impact your access and experience with
our Website.

Additionally, your cookies preferences are limited to this Website only and not to other
third-party owned websites. For more information on cookies used by those websites,
please refer to their specific privacy notice or cookies policy.

Seamless EU Customs Declarations

To ensure full compliance with EU customs requirements, a complete Entry Summary Declaration (ENS) in the ICS2 system before goods arrive in or transit through the EU. ICS2 regulations apply to all goods transported via sea, inland waterways, road, and rail—including postal and express shipments—to or through the 27 EU countries, Northern Ireland, Norway, and Switzerland.

Simplify your EU import and transit processes with our EU Customs module and declare goods in compliance with ICS2 regulations directly through myMSC.

New Declaration

Simply enter a Bill of Lading number and all the necessary information to create a declaration. This will generate an Entry Summary Declaration (ENS) and submit it to EU authorities through their Import Control System (ICS2).

Learn more about myMSC

Read the frequently asked question about our eBusiness platform.

How secure is the myMSC portal?

Keeping your data secure is very important to us at MSC. That’s why we are introducing Multi-factor Authentication (MFA) for your myMSC portal.

Also known as two-factor authentication, this extra security verification means that only authorized users can log into myMSC.

It relies on a combination of your username, password, and a code received via your mobile device or phone in order to ensure that only you are able to login to your portal.

Are templates available on the myMSC portal?

An eBooking or shipping instruction (eSI) can be created and submitted instantly on myMSC using templates. This helps you to avoid entering repetitive details and reduces time.

What documents can I view and download?

You can ‘view’ and ‘download’ the following documents directly to your desktop via the myMSC portal.

Arrival notice

An arrival notice can be viewed and downloaded using this screen. Enter the ‘Bill of Lading No.’ in the relevant field and click on ‘Retrieve’

Non-negotiable Bill of Lading

A copy of Non-Negotiable Bill of Lading for your export shipments can be viewed by specifying either the Bill of Lading Number or the Booking Number in the relevant fields and clicking on the ‘Retrieve’ button.

Booking confirmation

A ‘Booking Confirmation’ report can be viewed by specifying the ‘Booking Number’ in the relevant field and clicking on the ‘Retrieve’ button

NVOCC AMS declaration status

The AMS Declaration can be viewed by providing the Bill of Lading Number or the Container Number. This document can only be accessed by the ‘USA’ Customers on approval from the agency.

Why Trust your Agricultural
Shipments to MSC?

Services Designed to Maximize Quality and Shelf-life

Agricultural produce, such as cashews, cocoa, coffee, rice and soy, requires meticulous care throughout its journey to preserve freshness, taste, texture and aroma.

MSC’s green, modern and efficient fleet enables us to safely handle, stow and transport a range of dry and food-grade cargo to keep your perishable produce in perfect condition throughout its entire journey.

Personalized Approach

We work hard to build productive relationships with our customers, taking the time to get to know your unique business and finding flexible solutions to meet your changing needs.

With more than 50 years of experience in shipping agricultural goods, we have built up the expertise needed to deliver the efficient and cost-effective shipping services.

Any Cargo, Any Location

Thanks to MSC’s outstanding global port coverage and connectivity, we can provide local support throughout your cargo’s journey and deliver cost-effective door-to-door solutions. You can also rest assured that our reliable and well-maintained equipment (standard, food-grade or even reefer) will be right there, when and where you need it.

Learn more

Because you Need More Than
Port-to-Port Shipping

We make shipping agricultural produce simple, with expert support at every step of your cargo’s journey.

Why Trust your Cashew Exports to MSC?

Global Network

Our global sea and inland network connects the main exporters
in West and East Africa to importers in Asia and beyond,
offering direct calls and frequent sailings.

Scalable Solutions

Depending on the region, cashew nuts usually have two peak production periods per year, each lasting four to five months.
To meet the demands of this complex annual cycle, MSC provides flexible logistics support that can be scaled up, scaled down
or paused as required.

Learn more

Professional Support

Every single cashew journey we organize for our customers receives the highest level of attention and expertise. Our highly experienced teams take huge pride in supporting each step of the export process, from guiding customers through country-specific procedures,
to helpfully suggesting advice around container and shipment preparation.

“Over the past five decades, we’ve developed solid expertise in transporting cashews.”

Because you Need More Than
Port-to-Port Services

We provide the support your need throughout your cargo’s journey, from farm to store.

countries to the world’s main trade centres. In line with our Company value ‘We believe in equal opportunities’, we are proud to play a role

Did you know?

Brazil is the world’s largest coffee producer, providing a third of the beans consumed worldwide.

Why Ship your Coffee with MSC

From Farm to Cup

The coffee-stuffing process requires a high level of care and precision, as well as the resources, equipment and flexibility to scale up during peak season. MSC works closely with exporters, brokers and importers during the annual coffee season to tailor its inland transportation and handling services, global shipping and shipment preparation services to meet each customer’s exact needs.

Read more

Global Reach for your Coffee Exports

Our presence across 155 countries, including the world’s top coffee producers, Brazil, Vietnam, Colombia, Indonesia and Ethiopia, ensures MSC is well placed to support the thriving coffee trade. We provide depots with dedicated stuffing areas for coffee, container pre-stacking facilities and a bonded area to speed up the customs clearance process.

Exporting Coffee Whether Arabica or Robusta

Every single coffee journey we organize for our customers receives the highest level of attention and expertise. Our highly experienced teams take huge pride in supporting each step of the export process, from guiding customers through appropriate and country-specific procedures to advice around shipment preparation and compliance with local regulations.

Did you know?

Cotton is one of the world’s top five soft commodities.

Why Ship your Cotton with MSC

Customer Support

We take care to find the best possible transportation solution for each customer, leveraging our global sea and inland network. While your cotton is on the move, our dedicated team of local experts are available around the clock to answer questions on how to handle cotton while shipping and provide updates as needed.

Read more

Dedicated Trade Services

Our dedicated trade services from North and South America, Asia and Europe ensure that your cotton will be transported in the best condition. Thanks to our global logistics network and inland transportation services, you can choose from a complete range of shipment options. We will handle the full process from the time the cotton leaves the plantation to its point of export.

Flexible Transport Solutions

As cotton crops depend heavily on temperature and weather conditions, production volumes can fluctuate greatly from season to season. That’s why MSC specializes in scalable logistics solutions that can be adapted according to your production volumes and transactional needs – helping to make sure that none of your crop goes to waste.

We handle the entire process from the moment your cotton leaves the field to the moment it is delivered.

Why Ship your Dried Fruits and Nuts with MSC

Customer Support

Every single journey we organize for our customers’ cargoes receives the highest level of attention and expertise. Our highly-experienced teams take huge pride in supporting each step of the export process, from guiding customers through country-specific procedures, to helpfully advising on shipment preparation.

Global Reach

Our global sea and inland networks connect exporters to the world’s most important trade centres. Through our extensive inland transportation network, we also offer customized door-to-door solutions that can be adapted according to your needs. The result: a flexible and reliable service, all year round.

Services Designed to Maximize Quality and Shelf Life

Dried fruits and nuts require meticulous care to preserve their freshness, taste and texture. MSC’s green, modern, and efficient container fleet enables us to safely handle, stow and transport a range of dry and food-grade cargo to keep your dried fruit and nuts in perfect condition throughout their entire journey.

Why Trust your Rice Exports to MSC

Speak to our Experts for Tailored Support

MSC has decades of experience providing logistics and transport solutions across the different trade lanes for shipping rice. Our dedicated team of experts is always on hand to advise on the best solutions, technologies and standards to meet your needs.

Door-to-door Rice Shipping and Logistics Solutions

Thanks to our wide network, investment in technology and high level of equipment availability at origin, you can benefit from fast and reliable transit times, complementary logistics and transport solutions (road, rail and barge) and access to a knowledgeable customer service team whenever and wherever you need support. Our experts are here to support you on each step of the export process and ensure the transportation of your rice in the best possible conditions.

Read more

The Greenest Fleet at our Planet's Service

We are committed to promoting a sustainable business model that goes far beyond a "business as usual" approach, remaining true to our roots and our core family values, is our commitment.

Because you Need more
than Port-to-Port Shipping

By focusing on delivering best-in-class service to our customers, we are always available to help you with your particular needs and offer you a one-stop-shop solution for your next shipping request.

Navigating India’s Rice Export Industry with MSC

Globally, India is known for exporting several types of rice, with Basmati and Par-boiled being some of the most popular. Basmati rice, renowned for its long grains and aromatic fragrance, is a major export, with high demand in numerous markets.
As such, facilitating successful rice exports from India is vital for businesses involved in the industry. To ensure all exports are as quick and easy as possible, all regulatory compliance and documentation must be handled effectively to avoid costly delays.

Read more

Recipe for Success: 4 Key Ingredients for Transporting Rice

Rice is the world’s most eaten food. Even then its global consumption is forecasted to increase in the marketing year of 2023-2024 to 523.772 million metric tons (MT), a rise from the previous forecast of 523.022 million MT1. With a huge part of the world depending on rice for energy and nutrition, how do you ensure that it is transported safely, efficiently, and sustainably?

Why Ship your Sesame with MSC

Tailored to your Supply Chain

Our sea, road, rail and barge network connects the world’s largest sesame seed-producing regions in Africa and Paraguay with key trade centres in Asia, Europe and North America. We offer customized, end-to-end solutions that can be adapted according to your supply chain requirements.

Kept in Perfect Condition

We understand the importance of preserving the quality of sesame seeds. Thanks to our experience in transporting food and dry cargo, your precious seeds are in safe hands throughout the journey, from the moment you book until the moment they reach the end customer. This includes dedicated warehousing and storage. We use food-grade units to extend the shelf-life of the seeds, so we can transport them over long distances without damaging their appearance, flavour or quality.

End-to-end Support

By combining our extensive multimodal network in Paraguay and Africa with our global port coverage we ensure the very best door-to-door service no matter where your sesame comes from. Our highly skilled teams of local experts guide you through the different shipment options and handle the entire process, from container stuffing to customs paperwork.

Did you know?

In India sesame seeds are considered a symbol of immortality?!

Because you Need more than
Port-to-Port Services

From sourcing to delivery, we provide the logistics support you need for seamless sesame seed shipping. Whether it's specialized handling, customs clearance, or inland transport, we ensure your cargo moves efficiently every step of the way.

Experts in Transporting all Kinds of Sugar Around the World

Whether granulated, course or brown, we consume nearly 180 million metric tonnes of sugar in the world every year. But once it was a luxury. Refined sugar was extremely rare and often called ‘white gold’. Not any more! Thanks to its use as a sweetener, flavour enhancer and a source of energy, sugar has become a staple ingredient in what we eat and drink every day.

The global demand for sugar has never been greater. Sugar products, like molasses and sugar cane, require meticulous care on their journey through the supply chain in order to preserve freshness and taste. MSC is an experienced specialist sugar transporter with local experts in the major sugar producing territories.

We are present in 155 countries, including the world’s leading sugar producers. MSC’s outstanding global port coverage and connectivity means that we provide local support throughout your sugar’s entire journey to nearly any destination around the world. Our team of logistics experts will handle all your needs and we take great pride in our ability to help you every step of the way.

Keeping your Sugar Safe on its Journey

Our top-quality containers can be used to transport sugar in bulk and our thermal liners will help to keep it dry and safe from temperature disruptions during transit. If you are transporting sugar molasses, our Flexi-bags are also a safe, cost-effective and eco-friendly alternative to keep your liquid cargo in perfect condition.

Supporting Sugar Shipments Every Step of the Way

MSC offers tailor-made transport solutions across road, river, and sea to ensure the very best door-to-door service to meet your requirements. If there are lumps and bumps in the road to the sugar’s final destination, we are on hand with door-to-door support and expert advice.

FAQs about Sugar

How Sugar Should be Shipped?

There are specialist measures for shipping sugar, which is a product highly sensitive to contamination. Sugar needs to be neither too dry or too wet during transportation.

Containers should be maintained at a relative humidity level of 80-85% . If sugar of any type starts to lose moisture caking can take place. Damaged sugar can be saved if refined locally. White sugar is mainly transported as breakbulk cargo in bags of woven natural material or woven plastic bags with a plastic inner bag impermeable to water.

Share
Link copied!

Which countries produce the most sugar?

India, China, Brazil, Thailand and the US are the main sugar producing countries.

Share
Link copied!

How long does it take to grow sugar?

It can take 12-18 months for sugar cane to mature fully in the field before it can be harvested.

Share
Link copied!

What are sugar molasses?

In the 16th century, the Spanish introduced sugar cane to America. Some inhabitants of the region discovered that after extracting the sugar from the canes, a thick liquid remained: the molasses. Today molasses is used to prepare endless delicious dishes, desserts and drinks.

Why Trust your Car Parts Shipments to MSC?

Outstanding Port Coverage

At MSC, we balance our dedication to connecting the world with respecting and caring for our planet. With weekly efficient ocean services connecting all corners of the world, you can enjoy flexibility while knowing your shipments are as sustainable as possible.

Dedicated Customer Support

Working to the highest industry standards, requires deep knowledge of the transportation and logistical requirements auto parts shipping has.

Our teams of experts with years of experience in shipping all kinds of car parts will ensure you have everything you need to ship your time-sensitive commodities and ensure a seamless supply chain.

Wide Range of Equipment and Transport Methods

From the warehouse to the production line fast and safely. Take advantage of our full portfolio of solutions and create the dedicated service your business needs with the help of an expert. You can not only rely on our fast and reliable transit times but also enjoy real time tracking among other digital solutions.

Because you Need more than
Port-to-Port Services

Your all-in-one solution for your auto parts shipping needs. From cylinder blocks and pistons to suspensions and mirrors, we make shipping car parts easy for you. Offering top level inland solutions and warehousing facilities combined with cargo cover solutions, we elevate your shipping experience. Create a tailor-made service using our door-to-door solutions with the help of our experts and keep your supply chain running like clockwork.

What Factors can Impact Automotive Shipping?

As the automotive supply chain is complicated, it’s crucial to partner with a transportation and logistics company that understands the industry and its challenges. At MSC, our specialized automotive team has years of industry experience, enabling them to identify and help you overcome any challenges that may impact your cargo shipment. These include:

Environmental responsibility.

Seasonality.

Time-sensitive delivery requirements.

Vehicle size and weight.

Utilizing a wide range of technology to create a smooth supply chain.

Overview

how it works

Why Trust your Car Shipments to MSC?

Wider Port Coverage

For your new car's delivery, our fleet of vessels ensures you can reach smaller, more local ports anywhere in the world. Not only does this allow you to expand your customer base but also means you can enjoy a greater choice of delivery points. This, combined with less unnecessary inland transport, and fewer transshipments helps make your overall supply chain faster and more efficient.

Faster and more Reliable Transit

Our capacity and global network allows us to offer you the widest routes selection and most frequent ocean services available for your new car transportation needs. As a business, you’ll benefit from weekly sailings, helping to provide quicker transit times and ensuring timely delivery to your customers.

Premium Level of Care

When it comes to considering the ‘best way to move a car’, we meticulously handle every shipment, providing thorough car inspections, precise loading and lashing of vehicles and careful unloading.

To ensure stability and protect your valuable new car from vibrations during transit, each vehicle is securely fastened inside our containers using advanced lashing techniques. It’s this attention to detail that helps significantly reduce the risk of scratches and accidents and means that your vehicles are transported with the highest level of precision and care.

Experience and Expertise

All our new car shipping processes are designed around your car production timetables and handling specifications to provide your business with the tailor-made solutions you need. Beyond this, you’ll be working with a global network of dedicated experts who are with you at every step. From car collection at origin to final delivery at destination, we will work with you to optimize your new car transportation supply chain so you can focus on delivering the very best to your customers.

Get into the Fast Lane with MSC

At MSC we combine our unmatched commitment to the safe and reliable delivery of automotive shipping with 50 years of experience and expertise (and an excellent damage record) to ensure your new car shipping supply chain is as smooth as possible. We are committed to keeping you on the road to success and miles ahead of your competition.

Leave your competition in the rearview mirror in MSC. With decades of experience and expertise, our automotive shipping specialists can steer you toward success. Contact us today to find out more.

50 years of car shipping
experience

Widest shipping routes available

Weekly sailings, worldwide

Greater choice of delivery points

How Shipping New Cars with MSC Works

We leverage our expertise in container logistics to offer reliable and efficient car transportation solutions for automotive customers. Our strict quality protocols for containerized car transport ensure the utmost care and precision in vehicle transportation, offering Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) unparalleled peace of mind.

In loading, each new car is securely fastened using advanced lashings which ensure stability and shield your cargo from vibrations during handling. Containers protect cars from external elements such as rain, hail, saltwater, and sand, while our meticulous approach significantly reduces the risk of scratches and accidents. With the highest level of care, our experts ensure that your valuable assets travel securely to their destination and arrive in flawless condition.

Results

Load more

Car Prep and Inspections

As soon as your car shipment arrives at the MSC Depot or storage space, a comprehensive survey is performed to ensure the vehicles are prepped for stuffing.

Stuffing, Lashing and Loading

Following the inspection, vehicles are being securely stuffed and lashed in the container with extreme care and then transported to the terminal to be loaded on the vessel.

Delivery and Collection

Upon vessel arrival, the container will be transported to the MSC Depot where the cars will be meticulously unlashed and destuffed. To ensure your car shipment is ready to be collected a thorough survey will be conducted.

Greater Flexibility For Your
Used Car Supply Chain

Containerized shipping is a flexible, safe, and convenient choice when considering how to transport a used car. Not only does it protect your vehicles from external damage during transit but also enables you to reach more ports and inland destinations.

Alongside our weekly transport schedules, we provide tailored shipping solutions for used car exporters and importers, connecting you with customers all over the world. Unlike other used car transport services, which are limited to deep-water ports and infrequent schedules, our vessels sail weekly to a wide network of ports – including smaller, more local destinations.

Whether you are exporting vehicles to West Africa, the Middle East or other international markets, moving used vehicles efficiently requires balancing transit times, cargo protection, destination coverage and vessel availability. MSC's containerized transportation solutions help exporters, traders and freight forwarders move vehicles with greater control, access more markets and protect vehicle value throughout the journey.

A greater choice of delivery points

Fast and reliable transit times

Less inland transport and fewer transshipments

Competitive rates with no hidden service fees

Connecting Every Corner of the World for your Used Cars Exports or Imports

Enhance your automotive logistics with our fast and reliable shipping solutions, designed to keep your business moving. You’ll have access to a network of 300 global routes that connect more than 500 ports of call, plus the advantage of our fleet of 1,000 vessels and a worldwide network of car shipping experts helping you every step of the way.

Global Reach and Flexibility for your Used Car Logistics

With the world’s widest shipping network, we can offer you unmatched global reach, connecting your business to over 520 ports across 155 countries. Trust our 50+ years of experience delivering reliable, efficient solutions to enhance your approach to second hand car shipping.

Flexible, Scalable and with Competitive Rates

Enjoy unmatched convenience and flexibility with weekly departures and access to a vast network of ports and inland destinations. In addition, our scalable solutions can be adapted to your unique requirements to ensure seamless used car transportation for your business.

For additional peace of mind and efficiency, leverage on our competitive rates and our smart containers and advanced tracking systems for real-time monitoring.

Enabling Sustainable Supply Chains

Compared to other forms of transport, shipping used cars in containers can help to cut road congestion, air pollution, and overall environmental impact. By carrying more vehicles in a single journey, using more direct routes, and accessing smaller, more local ports you’ll not only be expanding your business but doing it in a more sustainable way.

Learn more about our unique approach to sustainability.

How we Integrate with your Supply Chain

1. Container delivery

We deliver the empty containers to you ready to be loaded with your used cars.

2. Vehicle preparation & loading

You handle vehicle preparation and loading, before returning the filled containers to MSC for shipping.

3. Shipping

We ensure efficient transportation to ports and inland locations worldwide.

4. Unloading

You unload the vehicles at your chosen destination.

Everything you Need to
Ship Used Cars

Ship your cars your way. Our adaptable approach allows you to retain control over your used car shipping process while still benefiting from our extensive transportation network. Our end-to-end solutions ensure a seamless shipping experience with faster market speed, stabilized costs, and compliance with used car transport regulations.

Count on us for your Chemical & Petrochemical Shipments

Plastics, fertilizers, medical equipment, and detergents are just some of the products that rely on petrochemical shipments. However, shipping both chemicals and petrochemicals internationally can be a complex process due to the different safety, regulatory, and logistical considerations involved.

Different countries have different regulatory requirements for the import and export of chemicals. Equally many chemicals and petrochemicals are classified as hazardous materials. This means that some commodities cannot be imported into certain countries, while others can be imported only after an extensive amount of due diligence checks.

At MSC, we have decades of experience in the transportation of petrochemicals and other hazardous materials. This means we can provide customers with careful, precise, and robust processes that ensure any hazardous materials are shipped safely and in compliance with relevant regulations. Beyond this, our global team is also on hand to deal with any contingency wherever you are shipping around the globe.

Why Trust your Petrochemical Shipments to MSC?

Experts in Petrochemical Shipping

One advantage of partnering with MSC for your chemical or petrochemical shipments is our specialist chemical support department. Our global team will work with you to safeguard your containerized chemical cargoes from pick up to delivery.

We are experts in the various HS codes used to classify chemical shipments and can provide guidance on how to treat your petrochemical cargo on an individual basis. Our proficiency means we ensure all dangerous and potentially hazardous cargo is stowed and shipped in compliance with the necessary legal and safety requirements.

Peace of Mind for Hazardous Goods Transportation

Beyond the specific chemical and petrochemical shipping regulations, transporting hazardous goods requires well planned processes to avoid delays to your overall supply chain.

No matter where you are in the world, for bulk chemical shipping, you can trust that MSC will always meet the highest national and international environmental and safety standards. We ship across hundreds of ocean routes, and with our added cargo cover solutions, we’re committed to simplifying the entire chemical shipping process for our clients.

Safeguarding your Petrochemical Cargo

Ensuring that your cargo is being handled carefully is crucial throughout the petrochemical shipping process. Because of all the different forms of petrochemicals, there are numerous shipping container options for each individual shipment. At MSC, we have a variety of container types available and will work with you to help you decide on the right size for your shipment.

Even better, our off-dock container depots and repair facilities ensure container quality and availability. Designed to help you reduce unnecessary costs and protect your chemical cargo during transportation.

Because you Need more than
Port-to-Port Shipping

Chemical or petrochemical shipments require careful handling and precision. Our range of equipment, combined with our expertise and experience in all labelling and documentation requirements ensures we can provide the best support for our customers.

You will also have access to MSC’s dedicated customer support team who are on hand to assist at loading points, connectivity at transshipment hubs, and to ensure timely discharge and delivery. All these services are in place to help you mitigate any challenges or concerns that come with shipping chemicals internationally. Contact us today to explore how MSC’s chemical shipping solutions could be beneficial for your business.

Chemical and Petrochemical Shipment FAQs

Read our expert’s answers to commonly asked questions relating to shipping hazardous materials like chemicals and petrochemicals.

Which are some Common Chemical and Petrochemical Shipping Challenges

Shipping hazardous materials like petrochemicals also requires strict adherence to international regulations such as the United Nations Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods (UNRTDG). Your shipping partner should be well acquainted with all the different rules and regulations relating to your petrochemical shipment and can help you navigate them successfully.

Various safety precautions must also be followed when shipping chemicals to ensure the safety of both the shipment and the individuals involved in transportation. As part of this, all chemicals and petrochemical shipments must be packaged properly and appropriately labelled to ensure a smooth transit and customs clearance process.

Share
Link copied!

What are the Environmental Considerations in Chemical and Petrochemical Shipping?

Due to their hazardous nature, chemical and petrochemical shipping may come with several environmental considerations. These include:

Potential chemical spills or leaks causing water contamination

Chemical stability

Greenhouse gas emissions

Local regulations depending on the country of import and export

At MSC, our state-of-the-art-container-fleet, combined with industry experience means we are well placed to help you manage any environmental considerations throughout your chemical transportation process.

Share
Link copied!

How to Ship Petrochemicals and Plastics Internationally?

Because of the variety of forms petrochemicals come in (pellets, beads, flakes, sheets, or emulsions), petrochemicals can be shipped internationally using different container types. The most shipped petrochemicals by MSC are Polymers of Ethylene (pellets), Polymers of Propylene (pellets or flakes), and Poly Acetals (various forms), all of which are the primary forms of plastics used in everyday life.

Petrochemical shipping at MSC is not just limited to primary products. Once the various manufacturing and wholesale companies have created the petrochemical products, they can then be processed into plastic commodities such as fibres, plastic tubes, pipes, hoses, plastic sheets, and plastic packaging. Once this manufacturing process is complete, we are then able to step in again and facilitate the international export of the finished plastic products. Equally, for businesses looking to ship scrap or waste plastic products internationally, we have the services to help make this process as seamless as possible.

Share
Link copied!

How do you Handle Hazardous Chemicals and Petrochemicals during Shipping?

The first step is to determine whether your cargo is classified as a hazardous good, and if so, what class it falls under. This determines which procedures, labelling, and packaging are required. It also impacts whether your cargo can be shipped via air or ground.

Working with a transportation partner like MSC who has experience in shipping chemicals can help you ensure you have all the correct packaging and paperwork needed to ship your chemical cargo quickly and easily.

Share
Link copied!

What are the Safety Regulations and Precautions for Shipping Chemicals and Petrochemicals?

There are numerous safety regulations and standards that must be followed throughout all non-bulk and bulk chemical shipping. These can vary depending on the type of the cargo being shipped, but some regulations that you should be aware of include:

The Title 49 Code of Federal Regulations controls

This covers the description of hazardous materials by class. It also covers the number of hazardous materials permitted in each package, the labelling and packaging of hazardous materials, and the additional documentation required for import and export.

IMDG (International Maritime Dangerous Goods Code) Code

This code is designed to regulate the safe shipping of hazardous goods by sea for international shipping. It is also used to ensure that the individuals involved in handling chemical shipments and the marine environment are protected.

Share
Link copied!

What Types of Chemicals and Petrochemicals can be Shipped?

A wide range of chemicals and petrochemicals can be shipped, including:

Chemicals:

3905 –PVA

3906 – Acrylic Polymers

3911 – Petroleum Resins

3913 – Natural Polymers

Petrochemicals shared with plastics:

3901 –Polymers of ethylene

3902 – Polymers of Propylene

3903 – Polymers of styrene

3904 – PVC

3907 – Polyacetals

3908 – Polyamides

3909 – Amino Resins

3910 – Silicones

3912 – Cellulose

3916 – Monofilaments of Plastic

3921 – Plates, sheets, clingfilm or plastic strips

Shipping your Food and Beverages Cargo with MSC

Meat, seafood, fruit, vegetables and beverages, such as coffee, represent some of the world's most popular commodities. Frequently shipped fresh or in frozen form, for businesses involved in shipping this type of cargo there can be some significant challenges, including maintaining quality, temperature, freshness, or managing seasonal fluctuations.

Thanks to decades of experience shipping beverages and different types of food, our team at MSC has an expansive knowledge of the requirements and challenges of each sector.

Whether you’re shipping frozen food, fresh fruit, or liquid cargo, by partnering with MSC for your international food and beverage exports and imports you’ll be working with a global shipping company with the scale to provide bespoke solutions to meet the needs of your specific cargo.

Shipping Beverages and Food: MSC’s Key Offerings

At MSC we have wealth of experience shipping numerous types of freight around the world. This, combined with our range of shipping solutions, including dry, reefer, and liquid cargo allows us to offer you bespoke services designed to meet the needs of your business.

A Reputation for Integrity

From fresh fruit and fine wines to frozen meat and fish, many of the world’s most celebrated brands trust MSC to fulfil their shipping and logistics needs.

Our scale, resources and flexible approach have enabled us to meet the needs of growers, producers, wholesalers and retailers from all over the world.

Customer Service Tailored to your Needs

Our global network of offices around the world work closely with trade specialists who provide expert advice at a local level. This means we can provide you with rapid and transparent advice as well as offering an unrivalled tailor-made approach for your food and beverages cargo.

Door-to-door Reefer Shipping Services

We understand that the best way to ship cold food is by using state of the art reefer technology and door-to-door transportation solutions. Based on your specific needs, we create tailor-made solutions that combine our strong road, rail, and barge network with our weekly and regular shipping services, helping to reduce food loss and enhance quality food supply.

Learn more

Real-Time Tracking of Shipments and Loads

Managing your fresh, frozen, food or beverage shipments requires tracking and monitoring throughout transportation. At MSC our digital solutions enable you to monitor your cargo wherever it is in the world, offering you both peace of mind and the opportunity to react quickly in the event of any delays or bottle necks.

Best Practices and more for your Food Transportation and Logistics

Thanks to decades of experience servicing the food and beverage industries, at MSC we have the expertise to offer the very best services when it comes to shipping in this diverse industry.

Considerations when Shipping Food and Beverages

There are several factors that should be considered when shipping beverages, frozen food, and fresh goods. These include:

Ensuring all your cargo is properly packaged ahead of shipping.

Maintaining the correct temperature throughout transportation.

Adherence to different shipping regulations and compliance standards.

Tracking and monitoring your cargo.

Considerations when Shipping Food and Beverages

There are several factors that should be considered when shipping beverages, frozen food, and fresh goods. These include:

Ensuring all your cargo is properly packaged ahead of shipping.

Maintaining the correct temperature throughout transportation.

Adherence to different shipping regulations and compliance standards.

Tracking and monitoring your cargo.

Maximizing the shelf lives of different products is also crucial, particularly when shipping frozen food as this needs to arrive at its final location without being defrosted to prevent spoilage. Ensuring that your overall supply chain is running as smoothly as possible is a vital part of maintaining the quality and maximizing the shelf life of your fresh and frozen cargo. Enhancing your supply chain can be done in the following ways:

Increasing the efficiency of your loading and offloading times.

Selecting carriers that adhere to all food-grade transportation standards.

We understand that flexibility and scale are crucial for shipping cold food, beverages or fresh food successfully. By partnering with our team of experts when shipping these commodities, you’ll be working with a shipping company with the scale and experience to offer you the carrying capacity your business needs.

Tips for Shipping Food Internationally

Utilize Real-Time Communication Tools and Platforms

Utilizing Transport Management Systems (TMS) and online tracking tools with real-time communication systems allows for automated tracking and scheduling of door-to-door shipments. Not only can this help to reduce labour costs, but also enables better logistics and inventory planning throughout your supply chain.

Specialized Equipment Availability

Using specialized food shipping containers, whether it be dry, liquid, or reefer is vital to preserve the quality of your cargo. Working with a shipping company that can ensure you have access to the specific equipment you need for your shipment is highly important for planning your overall supply chain and preventing both wastage and loss of revenue.

Because you Need more than
Port-to-Port Services

Whether you’re shipping cold food, beverages, or fresh fruits and vegetables our teams of local experts have the experience and knowledge to provide the best shipping solution for your business. We will work closely with you and your team to ensure that your cold chain logistics are as efficient as possible from pick-up to delivery.

Beyond our global port coverage, industry-specific equipment availability, and reliable scheduling, other benefits to shipping with MSC include:

Door-to-door Transport Solutions

You can reach any corner of the world with MSC’s ocean and intermodal (road, rail and barge) solutions. Especially for beverage customers, we can also offer:

Special security measures to transport glass bottles

Keeping Drinks Fresh with New Technologies

MSC’s world-leading reefer fleet is managed by our dedicated team of more than 1,000 reefer experts. Using the latest temperature-control and dehumidification technology, we can make sure that chilled drinks arrive in perfect condition – even after days or weeks on the move.

We’re mindful of product shelf-life and the relentless pace of supplying consumer markets.

Why Ship your Dairy Products with MSC

Milk and Cream

The global demand for dairy makes it one of the world’s most important perishable products. MSC is a trusted partner for many worldwide dairy suppliers, and understands the importance of transporting liquid milk and cream in perfect condition, to any destination. Our reefer containers ensure food integrity for all kinds of milk and cream products.

Butter

Butter can be shipped as frozen or chilled, depending on customer requirements. This delicate dairy commodity requires particular temperature, humidity and ventilation equipment. Our cutting-edge reefer containers keep your butter cargo at optimum conditions during transit, ensuring the best results from door to door.

Door-to-door Reefer Solutions

Chilled and frozen dairy products are in safe hands with MSC. We understand the importance of preserving the condition of our customers’ perishable cargo, with door-to-door reefer solutions. Our cold-chain logistics includes cold storage warehousing, road, rail and barge networks, ensuring the quality of your dairy produce from the moment it is loaded to its delivery point.

Our local experts will support and guide you through the shipping process. We ensure fast and secure transport solutions to any destination.

Why Ship your Meat with MSC

Experts in Cold Chain Logistics

As a perishable commodity, our dedicated team of 1,000+ reefer experts understands that your meat cargo requires the utmost care during shipping to ensure it arrives in perfect condition. No matter where in the world your shipment is heading, at MSC we offer the very best support for our customers.

Learn more

Seamless Connections

Part of choosing the best shipping services for your needs means working with a company that can offer you fast, safe, and cost-effective deliveries anywhere in the world. Not only do we use the latest reefer technology to ensure that meat products remain in optimal condition, but our intermodal transport solutions combine our ocean services with our road, rail, and barge network to guarantee a seamless journey for your meat cargo.

Focused on Sustainability

By combining our energy-efficient fleet with our extensive inland network, MSC’s transportation solutions can help to reduce your supply chain’s carbon footprint. Our modern and reliable reefer containers also help to keep meat fresh for longer and minimize food waste.

Because you Need more than
Port-to-port Shipping

Looking for extra storage, inland transportation or support with customs paperwork? We've got you covered.

From pre-trip inspections to preparing containers to food-grade specifications and facilitating production planning, our team will be on hand to ensure your supply chain operations are as smooth as possible.

FAQs About Shipping Meat Products

Why is temperature control important for meat shipping?

In order to minimize the opportunity for the growth of spoilage or food poisoning organisms that could irreversibly damage your cargo, it’s crucial that the correct temperatures are maintained. Throughout shipping, meat and poultry products must be kept at the right temperatures in order to prevent the growth of bacteria.

At MSC we have dedicated cold storage solutions to ensure that the quality of your products is maintained throughout your supply chain. We also ensure full traceability so you can rest assured that your meat and poultry cargo is being stored safely, and to the highest standards.

Check with your local agent for availability.

Share
Link copied!

What are the key steps to shipping meat internationally?

In the last 30 years, meat production has increased by around 110% due to a rise in consumer demand and developing economies. With an additional 8% growth predicted in the next 10 years, it’s more important than ever for transportation companies like MSC to facilitate fast supply chain operation and management. When it comes to shipping meat internationally, we follow several key steps, including:

Utilizing cutting-edge technology including our reefer fleets to ensure your meat cargo arrives at its final destination fresh and unspoiled.

Pre-trip inspections of our containers to confirm the correct functioning of the cooling unit and temperature control.

Use food-graded containers and effective insulation systems to protect your cargo.

Count on us for your Fish and Seafood Shipments

Fish and seafood are among the most perishable products in global trade, and their strict conserving and transporting conditions can place significant pressure on supply chains. Managing these challenges requires a shipping partner with the expertise and flexibility to ensure successful seafood logistics.

With weekly services worldwide and the ability to adapt to seasonal fluctuations, we support your fish shipping needs with confidence and efficiency. Speak with our specialists and explore our full portfolio of ocean and intermodal solutions for your chilled and frozen seafood shipments.

reefer technology

Pre-trip inspection

How to ship frozen fish and seafood?

Successful fish shipping begins with proper preparation. When transporting frozen fish or seafood, it’s essential to pack boxes tightly to create a solid block, while leaving space between the cargo and the container walls. This ensures consistent air circulation and temperature control throughout the journey, helping maintain product quality.

You Have the Seafood, we Have the Expertise

Why Trust your Tea Shipments to MSC?

A Global Tea Service

We ensure the trade in importing and exporting tea continues to thrive. MSC has a presence in 155 countries, including the world’s leading tea producers. We have dedicated trade services connecting the main exporting countries with the major tea market hubs worldwide.

MSC offer customers good availability of food grade containers, dedicated container depots and intermodal solutions, as well as staff trained in the details of tea transportation.

From Fields to Cup

To prepare different types of tea for transportation with the highest level of care, our expert teams work closely with tea exporters, brokers and importers. From tailor-made inland solutions to tea-stuffing and handling services, here at MSC we offer the resources, equipment and flexibility required by professionals in the global tea supply chain.

With a particular focus on the peak season of April, May and June, MSC leads the way in making the tea supply chain run as smoothly as possible.

Supporting Tea Supply Every Step of the Way

Every tea shipment is different, and its transportation needs attention and expertise of the highest level. We’ve also got your multimodal transport and handling needs of tea shipping covered, from pick-up to delivery.

Our dedicated teams offer appropriate and country-specific procedures. We provide advice around shipment preparation and compliance with local regulations. If you have any questions about the cargo services we offer for shipping tea, please do not hesitate to get in touch.

Taking the Risk out of Tea Transportation

Shipping tea is a delicate business. The raw products needs to be harvested at the right time during the season. Too late and tea runs the risk of degrading during transportation. In the right storage conditions tea can last for 18 months, but particular care needs to be taken at every step of the tea export process to protect the goods. Tea can spoil for any number of reasons – moisture ingress, odours, shrinkage, inadequate ventilation, pest infestation or poor cooperage. At MSC we ensure that checks are carried out at every step of the tea’s journey.

Ensuring Perfect Conditions

Tea needs optimum conditions as it moves between locations around the world. That is why we carry tea in food-grade dry containers with the correct level of regulated ventilation. We ensure that there are no risks from cross-contamination from damp flooring, and that the tea is packaged correctly at all times. Aluminium linings in the chests or multiwall paper sacks should be in contact with the tea. If you have any questions about the cargo services we offer for shipping tea, please do not hesitate to get in touch.

FAQs about Shipping Tea

Which countries produce the most tea?

India, Kenya and Sri Lanka are the main producing countries of tea and account for 75% of global tea production.

How soon after it is harvested should tea be shipped?

In general, tea can be shipped 3-4 weeks after it is harvested, but you can wait up to 2½ months before shipping tea, if it is stored correctly.

What are the best ways for packing tea for shipping?

It is recommended that tea leaves be packed in plywood chests lined with aluminium foil, polypropylene or jute sacks lined with polyethylene, or multiwall paper sacks lined with aluminium foil.

Why Trust your Fruit Shipments to MSC?

Temperature Control & Dehumidification - Reefer Technology

Whether you’re shipping apples or avocados, our world-leading reefer fleet is equipped with the technology you need to keep your fruit in perfect condition. We use the Cold Treatment process as a chemical-free way to disinfect your fruit and protect it from pests. Our containers also feature Controlled Atmosphere (CA) technologies to extend shelf life.

Learn more

Door-to-door Solutions

MSC’s expert teams are specially trained to deliver flexible and cost-effective door-to-door transport solutions across our worldwide sea and inland network. Using our modern, efficient fleet, our fast and reliable connections help to bring quality food around the world, reduce food loss and improve market access for producers.

Learn more

Flexibility & Scalability

We understand that your production volumes – and logistical needs – can fluctuate depending on the season, weather conditions and other factors. We also know that different fruits have different needs. That’s why MSC specializes in creating scalable, tailor-made solutions to fit each customer’s unique supply chain, ensuring a service you can rely on all year round.

MSC has become one of the leading carriers of New Zealand apples thanks to our extensive network and global port coverage. MSC vessels call at every key destination for the New Zealand apple export market, providing apple growers with a truly worldwide reach.
