Special customs regulations

Special conditions

For all imports to Suriname, all bills of lading must clearly state the full name, local address and local contact number either as notify party or consignee. Failure to do so may result in all port storage/line demurrage being for the account of the port of loading. Effective Friday June 23, 2017, the following measure shall apply, as determined by the Minister of Finance, G. Hoefdraad, regarding the release of containers:

Each container leaving the harbor shall be subjected to a full inspection.

Inspection may include the services of Customs Investigation and Excise Unit.

Release of containers shall occur only from Monday through Friday between 07:00 and 15:00 hrs.

Once released, the container(s) shall have to leave the harbor before 15:00 hrs.

Release of urgent cargo during the weekend shall require written permission from the acting head of duty.

Detention, Demurrage, Per Diem and Storage Charges

What is Detention?

Detention is the charge applicable after the free time expires, for the use of the carrier’s full container inside the marine terminal or container yard. This charge can also apply while the container is undergoing Local customs inspections, or while the cargo inside the container is being reworked for safety reasons.

What is Demurrage?

Demurrage is the charge applicable after the free time expires, inside or outside of the terminal.

What is Per Diem?

Per Diem (meaning “per day”) is the demurrage charge applicable, after the free time expires, for the use of the carrier’s container (full or empty) inside or outside the marine terminal.

What are Storage Charges?

A storage charge is applicable after the free time expires, for containers left inside the terminal. These charges are paid by the customer directly to the terminal operator.

Detention and Demurrage: Updated Payment Policy
MSC Trinidad and Tobago accepts payment via Direct Deposit, wire transfer or physical deposits done by customers at our local commercial bank.

SOLAS VGM Information for Trinidad and Tobago

What is VGM?

Verified Gross Mass or VGM refers to the exact, verified weight of a packed container. For safety reasons, vessel operators can only load a container if its weight has been verified.

In line with SOLAS (Safety of Lives at Sea) regulations, all marine terminals in Trinidad and Tobago are now allowed to use their certified scales to record Verified Gross Mass (VGM) of shipments.

What do I need to include in my VGM Instructions?

You must include the following on all VGM instructions:

Booking or Bill of Lading (BL) number

Container number

VGM + weight measurement unit (lbs. or kgs.)

Name of Responsible Party (Shipper)

Digital signature of the authorized signatory in all CAPITAL LETTERS.

How can I submit my VGM Instructions?

via www.myMSC.com

Guidelines for submitting your VGM Instructions

MSC prefers to receive a Shipper-Verified Gross Mass (VGM) before cargo is delivered. This helps to avoid any unexpected weighing charges being levied against the cargo at the Trinidad Port of Loading, which will be billed to the Shipper of Record.

Any Shipper of Record-signed VGM will override any VGM derived at or by the terminal.

For truck delivery, the ultimate deadline for VGM submission will be 12:00 noon local time on the day of the specified cargo cut-off.

There are currently no Trinidad terminals with a “NO VGM – No GATE” policy.

MSC Administrative Fees and Costs

Manual VGM Submission Fee (applies to email, fax, and inclusion on standard shipping instructions): USD25.00 per container.

Late VGM Submission Fee: USD25.00 per container.

VGM Misdeclaration Fee: USD300.00 per misdeclaration, per container.

Questions about VGM?

Contact our Trinidad & Tobago team TT368-exports@msc.com.

SOLAS VGM information for the USA

SOLAS VGM INFORMATION USA

A regulation for a safer supply chain

VGM Receiving Policy

Accepting the U.S. Coast Guard’s declared equivalency, whereas they have confirmed that the existing terminal weighing practice for on-dock scales in the United States is compliant with SOLAS regulation, all U.S. marine terminals are now allowed to use their certified scales to record the VGM.

MSC accepts the “Terminal Weighing Approach” to derive a compliant VGM for loading.

What to include in your VGM instructions

The following items are mandatory and must be on all VGM instructions:

Booking or Bill of Lading number

Container number

VGM + weight measurement unit (lbs. or kgs.)

Responsible party name

Digital signature of the authorized signatory in all CAPITAL LETTERS.

How to submit your VGM instructions

myMSC (Free of charge)

EDI (via INTTRA; GT NEXUS; Cargo Smart)

Manually (via INTTRA; GT NEXUS; Cargo Smart)

Submit via email to: USA-export.customerservice@msc.com with confirmation of Administrative Fee, applicable per Bill of Lading and Manual VGM Fee, applicable per container per MSC published tariff rules.

Policy questions should be directed to the toll-free number: +1 800 222 3367

Deadlines for sending your VGM instructions

We encourage customers to submit their Shipper-Verified Gross Mass (VGM) before cargo is delivered to avoid any unexpected weighing charges being levied against the cargo at the US port of load, which will be billed to the shipper of record.

Currently, there are no US terminals with a “NO VGM – No GATE” policy. All “rail shipments” must have the VGM submitted within 24 hours of the container gating in at the origin rail ramp, to avoid any extra fees levied by the terminal for weighing services. Late gates will only be considered for approval when a VGM is submitted by the shipper of record before noon, local time, the day of the cargo cut-off.

MSC Admin Fees and costs

***Please note that in the event of any conflict between the fee conditions listed herein and those found in the applicable MSC tariff, the rates and conditions in the tariff shall apply***

Manual VGM Submission Fee (applies to email and fax): applicable per container; Administrative Fee per Bill of Lading per published MSC tariff rules

Late VGM Submission Fee: applicable per container; Administrative Fee per Bill of Lading per published MSC tariff rules

VGM Mis-declaration Fee: applicable per mis declaration, per container, per MSC tariff rules

Use of ISO 17712 Compliant Seals

MSC Mediterranean Shipping Company would like to remind our supply chain partners of our policy regarding the mandatory use of International Standardization Organization (ISO) 17712 compliant High Security Seals (HSS) on all full containers for international transport by MSC.

BACKGROUND: Under the Customs Trade Partnership Against Terrorism (CTPAT) full Instruments of International Traffic (i.e. shipping containers) must have high security seals properly affixed at the point of stuffing to prevent pilferage, the introduction of terrorist devices, and other contraband from entering the global supply chain.

MSC POLICY: It is MSC’s policy that an ISO 17712 compliant seal should be applied at all times during the transport under MSC’s custody and that all the letters and digits of the HSS number shall be documented properly and accurately on the Shipping Instructions, Bill of Lading, Manifest, or any other documentation related to the movement of the cargo. All shipments transported by MSC that are capable of being sealed must be secured immediately after loading/stuffing/packing by the responsible party (i.e. the shipper or packer acting on the shipper’s behalf) with a high security seal that meets or exceeds the most current ISO 17712 standard for high security seals and emphasized on MSC’s contract of carriage (Bill of Lading) which states under section 11.3:

The Merchant is responsible for the packing and sealing of all merchant-packed containers and, if a merchant-packed container is delivered by the carrier with an original seal as affixed by the merchant or customs or security control intact, or the carrier can establish bona fide circumstances in which the original seal was replaced, the carrier shall not be liable for any shortage of goods ascertained upon delivery.

As a best practice, it is recommended shippers take clear photographs of the following when preparing shipments for transit:

1. Their shipments inside the container before closing the doors.

2. The container door closed, with the container number clearly visible.

3. A legible close-up of the seal and the seal number before affixing it to the container; and lastly,

4. The high security seal properly affixed to the inner right door locking rod latch or lower right locking rod cam.

FAQ

How do I request a new rate?

For standard dry containers and most reefer shipments, use the Instant Quote feature in myMSC. For Hazardous, Out of Gauge (OOG), and Shipper-Owned Containers (SOC), use the Request Tariff Rates feature available in myMSC.

What is the standard free time at destination?

Free time and destination-specific requirements are available on MSC Local Information pages. Select the destination country to view applicable requirements and free time information. For additional assistance, contact USA-Export.CustomerService@msc.com.

How can I book a shipment, access my booking confirmation, or track cargo?

Use myMSC to create bookings, access booking confirmations, and track cargo using a container, booking, or bill of lading number. Cargo tracking is also available on MSC.com.

Who do I contact if the consignee is having issues with destination free time?

Please reference the contracted free time in your inquiry and send requests to USA-Export.RateDisputes@msc.com.

Where do I send disputes related to charges on my export freight invoice?

For dry general cargo, email disputes to USA-Export.RateDisputes@msc.com

Import Security Filing (ISF)

Get easy access to Bill of Lading Number information to complete ISF filings with US Customs.

Preliminary ISF booking information:

Bill of Lading

Containers

The information provided is to allow our Customers to have an easy access to Bill of Lading Number information to complete their ISF filings with US Customs in a timely manner and in accordance to the guidelines for the ISF regulations. You will find the BL number and container numbers assigned at the time of booking from the foreign party.

This information is subject to change at any time in accordance to the requirements asked by the BOOKING PARTY.

This is to advise you that MSC is fully aware that many of our Non-AMS NVOCC's intend to start making, or have started to make, their own Importer Security Filing (ISF). According to the ISF Rule, the ISF filing must be done at the lowest House Bill of Lading number level, but referencing the MSC bill lading number(s) as Carrier. Therefore, it is our aim to provide you with the MSC Bill of Lading  number(s) when the booking is confirmed by MSC, in order to facilitate a smooth ISF filing for you.

Breakbulk and Project Cargo

If it Fits or Not
We Move It

From infrastructure and energy to complex industrial projects, MSC’s Breakbulk and Project Cargo solutions handle what standard shipping can’t. Out‑of‑gauge, heavy‑lift, or uniquely engineered, we move it with precision and flexibility, backed by full operational oversight. With global reach and U.S. expertise, we keep your oversized cargo moving smoothly from origin to destination.

Global network

Lifting capacity

Dedicated customer service desk

High sailing frequency

"
In project cargo, no two days are the same; each brings new challenges that demand adaptability, precision, and teamwork. At MSC USA, we view every project as an opportunity to grow, refine our expertise, and deliver value. Our team of experts is energized by what lies ahead and remains committed to supporting our customers from initial planning through final execution.
"

Luis Varela
Regional Manager, Project Cargo

Custom Logistics Solutions for Complex Cargo

MSC’s Breakbulk and Project Cargo service is to adapt to your needs. From import and export to cross‑trade, our experts design and execute customized logistics plans for each shipment. Even the most complex cargo is handled with precision and care, protecting your goods from origin to destination.

Nationwide Strength
Global Scale

With full access to MSC’s global fleet and every major U.S. port, MSC USA moves Out of Gauge (OOG) and Breakbulk cargo with ease. Frequent sailings and strong local support keep your cargo moving reliably, across America and around the world.

Specialized Support

from Strategic U.S Hub

Our Project Cargo team in Houston delivers expert coordination from planning through final delivery. Their solutions‑driven approach aligns with your operational priorities to develop dependable outcomes you can trust.

Delivering When It
Matters the Most

We’ve rerouted vessels to meet urgent deadlines, deployed floating cranes for complex heavy‑lift operations, and delivered on time for mission‑critical projects. Every move is a demonstration of our flexibility, technical skill, and customer‑first mindset.

America

Cross Border Solutions

Go Further, Faster:
Europe - Midwest with MSC

Experience seamless cross-border shipping through MSC’s Montreal Gateway, the most efficient route linking Europe and the Mediterranean to the U.S. Midwest. Enjoy faster transits, reliable schedules and tailored logistics, all managed by our dedicated team and supported by direct rail connections to key inland hubs.

Shortest Transit

Reliable Frequency

Tailored Solutions

Cost Efficiency

The Fast Lane From Europe to the American Heartland

It’s built to move your cargo inland faster, with fewer touch points. With our dedicated Cross-Border Trade Team, your shipments benefit from:

The shortest total transit distance to the Midwest

Weekly sailings from key European and Mediterranean ports

Fast, direct rail access to Chicago, Detroit, and St. Paul

Three Weekly Services

One Seamless Journey

Our three dedicated services Montreal Express 1, Canada Express, and MED Canada Service offer fast, reliable transit into the U.S. Midwest:

Liverpool to Chicago CY: 12 days

Antwerp to Chicago CY: 11 days

Le Havre to Chicago CY: 10 days

Sines to Chicago CY: 12 days

With weekly sailings, solid capacity, and direct rail links, your cargo keeps moving on schedule without detours.

Designed For Your Cargo

And Your Deadlines

We know that every supply chain is different. That’s why MSC’s Cross-Border solution is built to adapt to yours:

• Customized routing and end-to-end logistics solutions

• Reliable inland connections through strong rail partnerships

•A dedicated rail desk in Chicago for support and real-time shipment visibility

Optimize Your Midwest Shipments

With Value at Every Step

Managing costs and keeping your supply chain running smoothly is our priority. MSC’s Canadian routing offers:

• Competitive ocean and inland rail rates

• Fewer weight restrictions for fuller, more cost-effective loads

• Less congestion than East Coast ports, reducing delays and unexpected fees

Reliable DFN Export Support
Built Around U.S Growers​

MSC supports dried fruit and nut exporters with consistent service, reliable equipment availability, and a network designed around California supply chains, season after season.

From personalized customer support to dependable global connections, MSC focuses on what matters most in the DFN market: service you can plan around.

Dedicated DFN support desk

Equipment availability

Dependable service

Direct Access to Expert
Priority Assistance

Every DFN shipment matters. That’s why MSC offers a dedicated DFN support team based in Arizona, providing real‑time, priority assistance during West Coast operating hours.

Exporters benefit from direct access to an experienced team who understands DFN cargo requirements and responds quickly when support is needed - helping resolve issues efficiently and ensuring a smoother shipping experience.

Containers Available
When it Matters Most

Reliable equipment access is essential for DFN exports, particularly during peak demand periods.

Backed by a large, modern container fleet and strong equipment positioning, MSC supports DFN exporters with consistent container and chassis availability, helping reduce disruption and allowing shipments to move as planned, even during high‑volume season

Strong West Coast Gateways,
Global Reach

MSC’s DFN network is built around California’s key export gateways, including Oakland and Los Angeles / Long Beach.

Through established, dependable services, MSC connects U.S growers to major European, Mediterranean, and global markets, ensuring consistent access to international trade lanes aligned with DFN export flows.

Service Dependability
You Can Plan Around

Rather than competing on marginal transit time differences, MSC focuses on delivering what it commits to - consistently.

In the DFN market, dependable service often outweighs minor transit variations. MSC’s realistic, reliability‑driven approach supports stable planning across peak, shoulder, and year‑round shipping periods.

Plan Your DFN Exports
with Confidence

U.S eBL

Digital Bill of Lading
Built for American Business

MSC’s eBL is designed for business partners across the United States, making document release as fast as your supply chain demands. Instead of waiting for overnight couriers or managing stacks of paperwork, your team can access and transfer bills of lading online, anytime. The process is simple, secure, and cost-effective, helping you keep cargo moving and operations efficient across every port and trade lane.

Built on Security
and Compliance​

With MSC eBL, companies gain a digital solution that meets the highest standards for legal recognition and data protection. Every transaction is protected by advanced technology, ensuring that only authorised parties can access or transfer documents. MSC eBL is the digital version of your traditional Bill of Lading, with the same legal functions and recognition as paper, fully supported by modern regulatory standards.

Guided Onboarding
and Support​

Getting started is straightforward. Our local team guides you through every step, from requesting your first eBL release to connecting your business partners on the platform. You’ll have direct access to support for surrender requests, amendments, and technical questions, plus a welcome packet and training resources tailored to your needs.

"
We have found that using the eBL platform has greatly improved efficiency in getting our original MBL's down to Brazil. We have even had a couple of cases in which the original was released and needed to be sent back to the carrier for revision without the all the red tape that normally accompanies that scenario. Would highly recommend using the platform when original MBL release is required.
"

United World Line

Customer
Success Stories

U.S. exporters and importers are already benefiting from MSC eBL, with faster shipments, quicker document updates, and less administrative burden, especially in complex trade lanes. Industries handling high‑value or time‑sensitive cargo see fewer bottlenecks, reduced risk, and smoother coordination across supply chains.

Ongoing updates and specialist‑led webinars keep your team prepared and informed.

Live eBL Webinars
Your Digital Shipping Advantage

Join our complimentary live MSC eBL webinars, designed for U.S. businesses. Experts from MSC and our eBL provider show how electronic Bills of Lading streamline documentation, strengthen security, reduce costs, and support sustainability. Each session includes live Q&A with our specialists, so register below!

Register here!

I wanted to share some positive feedback regarding EBL. It has significantly streamlined our business operations, allowing us to receive BLs more swiftly and providing us with the flexibility to make necessary edits. Overall, EBL has noticeably enhanced our efficiencies, and I believe it’s making a substantial difference in our workflow. Additionally, the competitive pricing has helped us lower some costs.
"

Lakeland Fire and Safety

America

United States

Fruit

Keeping U.S Fruit Fresh
with Tailored Solutions

At MSC, we specialize in seamless, temperature-controlled fruit logistics, ensuring your produce arrives fresh and in optimal condition. In 2024 alone, the U.S imported over $13 billion in fresh fruits and berries, highlighting the need for reliable reefer shipping. With advanced cold-chain technology and dedicated support, we safeguard freshness from farm to market. Whether you’re importing to or exporting from the U.S, we deliver customized logistics solutions for your fruit business.

Local Experts

Controlled atmosphere

Cutting-edge

reefer technology

Pre-trip inspection

Your Fruit,
Handled with Expertise and care

Based in Charleston, South Carolina, our Reefer Operations team delivers exceptional support with a focus on precision and quality. In close coordination with the U.S. Department of Agriculture, we secure necessary approvals and carefully oversee cold treatment protocols for a wide range of fresh produce, including grapes, citrus, blueberries, fresh and frozen mangoes, avocados, berries, and more.

Peak Season Precision: Tailored Port Operations

MSC supports U.S. fruit importers and exporters with a wide network of direct port calls during peak seasons. From citrus, blueberries, and grapes to mangos and avocados, we adjust schedules based on market needs. With access to key ports like Philadelphia, New York, and Houston, we help your produce move efficiently and stay fresh.

iReefers: Where Freshness
Meets Efficiency

Stay in control of your fruit shipments with iReefer, MSC’s advanced real-time monitoring system. Fully integrated with myMSC and API platforms, it provides instant updates on temperature, humidity, and location. iReefer keeps your fresh fruit monitored and protected throughout the journey.

Learn About iReefer

"
When it comes to fresh fruit, temperature isn't just a number, it's the difference between delivering quality and compromising it. Consistent, precise temperature management is what keeps every shipment as fresh as the day it was picked.
"

Luca Scamardella
Import Trade Manager, MSC USA

From Harvest to Delivery
Our Local Experts are Ready to Help

INLAND SOLUTIONS

MSC USA connects your cargo to over 5,000 inland destinations with
precision-built road and rail solutions.

Watch the video

Schedules

Local Information

America

United States

Inland Solutions

Tailored Inland Solutions
Coast to Coast

Ready to revolutionize your logistics journey? With MSC, ocean transport is just the beginning. Our specialized inland transport solutions span the USA, ensuring efficient, cost-effective door-to-door delivery. Our extensive road and rail network offers unmatched flexibility and reliability, minimizing supply chain risks and reducing your carbon footprint. Wherever your cargo needs to go, MSC ensures it arrives smoothly.

Door-to-door expert support

Warehousing

Elite network of drayage providers

Extensive coast-to-coast railroad connectivity

Innovative and competitive inland solutions

"
Inland Transport is where your logistics strategy can shine. With MSC, you get coast-to-coast coverage, full visibility, and the confidence that your cargo will arrive smoothly and on time.
"

Robert Milazzo
Executive Vice President, Logistics

Connecting North America
for 40 Years

For 40 years, MSC has been a leader in North American logistics, linking the USA, Canada, and Mexico. With 35 terminals, over 90 rail ramps, and over 35 depots, we connect our customers to over 5,000 inland locations.  We also offer reliable, cost-efficient services across a 3,100-mile/5,000-km network railroad network with routing via East, West, and Gulf ports.

Intermodal Solutions

with Personalized Support

MSC’s intermodal team made up of more than 200 experts ensures seamless cargo transportation nationwide. We assist with trans-border and domestic shipments, offering personalized service and expert guidance tailored to your needs. With teams based in Boston, New York, Baltimore, Charleston, Miami, New Orleans, Houston, Chicago, and Tempe, we provide coverage from 8 AM to 8 PM EST.

Did you know?

The rail double stacked technology was invented in the U.S.

Specialized Equipment for Every Inland Move

At MSC, we move your cargo seamlessly across North America, offering specialized equipment and services. Choose from containers, versatile trailers, ISO tanks for liquids and chassis, along with multimodal transport, port-to-rail transfers, port-to-terminals, drayage services, warehousing and handling of oversize/overweight freight.  By utilising inland solutions, we help our customers reduce their carbon footprint through lower GHG emissions.

"
Every shipment matters to us. Whether it's cross-border or local, we work closely with our customers to make inland transport simple, reliable and stress-free.
"

Vincenzo Roveccio
Assistant Vice President, Intermodal

From Road to Rail
We are Here to Help

Meat

Your Expert Partner
for Shipping Poultry

When it comes to transporting frozen poultry, precision, care, and consistency are crucial. With our expertise and one of the world’s largest and most advanced reefer fleets, you can count on us to meet the needs of your cargo.

Enjoy a seamless and efficient poultry export experience with MSC.

Continuous investments in greener technologies

Cutting-edge

reefer technology

Global Coverage

Door-to-door expert support

Precision and Care
that Meet Global Standards

We go beyond standard reefer service with meticulous pre-trip inspections and food-grade container preparation to protect product integrity. MSC’s reefer operations follow the highest global food safety standards, including Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) -aligned protocols, to safeguard quality and compliance.

Did you know?

Did you know our new Savannah cold storage facility features a blast room with 1,280 blast freezing positions, capable of freezing 3 million pounds of meat in just 24 hours?

New Cold Storage Solution

Strategically located near the Port of Savannah, our modern cold storage facility ensures smooth, efficient handling for your poultry exports. Equipped with advanced temperature control systems and powered by sustainable energy sources, it’s built for reliability and environmental responsibility. Ready to keep your poultry fresh and your business moving forward with confidence.

iReefer: Smart Shipping for
Frozen Poultry

Stay in control of your frozen poultry exports with iReefer, MSC’s advanced real-time monitoring system. Fully integrated with myMSC and API platforms, it provides instant updates on temperature, humidity, and location, so you have full visibility into the status of your cargo throughout the whole journey.

Learn About iReefer

Reliable Cold Chain,
Precision in Every Step

Our dynamic offering includes warehousing solutions, eBL, and comprehensive Cargo Cover Solutions, ensuring all of your logistics needs are met with the highest standards.

Detention, Demurrage, Per Diem and Storage Charges

What is Detention, Demurrage, Per Diem and Storage in the USA?

Detention - Charge applicable, after the free time expires, for the use of the carrier’s full container inside the marine terminal or railroad facilities or container yard. This also applies while the container is undergoing U.S. custom examination, or while it is undergoing reworking of cargo for safety reasons.

Demurrage - Charge applicable, after the free time expires, inside the terminal for the use of the land.

Per Diem - Charge applicable, after the free time expires, for the use of the carrier’s container (full or empty) outside the marine terminal, rail ramp or container yard.

Storage - Charge applicable, after the free time expires, inside the rail ramp or container yard for the use of the land.

Detention and Demurrage Payment Procedure

Demurrage Detention and Per Diem Dispute Procedure

When initiating a dispute, if it’s related to Container Per Diem, please ensure to provide the Per Diem Invoice number that ends with ”P”. For all other types of disputes, Chassis Per Diem, Demurrage and Import detention it’s crucial to include the MSC BL number, the container number, and a comprehensive explanation of the dispute. Depending on the specific circumstances of the dispute, supplementary evidence may be necessary as detailed below.

Demurrage and Import Detention

Disputes for service contract special conditions: Service contract number and documentation for the relevant contractual terms.

Disputes due to inability to secure a terminal appointment to pick up equipment: A screenshot indicating no appointments were available for each day of the free time period and up to the day of pickup. Each daily screenshot must be time stamped and show no appointments were available for all shifts and as far into the future as the terminal system allows.

Disputes due to containers associated with Government holds: A statement validating the customs hold was not a result of any action by the shipper, their agent, or any party to the bill of lading.

Per Diem Dispute Policy

Purpose

This policy explains the documentation requirements and submission process for disputes related to Per Diem charges.

Scope

Applicable for disputes due to:

Service contract special conditions

Inability to secure a terminal appointment for equipment return

Inability to secure a rail reservation for export shipments

Documentation Requirements

1. Service Contract Special Conditions

Provide the service contract number.

Include documentation showing the relevant contractual terms.

2. Terminal Appointment Unavailability

Submit time-stamped screenshots from the terminal appointment system showing no available appointments at any MSC return location for the waiver date.

Screenshot Requirements:

Timing:

Day before Waiver Date: 6:00 a.m. – 12:00 p.m. (noon)

Waiver Date: 6:00 a.m. – 9:00 a.m.

Times must reflect the terminal’s time zone.

Content:

Entire screen, including URL address and appointment details for all terminals/inland facilities and shifts.

Automatically generated date/time stamp from the website.

Current date and time displayed at the bottom-right corner of the screen.

Clear evidence of relevant terminals.

Specific container number for which the waiver is requested.

3. Rail Reservation Unavailability

Provide a screenshot showing no reservations were available for each day of the receiving window as indicated on the booking confirmation.

Submission Guidelines

Submit disputes to MSC within 30 days of the invoice date.

MSC will provide feedback within 7 business days of receipt

Compliance Notes

Failure to provide the required documentation within the specified timeframe may result in denial of the dispute.

Detention and Demurrage payment through E- Pay

Paying by Credit Card: Please log onto https://www.mymsc.com/myMSC/epay and insert your invoice number (not BL#, CNTR# or any other reference). You can then add it to the cart and proceed with the payment. You will receive the payment confirmation and this same confirmation will be received by our Demurrage/Detention group which will proceed with the release and will notify you accordingly. No further message should be sent to US038-nydetention@msc.com

Detention and Demurrage updated payment policy

Please kindly note that by April 15th, 2021, the DDP Department will no longer accept check copies or written guarantees to release shipments from Detention and Demurrage hold.

The following options are available for release of shipment:

• For  immediate release, payment must be submitted via credit card.

• If the payment cannot be done by credit card, payment by check, ACH is acceptable. However, the shipment will be released ONLY after the payment is received.

Retail

End-to-End Logistics
Tailored for U.S Retailers

The U.S retail industry continues to evolve rapidly, shaped by e-commerce growth, shifting consumer expectations, and the demand for resilient supply chains. In 2024, U.S retail sales surpassed $6.2 trillion, reflecting the sector’s strength and complexity. Backed by decades of experience in retail logistics, MSC supports this dynamic market with integrated ocean and inland logistics, inventory optimization, and end-to-end visibility.

Door-to-door expert support

MSC Biofuel Solution

Expansive warehouse network

Retail Supported by People

Retail supply chains move fast, and when conditions change, reliable support matters. MSC’s customer service model gives retailers direct access to experienced teams who understand their cargo and stay involved from booking through delivery.

With fewer handoffs and clear accountability, our teams manage shipments proactively, resolve issues quickly, and provide practical, solution driven guidance across categories from apparel and footwear to furniture and home goods, MSC provides the human oversight retailers need to navigate complexity with greater clarity and control.

"
The people I work with are high-quality professionals who are committed to finding solutions. I trust that they strive to act as critical partners on projects. The challenges we face are primarily administrative in nature so identifying the right contact person to resolve specific issues can sometimes be difficult.

MSC has one of the most extensive port call networks in the industry. Customer service remains strong, particularly in terms of response time for contract holders. In my view, MSC continues to improve across all aspects of the business.

"

MSC Customer

Support Sustainable Retail Logistics
with MSC Biofuel

As sustainability becomes a top priority in retail, we help you reduce emissions without compromising reliability. Our certified Biofuel Solution offers opportunities that cut CO₂ emissions directly within your supply chain. By choosing MSC, you can actively decarbonize your logistics operations and move closer to your net-zero goals.

Discover Our Biofuel Solution

Streamlining Supply Chains
with U.S Warehouses

MSC offers access to an expansive network of over 40 warehouse facilities across key U.S retail hubs, including California, Texas, Georgia, South Carolina, New Jersey, and Pennsylvania. With more than 6 million square feet of storage, we support fast distribution for your retail supply chain.

Warehouses

End-to-End Warehousing for
Smarter Supply Chains

MSC USA offers nationwide warehousing solutions that integrate seamlessly into your supply chain. With over 40 facilities across the U.S and more than 6 million square feet of storage space, we support a wide range of industries, from retail to industrial cargo. Whether you're optimising inventory, reducing lead times, or scaling distribution, our warehousing network is built for reliability, flexibility, and performance.

"
Our focus is not just storing cargo, but keeping it ready, visible, and moving with purpose.
"

Michael Hay
Director, Intermodal

Expansive Warehouse Network
Across the U.S

Our warehouse network spans strategic regions across the U.S, including the West Coast, South, Southeast, and the Northeast. This extensive footprint allows us to shorten last-mile delivery times, reduce inland transit costs, and meet growing market demands. With 6M+ square feet of space, we support scalable storage and rapid throughout for fast-moving supply chains.

Customized Storage

that Works for You

We adapt to your operational needs, whether that’s cross-docking, transloading, long-term storage, or short-term buffer warehousing. Our facilities are designed for multi-client or dedicated setups and can flex with seasonal volume changes. With real-time inventory access and standardized processes, you stay in control from inbound to outbound.

Speed to Shelf Starts Here

From palletising, pick-pack, repacking, labeling and kitting, our value-added services streamline your downstream operations. We enable DC bypass to get your goods directly to store or end customer faster. These integrated services reduce handling time, lower costs, and improve time-to-market.

Eco-Efficient Warehousing
Built for the Future

Our facilities use energy-efficient lighting, recycling programs, and intelligent layout design to minimize environmental impact. We continuously work to reduce waste, emissions, and energy consumption across our operations. Partnering with MSC means aligning your logistics with our long-term sustainability goals by achieving measurable CO₂ reduction.

In case of demurrage disputes, email VE370-demurrage@msc.com mentioning the invoice and BL number in the email subject. Please describe the reasons for your dispute. Our Demurrage team will come back to you within 48 business hours.

What are storage charges?

A storage charge is applicable, after the free time expires, for containers left inside the container yard (for the use of the land). These charges are invoiced by the terminal directly to customers.

VGM Receiving Policy in Venezuela

What is VGM?

Verified Gross Mass or VGM refers to the exact, verified weight of a packed container. For safety reasons, vessel operators can only load a container if its weight has been verified.

In line with SOLAS (Safety of Lives at Sea) regulations, all marine terminals in Venezuela are now allowed to use their certified scales to record Verified Gross Mass (VGM) of shipments.

What do I need to include in my VGM instructions?

You must include the following on all VGM instructions:
• Booking or Bill of Lading (BL) number
• Container number
• VGM + weight measurement unit (lbs. or kgs.)
• Responsible party name
• Digital signature of the authorized signatory in all CAPITAL LETTERS.

How can I submit my VGM instructions?

Email: VE370-doc@msc.com

Guidelines for submitting your VGM instructions

We encourage customers to submit their Shipper-Verified Gross Mass (VGM) before cargo is delivered. This helps to avoid any unexpected weighing charges being levied against the cargo at the Venezuela port of loading, which will be billed to the shipper of record.

Questions about VGM?

Contact our Documentation team

VGM Receiving Policy

In line with SOLAS (Safety of Lives at Sea) regulations, all marine terminals in the USA are now allowed to use their certified scales to record Verified Gross Mass (VGM) of shipments. Download our USA VGM policy and terminal guidelines for more information.

What do I need to include in my VGM instructions?

You must include the following on all VGM instructions:

Booking or Bill of Lading (BL) number

Container number

VGM + weight measurement unit (lbs. or kgs.)

Responsible Party Name

Digital signature of the authorized signatory in all CAPITAL LETTERS.

How can I submit my VGM instructions?

myMSC (Free of Charge)

EDI (via INTTRA; GT NEXUS; Cargo Smart)

MSC in-house system - Magic-Hand

MSC administration on late VGM submission and misdeclaration

We impose Weight mis-declaration Penalty in the following cases:

Actual cargo weight exceeds container payload

VGM exceeds container payload plus tare weight

VGM is less than cargo weight plus container tare weight

Discrepancy between VGM and actual weight exceeds 5% or 1000KGS

Meantime, to ensure the timely declaration to relevant authorities and vessel operators, VGM Late Submission Fee is imposed in case VGM declaration after cut-off time.

Manual VGM Submission is not acceptable

The following commodities are forbidden for Import to INDIA:

Animal fats, skins, bones, horns; whalebone, Edible products of animal origin, Synthetic rags, Malfunctioned Devices (MFD) - Used Electronic Equipment's, plastic scrap, solid plastic waste  , used tyres etc.

Import of Betel nuts is banned at all Indian ports except for New Mangalore port effective 20th Feb'07

IMPORT OF   used, worn, old clothing is restricted.

(Harmonized code:  63090000). This commodity can no longer be imported for Commercial use or for resale in India. Any old / worn clothing will be accepted as RAGS only (shredded form).

As per Notification No. S.O.948(E) dt. 22-Mar-2017 - RAW HIDES, AND LEATHER ETC are not allowed to Custom clear at ICD Kanpur.  Importation of live-stock products are now permitted only to certain sea ports / ICD – check with MSC INDIA for acceptance.

Important Warning

IMPORTANT WARNING

It has come to our attention that a fraudulent scheme involving the so-called "Gianluigi Aponte Trust" is targeting individuals in the local region. We want to ensure the safety and security of our visitors and customers. Please be aware of the following:

• MSC and Gianluigi Aponte are NOT affiliated with any trust or investment scheme.

• Do NOT provide personal information or transfer money to any entity claiming to be part of the "Gianluigi Aponte Trust."

• Verify the authenticity of any communication or offer by contacting MSC India directly through our official channels.

If you believe you have been targeted or have fallen victim to this scam, please report it to the authorities immediately. We are cooperating with law enforcement to address this issue and protect our community.

Stay vigilant and protect yourself from fraud.

For more information or to report suspicious activity, please contact MSC India.

Connecting Indonesia to the world

MSC has been operating in Indonesia since 1996. Today MSC has around 180 staff dedicated to servicing the needs of our customers with six offices in the country – in Jakarta, Surabaya, Semarang, Belawan, Panjang, and Palembang – which are located close to the main ports of Indonesia. To further extend our business coverage, we are also represented by sub-agents in Padang, Batam, Solo, Bandung, Makassar, and Bali.

MSC offers the widest port coverage in Indonesia with four independent feeder networks connecting Indonesia ports with transshipment hub ports in Singapore, Tanjung Pelepas, and Yantian, where shippers can then leverage on MSC’s comprehensive global network of services with addition two direct calls in Jakarta bound for Australia and New Zealand.

Find out more in the MSC In Indonesia Brochure.

SOLAS VGM Information Indonesia

Government Approval Status

The Director General of Sea Transportation, Ministry of Transport, recently issued Regulation No. Hk.103/2/4/DTP2_16 on Verified Gross Mass of Container (VGM) carried by vessel (DG Regulation), which has been effective since 1 June 2016.

The DG Regulation aims to implement the VGM requirements for container as required by the Amendment to the Safety of Life at Sea (SOLAS).

In the event if there is a discrepancy between the weights of the container received before container arrived at the terminal facility at the port and the VGM acquired through the weighing facility in the port, then the VGM that is recognized is the one acquired from the terminal facility in the port.

Container exceeding the maximum gross weight as stated by the Safety Approval Plate (CSC Safety Plate) will not be loaded into the vessel.

Failure to comply with the DG Regulation is punishable by a sanction in a form of prohibition to load the container to the vessel by the port authority (syahbandar) which may impact the financing including postponement of loading or demurrage or return of container as stipulated by a contract between the parties.

What to include in your VGM instructions to MSC

The following items are mandatory and must be on all VGM instructions

Booking or BL number

Container number

VGM – Verified Gross Mass

Authorized person’s signatory (submitter of the VGM who may be authorized to act on behalf of shippers)

Responsible party Name (Shipper on B/L)

How to submit you VGM instructions?

myMSC

INTTRA; GT NEXUS; Cargo SMart

Via email- submitvgm@mscid.com

Subject Header of the Email, please indicate as <Submit VGM – Loading Vessel Name & Voyage – MSC assigned Booking Number>.

Deadlines for sending your VGM instructions

VGM cut-off deadlines for Email submission = 48 hours prior to Vessel ETA

VGM cut-off deadlines EDI channels = Container yard (CY) cut-off time

Admin Fees and Costs

MSC Indonesia encourages clients to declare VGM via online submission. There are no administrative charges imposed by MSC for the moment. Should there be new information, we will share with you.

Should there be any charges levied by 3rd party or by MSC incurred as a result of NO VGM received timely, will be for Shipper’s account.

Recommendations

For Part-Load shipments – instances where there are multiple Shippers consolidating their cargo in the same container. Please appoint 1 of the Shipper to submit VGM per container to MSC.

VGM cut-off information is available on the Booking Confirmation Form & MSC.com.

Amendments of VGM information are allowed before the assigned deadline.

Tax ID Regulation

Effective from 1 December 2023, all invoices to our customers will be issued on behalf of Mediterranean Shipping Company SA so that invoices are subject to final tax. Therefore, please do not withhold our invoice with WHT art. 23. We will pay and report the Final WHT art.15 to Tax Office for any export invoices. All invoices

on export shipments will be subject to Value Added Tax (VAT) with a tariff of 0%.

Invoice dated before 1 December 2023, especially invoice for local charges (ELC and ILC) with VAT 11%, due to certain reasons, needs to be revised on and after 1 December 2023, the revised invoice will be issued on behalf of Mediterranean Shipping Company SA, so VAT 0% will be applied and subject to WHT art.15.

Indonesia Coffee

Delivering Indonesia’s Finest Coffee Worldwide

Indonesia is among the world’s top coffee-producing countries, renowned for its distinctive varieties of Robusta and Arabica sourced from the farms in Sumatera, Java, and Sulawesi. From traditional brews to artisanal coffee blends, Indonesian coffee is enjoyed across the globe. MSC Indonesia recognises the value of this important commodity and that is why we are dedicated to care for your coffee cargo at every stage of the transport journey. From the ports of Jakarta, Panjang, Belawan, Surabaya, we are your shipping partner of choice for exporting coffee seamlessly to key markets in Europe, USA and Intra-Asia.

Outstanding port coverage

Food-grade containers

Tailor-made services in container depots

Local Experts

Fresh Coffee Delivered with Local Expertise

MSC Indonesia understands the unique logistics needs of coffee businesses. We link growers and exporters to key global destinations through flexible inland transport, cargo handling, and efficient shipment preparation. Supported by competitive transit times and extensive trade lane coverage, coffee is transported fresh and in optimal conditions to destinations like Antwerp, Manila, Alger, Saint Petersburg and more.

Thermal Liner Protection for Coffee

MSC’s Thermal Liner Solution protects coffee shipments from temperature and humidity fluctuations during transit. Installed inside standard containers and combined with moisture absorbers, it maintains a more stable internal environment even when external conditions range from -25°C to +60°C. This helps preserve freshness, aroma, and bean integrity so your coffee arrives closer to its origin quality.

Personalized Care

We are ready to support your coffee exports with expert documentation handling and strong local market knowledge. In addition, our dedicated coffee desk in Panjang office is on hand to offer specialised guidance to help move your cargo reliably and efficiently.

SOLAS VGM Information for Malaysia

Government approval status

All shippers are required to register themselves with Marine Department Malaysia (Jabatan Laut Malaysia) and declare the method which will be used to obtain VGM.
The Marine Department requires all weighing machines to be calibrated and certified by Metrology Corporation Malaysia Sdn Bhd, validity of 2 years for parties who perform the VGM weighing.

The weight acceptance variance at:

Port Kelang/Penang: +/- 5%; if the variance is >5% but within the CSC weight, terminal will accept and load the container

Pasir Gudang / Tanjung Pelepas: +/- 500kgs; if the variance is > 500kgs but within the CSC weight, terminal will accept and load the container

Terminal will deny entry at the gate if the weight exceeded CSC weight.

Based on above VGM verification, Terminal Operator will use the VGM for stowage planning.

What to include in your VGM instructions to MSC

The following items are mandatory and must be on all VGM declaration to MSC

• Booking number or Bill of Lading number

• Container number

• VGM – Verified Gross Mass

• Weighing Method

• Weighing Party

• Responsible Party

• Authorized person’s signatory (submitter of the VGM who may be authorized to act on behalf of shippers

• VGM acquired time (Optional)

• VGM reference (Optional)
Any missing information will be deemed as non-submission and NO LOAD.

How to submit your VGM instructions

All VGM is required to be submitted through POL terminal portal as well as to MSC via below:

-
via INTTRA

- via myMSC

- Manual submission by email to MY172-mscmsiavgmsubmit@msc.com .
Subject Header of the Email, please indicate as:<Submit VGM- Loading Vessel Name & Voyage - MSC Assigned Booking Number>

Deadlines for sending your  VGM instructions

- VGM cut-off deadlines = Container yard (CY) cut-off time

- Port Kelang: 10 hours before ETA

- Penang: 6 hours before ETA

- Pasir Gudang & Tanjung Pelepas: 8 hours before ETA

- NO additional plan allow after CY cut off

Admin Fees and costs

- MSC Malaysia encourages clients to declare VGM via online submission. There are no administrative charges imposed by MSC for the moment.Should there be new information, we will share with you.

- Should there be any charges levied by 3rd party or by MSC incurred as a result of NO VGM received timely, will be for Shipper’s account.

Recommendations

- It is recommended that shippers keep the VGM records for future references if required. If in doubt, always contact MSC’s local agency office.

- For Part-Load shipments – instances where there are multiple Shippers consolidating their cargo in the same container. Please appoint 1 of the Shipper to submit VGM per container to MSC.

- VGM cut-off information is available on the Booking Confirmation Form & MSC.com.

- Amendments of VGM information are allowed before the assigned deadline.

It is illegal to bring the following items into or out of Malaysia.

Imports

Emblems or devices likely to be adverse to Malaysian interests

Indecent or obscene publications or articles

Clothes bearing imprints or reproductions of verses of the Quran

Broadcast receivers capable of receiving radio communication within the ranges of 68-87 MHz and 108-174 MHz

Pens, pencils and other articles similar to syringes

Chemicals as follows: sodium arsenite, crocidolite, polybrominated biphenyls, polychlorinated biphenyls, polychlorinated terphenyls, trisphosphate, actinolite, anthophyllite, amosite, tremolite
chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs) and halons

Lightning arresters containing radioactive material

New pneumatic snow tyres and retreaded snow tyres for all types of vehicles

Certain breeds of dogs as follows: Pit Bull, American Bulldog, Neapolitan Mastiff, Japanese Tosa, Akita, Dogo Argentino, Fila Braziliero (please refer to the document Import Permit for Live Animals)

Particular pig or pork by-products

Feeding bottles which contain bisphenol A (BPA)
Preparations used in animal feed containing salbutamol, clenbuterol, salmeterol, terbutaline or formoterol

Fluid-absorbing granules for decoration purposes.

Foreign exchange control in Malaysia is governed by the Exchange Control Act, 1953, under which the Controller of Foreign Exchange, who is also the Governor of Bank Negara Malaysia, the central bank, is empowered to regulate foreign exchange dealings in Malaysia.

The Act imposes general restrictions on foreign exchange dealings by residents and non-residents. No person is allowed, among others, to buy or borrow foreign currency from, or sell or lend foreign currency to, any person; to make any payment in Malaysian ringgit to a non-resident in and outside Malaysia; or to deal in ringgit assets in Malaysia without the prior permission of the Controller.

There are no restrictions for non-residents to invest in Malaysia to purchase ringgit assets, such as landed property and securities. There is also no restriction for non-residents to transfer abroad, in foreign currency, all profits, returns and divestment proceeds from their investments in Malaysia.

Malaysia Meat & Poultry

Cold Chain Connectivity for Malaysia’s Meat Industry

Malaysia is a strategic player in the regional meat trade, exporting halal-certified poultry and processed meat products, like sausages, nuggets and halal ready-to-eat meals, to Singapore, Vietnam, Brunei, Thailand and Myanmar markets. At the same time, we support and facilitate imports of premium meat cuts, beef and mutton from New Zealand, Brazil, Spain, India, Vietnam, Indonesia, by utilizing reliable smart reefer logistics.

Whether it’s frozen or chilled meats, MSC’s iReefer technology ensures freshness is protected by monitoring and maintaining optimal temperatures throughout the shipping journey. Find out more how you can unlock greater cross-border meat trade opportunities in and out of Malaysia.

Customized Reefer Solutions

Pre-trip inspection

Strong Local Expertise

Door-to-door delivery solutions for businesses of all sizes

Freshness First

We ensure meat exports retain their freshness, safety, and halal integrity from end-to-end. Using our advanced iReefer system built to support temperature‑sensitive cargos, customers benefit from precise temperature control, real‑time monitoring, and full cold‑chain visibility from Malaysia to global markets. This significantly minimises the risks of spoilage of perishable foods, and you can be assured that every shipment arrives in optimal, market‑ready condition.

Reefers & Intermodal Solutions

Malaysia’s poultry production is set to grow, backed by steady demand from neighbouring Asian markets seeking reliable protein sources. We understand that meat cargo is highly sensitive, and fluctuations in production cycles or festive seasonal demand like Hari Raya Haji (Eid al-Adha) can affect shipment volumes. That is why our team is always ready to support exporters with our fleet of reefer containers – covering inland transport (road, rail, barge, and sea linkage) from factories, warehouses, to efficiently reach worldwide ports.

Leverage MSC’s Extensive Global Trade Routes

Southeast Asia, the Middle East and Africa are high‑growth regions for imported frozen meat and poultry. With our Standalone East/West Network reaching these fast‑growing trade corridors, MSC enables you to unlock more business opportunities for meat imports.

Fun fact

Animal feed ingredients contain meat. Poultry Meat Meal (PMM), Meat & Bone Meal (MBM), Feather Meal, and Blood Meal are some proteins we ship!

VGM Receiving Policy in the Myanmar

What is VGM?

Verified Gross Mass

What do I need to include in my VGM instructions?

The following items are mandatory and must be on all VGM instructions to MSC and the terminal:

Booking or Bill of Lading Number

Container number and size

VGM – Verified Gross Mass

Weighing method

Authorized person’s signature (submitter of the VGM who may be authorized to act on behalf of shippers)

Shipper’s name

Vessel name & voyage

How can I submit my VGM instructions?

myMSC (free of charge)

EDI via INTTRA (free of charge)

Manually (manual submission fee: USD 15.00 per container)

Email: mm961-mscmmrgnsubmitvgm@msc.com

(Note: the email will only be monitored for VGM declarations)

Guidelines for submitting your VGM instructions:

As per the Notification (No. 3/2006) of the Department of Marine Administration (DMA):

Shippers must initially register at DMA and shall commence their VGM declaration by using their respective registered numbers.

Shippers of garment products shall get their registration at DMA by taking responsibility for the accuracy of the weight declaration of their goods.

Apart from garment products, those who will be utilising loading method no. 2 for their goods shall obtain registration by presenting the weighing equipment. supporting documents and their assurance of taking responsibility for the weight of their export cargoes.

Shippers who will be utilising method no. 1 shall declare the VGM as per the respective weigh bridge of the port terminal having temporarily recognized.

Shippers utilising method no. 2 shall declare the VGM by showing the weight of commodities and the weight of the containers.

Based on the VGM copy received, terminals/feeder operators will use the VGM for stowage planning.

VGM cut off = 42 hours prior to vessel ETA

In Myanmar, there are currently in terminals with a “NO VGM, NO LOADING” policy.

MSC admin fees and costs:

Manual VGM submission fee (applies to email and inclusion on standard shipping instructions): USD 15.00 per container.

VGM misdeclaration/amendment Fee: USD 50.00 per container.

Detention, Demurrage and Storage in New Caledonia

What is detention?

Detention is the charge applicable, after the free time expires, for the use of the carrier’s full container inside the marine terminal, railroad facilities or container yard. This charge can also apply while the container is undergoing NC customs inspections, or while the cargo inside the container is being reworked for safety reasons.

What is demurrage?

Demurrage is the charge applicable, after the free time expires, inside the terminal for the use of the land.

In case of a demurrage dispute, email (email ncl-info@msc.comsubject: Dispute + Invoice Number), describing the reasons for your dispute.

MSC New Caledonia is offering combined detention and demurrage.

What are storage charges?

A storage charge is applicable, after the free time expires, for containers left inside the container yard (for the use of the land).

Questions about detention, demurrage, or storage charges?

Contact our New Caledonia team.

VGM Receiving Policy in New Caledonia

What is VGM?

Verified Gross Mass or VGM refers to the exact, verified weight of a packed container. For safety reasons, vessel operators can only load a container if its weight has been verified.

What do I need to include in my VGM instructions?

You must include the following on all VGM instructions:

Booking or Bill of Lading (BL) number

Container number

VGM + weight measurement unit (lbs. or kgs.)

Responsible party name

Digital signature of the authorized signatory in all CAPITAL LETTERS

How can I submit my VGM instructions?

myMSC (Free of charge)

EDI (via INTTRA; GT NEXUS; Cargo Smart)

Manually (via INTTRA)

Email: to your MSC New Caledonia contact

Guidelines for submitting your VGM instructions

LOI (Letter of indemnity) for lost or destroyed OBLs (Original Bills of Lading)

What is a Letter of Indemnity (LOI)?

A Letter of Indemnity (LOI)  is required when an original Bill of Lading is lost or destroyed. It can be completed by the shipper at the port of loading, or by the consignee at the port of discharge.

The LOI requires 200% of the commercial value of the cargo plus Ocean Freight to be guaranteed either through the bank or MSC’s insurance company.

MSC’s global LOI requirements are set out by our Geneva headquarters. The LOI must be completed as per these instructions in order for a duplicate Bill of Lading to be issued.

Since opening our first New Zealand office in 1996, MSC has grown into a nationwide team of more than 90 people across the North and South Islands, led from our Christchurch head office.

Detention, Demurrage, and Storage in New Zealand

What is detention?

Detention is interchangeable with Container Hire but also applies when unit is with Customer due to our Combined Tariff for freetime, not restricted to Terminal/Depot.

What is demurrage?

Demurrage as Terminal/Depot Storage is not something many Countries offer, Australia/New Zealand do not although we are asked often.

Questions about detention, demurrage, Per Diem or storage charges?

Share
Link copied!

VGM information for New Zealand

What is VGM?

Verified Gross Mass or VGM refers to the exact, verified weight of a packed container. For safety reasons, vessel operators can only load a container if its weight has been verified.

In line with SOLAS (Safety of Lives at Sea) regulations, all marine terminals are now allowed to use their certified scales to record Verified Gross Mass (VGM) of shipments.

Government approval status

National body in New Zealand is MNZ (Maritime New Zealand)

All verified weighing equipment within New Zealand must be certified by the Trading Standards Division of the Ministry of Business, Innovation and Employment.

All container terminals have announced across the board that no container will be gated in without certified VGM.

What do I need to include in my VGM instructions?

New Zealand terminals will require the following items to be declared in Pre Receival Advices (PRA) prior to containers being accepted into the terminal.

The following items are mandatory and must be on all VGM instructions

Booking number

Container number

Verified Gross Mass

Declaration that the VGM has been calculated using one of the approved methods and being submitted by an authorized party on behalf of the shipper.

Weight Calculation Method

Verification Date

Name of Declarant

Company

Either Phone or Email Address

How can I submit my VGM instructions?

Refer to individual terminal notices on how to submit PRA/VGM.

Deadlines for sending your VGM instructions

VGM must be declared when submitting the PRA, prior to containers being delivered to the terminal.

Admin Fees and costs

Some NZ terminals will apply a fee to accept manual submission for VGM information.

Any weighbridge, transport or other cost incurred to determine the VGM is for shipper’s account.

If shipper presents container at a terminal without having declared the VGM, the container will not be accepted, and any associated costs will be to shipper’s account.

If an amendment to a VGM is requested after the container has been accepted into the terminal, any costs incurred will be to shipper’s account.

Recommendations for submitting your VGM instructions

Determine the weight calculation method that is most suitable for your cargo.

Ensure that appropriately trained and authorized personnel are responsible for the calculation and submission of the VGM.

Ensure that appropriate record keeping is in place.

Register for myMSC.com for access to container tare weights if necessary.

Reefer Cargo

MSC has goes ‘the extra mile’ by expanding our services beyond ports. Thanks to our integrated road, rail, and barge network across the world, we offer door-to-door transport solutions that keep our customers’ cargo fresh and cool for the whole journey.

PRE-TRIP INSPECTION

At the depot, our reefer experts carry out a thorough inspection of the container in preparation for loading. This helps you meet the relevant regulatory requirements and retain the sale value of your cargo at its destination.

PICK-UP AND LOADING

We come to you to load your cargo into our reefer units:

20ft or 40ft high cube containers

Controlled through an integrated microprocessor

Fresh air adjustment and dehumidification

CFC-free insulation ensures minimum temperature loss.

INLAND TRANSPORTATION

While the reefer containers are in transit over land, MSC can provide a genset portable diesel generator to keep the container operating at the required temperature. We bring the containers directly to the port, where they undergo strict security checks.

SHIPPING

While reefer containers are on board our vessels or in a port, they are always plugged into a constant power source. Our reefer containers are fitted with a software programmed to display specific alarm codes should a malfunction be detected. This immediately notifies our fully trained engineers, who can attend to the unit directly.

TRANSPORTATION TO FINAL DESTINATION

We deliver your goods in optimal condition to any address in the world. If necessary, your cargo can also be stored at cold storage warehouses on the way.

Dairy New Zealand

Taking New Zealand Dairy Further

New Zealand is renowned worldwide for premium dairy trusted for its quality from having been produced by cows with access to lush, green pastures. Moving these products across long distances requires specialist care, dependable temperature control and a cold chain built to maintain freshness at every stage.

With more than 30 years of local experience, MSC New Zealand is well versed on the requirements for transporting milk, cream, cheese, butter and other dairy products to markets worldwide. Our local team combines specialist knowledge with MSC’s global network, using a range of reefer containers and integrated road, rail and sea connections.

From New Zealand farms to supermarket shelves around the world, we help preserve freshness, quality and shelf life, so the country’s celebrated dairy products arrive at their destination at their best.

Global Coverage

Pre-trip inspection

Controlled atmosphere

Customs clearance support

Quality Begins in New Zealand

New Zealand’s climate and expansive pastures allow dairy cows to graze outdoors for much of the year, supporting the production of dairy products recognized in markets worldwide.

Milk and cream require careful handling and consistent temperature management throughout their journey. We provide refrigerated transport designed to maintain optimal conditions from origin to destination.

Butter is sensitive to changes in temperature. Our advanced reefer containers maintain carefully controlled conditions throughout transit, helping protect its texture, freshness and quality from door to door.

Cold-Chain Expertise That Scales with You

Even the finest dairy products depend on an expertly managed cold chain. MSC’s reefer specialists understand the requirements of dairy cargo, helping New Zealand producers maintain product quality across long international journeys.

From pre-trip container inspections and food-grade container preparation and equipment coordination, our local team provides practical support to keep your supply chain running smoothly. Whether moving a single shipment or managing substantial export volumes, our solutions can scale with your business.

From Pasture to Shelf, Kept at Its Best

MSC’s door-to-door reefer solutions connect New Zealand’s dairy-producing regions with consumers worldwide. By combining local inland capabilities with our global ocean and destination networks, we keep cargo moving seamlessly from production facilities to its final delivery point.

Our cold-chain services include refrigerated containers, cold-storage warehousing and integrated road, rail and barge connections. At every stage, we focus on maintaining the conditions needed to protect the freshness, shelf life and premium quality of your dairy products.

New Zealand Dairy Punches Above Its Weight

New Zealand may not be the biggest country in the world, but its local dairy has built an exceptional global reputation. Kiwi farms produce considerably more milk than the domestic market consumes, making exports essential to the industry and taking New Zealand-made milk, butter, cheese and cream to tables around the world.

eBL New Zealand

One Click Closer to Global Markets

As global trade becomes increasingly digital, paper Bills of Lading can create unnecessary delays, costs and complexity. MSC’s electronic Bill of Lading (eBL) provides New Zealand businesses with secure, round-the-clock access to essential trade documents, wherever their cargo is moving.

An eBL has the same legal value and performs the same functions as an original paper Bill of Lading, but in a streamlined electronic format. Supported by MSC’s local New Zealand experts, it helps businesses simplify documentation, improve visibility and trade globally with greater speed and confidence.

Fill in the below form to register your interest

Activate your account with the log in details you will receive by email

Invite your global business partners

Request the eBL in your next Shipping Instructions and receive your eBL seamlessly

Faster Documents Safer Transactions

Transfer Bills of Lading electronically and exchange documents in minutes rather than waiting for international courier deliveries. By removing physical document handling, MSC eBL accelerates document flows and can support faster payment processes across the supply chain.

The solution is available through the WAVE BL digital courier platform, where authorised parties connect through a decentralised network to exchange documents securely. Blockchain technology protects and encrypts the data, while documents and signatures are automatically verified and authenticated.

Towards a lighter Footprint

New Zealand is a beautiful country with many natural wonders that deserve to be preserved. The MSC eBL solution replaces paper Bills of Lading with a fully paperless process. By reducing the need to print and courier physical documents between multiple parties, we help support more sustainable documentation processes and lower carbon footprint supply chains.

Amend, endorse, surrender, or transfer your eBL at any time, from anywhere, via the WAVE BL user-friendly platform. Mirroring the traditional paper-based process, electronic Bill of Lading helps reduce human errors and time-consuming processes. With eBL you can also reduce your carbon footprint with paperless process.

Less Paperwork So You Can Prop Up Those Jandals

MSC eBL keeps documents secure, verified and accessible throughout the shipping journey. Going digital reduces the risk of loss, fraud and delays while helping New Zealand businesses:

Speed up document transfers and payments

Reduce administration and courier costs

Access documents securely, anytime and anywhere

The Land of the Long White Cloud Is Moving to the Digital Cloud

New Zealand continues to embrace digitalization across government, infrastructure and industry. As international trade becomes faster and more connected, digital documentation helps local businesses remain agile, competitive and ready to respond to opportunities worldwide.

Inland Solutions New Zealand

To Port and Beyond

The journey of cargo begins and ends on land. MSC New Zealand's inland solutions connect businesses across New Zealand, bringing the North and South Islands closer through integrated door-to-door transport.

Supported by an expanding road and rail network, we move your cargo efficiently and cost-effectively from origin to destination. With local expertise, flexible connections and access to MSC’s global network, we help simplify your logistics, reduce supply chain risk and keep New Zealand trade moving with confidence.

Local Experts

Outstanding port coverage

Road

Rail

Warehousing and Storage

Full Coverage Across New Zealand

Whether you need a standalone transport solution or additional support for your existing logistics program, MSC connects your cargo with destinations across New Zealand, from major urban centers to regional and rural communities.

Our integrated road, rail and sea services extend beyond port-to-port shipping, providing safe, efficient and cost-effective connections for both imports and exports.

BMSB Fumigation Support

New Zealand’s unique and fragile ecosystem depends on strong biosecurity. During the Brown Marmorated Stink Bug (BMSB) season, imported cargo must meet strict treatment requirements to prevent unwanted pests from entering the country.

MSC New Zealand’s local team can coordinate the entire fumigation process, helping you meet biosecurity requirements and avoid unnecessary customs delays. From arranging treatment to completing post-fumigation inspections, we help ensure your container is compliant, pest-free and ready for its onward journey.

New Zealand, a Land of Juxtaposition

New Zealand is shaped by remarkably diverse landscapes. The Southern Alps stretch approximately 480 kilometers across the South Island, with more than 20 peaks rising above 3,000 metres. The West Coast features rugged terrain, glacier-carved valleys and lush rainforests, while the North Island is renowned for its volcanic and geothermal landscapes, including Lake Taupō and the peaks of the Central Volcanic Plateau.

Surrounded by more than 15,000 kilometers of coastline, New Zealand presents a unique logistics environment. From coastal gateways to challenging inland destinations, MSC combines local knowledge with flexible transport connections to keep your cargo moving across Aotearoa and beyond.

iReefer New Zealand

Bringing Distant Markets Closer

New Zealand’s premium fresh produce traverses some of the world’s longest refrigerated trade routes. Across such vast distances iReefer solution enables you to keep tabs on how your cargo is travelling to ensure the essential needs are being met to protect cargo quality and value.

MSC iReefer solution gives New Zealand exporters real-time visibility into shipment location, temperature, humidity and journey conditions. These actionable insights help you respond sooner, reduce the risk of cargo loss and keep your supply chain performing efficiently from Aotearoa to markets worldwide.

Available through myMSC or MSC Integration Suite, iReefer brings smarter monitoring and greater control of your refrigerated cargo shipment!

Real-time Monitoring

Mismatching time zones? Sweet as, you can track your cargo condition live in your own time.

Temperature Control

You wouldn’t let your full chilly bin go warm; you don’t have to let your reefer container go warm either.

Cost Savings

Save some bucks by preventing spoilage and waste.

Watch Over Your Cargo Like a Haast's Eagle

New Zealand is renowned for premium, temperature-sensitive exports. When quality must be maintained across thousands of kilometers, peace of mind means seeing more than a container’s location. MSC iReefer provides deeper insight into cargo conditions on land and at sea. Remotely monitor temperature, humidity and performance trends so you can respond faster, plan with confidence and maintain a resilient cold chain from origin to destination.

Accessible through myMSC and available via MSC Integration Suite, iReefer puts greater visibility, control and risk management at your fingertips.

Your Cargo, Your Level of Control

Different New Zealand exports have different monitoring needs. MSC iReefer offers three packages, allowing you to choose the right level of visibility, tracking and analytics for your cargo and operations.

Essential: Unlimited users get access to container overviews and predicted ETA’s along with container journey logs and graphs.

Pro: All your essential package benefits with added container GPS locations, controlled atmosphere, and cold treatment monitoring, off power/defrost period tracking, and unlimited data log downloads.

Ultimate: Benefit from all the Essential and Pro packages have to offer, along with the full MSC Integration Suite.

New Zealand: Isolation by the Numbers

Kiwis are prolific travelers and so is their reefer cargo, which experiences some of the most significant reefer sea mile lanes you see in global trade. The long journeys make iReefer an attractive tool allowing New Zealand shippers to check in on their cargo on demand while travelling the sort of distances we see below!

Melbourne: over 1,700 nautical miles

Shanghai: over 6,300 nautical miles

Philadelphia: over 13,800 nautical miles

London Gateway: over 16,000 nautical miles

Kiwi Fruit New Zealand

Taking New Zealand Kiwifruit to the World

New Zealand kiwifruit is enjoyed worldwide for its distinctive flavor, freshness and premium quality. Protecting these qualities across long international journeys requires speed, flexibility and precise temperature management.

MSC combines local New Zealand expertise with advanced reefer technology and a global transport network to keep your kiwifruit in optimal condition. From local orchards to overseas markets, we help preserve taste, texture, aroma and shelf life at every stage of the journey.

Pre-trip inspection

Cutting-edge

reefer technology

Continuous investments in greener technologies

Customs clearance support

Keeping it Cool and Under Control

World-renowned New Zealand kiwifruit deserves world-class cold-chain care. MSC’s modern reefer fleet provides the temperature, humidity and atmospheric control needed to protect fruit throughout transit.

Controlled Atmosphere technology helps slow the ripening process and extend shelf life, while cold-treatment capabilities can support applicable pest-control and market-entry requirements. From pre-trip inspections and food-grade container preparation to equipment coordination and production planning, our specialists help keep every shipment running smoothly.

Let the Locals Help you go Global

We understand the importance of having a local Kiwi point of contact, which allows us to provide the personal touch and tailored service you need. With North and South Island offices, from Auckland to Bluff, we have just the local ready and waiting to take your call, with no time zone difference to manage.

Our experienced local teams will ensure the efficient transportation of your Kiwi fruit shipments; they can take care of all your needs. Anything you need, a friendly MSC voice can be on the other end of the phone to help get the job done.

Flexible Solutions from Orchard to Market

MSC provides integrated, cost-effective door-to-door transport across New Zealand and beyond. By combining local road and rail connections with our global ocean network, we help producers move premium kiwifruit efficiently while protecting quality and reducing food loss.

Harvest volumes and transport requirements can change with the season, weather and destination. Our scalable, tailored solutions adapt to your needs, supported by local experts from collection through to final delivery.

New Zealand's Small but Mighty Superfruit

New Zealand’s humble kiwifruit is a small but mighty superfruit, punching well above its weight, being packed with nutritional benefits.

Rich in vitamin C: Kiwifruit is an excellent source of vitamin C, supporting normal immune function.

Fibre in the skin: The edible skin, while furry, does provide additional fibre and nutrients.

A source of potassium: Kiwifruit contains potassium, an important part of a balanced diet.

Natural digestive support: Green kiwifruit contains actinidin, an enzyme that helps the body digest proteins.
