Meat New Zealand

Taking New Zealand’s Finest Meat to the World

New Zealand has a proud history of pioneering frozen meat exports, beginning with the first successful shipment to Britain in 1882. Today, the country’s chilled and frozen meat remains valued worldwide for its quality, food safety and traceability.

MSC combines local industry knowledge with extensive global reach and connections to major markets, including China, the United States and the United Kingdom. Our integrated sea and inland solutions help maintain reliable, uninterrupted cargo movement from production regions to customers worldwide.

Supported by one of the world’s largest reefer fleets and experienced cold-chain specialists, we provide the precise handling and temperature control needed to protect New Zealand meat throughout its journey, whether chilled or frozen.

Digital business

solutions

Cutting-edge

reefer technology

Global Coverage

Fast Access to Key Meat Markets

MSC’s global network provides the capacity and connectivity New Zealand meat exporters need. We deliver meat to key markets quickly, with weekly services providing direct access along with connections to key destinations on both the East and West Coasts of the United States.

With efficient transit times and carefully controlled reefer conditions, we help preserve product quality and shelf life from New Zealand to destination.

Local Team that Understands Your Business

When dealing with temperature-sensitive cargo, access to responsive local support makes a real difference. With teams across the North and South Islands, MSC provides personal service in your time zone and a practical understanding of New Zealand’s meat export industry.

Our local specialists coordinate the details of each shipment and provide tailored support to keep your chilled and frozen meat moving efficiently from origin to market.

Cold-Chain Expertise That Scales with You

New Zealand meat may be a prime cut, but its premium quality depends on a carefully managed cold chain. MSC’s reefer specialists understand the different requirements of chilled and frozen products, maintaining the conditions needed to protect freshness, quality and shelf life throughout transit.

From pre-trip inspections and food-grade container preparation to equipment coordination and production planning, our team supports smooth supply-chain operations. Our scalable solutions can also adapt to seasonal volumes, changing destinations and evolving business needs.

Quality Is About More Than Just The Taste

New Zealand’s temperate climate allows livestock to graze outdoors for much of the year, contributing to the distinctive quality of its meat.
Its global reputation is also built on rigorous food-safety and traceability systems.

These systems help track animal health, farming practices and product handling throughout the supply chain, giving international customers greater confidence in New Zealand meat from farm to destination.

Seafood New Zealand

Taking New Zealand Seafood from Pristine Waters to the World

Surrounded by some of the world’s most remarkable waters, New Zealand is renowned for premium fish and seafood valued for its freshness and quality. As seafood is highly perishable, protecting that quality across long international journeys demands precise temperature control, careful handling and a dependable cold chain.

With weekly services from New Zealand’s main ports, MSC combines local expertise with global ocean and inland connections to move chilled and frozen seafood efficiently. Our local specialists understand the demands of the industry and provide tailored support to keep your products in optimal condition, from New Zealand’s shores to markets worldwide.

Cutting-edge

reefer technology

Pre-trip inspection

Reefer solution

Customs clearance support

From Shore to Market, Kept at Its Best

New Zealand seafood deserves specialist care throughout its journey. Supported by experienced reefer teams, our advanced reefer container fleet maintains the carefully controlled conditions needed to protect product quality, freshness and shelf life.

Our integrated door-to-door solutions combine ocean transport with road and rail connections, providing reliable handling and consistent temperature management from collection through to final delivery. Whether chilled or frozen, your seafood remains in experienced hands at every stage.

Seafood Expertise Meets Global Logistics

Your seafood business needs speed, visibility and reliable access to international markets. MSC brings together global shipping services, flexible inland transport and digital tools to help you manage your seafood supply chain more effectively.

With extensive port coverage and scalable solutions, we connect New Zealand seafood producers with customers worldwide helping you respond to seasonal volumes, protect product value and deliver with confidence.

A Great Nation with a Vast Ocean Territory

New Zealand lies between the Pacific Ocean and the Tasman Sea, with waters ranging from subtropical conditions in the north to cooler southern environments. This remarkable variety supports a rich diversity of fish and seafood species.

New Zealand’s Exclusive Economic Zone is one of the world’s largest, covering a marine area more than 15 times the size of its landmass a vast ocean territory that helps make seafood one of the country’s distinctive natural exports.

Wine New Zealand

Taking New Zealand Wine from Cellar Door to the World

New Zealand wines are celebrated worldwide for their distinctive character, premium quality and commitment to sustainable production. With around 90% of the country’s wine produced for export, wineries need a logistics partner that understands the value of every bottle and the importance of careful handling, consistent transit and reliable market connections.

From Marlborough and Hawke’s Bay to Central Otago, Wairarapa, Nelson and Canterbury, MSC New Zealand combines local wine-industry knowledge with an extensive global network. Whether you ship bottled wine, premium vintages or bulk volumes, our tailored solutions help preserve product integrity from the winery to customers worldwide.

Reliable connections to key wine markets across North America, Europe, Asia, Australia, and beyond

Dry, reefer, and flexibag solutions for bottled and bulk wine

Integrated inland transport and door-to-door logistics across New Zealand

Local Kiwi specialists supported by MSC's global network

Digital tools that make it easier to book, manage, and track shipments

World-Class Shipping to match a World-Class Drop

New Zealand’s cool-climate wine regions produce distinctive varieties sought after around the globe from Marlborough Sauvignon Blanc and Central Otago Pinot Noir to Hawke’s Bay Syrah and Chardonnay.

MSC helps wineries take these celebrated wines further with flexible shipping solutions tailored to their cargo, production volumes and destination markets.

The Sommeliers of Global Shipping

MSC's experts know that every wine shipment has its own requirements. Whether you are moving bottled wine, bulk volumes or premium vintages, maintaining quality throughout the journey is essential.

MSC combines reliable schedules and careful handling with dry-container, reefer and flexibag solutions. Our specialists help select the right transport option to protect your wine’s condition, character and commercial value from cellar door to destination.

From Cellar to Customer

Our support extends beyond ocean freight. MSC can combine local inland transport, door-to-door logistics and digital shipment visibility into one connected export journey.

With experienced local teams coordinating each stage, New Zealand wineries benefit from simpler logistics, greater visibility and one trusted partner from collection through to delivery.

Raise a Glass to Global Reach

MSC connects New Zealand wineries with established and emerging markets across North America, Europe, Asia, Australia and beyond. By combining responsive local support with our global shipping network, we help New Zealand wine travel further, reach customers reliably and strengthen its presence on the world stage.

Did you know?

New Zealand may produce only a small share of the world’s wine, but its distinctive varieties enjoy an international reputation far beyond the country’s size. Its wines are exported to more than 100 countries, generating over NZ$2 billion in annual export value.

Sauvignon Blanc leads the way, while Pinot Noir, Chardonnay, Pinot Gris and other regional styles continue to strengthen New Zealand’s premium reputation. Long sunshine hours, cool nights, diverse soils and maritime influences create the vibrant flavours and freshness for which its wines are renowned.

Detention, demurrage, Per Diem and storage charges

What is detention?

Detention is the charge applicable, after the free time expires, for the use of the carrier’s full container inside the marine terminal, railroad facilities or container yard.

What is demurrage?

Demurrage is the charge applicable, after the free time expires, inside the terminal for the use of the land.

What is Per Diem?

Per Diem is the charge applicable, after the free time expires, for the use of the carrier’s container (full or empty) outside the marine terminal, rail ramp or container yard.

Share
Link copied!

SOLAS VGM information

What is VGM?

Verified Gross Mass or VGM refers to the exact, verified weight of a packed container. For safety reasons, vessel operators can only load a container if its weight has been verified.

Government approval status

Terminal (DPW + KICT) will accept container at Gates without VGM, terminal will weigh the container after gate in as per shipper request and send VGM to Carrier.

Method 2 subject to certification by government.

All four provinces of Pakistan are enforced by Ordinance or Acts. It is responsibility of weighing instrument operator to ensure that equipment has a maintenance procedure, calibration and records are kept as laid down in Ordinance / Act.

MSC Pakistan is contemplating penalties beyond tolerance level usd150 upto 3 tons, usd300 upto 3-5 tons, usd500 upto 5 tons and above per container.

Govt will impose penalties on mis declaration on the basis of regulation as per Merchant Shipping Ordinance 2001 .

Threshold +/- 5% of VGM of a container.

The authority in charge for Solas implementation is Directorate General Ports & Shipping (DGP&S)

What to include in your VGM instructions

The following items are mandatory and must be on all VGM instructions.

Booking or Bill of Lading number

Container number

VGM + unit

Authorized person’s signatory (submitter of the VGM who may be authorized to act on behalf of shippers

Responsible party Name

How to submit your VGM instructions

EDI (via INTTRA)

Standard shipping instruction signed.

Deadlines for sending your VGM instructions

VGM cut-off will be separately advised by MSC Pakistan for each vessel.

VGM cut-off different from Documentation & container cut off.

Admin Fees and costs

There are no administration charges imposed by MSC for the moment. Should there be any fees we will share with you.

Extra costs for failing to timely provide VGM as per

Carrier’s VGM cut-off shall be the Actual Cost incurred at terminal for additional handling of the units + penalty for late submission

Recommendations

From Governments procedures shipper must keep the VGM records

MSC Pakistan should be informed in advance about the appointment of 3rd parties to provide the VGM.

Terminal (DPW + KICT)  will gate in and weigh as per shipper request and send VGM to Carrier.

Prohibited & Restricted Goods

Free Importation and Exportation – Refers to goods that may be freely imported into and exported from the Philippines without the need for import and export permits, clearances or licenses, unless otherwise provided by law or regulation. (Chapter 3, Section 116 CMTA)

Regulated Importation and Exportation – Goods which are subject to regulation shall be imported or exported only after securing the necessary goods declaration, clearances, licenses, and any other requirements, prior to importation. In case of importation, submission of requirements after arrival of the goods, but prior to release from customs custody shall be allowed, but only in cases provided for by governing laws or regulations. (Chapter 3, Section 117 CMTA). For the list of regulated goods and their administering agencies, you may visit the Philippine National Trade Repository (PNTR).

Restricted Importation and Exportation – Except when authorized by law or regulation, the importation and exportation of the following restricted goods are prohibited: (Chapter 3, Section 119 CMTA)

Dynamite, gunpowder, ammunitions and other explosives, firearms and weapons of war, or parts thereof;

Roulette wheels, gambling outfits, loaded dice, marked cards, machines, apparatus or mechanical devices used in gambling or the distribution of money, cigars, cigarettes or other goods when such distribution is dependent on chance, including jackpot and pinball machines or similar contrivances, or parts thereof;

Lottery and sweepstakes tickets, except advertisements thereof, and lists of drawings therein;

Marijuana, opium, poppies, coca leaves, heroin or other narcotics or synthetic drugs which are or may hereafter be declared habit forming by the President of the Philippines, or any compound, manufactured salt, derivative, or preparation thereof, except when imported by the government of the Philippines or any person duly authorized by the Dangerous Drugs Board, for medicinal purposes;

Opium pipes or parts thereof, of whatever material;

Any other goods whose importation and exportation are restricted;

Weapons of mass destruction and goods included in the national Strategic Goods list (NSGL) as provided under Republic Act No. 10697 or the Strategic Trade Management Act (STMA);

Toxic and hazardous goods under Republic Act No. 6969 or the “Toxic Substances and hazardous and Nuclear Wastes Control Act of 1990.”

The restriction to import or export the above stated goods shall include the restriction on their transit.

Prohibited Importation and Exportation – the importation and exportation of the following goods are prohibited: (Chapter 3, Section 118 CMTA)

Written or printed goods in any form containing any matter advocating or inciting treason, rebellion, insurrection, sedition against the government of the Philippines, or forcible resistance to any law of the Philippines, or written or printed goods containing any threat to take the life of, or inflict bodily harm upon any person in the Philippines;

Goods, instruments, drugs and substances designed, intended or adapted for producing unlawful abortion, or any printed matter which advertises, describes or gives direct or indirect information where, how or by whom unlawful abortion is committed;

Written or printed goods, negatives or cinematographic films, photographs, engravings, lithographs, objects, paintings, drawings or other representation of an obscene or immoral character;

Any goods manufactured in whole or in part of gold, silver or other precious metals or alloys and the stamp, brand or mark does not indicate the actual fineness of quality of the metals or alloy;

Any adulterated or misbranded food or goods for human consumption or any adulterated or misbranded drug in violation of relevant laws and regulations;

Infringing goods as defined under the Intellectual Property Code and related laws; and

All other goods or parts thereof which importation are explicitly prohibited by law or rules and regulations issued by the competent authority.

Philippine National Trade Repository (PNTR)

Taking Your Supply Chain Logistics Further

Protecting Your Cargo From the Philippines and Beyond

Cargo transportation does not come without risks, and you need coverage beyond basic. Whether your goods are transported by land, or by air and at sea, we are here for you, and you can rest assured you are fully covered with MSC Extended Protection Solution. We offer you the widest possible coverage for maritime and inland transportation to ease your mind and protect your supply chain.

Contact Us

Intermodal Transportation & Haulage Solutions

Our extensive intermodal network ensures that every container is handled with care, connecting you to bustling commercial hubs worldwide. Whether you're shipping a single container or managing a complex logistics operation, we provide you with comprehensive support across road, rail, river and other waterway networks.

Contact Us

Ship More Efficiently with Electronic Bill of Lading

Meet the Electronic Bill of Lading (eBL) — This innovative digital document mirrors the functions of the traditional paper B/L while enhancing security and efficiency. With instantaneous transfer among parties, the risks of loss or forgery are virtually eliminated. It guarantees your rights to the cargo with unparalleled control and peace of mind.

Contact Us

Monitor Refrigerated Cargo in Real-Time with MSC iReefer

With MSC iReefer, you get real-time visibility into your shipment’s position, temperature, humidity, and overall journey, helping you prevent losses and optimize efficiency. Our remote tracking and monitoring solution puts you in full control of your refrigerated cargo shipment — to act swiftly and prevent potential losses before they occur. Seamless reefer cargo management is made much easier.

Contact Us

Biofuel Solution — From Ambition to Action

MSC Biofuel Solution is MSC's first certified carbon insetting programme designed to reduce CO2 emissions along your supply chain and within our own operations. Moving from ambition to concrete action is a “win-win” approach: we bunker sustainable biofuel, and our customers reap the CO2 savings. Let’s navigate our journey to net zero, together.

Contact Us

Thermal Liner for Cargo Protection

The Thermal Liner solution is designed to protect sensitive cargo from temperature, moisture and condensation changes or contamination that may cause damage to your products. The solution helps to maintain a stable environment throughout transportation and is ideal for shipping commodities like corn, dried fruit and nuts, salt, sugar, rice and more.

Gateway to Global Trade:

Shipping Excellence in Singapore

Inaugurated in 1996, the Asia Regional Office (ARO) in Singapore marks MSC’s earliest footprint in Asia. We connect people and markets, providing coordination and leadership across a network of offices across the region. The establishment of the MSC Singapore agency office in 2000 further strengthened our presence to serve the Singapore import and export markets — anchoring our transshipment capabilities to facilitate global trade flows across East-West corridors.

In 2025, MSC supported the transshipment of 8.7 million TEUs at Singapore Port. In addition, through TiL (Terminal Investment Limited), MSC is a joint venture partner in MSC PSA Asia Terminal (MPAT). As of 2026, MSC has 10 berths, with PSA responsible for the terminal's day-to-day management and operations. As we continue to reinforce Singapore’s role as a key pillar in global trade, we are committed to building long-term value for our customers and partners through an integrated logistics ecosystem.

"Every region needs a heartbeat. For MSC in Asia, that heartbeat has been in Singapore since 1996. As MSC's regional hub, we connect key markets across Asia, support our agencies in achieving operational excellence, and strengthen collaboration across our network. Together, we play an important role in enabling trade, creating opportunities, and delivering long-term value for the customers and communities we serve."

Grace Chia

Managing Director, MSC Asia Regional Office

Singapore SOLAS VGM Information

Government approval status

Further to the MPA industry consultation on the amendment to the SOLAS Convention Chapter VI Regulation 2, various parties in the maritime community comprising of MPA, SSA, PSA, SNSC, SLA, CDAS and main shipping lines have agreed to the following:

VGM to be submitted to Portnet via Electronic Shipping Note (ESN) by Haulier who will obtain information from Shipper.

VGM to be submitted prior to gate-in, per PSA Terminal’s cut-off time

Container would be denied entry at the gate if there was a 5 tons variance between declared VGM and the weight derived by the terminal operator.

For containers that are allowed entry, further verification will be made.

Tolerance of +/- 5% against declared VGM will be accepted for stowage planning.

If exceeding 5%, Haulier/Shipper needs to reconfirm weight to be used as VGM.  This will be alerted in real-time to Shipper/Haulier by Terminal Operator.

Based on above VGM verification, Terminal Operator will use the VGM for stowage planning.

How to submit your VGM instructions

All VGM is required to be submitted through the PSA Portnet.

What to include in your VGM ESN instructions to Portnet

The following items are mandatory and must be on all VGM instructions to Terminal

Booking Number / UCR Number

Container number

VGM – Verified Gross Mass

Weighing Method

Authorized person’s signatory (submitter of the VGM who may be authorized to act on behalf of shippers

VGM acquired time (Optional)

VGM reference (Optional)

Deadlines for sending your VGM instructions

VGM cut off = PSA Portnet cut-off time.

VGM Fees and Costs

For VGM discrepancy of +/- 5% between VGM declared and manifest, there will be VGM discrepancy fees imposed by MSC Singapore.

MSC Container Design Contest Singapore

Join the Contest: Turn your Container into a Canvas of Possibilities

As MSC commemorates 30 Years of Excellence in Singapore, we celebrate not only our growth as a team but also Singapore’s remarkable journey as a global maritime and logistics hub. Over the past three decades, MSC has been privileged to be part of Singapore’s transformation — supporting its port development, embracing innovation alongside the nation, and contributing to the maritime ecosystem that continues to drive global trade today. This provides an opportunity to reflect on how far we have come together, while looking ahead to the next chapter of collaboration, innovation, and shared progress.

In celebration of our 30 Years of Excellence milestone, MSC Asia Regional Office & MSC Singapore is pleased to invite the general public, our esteemed partners, and MSC staff (all participants must be based in Singapore) to design a commemorative container that reflects our shared heritage, values, and vision for the future.

Vote for your favourite Container Design

Explore the Top 3 shortlisted designs and cast your vote for the design that best reflects MSC 30 Years of Excellence in Singapore. Update (as of 4 September): Voting period for the contest has now closed.

Vote Now

Create a design inspired by any of the following themes

Theme 1: Our Past – 30 Years of Legacy

Celebrate Singapore’s development and MSC’s journey by incorporating:

National landmarks

Historical figures or notable events

Key maritime or port milestones

MSC’s evolution and longstanding partnership with Singapore

(Image credit: Wikimedia Commons)

Theme 2: Our Present – Singapore Today

Reflect modern Singapore by showcasing:

Multicultural harmony

Innovation and technology

Maritime excellence

The pioneering spirit of the nation

(Image credit: Wikimedia Commons)

Theme 3: Our Future – Vision for the Next 30 to 50 Years

Imagine the Singapore of tomorrow by exploring:

Futuristic skylines and infrastructure

Sustainability and green shipping

Aspirational concepts for future generations

The next chapter of MSC in Singapore

(Image credit: Wikimedia Commons)

Contest Structure and
Participation Details

Key Dates

Kindly refer to the key dates of the contest below.

Contest Period

15 July – 14 August 2026

Judging & Evaluation Period

17 August – 21 August 2026

Winner Notification

By 4 September 2026

Award Ceremony

Mid September 2026

Share
Link copied!

Judging Criteria

A panel of five (5) judges appointed by Mediterranean Shipping Co. (Switzerland) Asia Regional Office Pte Ltd (Management Team) will review all submissions and select the Top 3 designs. The judges will evaluate according to the criteria below:

Judging Criteria (weighted):

Creativity & originality: 30%

Relevance to theme & brand fit: 30%

Visual impact & scalability for container wrap: 30%

Technical quality & print feasibility: 10%

Once the Top 3 designs have been selected, they will be featured on this page for public voting. The design that receives the highest number of votes will be crowned the winning design.

Share
Link copied!

Guidelines for Artwork Submission

All artwork(s) must be original and abide to the competition theme.

Residency Requirement: Participants must be Singapore Citizens, Permanent Residents, or valid pass holders (e.g., Employment Pass, S Pass, Student Pass, Dependant’s Pass) residing in Singapore.

Artwork(s) can be created in any medium (painting, drawing, photography, calligraphy etc).

Artwork must be submitted in digital format (High-res PDF/JPG/PNG (min 300 DPI)) through the link: Submit Your Artwork

Participants are responsible for the image(s) resolution and artwork(s) will be judged according to image quality.

NO explicit language or offensive material allowed. MSC reserves the right to practice full discretion in refusal of any artwork deemed inappropriate or outside the competition parameters.

Any artwork found not to be original or that infringes the rights of any third party, including but not limited to copyright, trademarks, trade secrets, privacy, publicity, personal, confidentiality or proprietary rights, will be disqualified.

In the event of a disqualification, MSC will select an alternative winner using a similar Judging Criteria.

All entries must be submitted before 14 August 2026, 2359 (Singapore Local Time). Submissions thereafter will not be accepted.

The winning design from this contest will be transformed into a full-scale sticker decal and applied onto an actual MSC container. Launching in September 2026, this one-of-a-kind container will be showcased for 3 months and deployed in real operations across MSC’s shipping network.

Here’s a look at the winning design from our inaugural 2019 contest, held in celebration of the Singapore Bicentennial.

In addition, the winner will receive an exclusive MSC container model and a premium notebook, both customized with the winning design.

MSC Extended Protection for Singapore

Comprehensive Coverage for Your Singapore-Bound Cargo

We understand that even the most carefully planned shipments to Singapore can face unexpected risks. MSC’s Extended Protection helps protect your cargo’s value against damage, theft, or loss. Offering straightforward global coverage and a fast, simplified claims process, you can have peace of mind shipping when shipping high-value goods. From origin to destination, choose to have extra reassurance and strengthen your cargo’s risk management.

One-stop-shop approach

Widest possible cargo protection

Easy pricing procedure

Unique point of contact for your claims

Comprehensive Coverage

MSC Extended Protection can be applied to both spot and volume shipments. Our solution is available for a wide range of cargo categories carried by MSC in dry and reefer containers, for a large number of destinations worldwide.

Easy Claims Process

MSC Extended Protection can be added to your booking on myMSC at the summary stage of your eBooking.

When submitting your cargo claims, MSC will take care and handle your claims directly. We aim to conclude all Extended Protection claims within a 30 working-day average period, running from the submission of your completed file.

Singapore Digital Business Solutions

Unlocking Efficiency Across Every Shipping Journey

Digitalization is reshaping decision-making across logistics supply chains. Being widely recognized as a “smart maritime nation”, Singapore has set the benchmark for future-ready shipping with smart ports, automation, and intelligent systems. Similarly, at MSC Singapore, we empower our customers to gain a competitive advantage with our robust portfolio of digital solutions. These include eBL (electronic bill of lading), myMSC platform, iReefer and more. Designed to ensure smoother coordination, customers benefit from enhanced operational efficiency and better control across every shipment.

Availability 24/7

Time-Saving

Cost-Saving

API

Improved Cargo Security

Worldwide Traceability

Simpler, Faster and Safer

Transitioning to MSC’s electronic Bill of Lading (eBL) benefits you by:

Simplifying document handling across your supply chain by eliminating the need for physical originals.

Securing online processing allows bills to be managed in just a few clicks, improving both efficiency and security.

Through the myMSC platform, quickly identify the best sailing options, get competitive rate quotations, and streamline your shipment planning.

Real-time Tracking and Insights

When it comes to moving cold cargo, it’s about understanding its condition at every moment. iReefer provides:

Continuous visibility into your cold cargo’s temperature, humidity, and location throughout its journey.

Deeper insights into the real-time condition of your shipment, whether it is on land or at sea.

Seamless integration with myMSC. Supported by API connectivity, iReefer delivers a smooth digital experience that helps improve operational efficiency.

Singapore Intermodal Transportation

Ensuring Smooth First and Last-Mile Connectivity

As a global logistics gateway, Singapore relies on intermodal transportation to seamlessly connect cargo with distribution networks. By integrating sea and inland transportation, our comprehensive solution enables you to have better control and visibility on your supply chain movements. Whether its retail items, food & beverages, pharmaceuticals, automotive, or other commodities, MSC’s tailored landside transport solution streamlines door-to-door delivery, helping you save both time and costs for your business.

Extensive Coverage in Singapore

Integrated Network

End-to-End Solutions

Dedicated Customer Support

Reliable Trucking Services

Going beyond ocean freight, our trucking solution connects your cargo to any destination across the island. Whether moving containers from port to warehouses, factories, or retail outlets, our trucking network delivers cargo reliably. We partner with trusted trucking operators across Singapore and Malaysia to ensure seamless first and last‑mile connectivity.

Regular Barge Connections to Batam

Our reliable barge service provides a cost-effective link between Singapore and Batu Ampar Port in Batam, Indonesia. As part of MSC’s integrated logistics solution, this service is designed to complement our global ocean network, ensuring smooth cargo movement for businesses operating across the Singapore–Batam corridor.

Dedicated Customer Support

Our local team in Singapore is committed to providing quick response and tailored solutions for urgent or complex inland requirements. Count on us to deliver your cargo with confidence.

Singapore Liquid Cargo Solutions

Streamlining Liquid Cargo Movement

Singapore imports a steady volume of liquid food commodities for local consumption and regional redistribution. These include edible oils, alcoholic beverages, fruit juices and concentrates, non-hazardous chemicals for industrial uses and more. Flexibags are designed to transport liquid cargo in bulk inside standard containers in a safe and efficient manner. From loading to delivery, MSC Singapore offer reliable support every step of the way, helping you streamline operations and reduce risk across your liquid supply chain.

Top-quality equipment

Intermodal transportation

Dedicated Team of Experts

Flexibag Equipment and Expertise

We work with an accredited supplier to provide the highest quality of flexibags. Our in-house experts carefully fit and secure each one at our dedicated fitting stations, using our own modern equipment. This means that there is less chance that your cargo could be spilled or contaminated during the loading process.

End-to-End Efficiency for your Liquid Supply Chain

A further advantage of shipping liquid freight with MSC is our end-to-end supply chains. By choosing MSC liquid cargo solutions, you can speed up your supply chain. This results in greater efficiency, lower costs, and reduced road miles.

Gateway to Global Trade:

Shipping Excellence in Singapore

Inaugurated in 1996, the Asia Regional Office (ARO) in Singapore marks MSC’s earliest footprint in Asia. We connect people and markets, providing coordination and leadership across a network of offices across the region. The establishment of the MSC Singapore agency office in 2000 further strengthened our presence to serve the Singapore import and export markets — anchoring our transshipment capabilities to facilitate global trade flows across East-West corridors.

In 2025, MSC supported the transshipment of 8.7 million TEUs at Singapore Port. In addition, through TiL (Terminal Investment Limited), MSC is a joint venture partner in MSC PSA Asia Terminal (MPAT). As of 2026, MSC has 10 berths, with PSA responsible for the terminal's day-to-day management and operations. As we continue to reinforce Singapore’s role as a key pillar in global trade, we are committed to building long-term value for our customers and partners through an integrated logistics ecosystem.

"Every region needs a heartbeat. For MSC in Asia, that heartbeat has been in Singapore since 1996. As MSC's regional hub, we connect key markets across Asia, support our agencies in achieving operational excellence, and strengthen collaboration across our network. Together, we play an important role in enabling trade, creating opportunities, and delivering long-term value for the customers and communities we serve."

Grace Chia

Managing Director, MSC Asia Regional Office

Singapore SOLAS VGM Information

Government approval status

Further to the MPA industry consultation on the amendment to the SOLAS Convention Chapter VI Regulation 2, various parties in the maritime community comprising of MPA, SSA, PSA, SNSC, SLA, CDAS and main shipping lines have agreed to the following:

VGM to be submitted to Portnet via Electronic Shipping Note (ESN) by Haulier who will obtain information from Shipper.

VGM to be submitted prior to gate-in, per PSA Terminal’s cut-off time

Container would be denied entry at the gate if there was a 5 tons variance between declared VGM and the weight derived by the terminal operator.

For containers that are allowed entry, further verification will be made.

Tolerance of +/- 5% against declared VGM will be accepted for stowage planning.

If exceeding 5%, Haulier/Shipper needs to reconfirm weight to be used as VGM.  This will be alerted in real-time to Shipper/Haulier by Terminal Operator.

Based on above VGM verification, Terminal Operator will use the VGM for stowage planning.

How to submit your VGM instructions

All VGM is required to be submitted through the PSA Portnet.

What to include in your VGM ESN instructions to Portnet

The following items are mandatory and must be on all VGM instructions to Terminal

Booking Number / UCR Number

Container number

VGM – Verified Gross Mass

Weighing Method

Authorized person’s signatory (submitter of the VGM who may be authorized to act on behalf of shippers

VGM acquired time (Optional)

VGM reference (Optional)

Deadlines for sending your VGM instructions

VGM cut off = PSA Portnet cut-off time.

VGM Fees and Costs

For VGM discrepancy of +/- 5% between VGM declared and manifest, there will be VGM discrepancy fees imposed by MSC Singapore.

- RF DG cargoes are not available to store at terminals in KOREA. Therefore, direct delivery is required for both import and export.

*For T/S cargo ( via BUSAN )*

- T/S cargo including IMCO 1, 6.2 & 7 is strictly not allowed.

- Because T/S cargo of IMO 2 / Reefer DG are not allowed to be stored at terminal, Additional local cost is incurred in Busan, in accordance with Pusan Port Authority

Detention, demurrage, Per Diem and storage charges

What is detention?

Detention is the charge applicable, after the free time expires, for the use of the carrier’s full container inside the marine terminal until the empty is handed over to the designated MSC depot. This charge can also apply while the container is undergoing customs inspections, or while the cargo inside the container is being reworked for safety reasons.

What are storage charges?

Terminal storage charge is applicable, after the free time expires, for containers left inside the terminal. These charges need to be settled directly to the terminal based on their published tariff. If the containers are abandoned, the line will be responsible for the storage charges.

Share
Link copied!

SOLAS VGM information

What is VGM?

Verified Gross Mass or VGM refers to the exact, verified weight of a packed container. For safety reasons, vessel operators can only load a container if its weight has been verified.

In line with SOLAS (Safety of Lives at Sea) regulations, all marine terminals in SL are now allowed to use their certified scales to record Verified Gross Mass (VGM) of shipments.

Government approval status

The Director General Merchant Shipping of Sri Lanka (DGMS) under Ministry of Ports & Shipping is the sole regulating authority of VGM in Sri Lanka.

Accepted Tolerance

The threshold for gross container weight tolerance will be 5% (+/-) or 01 Ton (+/-) per declared weight as mentioned in the VGM certificate. Container exceeding the threshold is not allowed to load on the vessel.

Terminal Gates will be checking VGM certificate when Container entering to Terminal stack.

No container will be accepted to vessel stack without having valid VGM after 01st of July 2016.

How to submit your VGM instructions

myMSC – customer can upload VGM data and PDF file of the VGM certificate.

Deadlines for sending VGM the instructions

Based on the standard CY cut off 12 hours prior vessel Berthing would be the VGM cut-off for none-EU cargo.

Containers arriving or VGM submitting after 12 hours cut-off would not be loaded on vessel. EU cargo , VGM cut-off is BL Draft. Submission weight declared at the time of cut-off should capture when transmitting manifest for EU cargo.

MSC admin fees and costs

Weight amendment fee: USD 25/- per container.

Incorrect weight declaration above 1 mt USD 25/- per container.

Manual submission of VGM USD 15/- per container.

Recommendations

As per DGMS, we will keep all the VGM certificates under our custody.

Submission of VGM certificate dully signed by shipper is mandatory requirement.

In case of container shut-out or additional expenses at Terminal due to VGM issue, shipper is responsible for all the additional costs

Storage, Demurrage and Road Limitations

What is storage?

Storage is the charge applicable, after the free time expires, inside the terminal for the use of the land. The charge applies while laden discharging to pick up or gate in full till loading.

What is demurrage?

Demurrage is the charge applicable, after the free time expires, for use carrier’s container. The charge applies while laden discharging to empty return or pick up empty till Performa sailing date.

For storage and demurrage charges, please log into your myMSC account.

Road Limitation regulation of transportation

for CY services

Dry :20’ & 40’ (container tare weight + cargo weight + lashing…)<28.5T

Reefer: 20’ & 40’ (container tare weight + cargo weight + lashing…)<27.5T

For Door services

Dry:

20’(container tare weight + cargo weight + lashing…)<20.5T

40’(container tare weight + cargo weight + lashing…)<28.5T

Reefer:

20’(container tare weight + cargo weight + lashing…)<19.5T

40’(container tare weight + cargo weight + lashing…)<27.5T

Pls kindly note:

The above is also subject to the safety payload of the equipment.

For overweight shipments, trucker cannot handle the trucking at POD. POL shall be liable for all penalty & costs arising and recover from shipper accordingly.

Prohibited Goods and Restricted Goods

Prohibited Goods

Prohibited Goods are goods for which either the import into or export out of Thailand are prohibited. Any person imports or exports prohibited goods is considered as committing offences and subject to penalties indicated in the relevant national legislation. In addition, such activity is also considered as an offence under Section 244 and 246 of the Customs Act B.E. 2560. It is prohibited by law to bring the following items into or out of Thailand.

Obscene objects/literature/pictures

Pornographic materials

Goods with Thai national flag

Narcotics e.g., marijuana, hemp, opium, cocaine, morphine, heroin

Fake currency, bonds, or coins

Fake Royal Seals/official seals

Pirated copyright goods e.g. musical tape, CD, VDO, computer software, etc.

Counterfeit trademark goods

Used sedan bodies and use motorcycle frame designated is not allowed in Thailand Import of used tires is not allowed in Thailand except for the following cases; Importing used tires for any kind of research or as sample product or as wheels for import vehicles within a certain limit of quantity as necessity required. Importing used tires as spare tires for Motor Racing or Travelling programs.

Imports of used motorcycles and parts, household refrigerators using CFCs, refurbished medical devices, gaming machines, and computer peripherals are prohibited.

Restricted goods

Restricted goods are goods of which the imports and exports are restricted by law and therefore require a permit from related government agencies. The permit must be presented during Customs formalities. Examples of restricted goods are as follows:

Taking Your Supply Chain Logistics Further

eBL for Faster & Simpler Shipping

The electronic bill of lading (eBL) is an original electronic document which offers a more efficient, secure, and sustainable alternative to a complex and costly process. It has the same legal value and replicates the functions of an original BL in paper, but electronically. No more paperwork, postage costs, delays or disruptions to move physically important trade documents between exporters, shipping agents, banks, importers and other parties.

Contact Us

Less costly

Faster, simpler data sharing

Smart Containers for Better Visibility

We know that being able to track and monitor your shipment remotely helps you to plan. That's why we offer MSC smart containers for all types of dry cargo.

We equip dry units with internet connected devices that collect data such as position, temperature and door opening in real-time – helping you to make the right decisions at the right moment.

24/7 visibility of your cargo

Protecting Your Cargo From Thailand and Beyond

Cargo transportation does not come without risks, and you need coverage beyond basic. Whether your goods are transported by land, or by air and at sea, we are here for you, and you can rest assured you are fully covered with MSC Cargo Insurance.

We offer you a tailor-made insurance solution with the widest possible coverage for maritime and inland transportation to ease your mind and protect your supply chain.

Value Added Solutions

Taking Your Supply Chain Logistics Further

Vietnam is growing fast as a major manufacturing and export hub. As more businesses develop their supply chains, we understand that customers need more than the standard port-to-port shipping.

Whether it’s coffee, garments, footwear, seafood, rice, charcoal, or other top commodities exported by Vietnamese businesses, our locally offered Value Added Solutions helps you streamline logistics and stay competitive in the global market.

Barlock Solution to Keep Your Cargo Safe

Safeguard your cargo from the risk of theft or tampering in transit with our innovative Barlock solution. Whether you’re transporting coffee, electronic devices or other high-value goods, this single-use steel locking bar adds another layer of safety and security to containers, deterring unauthorized access and helping to guarantee the secure transportation of goods. Download the MSC Barlock Flyer.

Ask Us About Barlock Solution

Smart Containers for Better Visibility

We know that being able to track and monitor your shipment remotely helps you to plan. That's why we offer MSC Smart Containers for all types of dry cargo. We equip dry units with internet connected devices that collect data such as position, temperature and door opening in real-time – helping you to make the right decisions at the right moment.

Ask Us about Smart Containers

Garment-on-hanger (GOH) to Save Time and Labour Transporting Clothing

If you ship clothing or textiles, you'll know that garment racks help to keep items in top condition and avoid creasing during transit. These specially designed hangers can also help to reduce packaging.

At MSC, we offer an efficient and competitive garment rack installation and removal service. Contact us to find out more.

Ask Us About GOH

Thermal Blanket for Cargo Protection

Protect your cargo from various types of damage caused by temperature fluctuations, moisture build-up and contamination. Through extensive material testing and development, we have created the Thermal Blanket solution that retains the high quality of cargo during transit and delivery, for both long and short haul journeys. Download the MSC Thermal Blanket Flyer.

Ask Us About Thermal Blanket

Liquid Cargo in Flexi-bags

Streamline your liquid supply chain with MSC's complete fit & supply flexi-bag solution for door-to-door deliveries. Flexi-bags allow you to fill dry containers with up to 24,000 litres of liquid or non-hazardous chemicals, offering a safe, cost-effective and eco-friendly alternative to traditional liquid transportation methods, such as ISO tank containers.

Our team of in-house forestry experts enables us to provide dedicated cargo fumigation services for the seamless shipment of wood. As a specialist in log shipments, including a long track record of shipping wood, we provide tailored support for all of our customers.

Whether your goods are transported by land, or by air and at sea, we are here for you, and you can rest assured you are fully covered with MSC Cargo Cover Solution. Our presence across Europe gives us insight into the unique requirements of the European market. This means that not only are all our services (including enhanced offerings such as the Dragon Service) designed for our customers, but they leverage on our local knowledge to ensure the most successful outcomes for companies shipping to and from Europe.

Our key services include:

Strong intermodal offering (road, rail, barge)

In-house experts

Significant Ports in Europe

As well as offering numerous services (such as our Transatlantic shipping services) that connect Europe with many countries, we pride ourselves on our presence across all the major hub European ports, including:

The Port of Antwerp:

One of the most significant ports in Europe is the Port of Antwerp. Its strategic position makes it an ideal gateway for goods entering or leaving the continent, and a key point for businesses looking to trade on a global scale.

Gioia Tauro:

Located in Southern Italy, Gioia Tauro serves as a gateway to Southern Europe. As a transshipment hub, this is a pivotal stage in numerous global supply chains and helps facilitate the flow of goods between Europe, Asia, Africa, and the Americas.

This approach helps us facilitate efficient global trade and connect European businesses with continents around the world.

Importing or Exporting: European Trade Routes

As it plays a crucial role in numerous trade deals and global supply chains, goods and services need to be shipped to Europe or from the continent as quickly and efficiently as possible. As different trades require different journeys, we use as many different shipping routes as possible for our European shipping solutions.

One of the many trade routes offered by MSC is our Short Sea Network, which aims to use ocean transportation as much as possible during shipping freight within Europe. Not only can this help reduce your carbon footprint, but also minimizes bottlenecks and enables you to expand your capabilities as a business.

For businesses shipping from Europe, our transatlantic shipping services are designed to deliver at scale and speed. Whether you need to connect with Canada, the USA, or Mexico, with 15 dedicated services our team will be able to deliver the best solution for your business.

Equally, our East-West Network makes shipping to Europe even more reliable. Offering access to more ports and with a greater number of weekly departures, you’ll have the opportunity to access the European markets with ease.

European Supply Chain Management Practices

Ensuring that your supply chain is agile and flexible is a vital part of enabling successful cargo shipping to and from Europe. This means you can quickly adjust to changes in demand, avoid bottlenecks and ultimately stay ahead of your competitors. Equally, having good communication throughout your supply chain also makes it easier to respond to changes or challenges quickly and enables a seamless flow of information and goods from the start of their journey to their final destination.

Working with MSC as your European shipping partner means that you’ll be working with local experts who understand the intricacies of shipping to and from Europe successfully. You’ll also have access to our ocean and intermodal transportation solutions, along with our dedicated warehouses and storage solutions all of which combines to allow you to optimize your supply chain as effectively as possible.

Detention and demurrage in France

What is Demurrage & Detention?

Demurrage & Detention is the charge applicable, after the free time expires, for the use of the carrier’s full container.

At Export

The period of freetime starts as of the day of empty container release and ends the day of the commercial proforma date – ETA (Estimated Time of Arrival) communicated during your booking – of selected vessel. If the loading vessel changes upon customer’s request, the application the application period begins when the empty equipment is picked-up and stops the day of loading on board vessel.

At Import

The period of freetime starts as of the day of discharge from the vessel at terminal and ends the day of the empty container drop off.

Share
Link copied!

SOLAS VGM information

What is VGM?

Verified Gross Mass or VGM refers to the exact, verified weight of a packed container. For safety reasons, vessel operators can only load a container if its weight has been verified.

Government approval status

The French government has published, since May 28, 2016, a decree outlining the verified gross mass (VGM) requirements for containers, which can be determined using two calculation methods.

What to include in your VGM instructions

The following items are mandatory and must be in all VGM instructions :

Booking number or B/L number

The container number

The VGM in kg

The name of the responsible person in capital letters, as electronic equivalent of the signature

How to submit your VGM instructions

myMSC.com

EDI (via INTTRA, GT NEXUS, Cargo Smart, and any other portal)

Email (subject to a service charge)

Deadlines for sending your VGM instructions

The VGM must be known by the shipping agent before the vessel’s cut-off time or before entry to the terminal, depending on the port.

The VGM cut-off date will be mentioned on the booking confirmation. If the VGM is received later, the container will not be planned / loaded on the vessel.

Admin Fees and costs

If the VGM has to be handled manually by the local agent, a local fee of 100€ per container will be applied. This also applies for VGM info added in the electronic booking.

If the VGM is not received before the VGM cut-off time, the container will not be loaded onto the requested vessel and will be put on hold. All related charges, such as demurrage, storage, terminal moves, potential power supply, etc., will be at the shipper’s expense.

If the VGM declaration is wrong after loading on board, a penalty will occured of 1000€ per container, extracost and collateral expenses will be invoiced.

Automotive Shipping Solutions

At MSC France, we fully understand the requirements and challenges of the automotive industry.

That is why we have established dedicated teams made up of experts from this very sector, to support our customers at every stage of their supply chain. Whether it involves automotive parts, international tenders, the stuffing and unstuffing of new vehicles in our French ports, or the transport of used cars, we have the resources needed to meet your requirements. With the largest shipping fleet in the world and tailor-made, end-to-end logistics solutions, MSC France is your trusted partner for automotive transport.

"
Today, our automotive customers are looking for reliability, visibility, and a tangible environmental commitment. Thanks to our global network and containerised solutions, we deliver exactly that: a controlled, seamless, and sustainable supply chain.
"

Vincent Charollais
Business Development Manager -  Automotive

Vehicle Loading & Unloading

In Le Havre, we handle the stuffing and unstuffing of thousands of vehicles using specially designed racks. These racks allow up to four cars per container, with three being standard. Without racks, two vehicles or light commercial vehicles can be loaded into a 40HC container. Our teams ensure every shipment is handled safely and efficiently.

Global Network & Destination Reach

The vehicle loading and unloading process can be replicated in other French ports, supported by our extensive global network. We organise stuffing and unstuffing operations to and from any origin or destination. Whatever your needs, MSC France provides the right solution to ensure reliable and seamless vehicle transport.

Driving More Sustainable Supply Chains

As the automotive industry accelerates its transition towards greener models, MSC France supports this shift by providing logistics solutions that are efficient, flexible, and responsible. Our containerised approach represents a genuine alternative to traditional roll-on/roll-off (Ro-Ro) transport, combining operational performance with a reduced carbon footprint:

Optimised capacity: up to four vehicles can be loaded into a single container using our specially designed racks, reducing the total number of shipments.

Fewer road journeys: our vast network of MSC ports, often located closer to production or distribution sites, helps to minimise road mileage.

Lower emissions per vehicle: increased loading density and integration into intermodal supply chains (rail, barge) contribute to more sustainable logistics.

Through this approach, we offer the automotive sector reliable, agile, and environmentally responsible solutions, supporting the sustainable transformation of the entire industry.

Comprehensive Automotive Parts
Transport

At MSC France, we manage the containerised transport of millions of automotive parts for manufacturers and equipment suppliers. From mechanical components and body parts to tyres and electronic systems, you benefit from the world’s largest maritime network. Our door-to-door solutions provide enhanced control over your supply chain, with optional tracking tools offering precise, real-time container visibility.

Reliable, Tailored Solutions

Aware of the challenges and risks of automotive logistics, we prioritise cargo linked to this sector. From spare parts to SKD shipments, MSC France delivers reliable, efficient, and industry-tailored solutions. Our expertise ensures that every shipment is handled safely and efficiently, supporting your operations with consistent, seamless, and fully integrated transport services worldwide.

Did you know?

While the traditional Roll On/Roll Off (Ro-Ro) mode remains dominant, several studies highlight an increasing adoption of containerisation for finished vehicles in 2025.

In other words: vehicle containerisation is no longer a niche, it is becoming a strategic option.

France East West Network

France | Far East

France | Transatlantic

Direct, Reliable & Fully Integrated Trade Solutions

MSC connects France to the Far East with a comprehensive network designed for both import and export flows.

Direct services, competitive transit times and strong inland connectivity ensure reliable access to key Asian markets. From main French gateways to a wide range of Asian ports, our solutions are built to support your supply chain performance.

Backed by our local expertise, customers benefit from speed, visibility, and operational consistency.

Direct Services to France

Optimised Transit Times

High Schedule Reliability

Integrated Inland Solutions

Service Guide Asia - North Europe

Service Guide Asia - Mediterranean

Direct Import Services from Asia

Le Havre is directly connected to Qingdao via the LION service, with MSC as the only carrier offering this call without transshipment, also covering key hubs such as Ningbo and Shanghai, ensuring fast and secure cargo flows.

In Southern France, Fos‑sur‑Mer is served through the JADE service, with wide Asian port coverage and consistent transit times.

Efficient Export Solutions to Far East

We support French exports to the Far East from Le Havre, Fos‑sur‑Mer, as well as secondary ports such as Montoir and Brest, with reliable port‑to‑port and door‑to‑door solutions managed from France.

Through LION, JADE and LYNX services, adapted to different supply chain needs, exporters gain direct access to China, South‑East Asia and East Asia, including Japan, South Korea and Taiwan.

Intermodal Connection

MSC France Far East services are fully connected to our inland network.

From Fos‑sur‑Mer, regular rail services link the port to Lyon, ensuring controlled inland transit times. Among others, barge solutions from the Paris region allow direct access to maritime services while reducing road dependency.

Discover our Intermodal Solutions

Operational Excellence

Our customers benefit from optimized terminal conditions (including D&D calculated from container discharge), improved planning, and greater visibility due to our network strength and local operational expertise. MSC France provides ongoing visibility, strong human support and close coordination across the entire transport chain.

Contact our local team

France – Far East Trade

Access detailed import and export information for the France–Far East trade, including services, port coverage and transit times.

Far East to France

Service Guide

Read more

France to Far East

Service Guide

Read more

Tailored Solutions Across the Atlantic

MSC connects France to North America through a strong Transatlantic network covering the US East Coast, Canada, the Gulf, the US West Coast and Mexico.

Direct services, competitive transit times, and multiple French gateways support both import and export flows. From Le Havre and Fos‑sur‑Mer, customers benefit from reliable connections, inland reach, and local expertise.

A network designed to support performance on strategic Transatlantic corridors.

Direct US and Canada services

Optimised Transit Times

Multiple French Gateway

Integrated Inland Connectivity

Service Guide Transatlantic

Direct Services to North America

MSC France offers direct Transatlantic services from Le Havre to the US East Coast, including Boston, Baltimore and Philadelphia. Through the NEUSEC2 and Canada Express services, we provide competitive transit times and some of the fastest import solutions from North America.

The direct Le Havre–Montreal connection further strengthens both import and export performance.

West Coast & Gulf Coverage
from France

From Fos‑sur‑Mer, we provide direct access to North America via dedicated services.
The California Express connects Fos to Los Angeles, Oakland, Seattle and Vancouver, offering a unique export solution from Southern France.
The Gulf is covered through direct calls to Veracruz, New Orleans and Mobile, supporting diversified Transatlantic supply chains.

Export & Import Solutions
with Inland Reach

Our Transatlantic services are fully connected to MSC France’s inland network.

Exports and imports benefit from rail and barge solutions linking Paris region, Rhône corridor and key industrial areas to Le Havre and Fos‑sur‑Mer.

This integration allows to control transit times and simplify cargo flows.

Discover our Inland Solutions

Valued-Added Solutions
& Tailored Equipment

Beyond Transatlantic transport, MSC offers value‑added solutions such as Smart Containers for cargo visibility and eBL to streamline documentation.

Customers also benefit from flexible equipment, including reefer or Breakbulk solutions, tailored to specific operational requirements.

eBL Solution

Simplifying Trade with eBills of Lading

MSC France offers the Electronic Bill of Lading (eBL), a secure and efficient way to manage your shipping documents digitally. This innovative solution reduces paperwork, accelerates processes, and ensures compliance with international standards. With eBL, you gain speed, security, and sustainability in your supply chain.

What is eBL?

The MSC eBL replaces traditional paper bills of lading with a fully digital version. It is legally recognized, secure, and easy to transfer between parties. By adopting eBL, businesses eliminate courier delays and reduce administrative costs, making global trade faster and more reliable.

How Does it Work?

The process is simple: the eBL is generated and transmitted through a secure digital platform. You can endorse, transfer, or surrender the document online in just a few clicks. This ensures full traceability and transparency, while maintaining the same legal validity as a paper bill of lading.

Why Choose eBL in France?

French exporters and importers benefit from faster document exchange and reduced carbon footprint. MSC France supports you with local expertise and global reach, ensuring smooth implementation. eBL is the future of shipping documentation : secure, efficient, and sustainable.

Fast

Secure

Sustainable

Compliant

Everything You Need to Know

Is eBL legally accepted in France?

Yes, MSC eBL complies with international standards and is recognized under French law. The eBL has the same legal value as a paper document.

Link copied!

How secure is the eBL platform?

It uses advanced encryption and authentication to protect your data and transactions. This innovation helps secure and simplify document exchanges between trading partners, thanks to a fully digital process.

Share
Link copied!

Can I switch from paper to eBL easily?

Absolutely. MSC France provides guidance and support for a seamless transition.

Share
Link copied!

How does eBL improve sustainability?

By eliminating paper documents and reducing courier transport, eBL significantly lowers carbon emissions. This digital process supports greener logistics and helps companies meet their environmental goals.

Looking to the Future

Our team is here to guide every client throughout the process, to achieve 100% of eBL target by 2030.

Food industry

Your Trusted Partner for Safe & Efficient Food Transport

MSC France is a trusted partner for manufacturers and distributors in the agri-food sector. Our tailored solutions ensure product safety, traceability, and freshness. Combining logistics expertise, local proximity, and a global port network, MSC France delivers optimised, compliant, and reliable supply chains, ensuring agility and efficiency at every stage, from producer to consumer.

MSC at SIAL Paris 2026

Following a successful first participation in 2024, MSC will be returning to SIAL Paris 2026, taking place from 17 to 21 October.

As one of the leading events for the food industry, SIAL Paris provides a great opportunity to connect with our customers and partners, share our expertise, and support their projects with solutions tailored to their specific challenges and ambitions.

See you soon at the fair!

Discover more

Managing Perishable Flows

MSC France ensures refrigerated transport and precise scheduling for all types of food products, both fresh and frozen. Our understanding of cold chain, combined with ventilated or refrigerated (reefer) containers and digital temperature monitoring, guarantees the quality, safety, and compliance of goods throughout transit. Every shipment remains reliable, efficient, and fully aligned with international food standards.

Discover our Reefer Solution

Strategic Network and Intermodal Solutions

With our extensive port and intermodal network, MSC France connects French ports directly to European, African, Asian, and American markets. In France, the integration of barge and rail transport reduces transit times and carbon emissions. Regional logistics platforms streamline import and export flows, ensuring sustainable, reliable, and efficient transport across the entire agri-food supply chain.

Read more

Sustainability and Customer Proximity

MSC France is committed to responsible, sustainable transport, reducing its carbon footprint through intermodal solutions and optimised logistics flows. Dedicated commercial teams provide guidance, monitoring, and regular support. MSC France ensures flexible, reliable, and environmentally conscious logistics solutions aligned with the high standards of the agri-food industry.

Digitalisation and Traceability

Digital innovation simplifies traceability and shipment management through real-time tracking on myMSC, paperless documentation via the eBL, and ERP integration through API/EDI. Combined with close customer support, this approach allows flexible solutions tailored to market needs and seasonality. We unite technology, expertise, and human commitment to deliver safe, transparent, and responsive food logistics.

MSC Connects
Sète to its Global Network

The port of Sète serves as a gateway to Europe for fruit and vegetable imports.
Connected by a regular MSC line from West Africa and connected to the hubs of Las Palmas and Valencia, Sète also provides access to Latin America, Asia, the Middle East, and North America.

Europe

France

Retail Industry

Connecting Retail Brands to Global Markets

In the constantly evolving retail landscape, logistics performance is a strategic lever for retail brands. MSC France provides tailor-made solutions combining reliability, visibility, and flexibility. With deep industry expertise and advanced digital tools, we simplify the management of flows, seasonal peaks, and omnichannel challenges, while maintaining strong commercial proximity with every partner.

"
With its local roots and global network, MSC France is a trusted and innovative partner for retail brands. Our passionate teams support every customer with precision, flexibility, and personal attention - delivering tailored logistics solutions that truly fit their needs.
"

Sylvie Alexandre
Commercial Department Director

A Committed and Human Partner

MSC France is more than just a logistics provider; we are a committed and innovative partner. Combining local presence with a global network, MSC France supports French retailers with reliable, flexible transport solutions. Each customer benefits from dedicated follow-up by passionate teams, ensuring personalized, responsive logistics perfectly adapted to the specific needs of the retail industry.

Flexibility and Logistical Agility

We handle fluctuating volumes and seasonal peaks through a flexible organization and agile shipment management. Our teams anticipate challenges, ensure the smooth execution of retail campaigns, and guarantee on-time deliveries. This operational responsiveness enables retailers to rely on efficient, secure, and adaptable transport, perfectly suited to the short deadlines and dynamic pace of the retail market.

Digital Tools and Cost Optimisation

Through our myMSC digital platform, customers can access instant quotes, order tracking, and simplified documentation management. Combined with intermodal transport options, these tools help optimise costs and enhance supply chain visibility. With regular departures from key sourcing hubs and precise shipment tracking, retailers benefit from global connectivity, operational control, and cost-efficient logistics performance.

Sustainability and Customer Support

MSC France supports retailers committed to environmental responsibility, while providing highly personalised human support. Our expert teams play a key role in operational implementation and KPI compliance, anticipating disruptions, adapting volumes, and ensuring commitments are met. By promoting local supply chains and valuing human relationships, MSC France delivers logistics solutions that are reliable, flexible, sustainable, and fully aligned with the strategic objectives of retail brands.

Europe

France

Wines and Spirits

Your Trusted Partner for Premium Beverage Transport

MSC France supports professionals in the wine and spirits industry with tailor-made solutions combining logistics expertise, product care, and human proximity. Through its global network and local teams, MSC France ensures smooth, secure, and reliable transport solutions adapted to the unique requirements of this prestigious sector.

Expertise and Product Protection

Drawing on deep experience in the wine and spirits sector, MSC France understands the unique logistics requirements of this demanding industry, from precise temperature control to customs regulations and international standards. Our teams rely on proven technical solutions, such as FLEXITANKS, ventilated containers, and reinforced bracing systems, to preserve the integrity and quality of every shipment throughout its journey.

Global Reach and Reliability

Through its global network, MSC France connects French ports directly to major import markets, including the United States, China, Japan, and many other destinations. Our regular and reliable services ensure on-time delivery while minimizing supply chain disruptions, offering our customers the continuity and dependability essential to their business success.

Digital and Intermodal Solutions

Digital innovation lies at the heart of MSC’s approach. Through myMSC and MSC Smart Containers, customers enjoy real-time shipment visibility for their most sensitive cargo. Combined with intermodal solutions (barge, rail, or road) and the support of dedicated local teams, these tools enable transport that is sustainable, agile, and transparent, reflecting MSC’s core values of responsibility and commitment.

Discover MSC Smart Containers

Dedicated Local Support

At MSC France, local experts are available to assist you every step of the way. Their in-depth knowledge allows them to tailor solutions to specific logistical, regulatory, and technical requirements, ensuring responsive, personalized service perfectly aligned with the expectations and standards of the wine and spirits industry.

Container rental and storage in Georgia

What is Container Rental?

Export Container Rental charges are fees that the shipping line charges customers for  "while with customer" period – from empty container(s) collection date including the return date of full container(s) to our depot/terminal and "while at terminal/depot" period – from receiving of full container(s) or from stuffed at depot /terminal container(s) date including the date vessel completes loading).

Import Container Rental charges are fees that the shipping line charges customer for the period starting from discharged from the vessel container(s) date including empty container(s) return date to the one of MSC terminals or depots.

Export container(s) storage - from receiving of full container(s) or from the date the container(s) are stuffed at depot/terminal including the date the vessel completes loading.

What are storage charges?

A storage charge is applicable, after the free time expires, for containers left inside the rail ramp or container yard (for the use of the land).

Detention and demurrage: updated payment policy

If no credit terms, payment of demurrage shall be performed via wire transfer before container release.

Questions about detention, demurrage, Per Diem or storage charges?

Contact our Georgia team.

SOLAS VGM information for Georgia

What is VGM?

Verified Gross Mass or VGM refers to the exact, verified weight of a packed container. For safety reasons, vessel operators can only load a container if its weight has been verified.

In line with SOLAS (Safety of Lives at Sea) regulations, all marine terminals in the Georgia are now allowed to use their certified scales to record Verified Gross Mass (VGM) of shipments.

What do I need to include in my VGM instructions?

You must include the following on all VGM instructions:

Booking or Bill of Lading (BL) number

Container number

VGM + weight measurement unit (lbs. or kgs.)

Responsible Party Name

Digital signature of the authorized signatory in all CAPITAL LETTERS.

How can I submit my VGM instructions?

myMSC (Free of Charge)

Manually (via IBOX )

Guidelines for submitting your VGM instructions

MSC prefers to receive a Shipper-Verified Gross Mass (VGM) via myMSC.com portal before cargo is delivered or right after sending BL instructions to the line.

This helps to avoid any unexpected weighing charges or delays in container planned for firstly vessel.

MSC admin fees and costs

Manual VGM Submission Fee (applies to email, and inclusion on standard shipping instructions): 25 USD per container.

Late submission (after cut off): USD 50xB/L+ USD 20 /box

Wrong submission: USD 500X B/L  +USD 30/box

What is POA?

According to the standard company procedures, only the named consignee or endorsee of the Bill of Lading is entitled to take delivery of the goods. Parties acting as agents or subcontractors of the consignee must be able to provide proof of their authority to take delivery on behalf of the consignee. Therefore, an appropriate Power Of Attorney, with relevant signature circular from the manifested consignee to their agent/proxy have to be provided prior cargo releases.

SOLAS VGM information Germany

Regulatory approval status

As of 1 July 2016, the SOLAS VGM Directive requires the timely reporting of the Verified Gross Container Weight (VGM) to the carrier worldwide.

In Germany the regulating body, BG Verkehr, follows a strict procedure and allows a zero percent tolerance. The tolerance is defined by the weighing method, a scale weighing class III or weighing class IV is necessary, and therefore amounts to a variance of -/+ 2 percent.

The BG Verkehr performs random spot checks.

Fines may be placed in case of wrong VGM (verified gross mass) declaration.

If you wish to obtain the VGM by using Method 2, your company must be ISO or AEO certified. If your company does not have one of these certificates please refer to the documents on www.deutsche-flagge.de.

At this point, German ports will allow containers to gate-in without VGM.

What to include in your VGM instructions

• Booking or Bill of Lading number

• Container number

• VGM

• Authorized person’s name

• Responsible party name

• Weighing date

How to submit your VGM

• myMSC

• EDI-Booking or Booking Update (IFTMBF)

• EDI-Shipping Instructions (IFTMIN)

• INTTRA

• Other providers

• VERMAS message

• Customized xml, csv, idoc, txt files.

Deadlines for sending your VGM instructions

• The respective VGM submission EDI deadlines will be displayed on your individual booking confirmations with immediate effect.

• As an additional service and to inform you proactively of missing VGMs, MSC Germany will send a notification the day prior to the VGM cut-off, which gives enough time to provide MSC Germany with the VGM before cut-off.

Status change Fee due to difference in payload

A status change is triggered whenever information relevant for storage at terminal or stowage on vessel is changed after the container has been received at terminal, thus requiring manual change of planning and/or change of storage and stowage.

Since the implementation of the VGM regulation changes between declared payload at time of booking and declared VGM is creating a status change at the terminals, as it might require a change of storage at the terminal and a change in the stowage plan. The exact criteria that trigger a status change due to weight difference are:

balance between original weight and VGM is larger than1.000 kg and change into another weight class:

Fees for a status change triggered by changes in vessel/voyage or POD are already charged.

Since 1st of June 2017 this status change fee is also charged for status changes triggered by changes in weight as listed above.

Recommendations

• VGM records should be stored three months after ships vessel arrival in POD.

• MSC Local agency should be informed in advance about the appointment of 3rd parties to provide the VGM.

• Weighing at terminals in Germany is not likely.

BMSB Fumigation at the Port of Hamburg

Compliance with seasonal Brown Marmorated Stink Bug (BMSB) regulations is essential.
We offer a complete, certified fumigation service directly at the Port of Hamburg—streamlining your logistics and ensuring your cargo meets international standards.

Our fumigation solutions include:

• Standard Fumigation: General pest control treatment to fulfil the import requirements of your destination

• BMSB Fumigation: Effective treatment targeting the Brown Marmorated Stink Bug for your Australia-bound cargo

• BMSB Winter Fumigation: Specialized treatment for colder temperatures, ensuring year-round BMSB fumigation

Why Choose us?

• Certified BMSB treatment: Fully compliant with Australian and New Zealand biosecurity requirements.

• End-to-end service: From planning and coordination to implementation and documentation.

• Professional equipment: Modern facilities and licensed fumigation specialists ensure safe and effective treatment.

• Efficient and cost-effective: Fewer steps, faster processing and less coordination effort.

Efficient Export Solutions from the Port of Hamburg

We offer direct service at the Port of Hamburg, ensuring smooth and reliable handling of your shipments. Our operations are seamlessly integrated with your export logistics, allowing for streamlined processes and minimal disruptions.
Leading exporters and freight forwarders rely on our expertise and consistent performance.
With transparent pricing and fast response times, we provide the clarity and efficiency you need to stay ahead in global trade.

Certified Disinfection Specialists

To guarantee a high-quality fumigation service and provide complete peace of mind, MSC has partnered with fully certified disinfection specialists.
Their expertise and certifications ensure that all fumigation processes meet the highest standards of safety and compliance.
