Continuous investments in sustainable technologies

Tailor-made approach

Flexible short-term handling

Personalised, Professional Support

Our specialised automotive logistics team in Hamburg are dedicated to creating tailored and efficient logistics solutions for your business. From spare parts and motorbikes to e-mobility products and oversized cargo, the MSC Germany automotive desk provide the most reliable and effective options for your supply chain.

Inland Transportation Solutions

Besides our wide ocean transport network we also provide inland transportation and logistics, allowing us to ship your automotive cargo worldwide, quickly, efficiently and easily.

MSC Germany currently offers 70 commercial intermodal solutions across Germany. These reach all five of the main ports in Europe: Bremerhaven, Hamburg, Rotterdam, Antwerp, and Trieste. Whether you need your automotive cargo moved by barge, rail or truck.

Download our Service Profile

A Modern, Efficient Fleet

Shipping your automotive cargo with our modern, efficient vessels equipped with the latest sustainable technologies can help you reduce your supply chain’s carbon footprint. Annually, MSC calls at 520 ports worldwide on 300 global trade routes.

For inland transport we partner with certified railway companies running their locomotives on 100% renewable energy. Our vessels also use shore power in German ports where available.

Because you Need more than
Port-to-Port Services

As a customer of MSC Germany, you benefit not only from our global coverage with fast transit times, direct port calls and the wide availability of equipment, but also from our additional products and services including inland transport, eBL, iReefer, Smart Containers, myMSC, Cargo Insurance/EPR, Biofuel, and our Liquid Cargo solution.

Automotive Shipment FAQs

Read answers to commonly asked questions relating to shipping automotive parts.

What Factors can Impact Automotive Shipping?

As the automotive supply chain is complicated, it’s crucial to partner with a transportation and logistics company that understands the industry and its challenges. At MSC, our specialised automotive team has years of industry experience, enabling them to identify and help you overcome any challenges that may impact your cargo shipment.
These include:

• Environmental responsibility
• Seasonality
• Time-sensitive delivery requirements

• Vehicle size and weight

Share
Link copied!

What are some Automotive Logistics Best Practices?

Effective automotive supply chain management is key in ensuring that delays do not occur. Our experienced and knowledgeable team has been creating transportation and logistics solutions for the automotive industry for decades and understands the importance of always following best practices.
This includes offering:

• Container tracking to enable planning across wider activities within your business.

• Efficient transportation on land and sea.

• Utilising a wide range of technology to create a smooth supply chain.

MSC STANDALONE

NETWORK

Local Information

Europe

Germany

Germany East West Network

Germany to Asia

Germany to and from India

Your Gateway from Germany to Asia

Our MSC East West Standalone Network connects Germany to the Asian trade lanes via the ports of Hamburg and Bremerhaven.To ensure reliable container transport, we offer five liner services with direct connections to Asia - without any additional transshipments. Benefit from fast transit times, a reliable schedule, high flexibility, and attractive pricing. With our many years of experience at MSC Germany, we provide personalized advice and ensure the smooth transport of your cargo.

Four weekly calls from Hamburg to Asia

Extensive port coverage

Improved transit times and reliable schedules

Express Connection from Germany to the Far East

With MSC’s extensive East-West network, companies in Germany benefit from fast and reliable container transportation to Asia.

From Hamburg and Bremerhaven, MSC Germany offers direct connections to eleven major Asian ports. These direct calls reduce transshipments, help avoid bottlenecks, and ensure predictable transit times and an efficient supply chain.

What Direct Routes Does MSC Offer from Hamburg to Asia?

With four scheduled services from Hamburg, MSC Germany offers efficient and flexible connections to China and South Korea.

Direct scheduled services from Hamburg to Asia:

• Lion Service: Singapur, China

• Swan Service: China, South Korea

• Condor Service: China

• Silk Service: China, South Korea

Other destinations, such as Malaysia, Vietnam, Thailand, and Taiwan, can be reached from Hamburg via transshipment.

Download our Service Profile

Ship Your Cargo Directly to Southeast Asia from Bremerhaven on the Britannia Service

With our direct liner services, you can reliably reach the growing markets of Southeast Asia via MSC’s own terminal in Bremerhaven.

• Britannia Service: Malaysia, China, Vietnam

In addition, German customers can take advantage of the Griffin Service via Rotterdam, which offers a direct connection to Laem Chabang in Thailand.

Flexible Transport – Capacity and Equipment

In addition to large storage capacities on our ships, and across our inland transport solutions, we can provide you with flexible equipment tailored to your requirements including:

- Standard containers

- Reefer containers

- Special equipment e.g. flatrack, open top, 45 high cube, pallet wide container, flexibags

All-Round Care - Additional Solutions from MSC Germany

As a customer of MSC Germany, you benefit not only from our global coverage with fast transit times, direct port calls and the wide availability of equipment, but also from our additional products and services including inland transport, eBL, iReefer, Smart Containers, myMSC, Cargo Insurance/EPR, Biofuel, and our Liquid Cargo solution.

What are the advantages of direct connections over transshipment solutions?

Direct connections reduce the number of additional port stops and transshipments. This helps minimize potential delays and improves the predictability of your supply chain.

Share
Link copied!

Can MSC handle large export volumes?

MSC offers multiple weekly services and extensive equipment availability. This allows the company to flexibly accommodate both regular and seasonal fluctuations in volume.

Share
Link copied!

What solution does MSC offer for time-sensitive shipments to Asia?

Thanks to direct services from Hamburg and Bremerhaven, as well as optimized transit times, time-sensitive shipments can be efficiently transported to key Asian markets.

Share
Link copied!

Can MSC also transport temperature-controlled or specialized cargo?

Yes. MSC offers reefer containers as well as specialized equipment such as flat racks, open-top containers, and 45-foot high-cube containers to meet individual shipping needs.

Share
Link copied!

How can I keep track of my shipments at all times?

Digital solutions such as myMSC, tracking services, and eBL provide customers with transparency regarding their shipments and documents.

Share
Link copied!

Connecting the Heart of Europe with India

Experience seamless connectivity and efficiency with MSC’s liner service NWC to IPAK to/from India. Benefit from flexibility and high capacities in our liner services network connecting the main German ports with the Indian Subcontinent. With our team of trade experts, we use our expertise to assist and guide you with your cargo transport requirements.

Direct calls to the ports of Hamburg and Bremerhaven

Experts in specialised commodities

MSC owned feeder service calling at 11 Indian ports

Largest inland container depot portfolio in India

Germany – Your Gateway to India

Thanks to MSC's extensive liner service network, we can offer you optimal connections for your Indian export and import cargo. Via Hamburg and Bremerhaven, you are connected well with our NWC to IPAK service to five ports on the Indian Subcontinent.

Benefit from our fast and reliable liner service from Northern Europe to India, Pakistan, Bangladesh and Sri Lanka!

Download Service Profile

Extensive Port and Inland Container Depot Coverage

Thanks to our own comprehensive MSC feeder services, the NWC to IPAK ports of call are connected to eleven other Indian ports covering the entire continent.
In addition, we can then offer you the largest inland container depot portfolio in the Indian hinterland for your imports and exports.

Benefit from our extensive network by land and sea for your fast and reliable cargo transport on the Indian subcontinent.

Experienced and Specialised in Commodities

Our colleagues from MSC Germany in the Trade India team will be happy to help you transport your cargo safely and reliably to and from India with solutions tailored to your requirements.
For your exports to India, we are experienced in large lots of timber, logs and paper. We are also experts in the transportation of textiles and stones from India to Germany.

At MSC Germany your cargo is always in good hands.

Flexible Transport - Equipment and Special Services

In addition to large capacities on our ships and across our inland transport solutions, we can provide you with flexible equipment and services tailored to your requirements including:

- Standard and reefer containers
- Special equipment e.g. flatrack, open top, high flatracks, high-cube open tops

- Special services e.g. flexibags, fumigation, garments-on-hangers (GOH)

All-round care – Additional Solutions from MSC Germany

As a customer of MSC Germany, you benefit not only from our global coverage with fast transit times, direct port calls and the wide availability of equipment, but also from our additional products and services including inland transport, eBL, iReefer, Smart Container, myMSC, MSC Cargo Insurance/EPR, Biofuel and our Liquid Cargo solution.

Germany Intermodal

Your Supply Chain Partner

At MSC Germany, we take the time to understand your requirements. With our extensive global ocean network and the largest intermodal network in Europe, we connect your imports and exports seamlessly from door to door. Our full portfolio of transport solutions including rail, road, and inland waterways are supported by more than 80 dedicated intermodal and logistics experts. Together, we design customised solutions thatkeep your supply chain efficient, reliable, and sustainable.

Efficient and reliable inland connections

Local German intermodal experts

Door-to-door transport solutions

Extensive port network and barge connections

Strong Network on Land and at Sea

Whether you are looking for ocean or inland transportation, MSC Germany is the reliable shipping partner you need for your exports and imports. Offering more than 70 commercial intermodal services by road, rail, and barge, we connect your business to all major ports such as Bremerhaven, Hamburg, Rotterdam, Antwerp, Trieste efficiently.
Leverage on our full portfolio of solutions and simplify your supply chain!

Download Service Profile

From Door to Door in One Go

If just-in-time delivery is important for your supply chain, we’ve got you covered. Our inland network connects the German mainland to all major ports in northern Europe, but also to the Italian port of Trieste.
Enjoy flexibility and reliability with MSC’s dedicated train connections between commercial centres and the ports of Bremerhaven, Trieste, Rotterdam, Antwerp and important logistic hubs in Germany. Put your cargo in our hands and make MSC Germany your trusted logistics partner.

Your Cargo Stays in Flow with us

Seamlessly transport your containerized cargo anywhere with MSC Germany. With more than 15 services on the Rhine and other key waterways, we connect ports across the German mainland efficiently and reliably. Integrate the environmentally friendly option of barge into your intermodal transport easily with our tailor-made solutions. Enjoy the flexibility and efficiency of our complete port and inland network and take your supply chain to the next level.

Better for the Planet

Intermodal solutions are not only safe, fast and cost-efficient – they are often better for the environment: We are cooperating with partners certified as train operating companies that fuel their electric locomotives with
CO² neutral power.

Keeping Empty Containers in Shape

Our MEDREPAIR empty container depots in Hamburg and Bremerhaven are specialised in empty container repair and storage, relocation and other services related to containers. We also offer third party depots in 31 locations throughout Germany.

Germany iReefer

Advanced Temperature Monitoring
with MSC iReefer

MSC iReefer is one of the most advanced container monitoring systems for reefer cargo. It provides real‑time visibility for temperature‑controlled cargo to prevent losses and ensure optimal product integrity.

We at MSC Germany understand that even small changes in temperature inside a container can have a significant impact when transporting perishable goods. Our team of experts will provide you with comprehensive support for both the implementation and use of our iReefer technology.

Reefer Monitoring, Redefined

Moving temperature-sensitive goods from Germany requires more than just tracking location. MSC iReefer provides real-time temperature monitoring on land and at sea. With our state-of-the-art technology we reduce risks and ensure quick reactions.

Stay in Control of your Reefer Cargo

You can easily track and control the precise temperature and humidity of your perishable goods remotely. With myMSC, you have seamless access to your data, which can be easily integrated via an API. The enhanced security allows immediate actions to ensure smooth performances across Germany.

Improve Your Cold Chain Management

At MSC Germany, we actively help you manage your cold chain to respond faster and plan smarter. Compare our iReefer packages to find the right level of monitoring, analytics, and tracking for your reefer cargo. Reduce your costs by preventing spoilage and waste.

Germany Pharmaceuticals

Overview

FAQ

Count on us for Pharmaceutical Shipping

Pharmaceutical logistics require adherence to strict regulation codes to ensure that all products, including medication and vaccines, are delivered on time and undamaged. At MSC Germany we pride ourselves on following GDP compliant practices and providing reliable, cost-effective deliveries to any destination.

Shipping with MSC Germany also means you’ll benefit from having access to our vast global network, which connects all the world’s major trading centres and enables you to deliver pharmaceutical support wherever it is required.

Global Coverage

GDP Compliant & Certified

Cutting-edge

reefer technology

Wide range of equipment

How are Pharmaceutical Products Transported?

Pharmaceutical cargo is transported in temperature-controlled reefer containers which allow the consistent management of conditions throughout transportation. At MSC Germany our reefer containers use the most advanced cooling systems, including:
• Primeline®

• Naturaline®

• Star Cool SA

These systems ensure that pharmaceutical products are kept at the required temperature during transit, while dehumidification systems prevent damage or degradation.

GDP Compliant Practices

Because of the sensitive nature of the cargo, the shipping of pharmaceuticals needs to be well organised, and best practices adhered to.

Our GDP certification ensures that our processes are aligned with the strict regulations required by the pharma industry. With MSC Germany, your cargo is in the hands of dedicated experts who are trained to offer the right support, advice and documentation whenever and wherever it is needed.

Seamless and Secure: Elevating Door-to-Door Solutions

At MSC Germany we offer door-to-door solutions that prioritize efficiency and security. By providing reefer containers for export at selected inland depots in Germany, we shorten loading distances and give you more flexibility in choosing intermodal carriers for transport to the seaport.
With our door-to-door services, we minimize touchpoints, reducing the risk of theft or damage and improving overall product quality. Trust our team of 25 dedicated reefer experts!

Inland Transport Solutions,
Tailored to Your Needs

Our team of over 80 intermodal and logistics experts will work closely with you to deliver tailored solutions that meet your specific needs. Offering more than 70 commercial intermodal services by road, rail, and barge, we connect your business to all major ports such as Bremerhaven, Hamburg, Rotterdam, Antwerp, Trieste efficiently. Utilizing our inland transport services not only saves you time and money but also contributes to reducing your business's carbon footprint.

Healthcare Logistics

Pharma and healthcare logistics demand strict compliance and reliable temperature control to prevent spoilage of vaccines and medications. At MSC Germany, we provide temperature-monitored supply chains and offer additional support across your healthcare logistics by acting as 2PL, 3PL or 4PL according to your needs.

Marine Cargo Insurance

Customs clearance support

Door-to-door delivery solutions for businesses of all sizes

Documentation support

Important aspects to consider in pharmaceutical shipping

Along with following best practices within the pharmaceutical industry throughout the entire shipping process, there are several important regulations to follow during the transportation process.
These include:

• Ensuring all pharma products are properly packaged and labelled. This mitigates the risk of any cargo breaking or becoming damaged during transit. Having clear labels on products also means that correct temperatures can be monitored and maintained during shipping.

• Licensing regulations. As there are certain licensing requirements needed to ship pharmaceuticals, it is crucial to work with a company like MSC that holds all the necessary licenses.

• The hygiene of shipping facilities. As well as being kept to the required temperate, all containers and storage facilities involved in transporting pharmaceuticals must be large enough in order to allow proper cleaning and airflow to take place shape.
At MSC we work hard to consider all aspects of pharmaceutical transportation, from the industry regulations we follow to our reefer container systems and shipping processes.

Share
Link copied!

How are you usually audited to be GDP compliant (Goods Distribution Practice)?

Our GDP certification is supported by mandatory internal and external audits. We go through an intense 1st, 2nd and 3rd party audit program, where we audit ourselves (1st party), our vendors and suppliers (2nd party) and we have an external certified body auditing our system (3rd party).

Each audit checks the following elements of our suppliers’ processes and systems:

Documents are verified – documental verification of our GDP system.

On-site inspections are carried out.

Calibrations are verified.

Traceability testing is checked.

The CAPA (Corrective Action and Preventative Actions) Management process is reviewed.

Overall system performance is reviewed and improvements are planned.

Share
Link copied!

How is quality measured?

Performance metrics for our GDP practices are overseen by several departments within MSC to ensure quality, including:

Customer Services (Agencies level)

Reefer Management (SSC Antwerp)

Claims Dept MSC HQ (Geneva)

Under Penalty Cargo (SSC Greece).

Share
Link copied!

Do you carry out CAPA (Corrective Action and Preventative Actions) procedures?

Yes. In order to be GDP compliant, we have an internal CAPA management process. CAPA management is internally shared, and its performances are periodically reviewed.

Share
Link copied!

Where can I find documentation?

All relevant documents are available from your local pharma expert, contact your local MSC office for more information.

Share
Link copied!

Are MSC staff GDP Trained?

MSC staff involved in GDP / FSMS undergo in-person or online training relevant to their roles, including reefer handling and maintenance, alarms and incident management and CAPA management.
Attendance to these training programs is both mandatory and verified.

Share
Link copied!

How are containers cleaned in order to be GDP compliant?

This is overseen by our Reefer department in Geneva and Antwerp.
They also oversee training practices for cleaning and adherence to high cleaning standards, according to the container and cargo needs.
Specific audits are planned and carried out globally to verify the adherence of our vendors to our GDP standards.

Share
Link copied!

Is the container temperature controlled?

Yes! All these procedures are part of our ISO 22000 audit and part of our general GDP practices.

We have departments dedicated to handling temperature-controlled units, both in Geneva and in our main facilities. All agencies have departments dedicated to temperature-controlled containers, with professionals available in each facility trained in pre-trip, and handling alarms etc.

Each vessel is equipped with essential spare parts in line with the type of equipment loaded.

Share
Link copied!

How is temperature monitored?

The temperature monitoring is regulated by the Service Contract Agreement with Vessels/Ports and Facilities and includes a minimum of two controls per day. Alerts are raised if a unit is out of an acceptable range.

For GDP units, the range of acceptance is ‘Zero Deviation’ from requirements. For specific cargo-loading plan-routing, temperature mapping is agreed with the shipper.

Share
Link copied!

Are MSC containers’ temperature sensors calibrated?

Calibration of thermal sensors is ensured by the certification of the constructor and suppliers of spare parts.

In addition, MSC tests has a specific procedure to verify the calibration of the units and a specific audit program to verify that unit probes are correctly calibrated.

Share
Link copied!

Is my cargo safe?

MSC’s security divisions maintain and audit cargo according to the highest standards and requirement of the US Customs and Border Patrol (USCBP). A Seal Management plan runs through the organization and involves all offices and depots across the company.
Our safe cargo checks are in line with ISO 28000:2007 certification.

Share
Link copied!

Do you work with certified suppliers?

With all our main vendors handling temperature-controlled containers, like ports and depot facilities, we have specific clauses in place for handling special cargo, including pharmaceuticals.

Audit operations are performed and verified by our Procurement department and are in line with our ISO 28000:2017 certification, our GDP 2013 and GDP 2015 certification and with ISO 22000: 2018.

Germany Project Cargo

Project Cargo Logistics in Germany: From Planning to Execution

In the case of project cargo shipments, our German team will work to provide you with one-stop support from the initial enquiry to delivery at the port of destination, regardless of whether it is an import, export or cross trade shipment.

We are at your disposal throughout the project cargo and breakbulk planning phase, through the negotiations and clarifications of the technical solutions. Our network of global specialists, combined with the expertise of our local teams across Germany allows us to provide bespoke solutions designed to meet the needs of your project cargo. Our team includes both heavy lift and special equipment experts not only help differentiate between the various transport options to establish the effective and cost-efficient method for your project cargo, but also communicate with external experts like independent surveyors on your behalf.

Tailor-made solutions: safe, efficient and on-time execution

Local German special cargo and project cargo experts

Additional solutions for transport & stuffing

Breakbulk: When Size Matters

Breakbulk cargo in Germany often includes heavy, oversized, or complex shipments that cannot be moved using standard container solutions. These cargo types require tailored loading, securing, and transport planning.

At MSC Germany, our local project cargo specialists coordinate breakbulk solutions through key German gateways, using flat racks, custom flatbed configurations, and specialist lashing methods to move cargo safely and efficiently.

Equipped for Every Special Cargo Need

For project cargo and oversized goods in Germany that cannot be loaded into standard containers, MSC Germany offers specialist equipment solutions including flat racks and open tops.

Our local teams tailor each solution to the size, weight, and handling requirements of your cargo, helping ensure complex shipments move safely and efficiently.

Your Oversized Cargo,
Our Commitment

At MSC Germany, we are a reliable partner throughout every project phase. Our team offers direct contact and fast response times. We conduct thorough technical evaluations to reduce risks and claims. With deep expertise in complex cargo, we deliver safe, efficient, and tailored solutions. We work closely with our colleagues around the globe, providing strategic guidance to enhance execution and customer satisfaction.

Stuffing and Stripping Services
for your Project Cargo

Whether your cargo moves in a standard container, open top container, or on flat racks, MSC Germany manages each stage with safe, efficient, and on-time execution.

From cargo acceptance to final terminal delivery, our local teams can also support stuffing and stripping services, giving you a seamless end-to-end project cargo solution.

How Does Project Cargo Shipping Work in Germany?

MSC Germany provides tailored project cargo solutions for oversized, heavy lift, breakbulk, and out-of-gauge shipments, coordinating every stage of the transport process from planning to final delivery.

• Assessment and Planning: Our local project cargo specialists evaluate your cargo dimensions, weight, route requirements, and handling needs to develop a tailored transport plan.

• Specialist Equipment Selection: Depending on the cargo, we identify the most suitable solution, including flat racks, open tops, breakbulk handling, and heavy-lift equipment.

• Execution and Coordination: Cargo is managed through Germany's major ports and logistics hubs, with careful coordination of loading, transport, and vessel operations.

• Monitoring and Delivery: Throughout the shipment, our teams monitor progress and provide support to help ensure your cargo reaches its destination safely, efficiently, and on schedule.

FAQs

What qualifies as project cargo when shipping to or from Germany?

Project cargo typically includes oversized, heavy-lift, breakbulk, or complex shipments such as industrial equipment, machinery, energy components, or infrastructure materials that require specialised handling.

Share
Link copied!

Which German ports handle project cargo shipments?

Major German ports such as Hamburg and Bremerhaven offer facilities and infrastructure suitable for heavy-lift and oversized cargo, depending on the project requirements.

Share
Link copied!

Are special permits required for oversized cargo in Germany?

Oversized or overweight cargo may require special transport permits, route surveys, and police escorts for inland movements. Requirements vary depending on dimensions, weight, and route.

Share
Link copied!

Can MSC arrange inland transport for project cargo within Germany?

Yes. Inland transport via truck, rail, or barge can be coordinated, including route planning and multimodal solutions for complex project movements.

Germany Smart Containers

Optimize Shipping with Real-Time Smart Container Tracking Across Germany

We enable businesses to optimise your shipping processes by providing dry containers equipped with real-time data tracking from pickup to delivery. Supported by a dedicated team of German experts, our Smart Container technology offers near-real time access to essential cargo data, delivering superior visibility, security, and operational efficiency.

Our advanced local operations and innovative technology ensure that your shipments are consistently monitored and safeguarded throughout every stage of transit.

This service is available at all major German ports as well as 31 inland container depots.

Door-to-Door Visibility

Monitor your cargo seamlessly from origin to destination and receive real-time notifications when shipments enter designated zones through our advanced geofencing feature. Whether your cargo transport begins in the German hinterland or ends at the Port of Hamburg, our intelligent
technology ensures comprehensive visibility into your container’s status at all times.

We Care for your Cargo

You get customized data instantly on your cargo status and receive personalised alerts on movement, location, geofencing, door openings and temperature. We offer technology that includes integrated sensors, GPS, and advanced data analytics.

Improve your Supply Chain Management

Improve your supply chain efficiency and streamline decision-making by tracking the position, condition and transit time of your cargo 24/7 and in real time, so you can make smarter decisions and take control with a platform designed for you.

Smart Container Coverage Across Germany

The smart container solution is available at the major German ports of Hamburg and Bremerhaven, as well as at 31 inland container depots across the country. In addition our extensive intermodal network ensures seamless access and coverage for your logistics operations and supply chain management in Germany.

Germany Trade Oceania Eastbound

Connecting Germany to Oceania

Leverage MSC’s extensive global network and specialised expertise within Germany.
Our well‑established direct Australia Express Service, complemented by the new Eagle Service via Panama Canal, ensures efficient connections between Germany and ports in Australia and New Zealand. Enjoy faster transit times, weekly sailing flexibility, and reliable scheduling.
With our deep industry experience, we provide tailored support and guidance for all your cargo transportation needs.

Three services to Australia and New Zealand

Eagle service offers improved transit times

Express direct connections to Oceania

Extensive port coverage

From Germany to Down Under

MSC's comprehensive liner service network provides optimal connectivity solutions for your export cargo to Oceania.
From Germany, you are connected well with our Australia Express service and additionally via Port Louis with the NWC to IPAK service covering major Australian ports. Benefit from our direct calls from Northern Europe to Sydney, Melbourne, Adelaide and Fremantle.

Download Service Profile

With our Eagle Service Across the Pacific

Significantly improved transit times are now available to Auckland, Wellington, Tauranga, and Brisbane. With our new Eagle Service we can offer expanded reach to Oceania. Connecting your cargo from Germany via Antwerp for smooth transportation across the Atlantic to the Panama Canal. At Rodman, the Eagle service takes over and transports your cargo fast to your destination ports.

Benefits for Exports to Oceania

The combination of our direct and hybrid services with weekly departures ensures fast transit times and well-coordinated connections throughout the network. Your cargo also benefits from extensive port coverage and reliable schedules on its journey from Europe to Oceania.

Equipment Options and Fumigation Service

In addition to large storage capacities on our vessels and across our inland transport solutions, we can provide you with flexible equipment and services tailored to your requirements including standard and reefer containers as well as Out of Gauge and Breakbulk shipments.
Take advantage of our BMSB fumigation service in Hamburg fully managed by MSC to simplify your process.

All-round Care – Additional Solutions from MSC Germany

As a customer of MSC Germany, you also benefit from our additional products and services including inland transport, eBL, myMSC, MSC Cargo Insurance/EPR, Biofuel and our Liquid Cargo solution with Flexitanks.

Connecting Greece to the world

MSC GREECE S.A. was founded in 1994. Within a short period of time, MSC Greece attained a leading position in the liner shipping industry in Greece, operating in all basic Greek ports (Piraeus, Thessaloniki, Volos, Heraklion).

MSC Greece also maintains the management and overview of the MSC agencies in Albania and Kosovo. Since 2016, MSC Greece has developed the Balkan Logistic Platform (BLP) promoting a flexible and customer oriented intermodal Balkan network. Since April 2018, MSC GREECE S.A. has been certified as Authorized Economic Operator Full version (AEOf).

The weekly connection with the global network of MSC, the continuous upgrade of the fleet of MSC through the incorporation of modern units and the high-quality services provided by our 250 specialized executives, guarantees the high level of quality transport services, which the Greek market seeks.

Deadlines for sending your VGM instructions

24 hours prior vessels arrival AND prior entry at the terminal but not later than Thursday week, end of business.

Piraeus PCT terminal only:

Containers which have not been weighed before entry will be accepted and weighed by the terminal provided that they will enter the terminal 48 hours prior vessel’s arrival and the shipping instructions have been given by the shipper.

Admin Fees and costs

Any extra costs for obtaining or verifying the VGM will be on shippers account.

Terminals:

Piraeus

Both PCT and PPA weigh all full containers at the time of entry, acting on behalf of the Shippers, irrespective of whether Shippers have obtained VGM of their own. A fee is charged by the Terminals per container The data acquired is dispatched via EDI to the Shipping Lines.

In the event that the VGM obtained as per above requires for any reason verification all extra costs will be  for shippers account

Herkalion

The terminal is equipped with certified scale. Weighs and provides scale receipts only upon request by the Shippers.  Shippers remain responsible to provide to the Line the VGM to the Line.

Volos

The Terminal has verified scales and may weigh containers at Shippers request. Shippers remain responsible to provide the VGM to the Line.

Landlocked / Adjacent countries

Shipments from landlocked countries will have to follow the rules applying at the Port of Loading.

MSC's cargo handling facilities are strategically located to ensure the efficient and timely loading of goods for export and import. We also provide cargo consolidation, loading and re-loading, packing, unpacking and cross-loading services from containers to trucks.

Container Weighing (VGM)

All MSC local offices provide certified scales to record and verify container weight (verified gross mass or VGM) in line with Safety of Lives at Sea (SOLAS) regulations. VGM instructions are mandatory for all shipments for safety reasons and vessel operators can only load a container if its weight has been appropriately verified. Contact your local MSC team for more information and support.

Our team of in-house forestry experts enables us to provide dedicated cargo fumigation services for the seamless shipment of wood. Demurrage and storage charges

What is demurrage?

Demurrage is the charge counted, after the free time expires, from discharging date until gate in empty (both included) (import) and from get out empty until loading date (both included) (export).

What are storage charges?

A storage charge is applicable, after the free time expires, for containers left inside the rail ramp or container yard (for the use of the land).

Questions about, demurrage or storage charges?

Contact us here.

Share
Link copied!

SOLAS VGM information

What is VGM?

Verified Gross Mass or VGM refers to the exact, verified weight of a packed container. For safety reasons, vessel operators can only load a container if its weight has been verified.

Government approval status

Authority in charge: Harbor Master – PSC Officers under the supervision of ‘’Comando Generale delle Capitanerie di Porto’’

Tolerance +/- 3pct ,

Fines unless the Law violation does not constitute or represent specific or more serious crime, every irregularity in the shipping document (declaration VGM) may be considered, prosecutable, towards shipper according to article 483 penal code.

Inspections carried out on random basis

M2 according to art.4 D.D 447/2016

No VGM – No Gate-in (unless approved in advance by terminal involved )

What to include in your VGM instructions

The following items are mandatory and must be on all VGM instructions

Booking or Bill of Lading (BL) number

Container number

VGM + weight measurement unit (lbs. or kgs.)

Responsible Party Name in full

Place and date of signature

Legible Signature

How to submit your VGM instructions

myMSC (Free of Charge)

EDI (via INTTRA; GT NEXUS; Cargo Smart)

Deadlines for sending your VGM instructions

VGM cut-off aligned with Custom Documentation cut off

Admin fees and costs

In case of discrepancy between the communicated gross mass and the actual gross mass, Carrier should any time roll over/discharge/dispose/abandon or restow the container or suspend the voyage at its sole discretion and any associated costs that will arise (including but not limited to: weigh or re-weight, additional lifts, storages, electricity, demurrages, gates charges) will be on Merchant account.

Recommendations

VGM records to be maintained till the end of the voyage but for a minimum period of 3 month

From terminals ( the general rule is no VGM – No Gate-in (unless agreed in with Terminal)

Failing the Shipper to provide to MSC Agent the VGM document, according to the IMO Resolution MSC. 380(94) dated 21/11/2014 which amended SOLAS Convention 74, sufficiently in advance of ship loading and in view to prepare and implement the ship stowage plan, the container/s would not be loaded.

Detention, demurrage, Per Diem and storage charges

What is demurrage?

Demurrage is the charge applicable for the excessive use of container equipment after the free time expires, at the terminal at Port of Discharge and Place of Delivery.

In case of a demurrage dispute, email KAZ-info@msc.com (email subject: Dispute + Invoice Number), describing the reasons for your dispute.

What are storage charges?

Storage charge is applicable for the use of the land after the free time expires, for containers left at Port of Discharge and Place of Delivery (destination railway station).

Demurrage and storage: payment policy

Please note that the shipment will be released ONLY after funds clear. The agency does not accept payment order copies or written guarantees to release shipments from Demurrage and/or Storage hold.

Questions about demurrage or storage charges?

Contact our Central Asia team.

Link copied!

SOLAS VGM information

What is VGM?

Verified Gross Mass or VGM refers to the exact, verified weight of a packed container. For safety reasons, vessel operators can only load a container if its weight has been verified.

What do I need to include in my VGM instructions?

The following items are mandatory and must be on all VGM

instructions:

Booking or Bill of Lading number

Container number

VGM + unit

Authorized person’s signatory (submitter of the VGM who may be authorized to act on behalf of shippers)

Responsible party Name and address

Weighing method used (1 or 2)

Unique number of VGM certificate and date of issue

How can I submit my VGM instructions?

myMSC

EDI (via INTTRA; GT NEXUS; Cargo Smart)

E-mails

It is compulsory to submit a scanned copy of VGM certificate by e-mail

Guidelines for submitting your VGM instructions

VGM submission should be done according to Port of Loading requirements on VGM. Port of Loading may vary depending on the shipment routing.

All VGM must be submitted electronically or transmitted to MSC prior loading, failing which containers will not be planned on the

scheduled vessel. All costs, consequences shall be on Shipper's account for any delay in submitting VGM, non-submission of VGM

and/or for any noncompliance to VGM statutory guidelines.

Specific cutoff date and hour for the VGM, will be mentioned on booking stage and vessel schedules provided by the local agency.

Cutoff times may vary according to each Marine terminal’s capacity and regulation.

Questions about VGM?

Contact our Export Customer Service team.

Detention, demurrage, Per Diem and storage charges

What is detention/demurrage?

Detention/demurrage is the charge applicable, after the free time expires, for the use of the carrier’s full container inside or outside the marine terminal, railroad facilities or container yard. This charge can also apply while the container is undergoing customs inspections, or while the cargo inside the container is being reworked for safety reasons.

In case of a demurrage dispute, email lv199-rixexport@msc.com or lv199-riximport@msc.com (email subject: Dispute + Invoice Number), describing the reasons for your dispute.

What are storage charges?

A storage charge is applicable, after the free time expires, for containers left inside container yard (for the use of the land).

Detention and demurrage: payment policy

The shipment will be released ONLY after all funds clear.

Questions about detention, demurrage or storage charges?

SOLAS VGM information for Latvia

What is VGM?

Verified Gross Mass or VGM refers to the exact, verified weight of a packed container. For safety reasons, vessel operators can only load a container if its weight has been verified.

In line with SOLAS (Safety of Lives at Sea) regulations, all marine terminals in are now allowed to use their certified scales to record Verified Gross Mass (VGM) of shipments.

What do I need to include in my VGM instructions?

You must include the following on all VGM instructions:

- Booking or Bill of Lading (BL) number

- Container number

- VGM + weight measurement unit (kgs.)

- Responsible Party Name

How can I submit my VGM instructions?

- MSC digital platform MYMSC.COM

- Via Email: Subject to charge

Guidelines for submitting your VGM instructions

MSC prefers to receive a Shipper-Verified Gross Mass (VGM) before cargo is delivered. This helps to avoid any unexpected weighing charges being levied against the cargo at the Port of Loading, which will be billed to the Shipper of Record.

The ultimate deadline for VGM submission will be advised by local agent in booking confirmation.

MSC admin fees and costs

Manual VGM Submission Fee (applies to email, and inclusion on standard shipping instructions): 10 EUR per container.

Late VGM Submission Fee: 50 EUR per container.

VGM Misdeclaration Fee: 150 EUR per misdeclaration, per container.

VGM INFORMATION

What is VGM?

Verified Gross Mass or VGM refers to the exact, verified weight of a packed container. For safety reasons, vessel operators can only load a container if its weight has been verified. VGM can be submitted on www.mymsc.com

Government approval status

- The government will check the procedures and will certify the methods used - Additional info

- The General Service for Shipping (DGS) will be responsible for enforcement and implementation of the VGM regulation within Belgium.

- More info

What do I need to include in my VGM instructions?

- The following items are mandatory and must be on all VGM instructions

- Booking or Bill of Lading number

- Container number

- VGM + unit

- Authorized person’s signatory (submitter of the VGM who may be authorized to act on behalf of shippers

- Responsible party Name

Deadlines for sending your vgm instruction

- VGM must be known to the ship-agent, at least 24hours before physical closing of the vessel. The VGM cut-off date will be mentioned on the booking confirmation.

- If the VGM is received later, the container will not be planned/loaded on the vessel.

Entrance at the terminal

- Containers arriving at the gate without VGM will be allowed at the terminal, however not loaded when VGM not provided in time. Please be aware that the terminal has no weighing facilities.

Admin fees and costs

- If the VGM has to be handled manually by the local agent, a local fee of 25€ per container will be applied.  This also applies for VGM info added in the electronic booking.

- If the VGM is not received before VGM closing time, container will be put on hold and all related costs (like demurrage, storage, moves, plugging), will be for the account of the shipper.

As per Municipal Council decision of 19 December 2016 under article 4.2.4 (1-5) of the MUNICIPAL PORT POLICE REGULATIONS all dangerous and/or contaminating goods (meaning hazardous cargo) have to be declared to the port authorities. The declaration must reach the Harbourmaster's Office no later than 24 hours before the scheduled handling time. Declaration has to be done electronically.

After a period of grace all violations will now be penalized by Harbormaster's office with a fine per container.

Since all violations will be penalized by Harbormaster's office, we will have to charge 250 EUR for every non-conformity with these instructions.

In Antwerp we retrieve all information from DMAXS. In order to submit the declaration we need the units with container number in status ACCEPTED or FINALISED in DMAXS.

Only when ACCEPTED or FINALISED with container number we have all crucial information available to successfully submit our declaration.

This all is only applicable when MSC Belgium has to perform declaration - instead of the forwarder/client.

In short: All hazardous containers must have container number in status ACCEPTED or FINALISED status in DMAXS

SOLAS VGM information

Government approval status

The authority in charge of compliance in Malta is Transport Malta ™ as the Regulating Authority

Verified Gross Mass regulations will be enforced with effect from the 1st July 2016 but as yet no fines or penalties have been announced as yet for any default.

There will be various controls to ensure compliance.   No container will be loaded unless the VGM of the container is declared in advance of loading.

All Shippers who will be adopting Method 2 are required to send their certificate and a copy of their documented procedures to the regulating authority for vetting. Once this has been approved, the shipper will be included in the list referring to the use of method 2 on the Malta Freeport Terminal (MFT) web based portal.

Gates procedures have been defined for both methods.  M1 requires the presentation of a printed weight certificate in addition to the standard shipping documents whilst M2 requires that a document is presented at the Gate which includes the of the Certified body, the Verified gross mass and the Shipper's contact details. Same report is to be dated and signed.

Extra costs for failing to provide timely VGM as per carrier’s VGM cut-off and countries guidelines may be incurred and will be for account of the Shipper.

Recommendations

Shippers are advised to retain all the VGM related documents within their records whilst copies must be forward to the shipping agent.

MSC Local agency should be informed in advance about the appointment of 3rd parties to provide the VGM if the Shipper chooses to do so.

Shippers are recommended to liaise closely with the shipping agent in case of any difficulty in securing a timely VGM.

SOLAS VGM information

What is VGM?

Verified Gross Mass or VGM refers to the exact, verified weight of a packed container. For safety reasons, vessel operators can only load a container if its weight has been verified.

What do I need to include in my VGM instructions?

You must include the following on all VGM instructions:

Booking or Bill of Lading (BL) number

Container number

VGM + weight measurement unit (lbs. or kgs.)

Digital signature of the authorized signatory in all CAPITAL LETTERS.

How can I submit my VGM instructions?

myMSC (Free of Charge)

Email: md695-mdkiv-office-dl@msc.com (USD 25/container)

Guidelines for submitting your VGM instructions

MSC prefers to receive a Shipper-Verified Gross Mass (VGM) before cargo is delivered. This helps to avoid any unexpected weighing charges being levied against the cargo at the Port of Loading, which will be billed to the Shipper of Record.

Any Shipper of Record-signed VGM will override any VGM derived at or by the terminal.

For truck delivery, the ultimate deadline for VGM submission will be 12:00 noon local time on the day of the cargo cut-off.

SOLAS VGM information

What is VGM?

Verified Gross Mass or VGM refers to the exact, verified weight of a packed container. For safety reasons, vessel operators can only load a container if its weight has been verified.

In line with SOLAS (Safety of Lives at Sea) regulations, all marine terminals are now allowed to use their certified scales to record Verified Gross Mass (VGM) of shipments.

What do I need to include in my VGM instructions?

You must include the following on all VGM instructions:

- Booking or Bill of Lading (BL) number

- Container number

- VGM + weight measurement unit ( kgs.)

- Responsible Party Name

How can I submit my VGM instructions?

- myMSC (Free of Charge)

Guidelines for submitting your VGM instructions

MSC prefers to receive a Shipper-Verified Gross Mass (VGM) before cargo is delivered. This helps to avoid any unexpected weighing charges being levied against the cargo at the Port of Loading, which will be billed to the Shipper of Record.

For truck delivery, the ultimate deadline for VGM submission will be 12:00 noon local time on the day of the cargo cut-off.

Some of the terminals (mainly Italy) apply “NO VGM – No GATE” policy.

All rail shipments must have the VGM submitted within 24 hours of the container gating in at the origin rail ramp, to avoid any extra fees levied by the terminal for weighing services. Late gates will only be considered for approval when a VGM is submitted by the Shipper of Record before 12:00 noon, local time, on the day of the cargo cut-off.

Demurrage, Storage, Plug In and YOC charges in the Netherlands

What is demurrage?

Demurrage is the charge applicable, after the free time expires, for the use of the carrier’s container. This charge is applicable for both inside the marine terminal, inland depot, railroad facilities or container yard and while with the customer.

What is storage?

A storage charge is applicable, after the free time expires, for containers left inside the marine terminal, inland depot, the rail ramp or container yard (for the use of the land).

What is plug in?

The plug in charge is applicable, after free time expires, for temperature operating containers inside the marine terminal, inland depot, the rail ramp or container yard.

This charge covers both the plugging, unplugging, monitoring and usage of electricity of the temperature operating container.

What is YOC?

Yard Occupancy Charge (YOC) is a one off charge at the marine terminals charged on the 13th day of dwelling after discharge.

This charge is a longstanding fee and will be charged only for import containers.

All of the aforementioned charges can also apply while the container is undergoing customs inspections, or while the cargo inside the container is being reworked for safety reasons.

If (an) import container(s) is/are on quay for over 20 days, we may block the container and request for immediate payment of aforementioned charges before unblocking the container.
In case of a dispute of one of the aforementioned charges, please write the reason of disputing as well as the invoice numbers to both of the following addresses:

NL356-bxrtm.debiteurenadm@msc.com ; NL356-bxrtm.demurragedisputes@msc.com

Government approval status

What to include in your VGM instructions

The following items are mandatory and must be on all VGM instructions

• Booking or Bill of Lading number

• Container number

How to submit your VGM instructions

• myMSC

Deadlines for sending your VGM instructions

• VGM must be submitted to the ship-agent ultimately 24hours before physical closing of the vessel. The VGM cut-off date will be mentioned on the booking confirmation.

• If the VGM is not timely submitted, the container will not be planned/loaded on the vessel.

Recommendations

• Containers arriving at the gate without VGM will be allowed at the terminal, however not loaded when VGM not provided in time. Please be aware that the terminal has no weighing facilities.

• Manual methods of submission (email or fax) will be accepted but strongly discouraged and charged with a fee. Preferred methods are the established digital channels to avoid delays and documentation errors.

- Regular cargo claims (reefer and dry containers)

- Incidents with financial consequences/loss

- Loss BL incidents

- Legal and Claims related advises

LOI (Letter of indemnity) for lost or destroyed OBLs (Original Bills of Lading)

What is an LOI?

An LOI (Letter of Indemnity) is required when an original Bill of Lading is lost or destroyed. It can be completed by shipper at the Port of Loading, or by the consignee at the Port of Discharge.

MSC’s global LOI requirements are set out by our Geneva headquarters. The LOI must be completed as per these instructions in order for a duplicate Bill of Lading to be issued.

Questions about LOI?

Contact our Claims team through NL356-bxrtm.claims@msc.com and herewith please find the LOI form.

How to get an online Freight Quotation

Getting a personal freight quote and Booking directly with the shipping line has become ever more simple with MYMSC.

This is a guide to understand how to get a freight quotation and book your import or export container online.

As Importing or Exporting party there are a few decisions to make around your logistics:

1-   Will the importer or exporter get an ocean freight quote and book the cargo

2-   Does one book directly with the shipping line or container carrier against using a freight forwarder or digital forwarder

3-   Will this be just an ocean freight quote or will one book an intermodal solution, so from and to door, ramp or port.

Container carriers taken up on the demand around booking online is serviced directly by the container carrier instead of making use of a (digital) freight forwarder, which on it's turn book the cargo with the same shipping line.

MSC has launched MYMSC.COM which walks you through all necessary steps to get your container loaded aboard a ship, including container tracking once loaded.

Step by step, MYMSC will guide you through the following modules:

1- Instant Quote - quick quotes 24/7

2- Documentation - your booking confirmations, Non-negotionable B/L, Arrival Notices, Invoices, Draft B/L & AMS Declaration status

3- SOLAS VGM - all steps to comply with timely VGM submission

4- Ebusiness - From Online Shipping instructions & additional services to Draft B/L Approval

5- Dashboard – status overview and notifications of quotes and shipments

6 Tracking & Vessel information – track shipments by B/L, schedules and cut-off’s and Customs Release Status

All in all today’s container shipping is a lot more transparent in comparison to the past especially considering that all operational schedules, deadlines and cut-offs are accessible online 24/7.

Link copied!

How to find the best Intermodal Solution for my cargo?

How to explore a logistics companies’ network capabilities and find the best fit for your supply chain.

MSC, being the world’s biggest shipping line, has a global logistics network which extends from all corners of the world meaning that there is always a transport solution and container depot next to your warehouse, factory, or store.

To best consider the optimal supply-chain for your import or export 20’, 40’ or 45’ container there are a few considerations to make around geography, what intermodal modalities to select next to your short-sea or deepsea transportation and whether to book ocean transport separate from intermodal transport.

In the Netherlands alone MSC deploys 15 container depots which are centered around multimodal transport, meaning truck, barge or rail, all offering multiple weekly or even daily sailings to the main ports of Rotterdam, Antwerp and Flushing.

We offer tailormade solutions for inland transport combining rail or barge with last-mile trucking, where maximum transit time is around 3 days from discharge in one of the main ports to final destination.

Rail to Venlo goes by a transit time of 2 days whilst trucking goes by a transit time of 1 day meaning loading and delivery are within the same day.

One point to take into consideration is around free-time, demurrage, and detention aside from the geographical journey of your cargo.

Hence, an intermodal solution booked directly with the shipping line in will make free-time and detention significantly more carefree as the complete pre-carriage plan is within control of the shipping line and therefore free-time on export is less of a factor, especially in combination with one of our container depots always close by.

Search MYMSC.com online 24/7 schedule information or contact one of our local MSC representatives for a quote.

How to choose the right supply-chain, using a forwarder or the shipping line?

How to choose the right supply-chain, using a forwarder or the shipping line?

Here are three things to consider when you’re deciding on your supply-chain outcome:

- What responsibility of which part of your supply-chain, i.e your INCOTERMS

- Booking an end-to-end logistics product or simply port to port

- Booking directly with the shipping line or a freight forwarder

Although the above-mentioned points may seem detached from one another, they do have one important consideration in common – how much do I want to be in charge of my cargo?

General adage:  What you focus on, grows. We invite you to grow the relationship with us online over MYMSC.com for quotes, bookings, documentation and much more or directly with one of our trade managers based in one of our 570 offices globally here.

Now, let’s dive in why:

Oftentimes smaller or inexperienced importers and exporters go to freight forwarders as the perception is that it is difficult to speak directly to a shipping line.

To some extent that used to be true, yet now with an ever digitalizing environment the online portals that come off the container carriers are the same sources of information that feed the Forwarder and all other trading companies within that supply-chain.

In today’s world its rather easy to ask, compare and book directly with the carrier. This goes for port to port combinations or door to door and everything in between and therefore the respective INCOTERMS that apply to your shipment.

At MSC and as an industry, we are doing our outmost best to minimize the information bias and supply everyone with up-to-date information 24/7 in our online portal MYMSC.com, which is easily accessible after a quick registration.

We invite you to register and build the relationship today, as long-term benefits is what we believe in at MSC.

Fumigation

A Comprehensive Fumigation Solution for Seamless Cargo Operations

MSC’s advanced fumigation solution in Rotterdam integrates seamlessly with our carrier haulage offering and streamlined documentation and compliance support which is linked to the port community systems to ensure your cargo moves efficiently through the supply chain to its destination.

MSC’s fumigation solutions are designed to comply with the latest international regulations, including:

BMSB Fumigation: Effective treatment targeting the Brown Marmorated Stink Bug for your Australia-bound cargo

BMSB Winter Fumigation: Specialized treatment for colder temperatures, ensuring year-round BSMB fumigation

Pre-export fumigation

Extensive intermodal offering (road, rail, barge)

Customs Clearance solution

Secure and timely arrival

Why Choose MSC Netherlands for Your Fumigation?

Comprehensive Service Offering

We offer a full suite of services, including specialised carrier haulage and intermodal solutions, ensuring a streamlined supply chain from start to finish. Whether you drop off your container at our depots or opt for collection via our carrier haulage service, we help you save time and streamline operations every step of the way.

Compliance and Regulations

MSC Netherlands fumigation services are designed to comply with the latest international regulations, for the mandatory BMSB treatment from September to April for shipments to Australia and New Zealand. This compliance reduces the risk of delays and penalties for our customers.

Expert Fumigation Solutions

We partner with certified fumigation solution suppliers within the Netherlands to provide high-quality fumigation treatments. The expertise and reliability of these suppliers ensure that we meet international standards effectively.

FAQs

What is BMSB fumigation, and why is it required for exports to Australia and New Zealand?

Fumigation is a treatment process targeting the Brown Marmorated Stink Bug for your Australia-bound cargo. Australia and New Zealand have strict biosecurity regulations to prevent invasive species from entering their ecosystems. Certain goods—such as wooden packaging, used machinery and vehicles, and specific cargo types—must be fumigated before export to comply with these regulations.

Share
Link copied!

Which cargo requires fumigation for export to Australia/New Zealand?

Goods that typically require BMSB fumigation include:

Wooden packaging materials such as pallets, crates, and dunnage

Used machinery and vehicles with potential pest habitats

Containers flagged by biosecurity authorities as requiring treatment due to high risk of pest infestation
If you're unsure whether your cargo requires fumigation, our team can assess your shipment and provide advice based on current regulations.

Share
Link copied!

Can MSC assist with export documentation for your container/cargo?

Yes! MSC offers a comprehensive export documentation service, ensuring that all necessary paperwork—including fumigation certificates—is correctly prepared and submitted. Our team streamlines the process to prevent delays and ensure compliance with Australian and New Zealand regulations.

Share
Link copied!

Where does MSC provide fumigation services?

MSC provides fumigation at key location in the Netherlands, ensuring that your cargo is treated before departure. We work with certified fumigation facilities to guarantee compliance with the latest biosecurity standards.

Share
Link copied!

Does MSC offer intermodal transport solutions in addition to fumigation?

Yes! MSC integrates fumigation with intermodal transport solutions, combining sea, rail, and road transport for efficient logistics. This allows us to optimize transit times and provide a seamless end-to-end export service.

Share
Link copied!

How can I book fumigation services with MSC?

You can book fumigation services by contacting our team directly. We will guide you through the process, ensure proper treatment is scheduled, and coordinate with our logistics network to streamline your shipment.

Share
Link copied!

What is the fumigation process for export?

The fumigation process ensures that your cargo meets biosecurity regulations before export. Here’s how it works:

1. Client Consultation: You provide details about your cargo and destination requirements

2. Booking: You place the booking of your cargo with MSC, which will be processed and confirmed

3. Inland Transport: Based on the booking - CY or Door, we will ensure smooth inland transport to the fumigation location

4. Certified Fumigation Treatment: We coordinate fumigation with top-rated suppliers, ensuring compliance with Australian and New Zealand regulations

5. Certification: A fumigation certificate is issued, verifying that your cargo meets the necessary standards

6. Export & Shipping: Once cleared, the cargo is transported and shipped to its final destination

BCW

Intermodal Solutions

At MSC Netherlands, through an extensive inland network of trucks, trains, and barges, we connect your business seamlessly to key locations into and beyond the Netherlands.

Customs Clearance solutions

Offering sustainable solutions

Extensive intermodal offering (road, rail, barge)

Door-to-door delivery solutions

Delivering peace of mind

Your Smart Connection Beyond Rotterdam

Through our extensive inland network, we offer flexible transport
options by truck, rail, and barge. With facilitated access to more than 20 inland depots
across the Netherlands, it provides logistics closer to your operations
and supports more efficient, sustainable cargo flows.

Seamless Connections Across Europe

From Rotterdam, your goods move far beyond the
Netherlands, thanks to one of the most advanced
intermodal networks in Europe. We connect your supply
chain to the continent's major markets including Belgium, France, Germany, Austria, and Czech
Republic in a fast, reliable, and sustainable way.

MSC's Dedicated Hub

Strategically located in Rotterdam, this dedicated extended gate provides seamless connections to inland
waterways and intermodal transport, ensuring
smoother and more sustainable logistics flows.

Discover more

MSC’s Dedicated Hub - Extended Gate

Our dedicated hub at the Barge Center Waalhaven (BCW) Terminal offers a faster, more reliable and sustainable alternative to road transport.

Cost efficient

Save time

12+ Weekly sailings

Delivering peace of mind

Why Choose MSC's Dedicated Hub?

Thanks to its strategic location in the heart of the Port of Rotterdam and its accessibility by barge, the hub enables faster and more reliable container delivery, ensuring seamless cargo flows between the terminals of Rotterdam, Amsterdam, Flushing, and Antwerp. By reducing congestion, CO₂ emissions, and road surcharges, and supported by several weekly sailings, extended opening hours, and reefer capability, the service guarantees on-time delivery and stress-free logistics.

Read more

Weekly Sailings to Move Your Cargo to and From MSC's Dedicated Hub

With over twelve weekly departures, including three fixed-window sailings, we provide frequent and reliable connections
for both dry and reefer cargo. Through seamless multimodal
links, your supply chain extends efficiently to the Netherlands and
Europe, ensuring reliability and consistency.

Tailored Services and Local Expertise

A comprehensive range of solutions will be available on-site for both import and export operations, including customs clearance, gas measurement, and liquid cargo handling. Our on-site experts are ready to provide hands-on assistance, ensuring a smooth process, dedicated customer support, and added value for your business at every stage of your journey.

Netherlands Liquid Cargo

Your Partner for Shipping Liquid Cargo

At MSC Netherlands, we understand that transporting liquid cargo requires precision, reliability, and expertise. From container selection to on-site support, our comprehensive solutions are designed to streamline your operations, reduce risks, and ensure that your shipments reach their destination safely and efficiently.

Extensive intermodal offering (road, rail, barge)

Door-to-door delivery solutions

Liquid cargo equipment at Medrepair

Delivering peace of mind

Ready to go Containers to and from Rotterdam

MSC Netherlands provides ready-to-use liquid cargo solutions directly from our dedicated depot based in the Port of Rotterdam. With flexitanks already fitted in our containers, your liquid shipments can move straight to the loading site, avoiding unnecessary stops or external handling. This efficient setup helps reduce costs, save time ensuring a smoother and more reliable supply chain. Whether you are moving edible oils, harmless chemicals, or other liquid commodities, our flexible solutions are tailored to support your business with efficiency and care.

Local Expertise for Your Liquid Cargo

MSC Netherlands offers the advantage of local expertise with dedicated specialists available on site to support your liquid cargo operations. Our team of experts is ready to provide hands-on assistance, answer your questions and propose tailored solutions whenever needed. This close guidance ensures smoother processes, reliable information and added value for your business at every stage.

Seamless Cargo Solutions

MSC Netherlands ensures peace of mind for your liquid cargo logistics. With the ability to select the most suitable container and using our own modern equipment, we optimize the container selection process. Through this process we ensure safety, customs clearance, compliance, and reliability across our extensive inland network in the Netherlands and beyond.

Netherlands Reefer

Your Cold Chain, Our Mission

At MSC Netherlands, we ensure your temperature-sensitive cargo stays in optimal condition along the journey. Thanks to our extensive global network and our expertise in Reefer solutions, we are able to ship your reefer cargo to the destination required. Whether serving the Dutch market or connecting you to the rest of the world, MSC Netherlands is your trusted partner in reliable and efficient temperature-controlled transport.

Temperature, ventilation and humidity controls

Real-time monitoring through iReefer solution

Door-to-door delivery solutions

Delivering peace of mind

Tailored Cold Chain Solutions for Every Cargo

MSC Netherlands keeps your temperature-sensitive cargo fresh and secure, from fruit and vegetables to pharmaceuticals, fish, meat, and dairy. Our advanced reefer system precisely controls temperature, ventilation, and humidity, ensuring optimal conditions from pick-up to delivery. Supported by one of the world’s most advanced reefer fleets and full GDP and FSM compliance, we deliver tailored solutions for every chilled and frozen shipment.

From Port to Door: Integrated Cold Chain Solution

At MSC Netherlands, collaboration is key to keeping temperature-sensitive cargo fresh from pick-up to delivery. Tailored to your needs, our inland solutions combine a strong intermodal network road, rail, and barge with more than 20 strategically located depots, regular weekly shipping services and customs support, ensuring seamless cold chain logistics across the Netherlands and beyond.

Dedicated Care for Your Reefer Cargo

Within MSC Netherlands we have dedicated reefer departments for both sales and customer service. We stand by your side to ensure your temperature-sensitive cargo is shipped efficiently whatever the season or the goods, ensuring your refrigerated goods arrive in optimal condition, at the right place and on time.

MSC iReefer Solution

Powered by MSC’s global technology and the local expertise of MSC Netherlands, gain full visibility over your refrigerated shipments with real-time data.

Netherlands Retail

Count on us for Your Retail Logistics

At MSC Netherlands, we understand that your shipping needs might be changing according to the seasons. Taking advantage of a global network, we are able to keep your supply chain running smoothly all year round. Whether you ship toys, textiles or any other consumer goods, our team of experts delivers reliable, efficient, and sustainable logistics solutions tailored to your business.

Global coverage

Direct calls and frequent sailings

Customs Clearance solution

Door-to-door delivery solutions

Delivering peace of mind

Global Shipping Coverage into the Netherlands

MSC connects the East West and North-South routes to the Dutch market through a global, reliable network designed to manage seasonal peaks. Using the port of Rotterdam as the European Gateway, ensures efficient import of consumer goods.

Intermodal Coverage in and Beyond Rotterdam

Leveraging an efficient inland network of barge, rail, and truck for last-mile transport, we deliver your retail cargo to its final destination with speed and reliability, while simplifying customs procedures.

Supporting Your Cargo Through Local Expertise

Our team of experts stand by your side to ship your goods efficiently. Each trade line is supported by a dedicated customer service team that ensures your cargo reaches the right place, at the right time. Our strong presence in the Netherlands is built on close relationships with customers, local partners, and suppliers. These long-standing connections reflect our commitment to understanding your business, anticipating challenges, and delivering reliable, efficient shipping solutions.

Netherlands Standalone Network

Rotterdam: Europe's Gateway to the World

Strategically positioned at Europe’s gateway, Rotterdam is a key hub in MSC’s global network, connecting core European markets with international trade routes. With frequent sailing, modern port infrastructure and a powerful intermodal network MSC Netherlands ensures fast, reliable, and efficient cargo movement to move your goods worldwide.

A Strategic Hub for your Cargo

Through dedicated loops, MSC Netherlands connects your cargo worldwide, supporting both import and export operations. Our network ensures reliable, efficient, and on-time movement, delivering your goods seamlessly across global markets with the port of Rotterdam serving as the strategic hub for your cargo.

Inland Transport Connections

Rotterdam is Europe’s most connected port, offering seamless intermodal solutions through MSC Netherlands. With trucks, trains, and barges linking more than 20 key Inland terminals, we ensure smooth cargo flows within the Netherlands and beyond delivering flexible, reliable, and sustainable alternatives to road transport.

Get in Touch With our Local Experts

Our team of experts located in Rotterdam are committed to delivering customer excellence, designing the right solution for your cargo with tailored support at every step. Contact us today and start your journey with MSC Netherlands.

What is demurrage?

What are storage charges?

VGM receiving policy in North Macedonia

What is VGM?

Verified Gross Mass or VGM refers to the exact, verified weight of a packed container. For safety reasons, vessel operators can only load a container if its weight has been verified.

In line with SOLAS (Safety of Lives at Sea) regulations, all marine terminals are now allowed to use their certified scales to record Verified Gross Mass (VGM) of shipments.

What do I need to include in my VGM instructions?

You must include the following on all VGM instructions:

Booking or Bill of Lading (BL) number

Container number

VGM + weight measurement unit ( kgs.)

Responsible Party Name

How can I submit my VGM instructions?

myMSC

Guidelines for submitting your VGM instructions

MSC prefers to receive a Shipper-Verified Gross Mass (VGM) before cargo is delivered. This helps to avoid any unexpected weighing charges being levied against the cargo at the Port of Loading, which will be billed to the Shipper of Record.

For truck delivery, the ultimate deadline for VGM submission will be 12:00 noon local time on the day of the cargo cut-off.

Some of the terminals (mainly Italy) apply “NO VGM – No GATE” policy.

All rail shipments must have the VGM submitted within 24 hours of the container gating in at the origin rail ramp, to avoid any extra fees levied by the terminal for weighing services. Late gates will only be considered for approval when a VGM is submitted by the Shipper of Record before 12:00 noon, local time, on the day of the cargo cut-off.

Demurrage and Storage charges in Portugal

What is Demurrage?

Demurrage is the charge applicable after the free time expires, calculation starts from discharge day (included) and ends on the gate-in empty day (included).

Demurrage is applicable at port of discharge or final destination, depending on contracted terms, unless stated otherwise during the negotiations and dully approved by MSC Geneva.

What is Storage?

Storage charge is applicable after the free time expires, calculation starts from discharge day (included) and ends with gate out full day (included) from terminal.

If a customer requests to perform the customs clearance at POD Sines before rail positioning storage and demurrage charges as per standard tariff are applicable in addition to the ones applicable at final destination.

Demurrage and Storage charges are applicable per container per calendar day (i.e. including week-ends and holidays).

Detention, Demurrage and Storage charges in Portugal for Export

What is Detention?

Detention is the charge applicable after the free time expires, calculation starts from empty pick up day (included) and ends with the gate-in full day in the Sea Port/Terminal with complete documentation ready to be loaded on Vessel.

What is Demurrage?

Demurrage is the charge applicable after the free time expires, calculation starts from gate in full day at Sea Port/Terminal (included) until ETS day (included).

Some contracts have combined detention and demurrage, this charge is applicable after the free time expires, calculation starts from empty pick up day (included) until ETS day (included).

What are storage charges?

Storage is the charge applicable after the free time expires, calculation starts from gate in full day at Sea Port/Terminal (included) until ETS day (included).

Detention, demurrage and storage charges are applicable per container per calendar day (i.e. including week-ends).

Any rollover or earlier delivery at the Sea Port / Terminal requested by client may have Demurrage and Storage costs.

Questions about detention, demurrage, or storage charges?

Contact our Dem&Sto Team by email: PT083-demurragestorage.user@msc.com

In case of detention, demurrage or storage disputes, email PT083-DisputeTeam@msc.com, mentioning the invoice number in the email subject. Please describe the reasons for your dispute.

Detention, demurrage, Per Diem and storage charges

What are storage charges?

A storage charge is applicable, after the free time expires, for containers left inside the container terminal  (for the use of the land).

What is demurrage?

Demurrage is the charge applicable, after the free time expires, inside the terminal for the use of the land.

What is detention?

Detention is the charge applicable, after the free time expires, for the use of the carrier’s container (full or empty) outside the marine terminal. For import, the timeframe is from the date the full container is picked up from the terminal until it is returned empty, whereas for export, the timeframe is between the date the empty container is picked up from the terminal until it is returned full, customs cleared and ready to be shipped.

Questions about storage, demurrage or detention charges?
