SOLAS VGM information

What is VGM?

Verified Gross Mass or VGM refers to the exact, verified weight of a packed container. For safety reasons, vessel operators can only load a container if its weight has been verified.

In line with SOLAS (Safety of Lives at Sea) regulations, all marine terminals in the USA are now allowed to use their certified scales to record Verified Gross Mass (VGM) of shipments.

What do I need to include in my VGM instructions?

You must include the following on all VGM instructions:

Booking or Bill of Lading (BL) number

Container number

VGM + weight measurement unit (lbs. or kgs.)

Responsible Party Name

Digital signature of the authorised signatory in all CAPITAL LETTERS.

How can I submit my VGM instructions?

myMSC (Free of Charge)

EDI (via INTTRA; GT NEXUS; etc – free of charge)

Email: RO187-ROBUH-Avizari@msc.com (the export team will declare the VGM on your behalf)

Guidelines for submitting your VGM instructions

The Verified Gross Mass (VGM) must be sent within the cut offs, immediately after stuffing.

If you cannot determine the VGM, we can provide this service at the container terminal in Constanta, but the request must be placed at the time of the booking.

The weighting can be done exceptionally after container is gated in, but there will be additional costs involved.

There is currently no “NO VGM – No GATE” policy.

MSC admin fees and costs

Manual VGM Submission Fee (applies to email, fax, and inclusion on standard shipping instructions): 5 USD per container.

Late VGM Submission Fee: 10 USD per container.

VGM Misdeclaration Fee: 70 USD per misdeclaration + weighting costs, per container.

Questions about VGM?

Contact our export team at RO187-BUH-Export-DL@msc.com.

Demurrage is the charge applicable, after the free time expires, for keeping container in port or with the customer, until it is returned empty

What are storage charges?

A storage charge is applicable, after the free time expires, for containers left inside the rail ramp or container yard (for the use of the land).

Questions about demurrage or storage charges?

Contact our Serbia team.

Share
Link copied!

SOLAS VGM information

What is VGM?

Verified Gross Mass or VGM refers to the exact, verified weight of a packed container. For safety reasons, vessel operators can only load a container if its weight has been verified.

In line with SOLAS (Safety of Lives at Sea) regulations, all marine terminals are now allowed to use their certified scales to record Verified Gross Mass (VGM) of shipments. Download our VGM policy and terminal guidelines for more information.

What do I need to include in my VGM instructions?

You must include the following on all VGM instructions:

Booking or Bill of Lading (BL) number

Container number

VGM + weight measurement unit ( kgs.)

Responsible Party Name

How can I submit my VGM instructions?

myMSC (Free of Charge)

Guidelines for submitting your VGM instructions

MSC prefers to receive a Shipper-Verified Gross Mass (VGM) before cargo is delivered. This helps to avoid any unexpected weighing charges being levied against the cargo at the Port of Loading, which will be billed to the Shipper of Record.

For truck delivery, the ultimate deadline for VGM submission will be 12:00 noon local time on the day of the cargo cut-off.

Some of the terminals (mainly Italy) apply “NO VGM – No GATE” policy.

All rail shipments must have the VGM submitted within 24 hours of the container gating in at the origin rail ramp, to avoid any extra fees levied by the terminal for weighing services. Late gates will only be considered for approval when a VGM is submitted by the Shipper of Record before 12:00 noon, local time, on the day of the cargo cut-off.

Automotive & Tyre Logistics from Serbia to the World

Whether you're exporting tyres to the EU and global markets or importing automotive parts into Serbia, you need reliable automotive logistics to keep your business moving. MSC Serbia provides tailored full-service logistics solutions for manufacturers, suppliers and distributors across the automotive and tyre industry. From factory gate to final destination, our global network, reliable weekly sailings and experienced local team ensure your cargo moves efficiently and on schedule. We offer specialist cargo handling for both complete vehicles and spare parts, a single point of contact and the dependable service you need to drive your supply chain forward.

Specialist automotive handling

Serbia as a strategic automotive hub

Reliable Weekly Connections to World Markets

MSC Serbia connects Serbian automotive and tyre businesses to key markets across Europe and beyond through frequent sailings, strong port coverage and integrated inland transport solutions. Supported by local experts, real-time tracking, myMSC visibility tools and customs clearance services, we deliver predictable transit times and reliable support from origin to destination.

Specialized Expertise for the Automotive Industry

MSC Serbia understands the demands of just-in-time production and high-volume exports. We handle passenger and commercial vehicles, automotive components, spare parts, tyres and production inputs using specialist loading, lashing and containerization methods to ensure safe, efficient and timely delivery worldwide.

Serbia: A Hub for Automotive and Tyre Exports

Serbia has become a leading production and export hub for global automotive and tyre manufacturers, benefiting from major investment, skilled talent and strong access to European markets. MSC Serbia builds on this strategic position to provide fast, reliable links between Serbian production sites and customers worldwide.

Secure, Containerized Transport for Automotive Cargo

MSC Serbia's container solutions provide a secure, weather-protected alternative to open transport, keeping vehicles and tyres clean, dry and protected throughout their journey. By maximizing container utilization and optimizing routing and inland transport distances, we help you build a more efficient and sustainable supply chain.

Your Trusted Partner for Coffee Imports

Coffee is one of the world's most valuable commodities, which is why coffee imports demand expertise, precision and a global network you can rely on. MSC Serbia provides Serbian importers with a fully managed, integrated coffee import solution, from the world's leading growing regions to your warehouse door. Whether you’re importing Arabica or Robusta, we offer specialist cargo handling, in-depth knowledge of Serbian coffee customs regulations and the backing of MSC's global presence in over 155 countries. That’s how we help Serbian importers maintain quality, control costs and ensure consistent supply.

Local Serbian expertise and support

Specialist coffee cargo handling

Complete coffee import management

Global network, 155+ countries

Connecting Coffee Origins to Serbia

MSC Serbia manages your coffee imports from the world's leading coffee-growing regions, including Brazil, Vietnam, Colombia, Indonesia and Ethiopia. Backed by MSC's global network and a single point of contact overseeing every stage of the journey, Serbian coffee importers benefit from a seamless and reliable door-to-door solution.

Specialized Coffee Cargo Handling

Coffee is sensitive cargo that demands careful treatment throughout transit. MSC Serbia ensures correct container preparation, stuffing and moisture protection to preserve quality from origin to warehouse. Where required, thermal liners protect cargo from temperature fluctuations and maintain optimal conditions throughout the journey.

A Global Network Built for Coffee

With a presence in 155+ countries and direct access to every major coffee-producing region, MSC Serbia secures consistent, reliable supply chains for Serbian importers. Whether you source Arabica, Robusta, or both, we guarantee dependable departures and stable schedules, even during the most demanding peak seasons.

Support At Every Step

From customs clearance and documentation to final delivery, MSC Serbia's experienced local team supports you throughout the import process. Deep knowledge of Serbian coffee import regulations, proactive communication and responsive customer support help keep your supply chain moving without unnecessary delays.

Your Trusted Partner for Fresh Exports

Serbia is a key regional producer of apples, berries, and high-quality frozen fruit.
At MSC Serbia, we provide the expertise, equipment, and global network needed to deliver these products safely and efficiently to markets worldwide. Our dedicated Reefer specialists ensure precise temperature control, reliable transit times, and end-to-end support for exporters of fresh and frozen goods. MSC Serbia also provides real-time digital monitoring through iReefer technology, ensuring full visibility and enhanced cold-chain protection throughout the entire journey.

Local Expertise

Expert temperature control

Strong global network

Support for Agro exporters

Reefer Expertise for Fresh Serbian Produce

Our Reefer team in Serbia support exporters of apples, raspberries, blueberries, and mixed frozen fruit with tailored cooling solutions. From pre-trip inspections to temperature monitoring and ventilation settings, MSC Serbia ensures your produce arrives fresh and safe. We collaborate closely with local producers to understand their specific needs and provide reliable cold-chain performance for every shipment.

Frozen Fruit and Cold-Chain Reliability

Serbia’s frozen fruit exports are globally recognized for quality, and MSC Serbia delivers the cold-chain stability required to maintain that standard. Our fleet of advanced Reefer containers offers dependable deep-freeze performance, ideal for high quality frozen fruit. Thanks to our fast Trieste–Serbia intermodal rail connection, frozen cargo moves quickly and reliably from Serbia to key global markets.

Tailored Logistics for Agro Exporters

We understand the demands of seasonal peaks and time-sensitive shipments. MSC Serbia provides flexible solutions, strong inland connections, and reliable transit times to key global markets. With our experience in handling large volumes during harvest seasons, your fruit products move smoothly from farm to destination.

Local Support and Reefer Knowledge

With strong expertise in the fruit industry and long-standing partnerships, we anticipate customer needs and ensure smooth, efficient shipments, even during peak seasons.

Serbia Grain

Your Partner for Grain Logistics

Serbia is a key hub for grain trade and MSC Serbia supports exporters and traders with reliable ocean and inland logistics solutions. From planning and documentation to dependable schedules and global connectivity, our team helps move grain cargo efficiently to key markets worldwide. Key export commodities include corn as the leading product, followed by wheat, barley, and soybean/sunflower serving destinations across Europe, the Mediterranean and Far East. MSC Serbia also supports containerized grain shipments, ensuring flexibility and reduced handling risks for exporters.

Global Shipping Network

Reliable Inland Connectivity

Customer Support in Serbia

Connecting Serbia’s Grain Exporters to the World

MSC Serbia provides reliable and efficient logistics solutions for grain exporters. With strong inland connectivity, a global shipping network, and practical, market‑oriented support, we help move corn, wheat, and other key commodities safely and on schedule to major international markets. Our team ensures stable transport flows, quality handling, and dependable service tailored to Serbia’s grain trade needs.

Serbia’s Grain Trade, Powered by MSC

Serbia’s grain exports are a key pillar of regional and global trade, recognized for their volume, quality, and reliability. MSC Serbia supports grain exporters with stable, efficient logistics solutions designed for bulk-containerized grain shipments. With dependable sailing schedules and strong inland connectivity, we help ensure Serbian grain reaches international markets safely and on time.

Reliable Transport to Global Markets

Through MSC’s extensive global shipping network and efficient intermodal connections, grain cargo is transported smoothly from Serbia to key destinations worldwide. Our integrated logistics solutions enable stable transport flows, helping exporters maintain consistency, reduce transit risks, and meet market demand across multiple regions.

Local Expertise, Global Connectivity

MSC Serbia is developing sustainable grain‑export solutions in close cooperation with local partners. "We are expanding partnerships to further strengthen our containerized grain solutions and embrace new opportunities” says Mirjana Matović, our Business Development Manager.

We combine local market knowledge with the strength of a global logistics network to support grain traders and exporters at every stage of the supply chain. By working closely with customers, we provide practical, market‑oriented solutions that help Serbian grain remain competitive and well‑positioned in global trade.

Serbia Intermodal

Connecting Serbia to Europe’s Key Markets

Strategically located at the crossroads of major European transport corridors, Serbia plays an important role in regional and international trade, enabling direct access to markets across the Balkans and Central Europe. Leveraging  strong relationships with terminals, rail operators, trucking companies and logistics providers, MSC Serbia connects businesses with key ports and inland destinations to deliver fast, reliable cargo distribution for a broad range of industries and cargo types. Have a unique or non-standard logistics request? Our experienced Serbian team will find solutions, develop new models or create a tailor-made transport concept to meet your needs.  Supported by an extensive inland network including, Metrans Inđija, Nelt Belgrade, and Leget (Sremska Mitrovica), we provide seamless connections to major European and Adriatic gateways such as Koper, Rijeka, Trieste and Genoa.

Rail Network

Tailored Solutions

Local Expertise

Specialist Equipment

Extensive Rail Network

MSC Serbia operates a network of seven inland terminals, offering more than 20 weekly rail departures that connect Serbia with key Adriatic ports, including Bar, Koper, Rijeka Working with established rail operators, MSC Serbia keeps cargo moving, cutting transit times and offering lower-emission alternatives to road-only transportation for both imports and exports.

Tailored Intermodal Solutions

MSC Serbia combines road, rail and maritime transport to deliver tailored intermodal solutions to meet every customer’s requirement. Supported by an extensive inland network, trusted rail operators and more than 40 trucking partners, we provide nationwide coverage and seamless connections to key European and Adriatic gateways, selecting the most efficient routing to meet your cargo requirements, priorities and transit times.

Specialist Equipment for Every Cargo Type

MSC Serbia provides specialist equipment for every cargo type utilising a trusted network of transport partners. From standard and ADR-certified vehicles to reefer solutions, we ensure equipment availability, efficient terminal services and proactive planning to support reliable operations. Strategically positioned empty containers across Serbia enable rapid responses to urgent export requirements and help keep your supply chain moving.

Sustainable Logistics Solutions

MSC Serbia actively supports modal shift initiatives, helping customers move cargo from road to rail transport whenever feasible, for fewer emissions, a smaller footprint and a more resilient supply chain.

Through a combination of local expertise, operational flexibility, extensive transport capacity and the strength of MSC's global network, MSC Serbia helps customers optimize their supply chains, improve cargo visibility and achieve efficient, reliable and sustainable logistics solutions across Serbia and beyond.

Complete Visibility and Control for Serbia’s Temperature-Sensitive Exports

For temperature-sensitive cargo, visibility means more than location, it means protecting quality at every stage. With MSC iReefer, exporters in Serbia benefit from advanced, real-time monitoring of cargo position, temperature, humidity and overall condition. Accessible via the myMSC platform or API integration, our digital solution enables full transparency, faster decision-making and reduced operational risk.

Track Your Cargo in Real Time

Never Miss a Temperature Deviation

Continuous humidity monitoring

Complete Visibility of Cargo Health

Tailored to Serbia’s Export Industry

MSC iReefer is tailored for all temperature-controlled exports from Serbia, including:

- Fresh and frozen fruits & vegetables

- Meat, poultry and seafood

- Dairy and processed food products

- Pharmaceuticals and healthcare products

- Beverages and other sensitive commodities

Real-Time Cargo Protection

Monitor. React. Protect.

- Live tracking of temperature, humidity, and location

- Immediate visibility of cargo status

- Preserve product quality and reduce losses

Cold Chain Reliability – From Serbia to Global Markets

Consistency you can trust. With our reefer solutions you can benefit from:

- Seamless cold chain management

- Backed by MSC’s global network and local expertise

- Reliable delivery across all major trade routes

With strong local expertise, MSC Serbia ensures reliable cold chain performance from origin to destination.

Proactive Risk Management

Stay ahead of disruptions.

- Early alerts on any deviation

- Minimize claims and supply chain interruptions

Your Trusted Reefer Partner in Serbia

As your logistics partner, MSC Serbia combines global reach with local expertise, ensuring your cargo remains protected, controlled, and delivered in optimal condition every time.

Serbia Liquid Cargo

Your Trusted Partner in Serbia for Liquid Cargo

MSC Serbia provides a reliable door-to-door solution for transporting liquid cargo worldwide. Combining Serbia's strategic location in Southeast Europe with MSC's unrivalled global network, we offer a single point of contact for your entire liquid supply chain. We use specialist flexitanks that are professionally installed while our knowledgeable teams manage everything from loading at origin to safe delivery at destination. Whether you’re exporting edible oils, chemicals, wine or other bulk liquids, MSC Serbia delivers cost-effective, reliable and sustainable logistics tailored to your needs with the precision and care needed for liquid cargo.

Bestpoke Solutions

Dedicated Liquid Tanks

Tracking and Security

Careful Handling

Cost-efficient Liquid Cargo Exports from Serbia

MSC Serbia reduces your overall logistics costs through optimized routing and fully integrated transport solutions for liquid cargo. Leveraging Serbia's competitive operating advantages and MSC's global network, we deliver a seamlessly connected supply chain with faster transit times, reduced road transport, included product liability insurance and complete documentation support.

Advanced Flexitank Technology for Safe Transport

MSC Serbia uses premium quality flexitanks designed to safely transport bulk liquids while preventing contamination and spillage throughout the journey. Holding up to 24,000 litres per 20' container, flexitanks provide a cost-effective alternative to traditional tank logistics and are professionally installed by certified experts.

Seamless Global Connections from Serbia

Combining Serbia's strategic Southeast European location with MSC's extensive global network, MSC Serbia connects liquid cargo exporters to markets across Europe, the Middle East and beyond. Integrated ocean, road, rail and inland solutions provide reliable global market access coverage from your facility in Serbia to customers worldwide.

Expert Handling and 24/7 Support

MSC Serbia's specialist liquid cargo teams provide around-the-clock support, alongside professional flexitank fitting, supervision and management. Expert handling minimizes the risk of contamination, leakage and operational delays, ensuring your cargo moves safely and efficiently from origin to destination.

Serbia Smart Containers

Serbian Exports Gain Full Visibility with MSC’s Smart Containers

Today’s supply chains move quickly and can be unpredictable. That’s why visibility over your cargo is essential for maintaining control. With MSC’s smart containers, Serbian exporters gain real-time insights into cargo location, status and condition, enabling better planning and faster responses. Our smart containers are equipped with Internet of Things (IoT) technology to capture shipment data, including location, temperature and door activity. Suitable for all cargo, from machinery and agricultural products to Project Cargo, and available via myMSC or API integration, smart containers deliver transparency, security and improved efficiency, helping Serbian exports move safely and more confidently across global markets.

Real-Time Cargo Visibility

Enhanced Cargo Security

Valuable Data at Every Stage

Data-Driven Operational Decisions

Real-Time Visibility From Origin to Destination

MSC's smart containers provide real-time visibility of your container's location, condition and journey status from origin to destination. Powered by Internet of Things (IoT) technology, they continuously capture shipment data across inland and ocean transport, giving you greater transparency, improved planning and the confidence to stay in control throughout every stage of the journey.

Protecting Your Cargo at Every Stage

Receive instant alerts for door openings and other unusual events, enabling faster responses to potential issues throughout the journey. Continuous monitoring helps reduce the risk of theft, unauthorized access and cargo damage, while giving you greater confidence that valuable shipments remain protected from origin to destination.

Operational Intelligence that Drives Efficiency

Reliable shipment data helps you make informed decisions and optimize operations across your supply chain. MSC’s smart containers integrate with your existing IT systems through automated data collection, centralized monitoring and reporting. Reduce manual tracking, respond faster to disruptions, improve communication with customers and partners, and enhance efficiency through accurate, up-to-date information.

Local Support for Smarter Shipping

MSC Serbia combines smart container technology with dedicated local expertise to help customers make the most of real-time shipment visibility. Our local team supports you with practical guidance, from understanding cargo data and alerts to improving planning and coordination across your supply chain. With MSC Serbia, you benefit not only from advanced tracking technology, but also from people who understand your market, your cargo and your logistics needs.

Detention, demurrage, Per Diem and storage charges

What is Demurrage?

Demurrage is the charge applicable, after the free time expires, for the use of the carrier’s full container inside and outside the marine terminal, railroad facilities or container yard. This charge can also apply while the container is undergoing customs inspections, or while the cargo inside the container is being reworked for safety reasons, etc.

What is Storage?

A storage charge is applicable, after the free time expires, for containers left inside the marine terminal, rail ramp or container yard (for the use of the land).

What are the applicable conditions?

Please get in touch with us at

SK466-teamsk.export@msc.com for export shipments or

SK466-teamsk.import@msc.com for import shipments

to get valid demurrage and storage conditions for your shipment.

Share
Link copied!

SOLAS VGM information

What is VGM?

Verified Gross Mass or VGM refers to the exact, verified weight of a packed container. For safety reasons, vessel operators can only load a container if its weight has been verified.

In line with SOLAS (Safety of Lives at Sea) regulations, all marine terminals in the USA are now allowed to use their certified scales to record Verified Gross Mass (VGM) of shipments.

What do I need to include in my VGM instructions?

You must include the following on all VGM instructions:

Booking or Bill of Lading (BL) number

Container number

VGM + weight measurement unit (lbs. or kgs.)

Responsible Party Name

Digital signature of the authorized signatory in all capital letters.

How can I submit my VGM instructions?

myMSC (free of charge)

3rd party platforms (via INTTRA; GT NEXUS; etc.)

Manually (contacting SK466-teamsk.export@msc.com although manual submission fee will be applied)

Guidelines for submitting your VGM instructions

Most of the European Ports of Loading require to have VGM submitted prior to container gate-in otherwise shippers face a risk being charged for incorrectly declared container weight.

MSC prefers to receive a Shipper-Verified Gross Mass (VGM) before cargo is delivered. This helps to avoid any unexpected weighing charges being levied against the cargo at the European Ports of Loading, which will be billed to the Merchant or the Booking Party.

Please check your respective Booking Confirmation for specific VGM deadlines or refer to myMSC for updated schedule and closing details.

Questions about VGM?

Contact us at SK466-teamsk.export@msc.com.

Link copied!

Intermodal conditions for positionings in Slovakia

Waiting time

For truck positionings in Slovakia in the MSC’ care there is free time for loading and eventual custom procedures 3 hours since delivery of the container to the first delivery place (unloading place or custom office). There’s not counted in this time the time of driving between stops. By exceeding this free time there will be charged waiting time for each commenced hour till the end of all activities or stops. Merchant is obliged to confirm the trucker the end of loading or unloading on a special form or in electronic device which are at driver’s disposal.

Overweighted shipments

In case the axle pressures of the road or railway limits are exceeded due to incorrect distribution of the cargo loaded in a container, the Merchant and the booking party will be charged a possible fine and any associated costs, as well as all costs and penalties incurred by incorrectly declared weight of goods.

Positioning cancelation

If cancellation of the transport by truck is done after 11:00 a.m. of the workday before appointment date, the Merchant and the booking party will be charged with all actual incurred costs connected with the transport.

If the Merchant or the booking party cancels the train from or to the port less than 72 hours before the scheduled departure, he may be charged with Dead Slot Fee for all actual incurred costs.

Container weighing

MSC can arrange weighing for VGM purposes in case of Carrier’s haulage shipment as an additional service. If the Merchant or the booking party submits a request to arrange weighing for VGM purposes within EDI booking, the service is subject to a fee; if afterwards once a booking is already processed, the fee is different.

VGM certificated is shared with Merchant or the booking party after the container is loaded with cargo by the Merchant or its subcontractors and once the certificate is available.

Container inspection prior cargo loading

In case of Carrier’s haulage, the Merchant is responsible for inspecting the empty Container for its suitability to carry the specific shipment booked at the time of arrival to place of receipt. Any later refusal of a Container will cause additional costs for the account of the Merchant and neither MSC nor its agents shall be held liable for the costs of changing/replacing a Container accepted during empty positioning unless the defect affecting the Container was not detectable during a reasonably careful inspection; in which case the costs of the Container changing shall be shared equally. Notwithstanding the generality of the above, a light-test (visual verification of any light entry from within the Container with closed doors) is compulsory prior to each empty Container’s acceptance and no liability shall be borne by the Carrier or its agents for costs of exchanging a Container found with holes or cracks at a later stage if this could have been detected by a light test.

Booking cancelation fee

In case of cancellation of the placed booking, a Booking Cancelation Fee (BCF) will be applied and charged to the Merchant or the Booking Party. There are multiple tiers of BCF that varies based on the day the cancelation is requested.

For more information on Booking Cancelation Fee please get in touch with us at SK466-teamsk.export@msc.com.

Special import and export requirements

Imports

Merchant’s delivery instructions should be addressed to SK466-teamsk.import@msc.com latest 4 working days before vessel arrival.

The instruction for a container release in port of discharge can be considered as an email message that must contain:

Bill of Lading number and container number as a reference and such should be mentioned in the subject of the mail and

requested empty return location and anticipated date of empty return.

The instruction for a delivery of a container to its place of delivery can be considered as an email message that must contain:

Bill of Lading number and container number as a reference and such should be mentioned in the subject of the mail,

appointment date and time,

place of delivery including full name of the company, where delivery should take place, street name including building identification number, city, ZIP code and telephone contact details.

For T1 issuance purposes please specify HS codes consisting of minimum 8 (eight) digits and cargo description, also

additional transport documents as commercial invoice, packing list, DG related documents and other related documents are to be submitted to MSC Slovakia.

We cannot accept any shipments for individuals (for example, but not limited to household goods, personal effects, and vehicles).

Consignee must be a company (forwarder or direct account) with valid Tax ID.

In case of concerns, do not hesitate and contact us SK466-teamsk.import@msc.com.

For ports of discharge located in Bremerhaven, please do not forget it is mandatory that the cargo description and HS code of the goods is manifested in correct way.

Each commodity must be manifested with the specific details (HS code, number of packages and cargo weight) as one separate item on Bill of Lading. It is not permitted to manifest different commodities under one item as a continuous text in 'description of cargo’ (for example "100 cartons of trousers, 10 cartons of socks, 50 cartons of shoes, etc.").

This must be done within first 120 characters of the cargo description.

Questions about import requirements?

Contact us at SK466-teamsk.import@msc.com.

Exports

The booking request must consider following mandatory information:

port of loading,

port of discharge,

origin inland location and requested mode of transport if applicable requests including full address details, requested date and time of positioning, customs procedure details and VGM method details. GPS coordinates are not sufficient.

Preferred empty pickup location and empty pickup date for Merchant Haulage,

destination inland location and requested mode of transport if applicable,

cargo description including preliminary HS code,

cargo weight for each container,

quotation reference and

payment method for origin, freight and destination charges.

Please always consult import local requirements of respective destination prior shipping your cargo. It is mandatory to comply with all regulations and requirements of the local government and authorities.

Non-compliance with such regulations and requirements can lead to undesirable dwell time that can generate extra costs.

Questions about export requirements?

Contact us at SK466-teamsk.export@msc.com.

What is demurrage?

Demurrage is the charge applicable, after the free time expires for use of units as warehouse while on terminal or with customer:

Import: From the end of the free time till empty unit is returned

Export: from empty unit pick-up until full unit loaded on nominated vessel

In case of a demurrage dispute, email SVN-sales@msc.com subject: Dispute + Invoice Number), describing the reasons for your dispute.

What are storage charges?

A storage charge is applicable, after the free time expires, for containers left on the terminal (for the use of the land).

SOLAS VGM information for Slovenia

What is VGM?

Verified Gross Mass or VGM refers to the exact, verified weight of a packed container. For safety reasons, vessel operators can only load a container if its weight has been verified.

Port of Koper is operating on principle “No VGM – No Entry” on marine terminal. With this it is possible to perform VGM procedure before entry to marine terminal upon special request.

What do I need to include in my VGM instructions?

You must include the following on all VGM instructions:

Booking or Bill of Lading (BL) number

Container number

VGM + weight measurement unit (lbs. or kgs.)

Responsible Party Name

Digital signature of the authorized signatory in all CAPITAL LETTERS.

How can I submit my VGM instructions?

myMSC (Free of Charge)

EDI (via INTTRA)

Manually via email SVN-export@msc.com or SVN-logistics@msc.com

Guidelines for submitting your VGM instructions

MSC prefers to receive a Shipper-Verified Gross Mass (VGM) before cargo is delivered. This helps to avoid any unexpected weighing charges being levied against the cargo at the port of Koper, which will be billed to the Shipper of Record.

The policy in place in port of Koper is “NO VGM – No GATE”

MSC admin fees and costs

Manual VGM Submission Fee (applies to email and inclusion on standard shipping instructions): 30 EUR per container.

Late VGM Submission Fee: 30 EUR per container.

VGM Misdeclaration Fee: 30 EUR per misdeclaration, per container.

Weighting per request per unit Fee: 60 EUR

Connecting Spain to the World

Since 1982, MSC has been helping local businesses transport their cargo to and from Spain, offering seamless connections across the globe. Today, with over 700 experts across 14 locations in the country, you can trust us to handle your international transport and logistics needs and move your business forward.

MSC Spain is built on strong values, putting people, relationships and service at the heart of everything we do. This means that, for us, transportation is more than moving goods; it’s about long-term partnerships and customer trust.

With a Net Promoter Score (NPS)* above 40, MSC Spain is highly regarded by companies of all sizes and sectors. Our customers report an overall satisfaction of 8.0, and rate the ease of doing business with us at 8.2.

"
For us shipping is more than transporting containers. We are aware that your cargo is a fundamental part of your supply chain. That is why we never stop keeping an eye on it to ensure that each shipment is delivered on time and in perfect condition. With us, your cargo is in the best hands.
"

Jose Mazarrasa
Madrid Branch Manager

Prohibited Cargo

Before arranging your shipment, you should take into account that not all the goods can be exported from/imported in Spain or accepted by your destination country. Some products are prohibited by local authorities, while others may be subject to restrictions or need special licenses.

We recommend you check the European Commission Access2Markets website to check any restrictions in place or speak to our local export and import teams.

Detention, Demurrage and Storage Charges

What is detention?

EXPORT

Detentions is a charge applicable on containers once the free time period has expired. The detentions period starts from pick up of the empty container from the terminal or designated depot until it enters full into terminal for further shipment. This charge covers the use of the container.

What is demurrage?

EXPORT

Demurrage is the charge applicable on containers once free the time period has expired. The demurrage period starts when the full container enters the port, and finishes on the actual ETA of the designated vessel. This charge covers the use of the container.

IMPORT

Demurrage is the charge applicable on containers once free the time period has expired. The demurrage period starts when the vessel arrives at the port, and it covers until the container has been taken out of the premises and it is returned empty to the designated depot or terminal. This charge covers the use of the container.

What are storage charges?

EXPORT

Storage is the charge applicable on containers once the free time period has expired. The storage period starts when the container arrives at the port, and it covers until the vessel sailing date.

IMPORT

Storage is the charge applicable on containers once the free time period has expired. The storage period starts when the vessel arrives at the port, and it covers until the container has been taken out of the premises to be delivered and unstuffed.

Do you have any questions on Detention, Demurrage & Storage Charges? Please contact our local teams

DeCA FAQs

At MSC Spain, we continue to work to ensure that the implementation of DeCA is as straightforward as possible for our customers, guaranteeing continuity and quality of service as the sector moves towards increasingly digitalised transport.

What is DeCA?

The Electronic Administrative Control Document (DeCA) is a new regulatory requirement that forms part of the digitalisation process for road transport in Spain and is expected to come into force on 5 October 2026.

How will DeCA affect MSC customers?

At MSC Spain, we have been working for several months to adapt our systems and processes to this new regulation. Our aim is to ensure a simple, agile transition with no impact on our customers’ usual operations.

Will the way we work with MSC change?

No. The implementation of DeCA is not expected to change the way our customers work with MSC or affect their usual processes.

Will any new administrative procedures be required?

The adaptation to the new regulatory framework will not create any additional administrative burden for our customers. MSC will implement the necessary changes to ensure compliance with the regulation.

What is MSC doing to prepare?

We have been adapting our systems and processes for several months to comply with DeCA requirements and ensure a smooth transition, while maintaining the same standards of service, proximity and efficiency that our customers expect from us

Spain - Automotive

Count on MSC for your automotive shipments

At MSC Spain, we understand the key role automotive industry plays in driving global mobility and powering international supply chains. That’s why we deliver end-to-end logistics solutions designed specifically for the sector’s unique needs. From strategically connected Spanish ports and flexible transport options to reliable on-time delivery and proactive visibility tools, we work to keep your supply chain running smoothly and efficiently. And with a strong commitment to sustainable shipping, we support you in reducing your carbon footprint while keeping your cargo moving.

If you are looking to import or export parts or finished vehicles to or from Spain, we can help you find the best transport solution. Besides reliable shipping, global coverage, fast transit times and exceptional customer support, we offer a full range of solutions to move your automotive cargo around the world.

Dedicated Spanish automotive team

Outstanding port coverage in Spain

Inland transportation solutions

"
At MSC, we make automotive logistics simple and reliable. From finished vehicles to spare parts, we ensure every shipment moves quickly, safely, and on time keeping your supply chain running smoothly.
"

Marisa Gonzalez
MSC Spain VIP Accounts Manager & Automotive Expert

Everything you need for your automotive exports and imports

Local expertise you can trust

Our dedicated team of experts in Spain is here to support the fast-moving demands of the automotive industry. From specialized reporting and direct routing to flexible transport options, we streamline your supply chain. Whether you’re moving vehicle parts, engines, batteries, or e-mobility components, our Spanish experts handle every detail with precision, care, and local insight, ensuring your shipments reach their destination efficiently and reliably.

The widest port coverage in Spain

MSC Spain offers comprehensive coverage of the whole country through calls at the main Spanish ports, and has an extensive presence in the main inland logistics centres (such as Madrid, Zaragoza, Seville and Cordoba). Our road and rail network allows us to connect the main automotive production hubs with global markets through efficient maritime routes and intermodal services.

Inland transportation solutions

Because you need more than Port-to-Port Services, MSC Spain offers a fully integrated service that connects every stage of your supply chain. From pickup at origin to final delivery, we combine ocean, rail, and road transport to ensure efficiency, security, and sustainability. Our intermodal approach reduces transit times, optimizes costs, and lowers your carbon footprint, while meeting the automotive industry’s just-in-time requirements and guaranteeing your vehicles and components arrive exactly when you need them.

Spain - Cold Store

Your Trusted Partner for Cold Storage in Spain

Our new state-of-the-art cold storage facility in Valencia is designed to have a capacity of 30,000 pallets for chilled and frozen goods, setting a new standard in storage and logistics capabilities in Spain. Located in Valencia’s Logistics Activities Zone (ZAL), the facility offers direct access to the main container terminals in Valencia Port, just one kilometer away. This facility is an integrated supply chain solution designed for a wide range of temperature-controlled cargo and business needs.

Temperature Controlled Storage

The Cold Store offers world-class temperature control and monitoring technology to store
products at the proper temperature and conditions. It also counts on specialized rooms for in-transit cold treatment pre-cooling required by countries like USA, China and South Korea.

Chilled and Frozen Goods Expertise

Operated by specialists with experience handling chilled and frozen commodities, the Cold Store is suitably equipped with state-of-the-art Material Handling Equipment (MHE) and mobile racking systems.

Avanced Stock Control

Our stock control protocols use a cutting-edge warehouse management system (WMS) to support our clients’ supply chains, including managing and monitoring stock movement in real-time.

Spain - East West Network

Connecting Spain to the World

Due to its strategic location between the Mediterranean and the Atlantic seas, Spain is a key player in MSC’s global network. From its hubs in Valencia, Las Palmas and Barcelona, we offer unmatched connectivity between Europe, the Far East and its Transatlantic routes. With the widest port coverage in the country, high-frequency sailings, and our extensive intermodal offering, MSC Spain guarantees the efficient, safe and reliable transportation of your cargo.

Our extensive East-West Standalone Network features 34 loops across 5 key trade routes, we offer flexible and reliable connections and direct corridors via the Suez Canal and the Cape of Good Hope.

Global network

Dedicated customer service and sales teams

The widest port coverage in Spain

The most extensive intermodal network in Spain

Global Coverage, Local Support

Our local teams in our 14 offices across Spain are on hand at all times to provide guidance and help you arrange your shipment. With weekly services to and from the Far East and North America, MSC Spain offers greater flexibility for loading, faster transit times and increased capacity, making our offering the largest in the market.

Efficient Inland Connections across Spain

With over 40 years' experience, MSC Spain can manage the transport of your cargo anywhere in the country, thanks to our comprehensive coverage and seamless service via road, rail and sea. Our local teams will ensure the smooth operations of your cargo and swift change of transport mode so that you can focus on what really matters: your business.

Large Capacity and a Full Range of Equipment to Meet your Needs

In addition to large storage capacities on our ships and across our inland transport solutions, we can provide you with flexible equipment tailored to your requirements including:

• Standard containers

• Reefer containers

• Special equipment e.g. flat rack, open top, high cube, pallet wide, etc.

Spain - eBL

Manage your eBills of Lading in a matter of Clicks!

Maritime transport is responsible for moving approximately 90% of global trade, which shows its importance in the global economy. That is why the maritime industry is undergoing a digital transformation and the implementation of digital bills of lading (or eBLs) is key to this goal.

The bill of lading, or BL, is a fundamental document in international trade. It serves as proof of receipt of the goods by the carrier, as well as a contract of carriage between the shipper and the shipping company, in addition to being a title of ownership of the goods. This document is essential for logistics and customs operations, as it is used to release goods at the port of destination and is a key document for processing insurance and claims in the event of damage or loss. Until now, this document has been handled in paper format, but it is increasingly being used in digital format, which facilitates its exchange between the parties involved in the commercial transaction.

Every day more and more companies are adopting the digital B/L or eBL. This is an original electronic document which offers a more efficient, secure, and sustainable alternative to a complex and costly process. The digitalization of the BL holds great potential to remove friction in global trade, to the benefit of our customers’ experience and the environment.

At MSC Spain, our local experts can help you enter the world of eBL and reap all the benefits of our transformative digital solution. No more paperwork, courier costs, delays or disruption. It has the same legal value and replicates the functions of an original BL in paper, but electronically.

Digitalize your documentation and adopt MSC eBL solution now!

"
MSC eBL offers benefits in terms of speed, cost reduction, sustainability, and security, making it an advantageous option for companies seeking to optimise their logistics and customs operations. At MSC Spain, we are experts in guiding our customers through the transition to eBL.
"

Marisa Gonzalez

MSC Spain VIP Accounts Manager & Automotive Expert

Five Powerful Reasons to Transfer to eBL

Faster

In a single shipment, a paper Bill of Lading may need to be couriered several times, often taking weeks. Any disruption in transit or documentation issue can trigger delays that leave cargo idle at its destination, costing you both time and money. With MSC eBL, processing happens in seconds, giving authorised parties instant access to the document whenever and wherever they need it!

Safer

Our eBL solution is delivered through WAVE BL’s digital courier platform, connecting all involved parties in a decentralised network that enables the secure exchange of documents. All information is protected and encrypted using blockchain technology, with every document and signature fully verified and authenticated.

As a result, the risks of document loss, forgery, or fraud are effectively eliminated.

Greener

With eBL you can also reduce your carbon footprint with paperless process!

Join the sustainability movement with our environmentally friendly digital solution, reducing carbon emissions associated with couriering paperwork across the world.

Simpler

Accessible anytime, anywhere, from any device, MSC eBL simplifies processes, speeds up processing times, and enables seamless collaboration across time zones.

Cost Efficient

Unlock substantial cost efficiencies by shifting to MSC eBL, cutting down on administrative workloads, eliminating courier expenses, and avoiding the costs associated with reissuing lost or fraudulent Bills of Lading.

"
At MSC, we believe that digitalization also has the power to make shipping more efficient, safer and more sustainable. We continuously invest in the development of new tools to offer our customers easy-to-use, flexible and secure online shipping management solutions. Our solutions aim to provide complete visibility and control over the shipping experience without losing MSC's personal touch.
"

Eva Gomez
MSC Spain Global Accounts Manager & MSC Barcelona Commercial Manager

Did you Know?

Each eBL transaction takes around 8 minutes instead of days.

Using eBL saves around $6.5 billion per year in direct costs!

Learn more about our MSC eBL solution!

Download brochure

Ready to adopt MSC eBL?

Enter your details here and start the process in just a few clicks. It has never been easier!

Once you have registered, MSC will organise training sessions to familiarise you with Wave platform, whose interface is not only secure but also very easy to use, as it is designed to simplify the process of issuing and receiving eBLs.

Trust us with your Fruit and Vegetables

The benefits of the Mediterranean diet and the high quality of the fruit and vegetable products grown in our country have made Spain a world leader and a reference in the export of fruit and vegetables.

The demand for fresh fruit and vegetables is increasing in international trade, and the world market is expected to continue to grow. MSC Spain has been helping producers, exporters and importers get their goods from the field to tables around the world in perfect conditions for more than 40 years.

In our mission to deliver fresh produce to markets worldwide, MSC Spain stands as a trusted partner throughout the fruit and vegetable supply chain with a commitment to provide tailored solutions that meet each client’s specific needs.

"
Thanks to significant investments in the MSC fleet in the past few years, we are able to reliably support our customers’ needs for reefer container availability with weekly sailings to key markets. Whatever the future holds, we will continue to work closely with our customers to make sure we always understand what is needed and when.
"

Julio Nestar
MSC Spain Reefer Manager

30+ Reefer Experts in Spain

Pre-trip inspection

Personalized

door-to-door service

A Team of Reefer Experts at your Disposal

Aware that export volumes and supply chain needs can vary seasonally, our experts develop customized solutions that are tailored to each customer's supply chain, providing a service that exporters and importers can rely on all year round.

MSC iReefer: the Real-Time Data Revolution

Today's consumers want to enjoy fresh, tasty apples, bananas, melons, and avocados all year round, but transporting these products from the field to the table without losing flavor, freshness, texture, and aroma requires agility, flexibility, and the latest technology. Cold chains and refrigeration technology can make a difference in improving the supply of quality products worldwide and reducing food loss.

Discover MSC iReefer

A New Cold Store in Spain

With a capacity of 30,000 pallets for chilled and frozen goods, our new cold storage facility in Valencia is setting a new standard in storage and logistics capabilities in Spain. Located in Valencia’s Logistics Activities Zone (ZAL), the facility offers direct access to the main container terminals in Valencia Port, just one kilometer away. This cold store is an integrated supply chain solution designed for a wide range of temperature-controlled cargo and business needs.

Spain - Intermodal

MSC Intermodal Network in Spain

Building on decades of integrated intermodal expertise, MSC Spain is continually investing in infrastructure, assets and people to provide flexible, innovative and sustainable door-to-door solutions to bring the ports closer to inland locations.
​

With over 40 years' experience, MSC Spain can manage the transport of your cargo from end to end, providing comprehensive coverage across Spain and offering a seamless service via road, rail and sea.

50+ Intermodal Experts in Spain

The widest intermodal offering in the market

Personalized door-to-door service

"
At MSC Spain we have designed our intermodal network to offer our customers the flexibility, reliability and competitiveness they need to make their business grow. We create seamless connections between ports and inland locations by combining rail and road solutions, ensuring cargo moves efficiently and on time.
"

Ignacio Ballester
MSC Spain Deputy General Manager

Linking Ports and Inland Hubs in Spain

Extensive experience in logistics nationwide, connecting 17 Spanish ports and inland locations, makes us the perfect partner for Spanish supply chains. MSC Inland Terminals are well connected to our dynamic hinterland network through its excellent accessibility, inland rail infrastructure and specific areas dedicated to the change of transportation mode.

Intermodal Experts at your Disposal

With over 40 years of experience in Spain, our intermodal team of more than 50 specialists guarantees the smooth transportation of your cargo throughout the country. Thanks to our in-depth knowledge of the market and operations, we can support you with personalized advice and a bespoke service.

Smarter and Cleaner Logistics

MSC's rail services reduce carbon emissions and improve fuel efficiency, supporting your business sustainability objectives without compromising on cost or reliability.

Spain - iReefer

Advanced Technology for iReefer Container Monitoring

MSC iReefer allows you to know not only the location of your cargo, but also its actual condition at all times. It provides continuous visibility of your cargo’s key parameters such as temperature, humidity, and container performance. This helps you to anticipate potential issues and optimize every stage of the logistics process.

Designed to enhance the performance of your supply chain, MSC iReefer allows you make faster, more accurate decisions while improving your overall experience. Through a centralized and user-friendly platform, accessible via myMSC or API, you can remotely manage all the variables of your reefer containers.

Continuous Monitoring

Monitor cargo in real time to minimize risks while maintaining optimal temperatures to ensure the protection of your perishable goods.

Fast Reaction

Respond immediately to any incident to ensure the highest quality of service.

Improved Efficiency and Cost Reduction

Efficiency improves significantly when operations are guided by data-driven insights, enabling more accurate and timely decision-making. At the same time, cost reductions become achievable by preventing product spoilage and avoiding unnecessary waste, ultimately optimizing resources and boosting profitability.

Spain - Liquid Cargo

Integral Solutions for Liquid Cargo Transportation around the World

Spain is a major global exporter of high-quality liquid products such as fruit juice, wine and olive oil. For more than 40 years, exporters of these commodities have benefitted from MSC Spain’s Liquid Cargo solutions, ensuring safe handling and optimal transport conditions throughout their supply chains.

Together with our single point of contact approach, our wide range of in-house services, including the supply and installation of flexibags, allow us to meet all your bulk liquid transport needs, thanks to our specialized team in MSC Spain.

Our flexibags are designed to safely transport high volumes of liquid, preventing any risk of spillage or contamination. They offer a safe, cost-effective and sustainable alternative to other methods of transporting liquids.

Top quality equipment

In-house experts

Door-to-door service

Door-to-door Solutions

Our liquid cargo transport solutions are fully integrated with our maritime and intermodal network, allowing us to provide fast and efficient door-to-door services anywhere in Spain.

With our local customer service, we ensure professional handling of your shipments and the peace of mind that your cargo is in good hands at all times.

Fitting Expertise you Can Rely on

Our team of technicians is trained to carry out the installation and assembly of the flexibags using highly controlled procedures.
This significantly minimises the risk of spills or contamination during loading, providing maximum protection for your cargo.

Full Optimization of your Liquid Supply Chain

Whether you export fruit juice, wine or olive oil, choosing MSC Liquid Cargo Solution helps you simplified your supply chain by reducing the number of intermediaries.
This leads to increased efficiency, lower costs, and fewer road transports.

Spain - Olive Oil

Taking Spanish Excellence across the World

At MSC Spain, we understand the unique value of Spanish olive oil: a delicate, high-quality product that represents tradition and excellence. That’s why we offer specialized logistics solutions that ensure the safe and efficient transport, fully adapted to the needs of producers and exporting companies.

With a global network, a team of technicians, and range of services designed to preserve the product quality, we make sure that every olive oil shipment reaches its destination in perfect condition. From loading to final delivery, we apply the highest standards to support the international growth of one of the Spanish most valued products.

Complete door-to-door service

In-house experts

Top-quality equipment

"
Shipping plays a vital role in the olive oil supply chain. Having a reliable partner like MSC is essential to ensure the most efficient, safe and cost-effective transport, while preserving its superior quality of this delicate product throughout the journey.
"

Carlos de Castellvi
Andalucia Branch Manager

Expertise in Transporting Olive Oil around the World

Transporting olive oil across global markets demands specialised expertise and reliable, high-quality equipment to protect its flavour, properties, and value.

With MSC Liquid Cargo Solutions, producers and exporters of olive oil benefit from a single point of contact dedicated to managing every stage of their liquid supply chain. Our comprehensive in-house services cover all your olive oil logistics needs, from flexibag supply to professional fitting, ensuring safe and efficient transport for this premium product.

Door-to-door Solutions

Our presence in the main olive oil consumer markets, combined with our extensive intermodal coverage in Spain, allows us to offer unparalleled connectivity and take your olive oil from your doorstep.

A Solution Designed Especially for your Olive Oil

Our flexibags are specially designed to safely transport up to 24,000 litres of olive oil in a standard 20’ container, preventing spills and any risk of contamination.

Spain is one of Europe’s leading countries in the management of engineering projects, especially in the construction and renewable energies sectors, with 70% of the sector's turnover destined for international markets.

With over 40 years of experience shipping goods of all shapes and sizes across the world, at MSC Spain we understand that not all cargo fits inside a standard container and that oversized cargo requires special handling and care. Whether you need to ship heavy machinery or turbines, our project cargo experts can design safe, secure, and cost-effective logistics solutions for your cargo.
​
You can rest assured that your project cargo shipment will be planned down to the last detail and delivered safely and efficiently. Due to the unique requirements of project cargo, we assess each out-of-gauge and breakbulk shipment individually, tailoring our solutions to deliver your shipment to any destination.

A Team of Experts at your Service

Our dedicated team of experts in Spain are extensively trained and have a deep trade knowledge, offering full support from the initial enquiry to the delivery of the cargo.

From Planning to Execution

Our experts assess each project cargo shipment on a case-by-case basis to tailor the perfect solution for you and your cargo, ensuring maximum safety and security for each and every project.

A Wide Range of Additional Transport and Logistics Solutions

Let us handle the complexity for you. We offer additional solutions such as loading, lashing and securing of the cargo. We can also arrange inland collection and deliveries using a variety of equipment, as well as police/inland transport notifications, giving you a seamless, door-to-door logistics experience.

FAQs

What is project cargo?

Large engineering projects such as those involving infrastructure, energy, mining, oil and gas, or renewables, usually require the international transport of large, heavy or complex parts and equipment. This type of cargo is known as ‘project cargo.

Project Cargo usually includes industrial machinery, structural components, turbines, transformers, prefabricated modules, special vehicles, etc.

The success of large engineering projects depends on the logistical capacity to import or export these items safely and efficiently, to meet the agreed deadlines.

SOLAS VGM information for Sweden

What is VGM?

Verified Gross Mass or VGM refers to the exact, verified weight of a packed container. For safety reasons, vessel operators can only load a container if its weight has been verified.

In line with SOLAS (Safety of Lives at Sea) regulations, all marine terminals in Sweden are now allowed to use their certified scales to record Verified Gross Mass (VGM) of shipments.

What do I need to include in my VGM instructions?

You must include the following on all VGM instructions:

Booking or Bill of Lading (BL) number

Container number

VGM + weight measurement unit (lbs. or kgs.)

Responsible Party Name

Digital signature of the authorized signatory in all CAPITAL LETTERS.

How can I submit my VGM instructions?

myMSC (Free of Charge)

EDI (via INTTRA; GT NEXUS; Cargo Smart)

Manually (via INTTRA; GT NEXUS; Cargo Smart)

Email: local booking team

Guidelines for submitting your VGM instructions

MSC prefers to receive a Shipper-Verified Gross Mass (VGM) before cargo is delivered. This helps to avoid any unexpected weighing charges being levied against the cargo at the SWE Port of Loading, which will be billed to the Shipper of Record.

Any Shipper of Record-signed VGM will override any VGM derived at or by the terminal.

For truck delivery, the ultimate deadline for VGM submission will be 12:00 noon local time on the day of the cargo cut-off.

There are currently no SWE terminals with a “NO VGM – No GATE” policy.

All rail shipments must have the VGM submitted within 24 hours of the container gating in at the origin rail ramp, to avoid any extra fees levied by the terminal for weighing services. Late gates will only be considered for approval when a VGM is submitted by the Shipper of Record before 12:00 noon, local time, on the day of the cargo cut-off.

MSC admin fees and costs

Manual VGM Submission Fee (applies to email, fax, and inclusion on standard shipping instructions): 500 SEK per container.

Late VGM Submission Fee: 500 SEK per container.

VESSEL PROGRAMS & POSITIONS

SOLAS VGM information

Government approval status

• Directorate General Of Dangerous Goods and Combined Transport under Ministry Of Transportation, Maritime and Communication of Türkiye, is the regulator in charge of VGM.

• The tolerance is NO MORE / NO LESS (+/-) than 5 % for a packed container.

• Authorities are entitled to carry out the inspections randomly for the accuracy of VGM information on containers which are stacked in the ports ready for loading. In case of any noncompliance of the VGM directive, administrative penalties might be applied.

• Method 2 can be applicable only for shippers whom are licensed by the relevant government authorities.

• There is no any enforcement provided by VGM directive for application of NO VGM NO GATE IN policy. Marine Terminal Operator has right to reject or accept the gate-in of a packed container, if its VGM information has not been provided.

• Please check the announcement on VGM directive, dated 15 January 2021

What to include in your VGM instructions

The following items are mandatory and must be on all VGM instructions:

• Booking or Bill of Lading number

• Container number

• VGM (must be expressed in kilograms)

• Weighing date

• Weighbridge identity (registration no/serial no/authorization number)

• The method used for defining VGM (Method 1 and Method 2)

For VGM definition by Method 1, weighbridge operator name / title

For VGM definition by Method 2, authorized shipper’s name / title and license number

• Authorized person’s signature (submitter of the VGM should be authorized to act on behalf of shippers)

How to submit your VGM instructions either:

• myMSC

• INTTRA and GT NEXUS

• Email

Regardless of the instrument used for submission of information listed above, the VGM document must be issued in scope of:

• The shipper or authorized third party must provide the VGM document in template provided by MSC.

• The VGM document must be filled and duly signed by the authorized person.

• The shipper must provide either a POA (Power Of Attorney) or Proxy or Signature Circular for the authorized person as a proof of its representation for declaration of VGM.

Deadlines for sending your VGM instructions

• Specific cut off date and hour for the VGM, will be mentioned on booking /reservation stage and vessel schedules provided by the local agency.

• Cut off times may vary according to each Marine terminal’s capacity and regulation.

Admin Fees and costs

• For VGM submissions, below tariff will be applied by MSC;

$ 5+vat/Bill of lading (if submitted via Mymsc.com, Inttra, etc...)

VGM Late Submission fee

$ 50+vat/Container (if submitted after cut off but accepted on the loading list of the vessel)

VGM Misdeclaration fee

$ 500+vat/Container (if submitted wrong or missing )

Documents Required for Import Delivery Order

1. Original bill of lading duly signed and endorsed by the authorized signatory by consignee.

2. Identity card of the person who applies to our office to pick up the delivery order and power of attorney including the necessary authorities.

3. In case of the absence of the power of attorney, the letter of indemnity which was issued by the receiver company with the authorized signatures on it and also the circular of signature

o Letter of indemnity

4. In case of temporary import formalities of the container temporary acceptence indemnity form which should be duly signed and endorsed by the final receiver must be filled up.

o Recognizance of temprory acceptence-Basis of loading

o Recognizance of temprory acceptence-Yearly

5. A proof document which shows the payment in favor of MSC Shipping Agency S.A. for the local charges, deposit & freight charges if any. (Please contact our offices for further details.)

6. In case of PERSONAL EFFECT CARGO, the following documents shall be produced in addition to the above: Original passport and copy of passport.

The following endorsements are required

B/L consigned TO ORDER: Shipper's endorsement is necessary. If it is not exsiting then a letter of indemnity  is necessary.

B/L consigned TO BANK: Bank's endorsement is necessary; if the B/L is consigned to the bank of particular branch then that Branch's endorsement is necessary.

B/L consigned TO A NAMED CONSIGNEE: the named consignee must endorse the B/L.

Telex release - the telex release message has to be received by respective MSC Agency (Turkey) from load port. The delivery order will not be issued on the basis of a photocopy of telex release message produced by consignee. The consignee needs to keep in touch with our office to enquire the same before releasing the delivery order.

Freight payable elsewhere - in case of freight payable elsewhere, respective MSC Agency (Turkey) should receive "freight paid" confirmation from the elsewhere location. The consignee needs to keep in touch with our office to enquire the same before releasing the delivery order.

Express release - in case of express bill of lading, cargo can be released to the consignee on the manifest without requiring any original document.

Link copied!

Export Local Requirements

Documents Required for release of original bill of lading (OBL)

• Booking form is a pre-order of a shipping instruction given by the Shipper. The booking form must contain following information:

• Name of the shipper

• Contact details

• Shipping date

• Number of containers

• Type & size of containers

• Mode and place of stuffing

• Inland carriage specification

• Tonnage

• Port of loading

• Port of discharge

• Agreed sea freight

• Payment terms

• In case of hazardous cargo, the booking form must also contain the following:

• Correct technical name of the cargo

• Commodity

• UN number

• Class

• IMDG page number

• Flash point

• Shipping Instruction form is a BL instuction given by the Shipper in a format prescribed by MSC Shipping S.A.

• Telex Release form enables the release of the goods without presenting OBL. The shipper must surrender full set of OBLs along with a request form.

• Sea Waybill form enables the shipment to be manifested as SEA WAYBILL, and ensures that shippers will not request any OBL for the mentioned shipment/regular traffic.

• To be given by a merchant (shipper) prior to the issuance of a Non-Negotiable Sea Waybill in order to deliver cargo to a party nominated by the shipper (“the consignee”). This Letter of Undertaking should be issued on the letterhead of the party giving it, or this form should be signed and accompanied by a covering letter on their letterhead, confirming that the party has issued it. As the application of the Sea Waybill can vary from region to region, customers are required to contact concerned MSC liner for an approval in time of quotation before filling in the form.

• Authorization letter: Identity card of the person who applies for release of OBL with an authorization letter of shipper and also the authorized signature letter of the company. This is requested only once.  If the customs broker applies for BL release, then a copy of power of attorney of the shipper need to be presented.

• Courier commitment form is required from customers requesting OBL to be sent to their address by courier. An authorized signature letter of the company, containing the signature of whom applies for the courier commitment form must be enclosed as well.

• In case of hazardous cargo, a copy of Hazardous Declaration form must be presented by the shipper (to be collected from our office after stuffing of the container and 48 hours prior vessel's arrival of port of loading) And for shipments through Istanbul ports then following form must be presented.

• Material Safety Data Sheet must also be applied from the shipper's non-hazardous chemical commodity. (to be collected from our office after stuffing of the container and 48 hours prior vessel's arrival of port of loading)

• Due to the 10+2 Requirements for USA, for your exports to USA or via USA, besides the shipping orders Commodity Harmonized Tariff Schedule Number -first six digit- should be supplied to us (441520 Pallets , box pallets and other load boards). Sorry to inform that unless the HS CODES are not provided there will be no possiblity to accept your cargo due to the 10+2 Requirements for USA. These codes should also be filled by you or your agent in US customs. Any dicrepeancy between the given code to our agency and the one that filled in US system is definately not acceptable and may cause serious problems. Concerned codes are available at the following link www.foreign-trade.com. Neither the webmastering nor the control of subject website done by MSC Shipping Agency. Therefore, our company can not consider the responsiblity for any misinformation or erroneous content provided by this website.

Turkiye Depot Solutions

First Step for a Safe and Efficient Transportation

At MSC Türkiye, we provide comprehensive depot solutions designed to prepare your cargo for transportation in the most efficient and reliable way. Drawing on our expertise across a wide range of industries, we carefully plan every operation according to the specific requirements of each shipment.

From stuffing and securing cargo to protective applications and specialised handling operations, we manage every stage through a single point of contact. This approach helps maximise operational efficiency while maintaining the highest standards of cargo safety. Backed by extensive field experience and flexible operational capabilities, we help ensure your cargo begins its journey with confidence.

Wide range of equipment

Tailor-made solutions

Dedicated expert support

Safe Loading and Unloading Operations

We carefully manage loading and unloading processes through cargo-specific planning tailored to each shipment. Supported by specialist teams and appropriate equipment, our operations ensure cargo is securely positioned within the container. For various cargo types, including steel products, marble, and automotive shipments, we provide suitable lashing solutions to minimize transportation risks and enhance cargo safety throughout the journey.

Cargo Protection Solutions

Protecting cargo is just as important as transporting it. Our inner liner bag applications help preserve product quality by preventing direct contact between bulk cargo and container surfaces. For sensitive cargo, airbag dunnage solutions restrict movement inside the container, helping reduce the risk of breakage, cracking, and damage during transit. At MSC Türkiye, we also provide protective services such as fumigation and pest control treatments, ensuring your cargo is fully prepared for transportation.

The Right Container for Your Cargo

Container condition plays a critical role in maintaining operational continuity. Through our depot facilities, we offer container repair services to ensure your cargo is transported using equipment in optimal condition.

In addition, our full container storage solutions provide secure and controlled storage before shipment, giving you greater flexibility in planning your logistics operations.

Experts for Operational Support

The quality of any cargo operation depends on the expertise behind it. Our experienced teams apply industry-leading practices across a wide range of cargo types, ensuring that every stage of the process is handled with care and precision.

Thanks to this operational know-how, your cargo is prepared correctly, risks are minimised, and transportation processes move forward more smoothly and efficiently.

Turkiye Fruit

Fresh Fruit Transportation from Türkiye to Global Markets

Fruit grown in the fertile lands of Anatolia reaches consumers across the world every day. At MSC Türkiye, we combine our nationwide logistics network with advanced reefer technology to support your supply chain at every stage of the journey. From harvest location to retail shelf, we help preserve the freshness, flavour, and quality of your fruit cargo.

Door-to-door transportation

Wide range of equipment

Controlled Atmosphere

iReefer technology for real-time cargo visibility

Advanced Reefer Technology

Our modern reefer fleet is equipped with Controlled Atmosphere (CA) technology, humidity sensors, and advanced ventilation systems that help extend shelf life and maintain product quality throughout transit. Cold Treatment services protect cargo against pests without the use of chemicals, while comprehensive pre-trip inspections ensure every container is thoroughly checked before departure.

Dedicated Citrus Solutions During Peak Season

Türkiye is one of the world's leading suppliers of oranges, mandarins, lemons, and grapefruits. MSC transports citrus cargo from all our ports using temperature and humidity-controlled reefer containers to protect product quality. During harvest season, our dedicated citrus services provide direct connections, competitive transit times, and additional capacity to support export demand and maintain reliable access to global markets.

Reefer Solutions for Apple Exports

We support apple exporters across Türkiye's key production regions, including Isparta, Karaman, and Niğde. Our Controlled Atmosphere (CA) reefer containers help preserve freshness, texture, and flavour during long-distance ocean transportation. With a broad service network connecting Türkiye to India, the Far East, the Middle East and Africa, we provide reliable, flexible, and timely transportation solutions to help you manage peak-season export volumes efficiently.

Deep-Freeze Expertise for IQF Fruit

For IQF (Individually Quick Frozen) fruit shipments, our deep-freeze reefer containers maintain stable temperatures of -18°C and below, safeguarding product quality throughout transportation. Whether transporting strawberries, sour cherries, grapes, figs, or pomegranates, our solutions help preserve texture, colour, and nutritional value. Supported by continuous monitoring from our reefer specialists, your cargo arrives with the quality standards expected by customers.
