Turkiye Goods on Hanger

Fashion-Forward Logistics for Your Garment Shipments

Türkiye is one of the world's leading apparel and textile production hubs. For brands operating in a fast-paced industry, the condition in which garments arrive at the store is just as important as the product itself.

MSC Türkiye's Goods on Hanger (GOH) solution is specifically designed for garments that need to be transported hanging, including suits, jackets, coats, shirts, and dresses. By keeping your products on hangers from origin to destination, we help reduce the need for re-ironing, re-hanging, and additional handling operations.

Door-to-door transportation

Garment on Hanger (GOH) equipment

Wide range of equipment options

Dedicated expert support

Seamless Transportation from Factory to Store

Our Goods on Hanger containers, also known as Hangtainers, are available in both 20-foot and 40-foot configurations to meet your operational requirements. Goods are loaded directly onto hangers at the production facility and delivered ready for distribution at destination. This eliminates folding, packing, and re-hanging processes, helping your products reach retail shelves in the best possible condition.

Equipment Designed for Garment Exports

We offer two different internal configurations based on the weight and characteristics of your products. The bar system, consisting of high-capacity metal rails, is ideal for heavier garments such as coats, jackets, and suits. The string system enables high-density loading and is particularly suited for lighter products such as shirts, blouses and knitwear.

Reach Global Fashion Markets Through Our Network

With MSC's extensive ocean network, we provide regular connections from Türkiye to key consumer markets across Europe, North America, the Middle East and beyond. Supported by our global service network and experienced teams, we help plan transportation flows that align with the needs of your supply chain.

A More Sustainable Alternative

Goods on Hanger transportation supports a more sustainable export model by reducing the need for additional cardboard, plastic, and packaging materials. As garments can arrive ready for distribution, the need for re-ironing at destination is reduced, helping lower energy consumption. This contributes to a smaller carbon footprint while shortening the journey from production facility to retail shelf.

Turkiye Intermodal

Door-to-Door Transport Across Türkiye

At MSC Türkiye, we combine our global ocean network with Türkiye’s intermodal strength to move your cargo seamlessly from door to door, including MEDLOG partnership on demand. By integrating road, sea and rail transportation, we simplify your logistics processes while delivering speed, reliability and sustainability.

Efficient and reliable inland connections

Door-to-door transport solutions

Extensive port connections

Local experts

Strong Port Connections

We connect Türkiye’s 16 ports with key inland production and distribution centers through our intermodal solutions. By bringing together ocean services with rail and road connections, we ensure a smooth and continuous cargo flow between ports and inland locations. This integrated approach allows us to support your import and export operations with greater efficiency, flexibility and control.

Extensive Rail Network

Our rail solutions create efficient and reliable links between Türkiye’s main industrial regions and its ports. With regular services and well-coordinated schedules, we help keep your cargo moving smoothly across the country. Combined with our road transport solutions, our rail network enables a balanced, flexible and dependable inland transport flow.

Integrated Warehousing Solutions

We merge our intermodal services with warehousing and distribution solutions designed to simplify your logistics operations. From storage and handling to cargo preparation, our solutions help streamline your processes and improve operational efficiency, giving you greater visibility and control across your supply chain.

A More Sustainable Alternative

With our intermodal solutions, we use transport modes in the most efficient way and help reduce dependence on road transportation. By prioritizing rail transportation within our solutions, we contribute to reducing carbon emissions and offer our customers a greener, more efficient and future-focused logistics model.

Turkiye Liquid Cargo

Integrated Transport Solutions for Your Liquid Cargo

Türkiye is among the world's leading exporters of high-value liquid food products, including olive oil, sunflower oil, and fruit juice concentrates.

At MSC Türkiye, we combine our flexibag-based liquid cargo solutions with our global service network and intermodal expertise to transport your cargo safely from Türkiye to destinations around the world. Through our end-to-end service approach, we manage the entire transportation process, helping make your logistics operations more efficient.

Door-to-door solutions

Food-grade containers

Dedicated expert support

Complete Flexibag Solutions

The right equipment and operational management are essential for liquid cargo transportation. From flexibag supply and installation to loading planning and final delivery, every stage of the process is managed by our specialist teams. With reefer and dry container options available, your cargo is transported safely and efficiently.

Intermodal Infrastructure Designed for Liquid Cargo

Through our intermodal solution partner MEDLOG, we provide integrated intermodal solutions that connect your production facilities across Türkiye to ports and global markets. By combining road, sea, and rail transportation within a single network, we offer more flexible, efficient, and sustainable logistics solutions for your liquid cargo.

Discover Our Intermodal Solutions

Operational Expertise

At our fully equipped depots, we provide storage, handling, and operational support for flexibag cargo ranging from 16,000 to 24,000 litres. This enables greater control and efficiency across your supply chain while supporting the smooth management of your liquid cargo operations.

Discover Our Depot Solutions

Efficient and Greener Transportation

Flexibag solutions support more efficient transportation by maximising payload capacity and reducing the need for additional packaging materials. Their recyclable structure and capacity advantages help businesses enhance operational efficiency while contributing to their sustainability objectives.

Turkiye Marble

Count on us for your Marble &
Natural Stone Shipments

Türkiye is home to some of the world’s richest marble resources and holds approximately 33% of the world’s marble reserves; produces more than 80 types and over 120 different structures and patterns of marble. As global demand for premium natural stone continues to rise, connecting this unique potential with international markets requires working with a trusted industry leader.

Natural stones require careful handling and specialized expertise throughout every stage of the supply chain. Leveraging Türkiye’s strong marble production capabilities, MSC offers dependable, globally recognized logistics solutions designed to protect the value and integrity of your cargo.

Global Reach

Intermodal Solutions

Wide Range of Equipment

Local Expertise

Marble Transportation with MSC

With MSC, you can reach more than 520 ports worldwide through our services operating from 16 ports across Türkiye. This extensive network allows you to ship your marble cargo to any destination quickly, reliably and with the care your high value products demand.

Intermodal Solutions Designed for Marble Transportation

MSC is a key logistics partner for Türkiye’s marble industry, offering a unique intermodal network that connects mining and production regions through sea, road and rail transport. With our extensive storage facilities and specialized teams, we ensure seamless, door-to-door movement of your marble cargo, from the production site all the way to final delivery.

How Should Marble Be Transported?

Marble is typically shipped in blocks or slabs that are secured and stacked using wooden supports inside specialized containers. Cargo must also be loaded in accordance with the container’s weight limits to ensure safe handling and transport. The primary risk factors during transport include impact, shifting and breakage.

Marble-Class Containers

To minimize risks, the marble must be properly secured and protected against vibrations throughout the journey. At MSC, all containers are inspected at regular intervals by our expert teams. This meticulous monitoring ensures that the cargo is transported under optimal conditions and helps guarantee that the marble reaches its destination in the best possible condition, from origin to final delivery.

Dedicated Solutions for Out-of-Gauge Cargo

Whether transporting transformers, storage tanks, reactors, or industrial equipment, we develop bespoke transport plans for cargo with exceptional weight or dimensions. Through our flat rack, open top, and breakbulk solutions, we provide safe and efficient transportation options tailored to the technical requirements of your shipment.

Ensuring Safe Boat Transportation at Every Stage

Türkiye has a long-standing reputation as a leading boatbuilding hub, and we help connect local manufacturers with global markets. For water-to-water boat transportation projects, we carefully manage every stage of the operation, from lifting and handling to securing and loading, always prioritising the safety of your vessel. Backed by extensive project cargo experience, we provide reliable support even for the most complex and sensitive shipments.

Dedicated Field Services for Your Cargo

To ensure the safety and integrity of your shipment, we offer a comprehensive range of field services, including lashing and unlashing operations, shrink wrapping, and tarpaulin applications. Our specialist teams oversee every stage of the process, helping protect your cargo and ensure smooth operational execution from loading through to final delivery.

Door-to-Door Transportation Through Intermodal Solutions

Project cargo logistics extend beyond port operations. MSC Türkiye combines ocean freight with road and rail solutions to transport cargo from production site to destination. Our integrated intermodal network provides a single point of contact, ensuring visibility, efficiency, and control throughout the supply chain.

White Goods Transportation from Türkiye to Global Markets

Türkiye is Europe's leading and the world's second-largest white goods manufacturing hub, producing a wide range of products, from washing machines, dryers, and dishwashers to refrigerators, ovens, and small domestic appliances. This strong export capacity requires a flexible and reliable supply chain capable of responding to rapidly changing consumer demand.

At MSC Türkiye, we combine more than 30 years of local expertise with our global service network to provide transportation solutions tailored to the requirements of white goods exporters serving markets around the world.

Door-to-door transportation

Tailor-made logistics solutions

Wide range of equipment

Dedicated experts

Solutions Designed for the White Goods Industry

White goods require careful handling, appropriate equipment selection, and close operational supervision due to their size and sensitive surfaces. MSC Türkiye supports the safe transportation of your products throughout the supply chain with equipment solutions tailored to the industry's requirements and backed by experienced operational teams.

Direct Services from Türkiye and Competitive Transit Times

With 40 services connected to more than 300 global trade routes, MSC Türkiye provides a strong gateway for white goods exports. Our direct and regular service network connects all major production centers in Türkiye with key markets across Northern Europe, the Mediterranean, North America, the Far East and the Middle East.

Flexible Logistics Support for Changing Demand

Promotional campaigns, seasonal demand fluctuations, and orders from multiple markets often require greater flexibility in logistics planning. Through our extensive intermodal network and regular services, MSC Türkiye helps exporters adapt to changing volumes and delivery requirements while maintaining efficiency. Our integrated logistics solutions support resilient and sustainable transportation models for evolving market conditions.

FAQ:

What are applicable deadlines?

Please find the applicable deadlines for export activities by the following link:

Notice to clients EXPORT BOOKING to USA.pdf

Where can I find vessel schedule?

Please use official MSC website: https://www.msc.com/arrivals-departures

Follow us in Telegram: https://t.me/mscuainfodesk or scan this QR code:

How to properly read schedule provided through telegram?

1.  Vessel name and voyage number - Voyage can be different for export/import voyages

2. ETA - Estimated Time of Arrival. ATA - Actual Time of Arrival

3. ETB - Estimated Time of Berthing . Normally ETA = ETA+1 hour for Odessa; ETA+1 hour for Chornomorsk. ATB - Actual Time of Berthing

4. SI - Shipping Instructions Deadline, 48 hours before ETB at working time only

5. VGM – Verified Gross Mass submission Deadline, 24 hours before ETB at working time only

6. Cut off - Cut off Deadline, 24 hours before ETB at any time

7. SI и VGM deadlines for Chornomorsk are the same as for Odessa. Because Odessa is first port of call

8. Corrections, if any, are shown by red colour (foreground colour red)

9. If vessel alongside, the row marked by green colour (background colour green)

10. If vessel is on the anchor, the row marked by blue (background colour blue)

How to increase/decrease container quantity in booking?

Please send request for correct container quantity in booking to ua539-exp.custcare@msc.com and DO NOT change subject or delete people from recipients.

How to split booking?

If containers have already been released and container numbers are already linked to the booking,

Please send request to ua539-exp.custcare@msc.com with correct container numbers, correct vessel, port of discharge.

If you want to load containers on the same vessel and port of discharge, but in different BLs, there is no need to split booking, in this case just create two SI (shipping instructions) for the same booking number

How to check vessel for my booking?

First, please login into your cabinet on myMSC and push the print button on your booking to print booking summary.

If you still have questions, please ask ua539-exp.custcare@msc.com for assistance.

What is a maximum container quantity for one booking?

We can create booking containing not more than 20 units.

What do I need to know if my booking contains liquid cargo in Flexi Tanks?

If booking contains liquid cargo in Flexi Tanks, respective LOI (Letter of Indemnity) is required to be passed to MSC:

Download LOI template here.

LOI must filled by the Shipper as per BL.

LOI has to be sent by e-mail with the following subject “Flexi LOI Booking number : …“ to following recipients:

UA539-exp.custcare@msc.com and UKR-documentation@msc.com

Shipper must print LOI on the corporate blank and sign it. Then, the hard copy of the LOI must be handed over to MSC Odessa office (Export Documentation Division) prior SI deadlines.

Are there any additional requirements for export IMO cargo?

Please sent the below mentioned documents within below deadline by e-mail:

UA539-exp.custcare@msc.com  and UKR-documentation@msc.com otherwise, we won`t be able to handle your IMO shipment duly and it can be postponed on next available vessel:

DC Acceptance request.doc fully filled in with addresses, phones, faxes & contact persons with SI deadline.

scanned copy of dangerous goods declaration (all pages of English version in one .pdf file only) before SI submission deadline. Original of dangerous goods declaration and insurance certificate are to be handed over to MSC Ukraine Odessa office attention of Head of Operations Department.

MSDS scanned copy (all pages of English version in one file only) before SI submission deadline;

Scanned copy of IMO labels letter.doc to be sent before SI submission deadline. Original letter is to be handed over to Export documentation Team within VGM deadline.

Following documents must be presented before SI submission deadline (if applied), original documents is to be handed over to Export documentation Team within VGM deadline:

- Weathering certificates for the UN Numbers: UN1395, UN1398, UN1408, UN1405;

- Fishmeal: UN2216

- Tank Test Certificates for all Tank containers

- Specific authority reports (packaging instructions, exemption reports and certificates, etc.)

UAC: Unattended cargo & claims handling

STORAGE

Terminal storage charges are not under MSC control and to be paid directly by customer to port

BILL OF LADING CLAUSES

Reference to MSC Bill of Lading and Ukraine standard Terms & Conditions https://www.msc.com/ukr/contract-of-carriage

CUSTOMS STORAGE, FINES & FREE PERIOD

According to customs legislation the free period for storage of import cargo under customs control is 90 days after discharge date. This term can be prolonged to 120 days.

After units blocked by customs the cargo is to be placed on customs bonded warehouse and consignee must pay fine in amount 8500 UAH

After 191 days of import cargo is under customs control at customs area the customs apply storage rate in amount 0.5 EUR for m3 per day

UNCLAIMED & ABANDONED CARGO

Important points to know:

Definition of Merchant per clause 1. MSC Bill of Lading:

“Merchant: includes the Shipper, Consignee, holder of this Bill of Lading, the receiver of the Goods and any Person owning, entitled to or claiming the possession of the Goods or of this Bill of Lading or anyone acting on behalf of this Person”

Clause 2 Of MSC Bill of Lading

“CONTRACTING PARTIES AND WARRANTY

The contract evidenced by this Bill of Lading is between the Carrier and the Merchant. Every Person defined as "Merchant" is jointly and severally liable towards the Carrier for all the various undertakings, responsibilities, and liabilities of the Merchant under or in connection with this Bill of Lading and to pay the Freight due under it without deduction or set-off. The Merchant warrants that in agreeing to the terms and conditions in this Bill of Lading, he is the owner of the Goods, or he does so with the authority of the owner of the Goods or of the Person entitled to the possession of the Goods or of this Bill of Lading.”

Clause 20 Of MSC Bill of Lading

“20.1 Any mention in this Bill of Lading of parties to be notified of the arrival of the Goods is solely for information of the Carrier. Failure to give such notification shall not subject the Carrier to any liability nor relieve the Merchant of any obligation hereunder.

20.2 The Merchant shall take delivery of the Goods within the time provided for in the Carrier's applicable Tariff or as otherwise agreed. If the Merchant fails to do so, the Carrier may without notice unpack the Goods if packed in Containers and/or store the Goods ashore, afloat, in the open or under cover at the sole risk of the Merchant. Such storage shall constitute due delivery hereunder, and thereupon all liability whatsoever of the Carrier in respect of the Goods, including for misdelivery or non-delivery, shall cease and the costs of such storage shall forthwith upon demand be paid by the Merchant to the Carrier.

20.3 If the Goods are unclaimed within a reasonable time or whenever in the Carrier's opinion the Goods are likely to deteriorate, decay or become worthless, or incur charges whether for storage or otherwise in excess of their value, the Carrier may at its discretion and without prejudice to any other rights which it may have against the Merchant, without notice and without any responsibility attaching to it, sell, abandon or otherwise dispose of the Goods at the sole risk and expense of the Merchant and apply any proceeds of sale in reduction of the sums due to the Carrier from the Merchant under or in connection with this Bill of Lading.

20.4 Refusal by the Merchant to take delivery of the Goods in accordance with the terms of this clause and/or to mitigate any loss or damage thereto shall constitute an absolute waiver and abandonment by the Merchant to the Carrier of any claim whatsoever relating to the Goods or the carriage thereof. The Carrier shall be entitled to an indemnity from the Merchant for all costs whatsoever incurred, including legal costs, for the cleaning and disposal of Goods refused and/or abandoned by the Merchant.”

WHAT SHOULD I DO TO RE-EXPORT CARGO FROM UKRAINE?

To re-export cargo from Ukraine, following should be done:

1. Full set of original Bill of Lading must be returned to MSC office

2. Consignee’s Letter of Abandonment

3. Written letter from shipper instructing MSC to export cargo to new Port of Discharge, and stipulating that they will settle all extra charges (free form)

4. Written letter from new Consignee at new Port of Discharge confirming to take delivery of cargo and to pay any outstanding charges from discharge date up to release of cargo (free form)

5. Confirmation from new Port of Discharge stating that the import of goods is accepted

6. All outstanding charges must be paid prior re-exportation (including freight)

7. Security deposit (refundable once unit is empty at new Port of Discharge)

Import charges that should be paid prior re-exportation:

1. demurrage - up to date of cargo loading

2. Terminal Handling Charge – as per local tariffs to be advised by the MSC local agent

Export charges that should be paid prior re-exportation:

1. Freight to new destination

2. Terminal Handling Charge – as per local tariffs to be advised by the MSC local agent

3. BL issue – as per local tariffs to be advised by the MSC local agent

4. Storage - up to date of cargo loading (*in case re-export customs formalities arranged by MSC Ukraine)

5. customs' formalities - USD 750 / per container (*in case re-export customs formalities arranged by MSC Ukraine)

*(in case re-export formalities arranged by MSC Ukraine) – to start the procedure of cargo re-exportation and pass port and custom formalities the following docs have to be applied (by e-mail):

1. Packing list

2. Invoice

3.Certificates for cargo (origin, quality, veterinary, phyto-sanitary)

4. The letter from the shipper with request to send cargo to Port of Loading

5. The letter abandonment of the cargo of the direct consignee per Bill of Lading.

6. Letter from new consignee with confirmation of acceptance of this cargo

Port and customs documentary performing of re-exportation procedure usually takes 10-20 days

CLAIMS PROCEDURE

WHAT DO I NEED TO KNOW ABOUT NOTICE OF CLAIMS, TIME BAR AND JURISDICTION?

Clause 10 Of MSC Bill of Lading

“10.1 Notice - of loss or damage to Goods shall be given in writing to the Carrier or its agent at the Port of Discharge before or at the time of delivery. If the loss or damage is not apparent before or at the time of delivery, notice must be given within three (3) days of delivery to the Merchant or its agent. Claims shall be submitted in writing addressed by the Merchant to the Carrier's agent at the Port of Discharge.

10.2 Time bar - In any event, the Carrier shall be discharged from all liability if suit is not commenced within one (1) year after delivery of the Goods or the date that the Goods should have been delivered for claims related to loss or damage during the Port-to-Port carriage, and for claims related to loss or damage during Inland Transport the shorter of nine (9) months or any time limit provided for by any applicable international convention, national law, regulation or contract by virtue of clauses 5.2.2 (a) or (b).

10.3 Jurisdiction - It is hereby specifically agreed that any suit by the Merchant, and save as additionally provided below any suit by the Carrier, shall be filed exclusively in the High Court of London and English Law shall exclusively apply, unless the carriage contracted for hereunder was to or from the United States of America, in which case suit shall be filed exclusively in the United States District Court, for the Southern District of New York and U.S. law shall exclusively apply.

The Merchant agrees that it shall not institute suit in any other court and agrees to be responsible for the reasonable legal expenses and costs of the Carrier in removing a suit filed in another forum. The Merchant waives any objection to the personal jurisdiction over the Merchant of the above agreed fora.

In the case of any dispute relating to Freight or other sums due from the Merchant to the Carrier, the Carrier may, at its sole option, bring suit against the Merchant in the fora agreed above, or in the countries of the Port of Loading, Port of Discharge, Place of Delivery or in any jurisdiction where the Merchant has a place of business”

WHICH DOCUMENTS NORMALLY REQUIRED TO CONSIDER THE MERIT OF ANY CLAIM IF I WISH TO PLACE A CLAIM AGAINST MSC?

copy of the Bill of Lading or Sea waybill or Letter of Indemnity for delivery without Bill of Lading

If the Bill of Lading is a "to order" or "to order of X" one, in addition a copy of the reverse side of the Original Bill of Lading presented at Port of Discharge for delivery of cargo, clearly showing the endorsements, together with a copy of the delivery order

formal statement of claim, mentioning the amount claimed and its breakdown (in English, can be issued only by party entitled per Bill of Lading

commercial invoice ‐packing list‐claimant's survey report with photos if any

if claimant is an insurance company, duly signed subrogation letter

if claimant is a recovery agent, letter of authority authorizing them to pursue recovery of the claim, negotiate settlement, receive settlement monies, and sign the receipt and claim release form (+ subrogation if the recovery agent is working for an insurance company)

destruction certificate (for cargo damaged beyond use) and/or proof of salvage proceeds (if damaged cargo has been sold at a reduced price) ‐evidence that the loss has been properly mitigated (e.g., proof that salvaged goods have been sold to the highest bidder)

load port evidence to prove that the cargo was shipped in good order and condition which includes pre-shipment surveys, records of age and grade, cutting records, quality control records, records relating to identification and control of disease, cooling records, and packing records.

FOR BETTER INVESTIGATION OF THE CASE PLEASE KINDLY PROVIDE US WITH BELOW PRE-SHIPMENT DOCUMENTS:

the age and grade of the cargo;

post-harvest handling;

treatment and packaging;

the time between cutting and cooling;

pre-shipment surveys;

cutting records;

quality control records;

records relating to identification and control of disease;

cooling records and packing records.

LEGAL ADMINISTRATIVE FEE (LAF)

MSC shall charge the Merchant a Legal Administration Fee (LAF) covering the extra coordination / organization work and subsequent follow-up necessitated by any situation of damage or risk of damage to the cargo, container, crew and/or vessel caused or generated by the Merchant’s negligence, fault or misconduct. This fee will be charged in addition to the costs actually as the result of the situation itself and its remedy. Its amounts will be of:

FOR COSTS UP TO 500 USD: 40 USD PER CONTAINER

FOR COSTS BETWEEN 500 AND 1000 USD: 80 USD PER CONTAINER

FOR COSTS BETWEEN 1000 AND 2000 USD: 140 USD PER CONTAINER

FOR COSTS OVER 2000 USD: 200 USD PER CONTAINER

The Carrier and its Agent are authorised to charge the Legal Administration Fee in any other legal currency locally.

NOTA BENE:

The basis for our invoicing being the number of containers involved in the incident /casualty, not the number of containers listed on the Bill(s) of Lading.

The extra handling costs to be taken into account for the determination of the LAF being the final amount charged to MSC/MSC agents, including all taxes and charges.

General information: Import/Export intermodal activity

I am expecting a container with important cargo to be delivered to my warehouse, whom should i contact and what documents should i provide to arrange the inland delivery?

Please send the scan copies of the cargo documents by e-mail to:

UA539-intermodal@msc.com (the subject of the letter MUST contain the bill of lading number). Then please send the original copies to our office: MSC Ukraine Intermodal Department. 5, Lidersivsky Boulevard, 234 - 237 office, 65014 Odessa, Ukraine.

The list of the required documents:

1) 3 copies of Original Bill of Landing (in case of Telex Release or Sea Waybill issue, please provide the LOI Letter of Acknowledgment original copy)

2) Invoice (original copy)

3) Packing list

4) Customs clearance declaration (in any form it was issued; please provide it 3-5 days before cargo arriving to POD)

5) Letter of Authority with an indication of container and bill of lading numbers or General Letter of Authority without any indications of container and bill of lading numbers valid until the end of the current year (original copy).

Letter of guarantee (original copy)

* Required for the cargo that requires additional documentary control. Depending on the cargo type, Letter of guarantee might be necessary to issue the certificate of origin / quality / phytosanitary / veterinary or other documents required by customs.

Whom should i contact to arrange the inland transportation of import / export MSC shipping line cargo?

Please contact:

UA539-intermodal@msc.com

UA002-intermodal.dpt@medlog.com

Who is responsible for the customs clearance in case MSC is providing an inland delivery?

The consignee / shipper is responsible for the customs clearance of import / export cargo.

What customs code should i indicate in the customs declaration?

Port of Odessa: ВМО-3 UA500040

Sea Port of Chornomorsk: ВМО-4 – UA500110

How much free time do i have for customs clearance and container unload / stuffing?

48 hours

What stamp should i certify the CMR for certification of delivery with, if the container unload takes place at a rented warehouse?

You should use the consignee`s official stamp.

Do the tariffs for the container demurrage/detention change when using MSC inland delivery services?

NO, tariffs are calculated on the general terms of the MSC line.

Do the tariffs for the container terminal storage change when using MSC inland delivery services?

NO, tariffs are calculated on the general conditions of the container terminals.

Exception – please see Block 2 Block train.

Block-train intermodal activity

I want the cargo to be delivered by the block train, how can i get the rate and what should I start with?

You can find the current tariffs in the tariffs brochure.

Please send a request on email to place a booking

UA539-intermodal@msc.com

UA002-intermodal.dpt@medlog.com

The request email must contain an ONP delivery order and the booking/bill of landing number in the email subject.

Can i use the block train delivery service if there are no railway tracks in our warehouse? What is last / first mile?

Yes, you can. In this case, we offer the service of last / first mile delivery – the container will be delivered by truck for a short distance from / to the rail ramp to be further transported by a block train.

If using the block train+last/first mile delivery service, will i be charged additionally for the returning of an empty container from to the container depo after unloading?

NO, the tariff includes the empty container return.

UA539-intermodal@msc.com

UA002-intermodal.dpt@medlog.com

Can i arrange the custom clearance somewhere but the sea port and rail ramp when using the block train delivery service?

Normally, you can, in this case, a declaration of a transport mode change should be issued, which costs around 60 usd per cont, incl. VAT.

For more information, please contact:

UA539-intermodal@msc.com

UA002-intermodal.dpt@medlog.com

When does the import demurrge stop when using the block train delivery service?

From the moment the empty container is returned to the rail depo.

Do the tariffs for the container terminal storage change when using the block train delivery service?

Yes. Container terminal provides 7 days of free storage for dry containers with non-IMO cargo.

Can I use the block train services for the other shipping line`s containers delivery ?

Yes, you can.

For more information, please contact:

UA539-intermodal@msc.com

SEALS

High Security Bolt Seal is mandatory.

How can I make sure the shipper’s seal is compliant with ISO/PAS 17712:2013?

The shipper should be able to provide the following documents:

1. Valid ISO 17712:2013, Clause 6 Tamper Compliance Letter, which certifies that the High Security Seal has been tamper tested. This is issued by the manufacturer itself, and validated by a qualified third party, or by a thirdparty testing facility.

2. Valid ISO 17712:2013, Clause 5 test certificate for the security seal, documenting that the seal is classified as an “H” – High Security Seal - The test must be conducted by a third-party test lab.

3. The third-party test lab must document valid ISO 17025 accreditation to conduct testing of mechanical security seals as per ISO 17712:2013

4. Valid ISO 17712:2013, Annex A certificate of the seal manufacturer (best practices certificate)

5. Valid ISO 9001:2008 certificate of the Seal Manufacturer

SOLAS VGM information for Ukraine

What is VGM?

Verified Gross Mass or VGM refers to the exact, verified weight of a packed container. For safety reasons, vessel operators can only load a container if its weight has been verified.

What do I need to include in my VGM instructions?

You must include the following on all VGM instructions:

Booking or Bill of Lading (BL) number

Container number

VGM + weight measurement unit (lbs. or kgs.)

Responsible Party Name

Digital signature of the authorized signatory in all CAPITAL LETTERS.

How can I submit my VGM instructions?

MyMSC (Free of Charge)

EDI (via INTTRA; GT NEXUS; Cargo Smart)

Guidelines for submitting your VGM instructions

MSC prefers to receive a Shipper-Verified Gross Mass (VGM) before cargo is delivered. This helps to avoid any unexpected weighing charges being levied against the cargo at the Ukraine Port of Loading, which will be billed to the Shipper of Record.

The Verified Gross Mass (VGM) shall be submitted not later than 1 working day prior to vessel’s ETA.

There is “NO VGM – NO LOAD” policy for all export bookings.

Questions about VGM?

Contact our MSC UKRAINE team:

UKR-documentation@msc.com

Delivery advice to customers

Please note that deliveries will be in a standard 20ft/40ft container, on a standard trailer and heavy goods vehicle. If you require a delivery with special requirements, such as Tipper Chassis, Genset or, if your cargo is out of gauge, please email your usual Customer Service representative or call us on +44 1473 277777.

To ensure that we meet your delivery requirements, please note the following.

Customs Clearance: Container(s) must be cleared and landed in time for delivery. If the container(s) cannot be delivered as a result, wasted journey charges may apply.

Documentation: Please ensure that all relevant documentation such as Agent to Agent release, Telex and Express Support Letters and, Original BL's is in place before the delivery.

Quay rent & demurrage: Please endeavour to book your delivery for a date within your free time agreement to avoid quay rent and/or demurrage charges.

Road restrictions – If there are any weight or height restrictions on the approach route or surrounding area of the delivery site, please include these in the special instructions area of your booking.

Cancellations: Cancellations are free of charge up to 1200hrs one working day before the booked delivery date. Any cancellations made after this time will incur charges.

For full terms and conditions and to view our availability, please click here. For import haulage availability, please click here.

Hazardous Cargo

When you have completed loading of your Export Hazardous cargo please send us a copy of the completed DGN. Please note, it MUST be signed in boxes 15 & 17 with the container number clearly in Box 16. Please include this on an email with your booking reference and planned export vessel within the subject line.

Please make sure your container has had the correct placards applied to it as per IMDG and ADR to ensure acceptance into the terminal of export.

Share
Link copied!

VGM Receiving Policy in the UK

What is VGM?

Verified Gross Mass or VGM refers to the exact, verified weight of a packed container. For safety reasons, vessel operators can only load a container if its weight has been verified.

Government approval status

In the UK the regulating body, Maritime & Coastguard Agency (MCA), will allow for +/- 5% or 500kg whichever is greater. The MCA have the right to impose a fine or penalty for any misdeclared VGM information. If you intend on obtaining your VGM by using Method 2, you will need approval from the MCA. Further information about application can be found here.

What to include in your VGM instructions

The following items are mandatory and must be included on all VGM instructions:

Booking or Bill of Lading number

VGM weight (cargo weight + container weight)

Authorised person’s signatory (submitter of the VGM who may be authorised to act on behalf of shippers)

Responsible party name

How to submit your VGM instructions

Directly into the port systems (Destin8 / CNS)

myMSC

EDI (via INTTRA / GT NEXUS / Cargo Smart)

Deadlines for sending your VGM instructions

To avoid additional weighing charges from the port, please submit your VGM declaration to the port authorities before their cut off, 24 hours prior to vessel arrival. If you require MSC to arrange for the terminal to weight the container(s) on your behalf, we require this 48 hours prior to the ETA of the vessel.

Contact information

For more details, please email us or call our office: +44 (0)1473 954484

Prohibited Cargo

It is illegal to ship the following items out of the UK:

Military cargo, weapons, munitions, illegal drugs/ narcotics

Used refrigerators without valid de-gassing certificate Southampton - Containers with Flexi bags installed are not permitted via this port

Please note:

Any used cars for export must provide chassis number / VIN and registration

Used tyres are subject to management approval

Share
Link copied!

Shipping Instruction Cut-offs

We are required to submit advance European Security Manifests. To comply with this requirement, we will need to be in possession of the final shipping instructions in advance of the vessel's arrival. This requirement will affect all services departing the UK, therefore we feel it is important we provide you with a guide to avoid the deadline being missed, which could result in a delay to the exportation of your shipment.

Documentation (Final Shipping Instruction) Cut-Off Guide

Shipping instructions will be required 12hours prior to the vessel's arrival at the port of loading. Exceptions are as follows:

• Weekend arrivals: Instructions due by 12:00PM on the Friday (week prior)

• Monday arrivals: Instructions due by 16:00PM on the Friday (week prior)

• USA, Canada, Mexico, China, Japan and South Africa: Instructions due at least 36 hours (excluding weekend hours) before vessel arrival at the port of loading

Please note, late instructions (received after cut-offs) are at risk of short shipment and additional costs

Shipping Instruction Amendments

• For USA, Canada, Mexico, China, Japan and South Africa, amendments must be received 36 hours (excluding weekend hours) prior to the vessel arrival at the port of loading to avoid correction fees.

• For all other destinations, amendments must be received prior to the vessel’s arrival at the port of loading, to avoid correction fees. To note- for vessels arriving at the weekend, amendments are required by 1200hrs on the Friday prior.

Please note, failure to comply with the above may result in a correction fee of $60 USD

Additional Information

We aim to process instructions / amendment(s) and return a draft bill within 24 hours (excluding weekends). Destination charges will be registered as collect unless your instructions clearly state prepaid. The only exception will be for countries that do not accept collect charges.

Ipswich:   Customer Service | 01473 277777

Glasgow: Documentation | 01413 339100

Fruit Shipping Solutions for UK Importers and Exporters

Importing around 85% of its fruit supply, the UK is one of the world's largest fruit markets and relies heavily on efficient cold chain logistics to maintain a consistent flow of fresh, high-quality produce. Whether importing fruit from global growing regions or exporting UK produce to international markets, maintaining product quality, freshness, and shelf life throughout transit is essential.

MSC UK combines advanced reefer technology with local expertise to help preserve the freshness, appearance, texture, and shelf life of fruit shipments. Supported by our UK teams and global shipping network, we provide temperature-controlled transport solutions designed to keep your cargo moving safely and efficiently from origin to destination.

Meet our UK Fruit Shipping Experts

Expertise across Customer Service, Trade & Bookings

100+ years of combined experience

High quality reefer cargo solutions

Digital tools for tracking & monitoring

Direct weekly services & inland transport

What is Fruit Shipping?

In the UK, MSC’s fruit shipping services help importers and exporters move fresh produce safely through temperature-controlled reefer solutions.

With wide availability of advanced reefer equipment, a global shipping network, door-to-door solutions, and a team of dedicated reefer specialists, we help preserve fruit quality, freshness, and shelf life from origin to destination.

"
In the world of temperature-sensitive cargo, precision and reliability are non-negotiable. At MSC, our reefer services are designed to ensure your perishable shipments are maintained at their ideal temperature from start to finish. With our dedicated team overseeing every detail, you can be confident in the quality and safety of your cargo.
"

Simon Guy
Export Reefer Manager (MSC UK)

Market-leading Fruit Imports to the UK

Whether you’re importing grapes from India, citrus fruit from Egypt, or avocados from West Africa, MSC’s direct UK reefer services provide reliable transportation and advanced temperature-control technology to help keep fruit in optimum condition throughout its journey. For UK importers, this supports consistent supply into a mature, high-demand fresh produce market.

Award-Winning Reefer Experts

Our dedicated reefer trade and sales teams in the UK are on hand to deliver excellent customer service and expert guidance, providing regular support and updates every step of the way. With deep fruit sector expertise and long-term customer partnerships, MSC UK helps anticipate seasonal demand and manage shipments efficiently during peak periods.

Door-to-Door Solutions

With a single UK point of contact and one of the world’s largest shipping and intermodal transportation networks, MSC helps manage your chilled fruit cargo from collection through to delivery. From pre-trip inspections and haulage availability to customs clearance and cargo insurance, MSC UK provides joined-up support designed to keep UK fruit supply chains moving reliably.

How Does Fruit Shipping Work in the UK?

MSC UK helps importers and exporters move temperature-sensitive fruit through a managed cold chain process designed to maintain freshness from origin to destination. As a global hub for fruit trade, the UK is supported by MSC’s extensive national network, with connectivity across 10 UK ports, including Felixstowe, London Gateway, Liverpool and Southampton, alongside multiple inland rail terminals.

• Discuss your requirements with MSC UK: Our local reefer specialists assess your cargo, volumes, origin, destination, and temperature needs.

• Select the right reefer solution: We recommend suitable refrigerated containers and transport options to protect product quality.

• Connect through UK ports and inland terminals: MSC provides flexible import and export solutions across major UK ports and rail links.

• Receive end-to-end support:  From collection and customs clearance to inland transport and final delivery, MSC UK keeps your chilled fruit moving reliably.

"
MSC’s reefer solutions are designed to meet the highest standards of temperature control and reliability, providing peace of mind for all of your temperature-sensitive needs. With cutting-edge technology and a dedicated team here in the UK, we’re committed to providing a seamless and efficient service to ensure your cargo arrives in optimal condition, every time.
"

Kieran Butcher
Reefer Trade Support Assistant (MSC UK)

Questions about Fruit Logistics?

Our UK specialists are here to help.

Which UK ports does MSC use for fruit imports and exports?

MSC provides fruit shipping services through 10 UK ports, including Felixstowe, London Gateway, Liverpool and Southampton. Combined with multiple inland rail terminals, this network helps businesses move fruit efficiently throughout the UK and internationally.

How does MSC keep fruit fresh during transport?

MSC uses advanced refrigerated (reefer) containers to maintain precise temperature settings throughout the journey. This helps protect the freshness, quality, appearance, and shelf life of fruit from origin to destination.

Share
Link copied!

Can MSC help with importing fruit into the UK?

Yes. MSC supports fruit importers with temperature-controlled shipping, customs clearance, inland transport, and end-to-end logistics services to help ensure cargo reaches UK distribution centres and retailers efficiently.

Share
Link copied!

What types of fruit can MSC ship via the UK?

MSC transports a wide range of fresh fruit, including grapes, citrus fruits, avocados, bananas, berries, and other temperature-sensitive produce requiring refrigerated transport.

Link copied!

Does MSC provide inland transport for fruit shipments in the UK?

Yes. Through our network of UK ports, rail terminals, and haulage partners, MSC can coordinate inland transport to help move fruit from the port to warehouses, distribution centres, and final destinations across the UK.

Share
Link copied!

How do I get started with fruit shipping through MSC UK?

Simply contact MSC UK's reefer specialists with details about your cargo, origin, destination, and temperature requirements. Our team will recommend the most suitable shipping solution and guide you through the process.

UK Automotive Logistics for Vehicles, Parts and Components

MSC supports the UK automotive industry with reliable logistics solutions for finished vehicle shipping, aftermarket parts and automotive components. Designed to meet the demands of just-in-time manufacturing and global supply chains, our services combine specialist automotive expertise, extensive UK port coverage and worldwide shipping solutions to help cargo move safely, efficiently and on schedule.

Expertise in car parts, used & finished vehicles

Dedicated UK automotive team

Finished vehicle loading & lashing at both ends

10 UK Ports

Monitor your cargo 24/7 with smart containers

Flexibility and Speed

Automotive manufacturing schedules can change quickly. Access to frequent sailings, flexible routing options and responsive logistics support helps you adapt to changing production requirements and evolving market demand.

With multiple weekly services connecting the UK to major automotive trade lanes, alongside strategically located port and intermodal connections, MSC UK helps you maintain momentum across time-sensitive supply chains and minimise disruption when plans change.

Read more

Local Expertise for Automotive Excellence

With over 45 years of industry experience, MSC is committed to delivering customer excellence and finding the best solution for your cargo; ensuring your cars, motorcycles or engine parts are in the right place at the right time, every time.

By fastening cars securely inside of our clean, dry, and odour free containers, we protect your valuable vehicles from the elements as well as any potential damage for the duration of their journey.

Speak to our specialists

Driving Sustainable Supply Chains

As the automotive industry continues its shift towards a lower-carbon future, supply chains must become more efficient, flexible and sustainable.
MSC's containerised transport solutions supports sustainability goals by:

• Optimising cargo space utilisation

• Connecting cargo through a wider network of UK ports

• Reducing unnecessary inland mileage

• Supporting multimodal movements via road, rail and ocean transport
By transporting multiple vehicles within a single container, you can improve transport efficiency while helping reduce emissions per vehicle moved.

Download MSC UK brochure

How MSC UK Supports Automotive Supply Chains

Automotive supply chains depend on reliable transportation between manufacturing facilities, distribution centres and global markets. MSC works with automotive manufacturers, OEMs and suppliers to develop tailored logistics solutions that support production schedules, inventory planning and the timely movement of cargo.

From cargo collection and specialist vehicle securing to ocean freight and inland transportation, our UK team helps coordinate each stage of the journey, providing the flexibility needed to keep automotive supply chains moving efficiently.

Cargo is collected from manufacturing facilities, suppliers and distribution centres across the UK.

Read more

Finished vehicles are carefully loaded into containers using specialised loading and lashing techniques designed to minimise movement during transit.

Read more

Automotive parts, components and vehicles are connected to key international trade routes through our global shipping network.

Read more

Dedicated UK specialists work closely with you to develop transport solutions aligned to production schedules and inventory requirements.

Read more

Monitor shipments throughout your journey using our digital visibility and cargo tracking solutions.

Read more

Did You Know?

A single 40ft MSC shipping container can carry up to four compact cars, helping automotive manufacturers and suppliers move vehicles efficiently through global supply chains.
Download Automotive brochure

"
MSC supports some of the world's leading automotive manufacturers with reliable logistics solutions for finished vehicles, used vehicles and automotive components. In the UK, our dedicated specialist teams provide tailored vehicle shipping and supply chain support, including bespoke car securing methods, specialised loading and lashing techniques, flexible drop-and-swap agreements, and customised storage solutions. This helps customers keep cargo moving efficiently through time-critical automotive supply chains.
"

Robbie Moodie
Trade Development Manager

Need Help with Automotive Logistics?

Find answers to common questions about vehicle shipping, automotive parts logistics, containerised transport and UK automotive supply chains.

How does MSC support UK automotive manufacturers?

MSC supports UK automotive manufacturers through container shipping, inland transport, storage solutions and specialist vehicle loading services. Our automotive experts help connect UK supply chains to global markets.

Share
Link copied!

Can MSC UK ship both finished vehicles and automotive parts?

Yes. MSC provides logistics solutions for new cars, used cars, and automotive components, supporting manufacturers, suppliers and distributors throughout the automotive supply chain.

Share
Link copied!

How are vehicles secured inside shipping containers?

Vehicles are secured using specialist loading and lashing systems designed for containerised vehicle transport. By minimising movement during transit, these methods help protect finished vehicles while supporting safe, reliable automotive logistics solutions between the UK and global destinations.

Share
Link copied!

What UK automotive logistics infrastructure does MSC UK offer?

MSC provides automotive logistics solutions across 10 UK ports, including Felixstowe, London Gateway, Southampton, Liverpool, Teesport, Tilbury, Tyne, Grangemouth, Greenock and Portbury. Combined with nationwide road and rail connections, our extensive network provides flexible options for moving vehicles, automotive parts and components through UK and international supply chains.

Share
Link copied!

Is containerised vehicle shipping sustainable?

Containerisation can help reduce emissions by maximising cargo capacity, reducing empty space and enabling efficient multimodal transport through road, rail and ocean freight services.

Customs Clearance Solutions UK

Crossing Borders with Confidence

For businesses involved in importing and exporting, being able to get your goods through customs as quickly and efficiently as possible is vital. That’s why at MSC, our customs clearance services are designed to make your customs process as simple as possible so that you can avoid major delays in your overall supply chain.

We have a dedicated UK team of experts, who are on hand to guide you through every step of the customs clearance process. Their experience and skill mean you can rely on them to ensure your goods get through customs as quickly as possible.

Local experts, global networks

Profound knowledge of import and export processes

Avoiding unnecessary delays or expenses

Local Experts, Global Networks

Our teams of local networks are committed to helping you find the best solutions throughout our transportation process, including customs clearance.

We also offer a diverse range of services, including:

• MSC container clearance

• Third-party container clearance

• Trailer clearance

No matter how your goods are being imported, we’ll find the best service for you.

Advantages of Using a Customs Clearance Service

Not only do we have a dedicated UK customs clearance team, but as an Authorised Economic Operator (AEO), we ensure your cargo is processed through customs in the quickest, most efficient way. Whether you’re importing hazardous, temperature-controlled, project, or general goods, our in-house customs clearance services ensure a smooth and transparent transportation process.

MORE THAN CUSTOMS CLEARANCE

PROCESS

Did you know?

In addition to clearing shipments for MSC containers, we also offer clearance for trailers and

UK Eagle Service

Keep Your Cargo Moving From the UK to Australia & New Zealand

With seamless connections from London Gateway to Australia and New Zealand, MSC's Eagle service provides a streamlined route into key Oceania markets, helping your cargo move faster with less complexity.

Combining weekly sailings, predictable transit times and seamless onward routing, Eagle gives you the reliability and flexibility to keep your exports moving.

With MSC's Eagle service, you benefit from wider reach, greater control and dependable connectivity from the UK to Oceania.

Weekly sailings you can rely on

Quick access to key Oceania markets

Seamless onward connections

Predictable transit times

A Service Designed to Simplify Your Exports to Oceania

exports to oceania

faqs

UK to Oceania: How the Eagle
Service Works

The Eagle Service connects UK exporters with Australia, New Zealand and wider Oceania through weekly sailings from London Gateway. Move your cargo from origin to port with support from MSC UK's extensive road and rail network, before connecting with the Eagle network at Rodman to key destinations including Auckland (55 days), Tauranga (65 days), Wellington (70 days), Napier (73 days), Brisbane (60 days) and beyond.

Transit times are indicative and subject to change.

From schedules and transit times to inland transport and onward connections, MSC UK's Oceania trade specialists can help you plan shipments with confidence, providing the support and local expertise needed to move cargo efficiently across Australia, New Zealand and wider Oceania.

Request a quote

Reliable Connections to Australia
& New Zealand

Move cargo from London Gateway to Auckland, Tauranga, Wellington, Brisbane and beyond with a service designed to keep your supply chain moving. Weekly departures provide the consistency and flexibility to plan ahead with confidence, while seamless routing through the Eagle network ensures smooth onward connections to key destinations across Oceania.

Read more

Built for Time-Sensitive Cargo

Whether you're shipping retail goods, industrial products, foodstuffs or other time-critical cargo, Eagle offers a reliable and efficient solution. Designed for speed and simplicity, the service combines dependable schedules with optimised routing to help your cargo reach its destination on time.

Contact our Trade team

First and Final Mile Solutions

Supported by MSC's nationwide road and rail network, we provide collection and inland transport solutions across the UK, connecting every stage of your shipment into one seamless journey. With fewer handovers, full visibility and a dedicated UK team, you gain greater control and a more efficient way to manage your exports from door to destination.

Download brochure

"
When you're shipping to the other side of the world, certainty
matters. MSC's Eagle Service creates a straightforward route into Australia, New Zealand and wider Oceania for UK exporters,
combining weekly sailings from London Gateway with dependable transit times and seamless onward connections across MSC's global network.
"

Gary Butcher
Export Trade Development Manager (MSC UK)

Planning a Shipment to Oceania?

Explore answers to common questions about the Eagle Service, UK export shipping and MSC's wider logistics solutions.

Which destinations can I reach with MSC's Eagle service from the UK?

The Eagle Service connects UK exporters from London Gateway to key destinations across Australia and New Zealand, including Brisbane, Auckland, Tauranga, Napier and Wellington. Weekly sailings and seamless onward connections help UK exporters access major Oceania markets with greater reliability and flexibility.

Share
Link copied!

How can MSC UK support my business beyond ocean freight?

MSC UK offers a range of Solutions Beyond the Sea designed to support every stage of your supply chain, from inland transportation and digital shipping tools to cargo cover and specialist support for sensitive commodities.

Share
Link copied!

Does MSC provide inland transport within the UK?

Yes. MSC UK offers nationwide inland transportation solutions by both road and rail, helping connect your cargo from collection through to port as part of a seamless door-to-door service. Through our extensive UK network, customers benefit from nationwide coverage, access to specialist equipment, dedicated local support and more sustainable transport options, including the UK's largest electric HGV fleet and an extensive rail network.

Share
Link copied!

What types of cargo can I move on the Eagle Service?

Whether you're shipping dry cargo, temperature-sensitive goods, project cargo or specialist freight, the Eagle Service provides a reliable route from the UK to Australia, New Zealand and wider Oceania. Weekly sailings from London Gateway and strong onward connections help keep cargo moving efficiently across the region.

Share
Link copied!

Do I have alternative shipping options to Australia and New Zealand with MSC UK?

Yes. Alongside the Eagle Service, MSC UK offers additional shipping options connecting the UK with Australia and New Zealand through MSC's global network. These include the direct Australia Express service, as well as the NWC to IPAK service via Port Louis. This range of services provides UK exporters with greater flexibility, wider destination coverage and routing options tailored to different cargo, transit time and supply chain requirements.

With fewer handovers, full visibility and a dedicated UK team, you gain greater control and a more efficient way to manage your exports from door to destination.

Download brochure

"
When you're shipping to the other side of the world, certainty
matters. MSC's Eagle Service creates a straightforward route into Australia, New Zealand and wider Oceania for UK exporters,
combining weekly sailings from London Gateway with dependable transit times and seamless onward connections across MSC's global network.
"

Gary Butcher
Export Trade Development Manager (MSC UK)

Planning a Shipment to Oceania?

Explore answers to common questions about the Eagle Service, UK export shipping and MSC's wider logistics solutions.

Which destinations can I reach with MSC's Eagle service from the UK?

The Eagle Service connects UK exporters from London Gateway to key destinations across Australia and New Zealand, including Brisbane, Auckland, Tauranga, Napier and Wellington. Weekly sailings and seamless onward connections help UK exporters access major Oceania markets with greater reliability and flexibility.

Link copied!

How can MSC UK support my business beyond ocean freight?

MSC UK offers a range of Solutions Beyond the Sea designed to support every stage of your supply chain, from inland transportation and digital shipping tools to cargo cover and specialist support for sensitive commodities.

Share
Link copied!

Does MSC provide inland transport within the UK?

Yes. MSC UK offers nationwide inland transportation solutions by both road and rail, helping connect your cargo from collection through to port as part of a seamless door-to-door service. Through our extensive UK network, customers benefit from nationwide coverage, access to specialist equipment, dedicated local support and more sustainable transport options, including the UK's largest electric HGV fleet and an extensive rail network.

Share
Link copied!

What types of cargo can I move on the Eagle Service?

Whether you're shipping dry cargo, temperature-sensitive goods, project cargo or specialist freight, the Eagle Service provides a reliable route from the UK to Australia, New Zealand and wider Oceania. Weekly sailings from London Gateway and strong onward connections help keep cargo moving efficiently across the region.

Share
Link copied!

Do I have alternative shipping options to Australia and New Zealand with MSC UK?

Yes. Alongside the Eagle Service, MSC UK offers additional shipping options connecting the UK with Australia and New Zealand through MSC's global network. These include the direct Australia Express service, as well as the NWC to IPAK service via Port Louis. This range of services provides UK exporters with greater flexibility, wider destination coverage and routing options tailored to different cargo, transit time and supply chain requirements.

UK eBL

OVERVIEW

PROCESS

FAQS

Manage your eBills of Lading with MSC UK in Just a Few Clicks

In the UK’s fast-moving shipping and logistics market, instant access to trade documentation is essential for keeping import and export cargo moving efficiently. MSC UK’s electronic Bill of Lading (eBL) solution helps customers manage shipping documents securely online, reducing reliance on paper-based processes and supporting faster, more sustainable trade.

An electronic Bill of Lading is a digital alternative to the traditional paper document, designed to simplify how shipping documentation is handled. This means UK businesses can manage documentation more efficiently while reducing delays, courier costs, and administrative complexity.

With support from MSC UK’s local teams, customers can move towards paperless shipping with confidence. Our experts are on hand to guide you through the process, helping you adopt eBLs in a way that suits your operations, trade flows, and documentation requirements.

Meet our Experts: The Benefits of MSC's eBL Solution for UK Shipping

What is an Electronic Bill of Lading (eBL)?

The electronic Bill of Lading (eBL) is a digital version of the traditional paper-based Bill of Lading used in international shipping, offering a safe, cost-efficient and sustainable option. It has the same legal value and commercial functions as a paper BL, including serving as a receipt for goods, evidence of the contract of carriage, and a document of title. For UK importers and exporters, eBLs provide a simpler and faster way to manage shipping documentation, helping reduce administrative burdens and support smoother trade flows through the UK's major ports and international shipping networks.

"
The eBL is more than a digital document. It's a smarter way to manage your supply chain. By replacing paper processes with a secure, legally recognised digital solution, customers can reduce delays, improve visibility and keep cargo moving with greater confidence across trade lanes connecting the UK with Asia, Europe, North America and beyond. It's a simple change that delivers real operational and sustainability benefits.
"

Andrew Gooch
Senior Manager - Value-Added Services (MSC UK)

Safer

Handling international shipments from the UK has never been safer. MSC’s eBL solution reduces the risks of loss, damage, and forgery associated with paper Bills of Lading. Experience enhanced security through WAVE BL's digital courier platform, ensuring data encryption and access restrictions for authorised parties. For UK importers and exporters, this provides greater confidence when managing documentation across busy global trade routes.

Simpler

Accessible anytime, anywhere, from any device, MSC's eBL simplifies documentation processes for UK businesses shipping globally. Digitally managing Bills of Lading speeds up processing times, and enables seamless collaboration between shippers, consignees, banks, and partners across time zones. This is especially valuable for UK teams coordinating cargo through multiple ports, partners, and international markets.

Sustainable

The MSC eBL solution replaces paper Bills of Lading with a fully paperless process, helping UK businesses reduce the need to print, handle, and courier physical documents between multiple parties. By digitising trade documentation, MSC UK supports more sustainable shipping operations, helping importers and exporters lower the carbon footprint associated with paperwork across global supply chains.

Faster

In a single shipment, a paper Bill of Lading may be couriered multiple times, taking several weeks and causing delays that result in cargo sitting idle at its destination, costing you time and money. With MSC’s eBL, documents are processed in moments. For UK businesses, this enables instant document transfer, providing access to authorised parties within the supply chain wherever, whenever they need it, instead of waiting for paper bills of lading to arrive by courier.

Cost-Efficient

Using electronic Bills of Lading helps UK importers and exporters eliminate courier fees for sending documents multiple times, for example when updates or amendments are required. It can also help avoid additional costs by ensuring documentation is ready before containers reach their destination, supporting faster cargo release and smoother trade flows through UK ports.

"
With just a few clicks you can create, share and manage electronic bills in minutes, while saving thousands of pounds. It’s faster, safer, cheaper and simpler. And most importantly, it’s more sustainable by reducing paper waste and carbon emissions.
"

Edward Ellis
Business Development Manager - Value-Added Services (MSC UK)

How Can I Get Started with eBL in the UK?

Getting started with MSC’s electronic Bill of Lading (eBL) in the UK is simple. Our local teams help identify eligible shipments, guide onboarding, and support your move from paper documents to a secure digital workflow.

•  Contact MSC UK to discuss your eBL requirements.

•  Complete onboarding with support from local experts.

•  Access eBLs digitally through approved platforms.

•  Manage and transfer documents securely between authorised parties.

Whether importing or exporting, MSC UK helps you adopt eBLs efficiently and confidently.

Transfer your Bill of Lading in Minutes

In the traditional paper-based system, the Bill of Lading is printed at one of our UK offices and transported via multiple transportation methods before reaching its final destination; taking between 5 and 15 days, depending on the recipient’s location and the international trade route involved.

In the digital world of electronic Bills of Lading (eBLs), each transaction takes a maximum of 8 minutes. This means the eBL can be issued at the origin, passed through the necessary parties, and surrendered at the destination in less than one hour, helping UK importers and exporters speed up documentation across global supply chains.

Questions about eBL?

Our UK team have got you covered!

If I'm already using a waybill, why would I switch to an eBL?

Even if you already use a waybill, there are still plenty of benefits in switching to an eBL. Where waybills are typically non-negotiable, with eBLs, customers can enjoy the security and legal standing of an original bill of lading, while benefitting from the speed and efficiency of a waybill.

Share
Link copied!

How does the eBL process work?

The process typically involves the issuance, transfer, and surrender of electronic Bills of Lading through a secure online platform. Once issued, parties involved in the trade transaction, such as the shipper, carrier, and consignee, can digitally sign and exchange eBLs, eliminating the need for physical paper documents.

Share
Link copied!

How secure is the eBL solution?

MSC’s eBL solution utilises advanced encryption and authentication measures to ensure the security and integrity of electronic Bills of Lading. Access to the platform is restricted to authorised users, and comprehensive data protection protocols are in place to safeguard sensitive information.

Share
Link copied!

Is UK training provided for users of the eBL solution?

Yes, MSC UK offers training sessions with a local expert and resources to assist users in familiarising themselves with the eBL platform and its features.

Share
Link copied!

How do I get started with using the eBL solution?

Getting started with our electronic Bill of Lading solution is simple. Register your interest online today and a member of the MSC UK team will contact you to guide you through the onboarding process and help you begin issuing and transferring electronic Bills of Lading.

Share
Link copied!

We offer the largest UK inland transport fleet of any shipping line and can look after the door-to-door delivery of your cargo in an efficient and cost-effective way. Our fast-growing road and rail network offers you increased flexibility and reliability to move your cargo anywhere in the world; whilst decreasing your supply chain risk and carbon footprint in the UK, and beyond. We've Got you Covered Across Road, Rail & Sea With MSC, you always stay connected - to our people, our vessels, our ports and the information that keeps your supply chain moving. Download our brochure ​ 10 UK ports 800+ National UK Team 3 Regional Offices 800+ Trucks A Leading UK eHGV Road Fleet An extensive rail network One Partner. Total Control of Your Supply Chain Manage your cargo seamlessly from port to final destination, with one integrated partner overseeing every stage. Dedicated points of contact, specialist cargo expertise and clear accountability give you faster decisions and complete confidence throughout your journey. Faster, More Predictable Inland Delivery Keep your cargo moving with real-time visibility across vessel, port and inland operations. With haulage planned around vessel schedules and port calls, your cargo moves onward more quickly, with fewer delays and greater reliability. Flexibility to Adapt When it Matters Most Stay in control when conditions change. With operations across road, rail and sea, MSC can switch transport modes, ports or routings, helping you avoid congestion and maintain supply chain continuity. Tailored Transport for Every Type of Cargo Move your cargo with confidence, whatever the requirement. With a wide range of specialist equipment and flexible haulage options, including side loaders, tippers, and solutions for oversized, drop‑and‑swap and stand trailer operations, we support a broad range of cargo needs with precision and care. Lower‑emission Transport Without Compromise Lower carbon emissions with cleaner, more efficient inland transport options. With access to the UK’s largest electric HGV fleet and an extensive rail network that cuts emissions and saves millions of road miles each year, we help to strengthen the resilience and sustainability of your supply chain. Extensive Port Coverage UK's Largest Intermodal Fleet Nationwide Inland Expertise Flexible, Specialist Solutions, Fit for You Sustainable Transport Choices Full Visibility, Every Step of the Way Did You Know? Our extensive rail network saved over 34 million road miles in 2025 by moving cargo closer to its final destination. Using our landside transportation not only saves you time and money; it also reduces your carbon footprint. Import Haulage Availability Matrix We understand the importance of staying connected in today’s fast-paced logistics landscape. That’s why we offer digital solutions like our Import Haulage Availability Matrix. OVERVIEW

BLOGS

Count on MSC UK for your Retail
Shipping and Logistics

Retail consumers in the UK expect a wide range of high-quality goods at competitive prices, whether shopping online or in-store. Achieving commercial success hinges on efficient product sourcing and a “just-in-time” supply chain that is both flexible and robust.

At MSC UK, we offer seamless port-to-port delivery complimented by an extensive intermodal network, for retailers of all sizes, leveraging decades of experience and expertise in worldwide retail shipments. Whether you are shipping furniture, apparel, footwear or white goods, our direct, reliable services connecting Asia, the Indian subcontinent, the Mediterranean, and the UK, ensure your products arrive on time.

Dedicated local teams

Direct calls and frequent sailings

Garment-on-hanger (GOH) equipment and installation

MSC Biofuel Solution

"
Shipping plays a critical role in the retail supply chain, and having a
reliable partner like MSC is essential for our customers to ensure the most efficient, dynamic and cost-effective movement of their time-sensitive cargo.
"

Stewart Newson
Senior Strategic & Global Accounts Manager

Decarbonising Supply Chains

At MSC we are committed to achieve net zero decarbonisation by 2050, working with our customers to achieve their own climate targets by adopting lower emission modes of transportation such as Short Sea Shipping, while meeting increasingly strict environmental regulations.

Read more

Integrated UK Port Network and Inland Transportation

We know how important reliability is to our customers. When you choose MSC for inland transportation, you’ll benefit from market leading fleet capacity across road and rail, providing increased flexibility and reliability whilst moving your cargo closer to its final destination.

Learn more

Local Expertise

We understand the demands of retail distribution channels having built extensive relationships with our UK retail customers, dating back over 45 years.

Our UK based team have the expertise and experience to support you with your unique retail requirements, tailoring our services to support your business.

Download our brochure

Weekly, Direct Vessel Calls

Whatever your cargo, we ensure it is in exactly the right place at the right time.

With direct UK calls from the Far East via our Britannia, Swan and Griffin Services, combined with IPAK and North Mediterranean services, our weekly UK services enables us to ensure we can meet your time-to-market requirements, no matter how complex your supply chain is.

MSC’s Biofuel Solution delivers CO2 savings by replacing conventional fossil-based fuel with a second-generation biocomponent derived from used cooking oil.

Intelligence Inside Every Box

Smart Containers are equipped with IoT-enabled devices that transmit data throughout the cargo journey – whether by sea, road, or rail. The system works continuously, even when out of network range, and syncs data once reconnected. This technology offers:

• Real-time GPS tracking

• Alerts for door open and close activity

• Motion detection & geofencing for enhanced security

• Internal temperature monitoring

• Integration with MSC’s digital platform for full journey visibility

Position

Records precise location data throughout the journey (even offline) for full visibility and better planning.

Still Got Questions?

We've got you covered!

What is a Smart Container and how does it work?

A Smart Container is a dry shipping container equipped with IoT devices that track key data such as location, temperature, and door activity in real time. This technology allows you to monitor your cargo throughout its journey - by sea, rail, or road.

Share
Link copied!

Can I use Smart Containers at UK Ports?

Yes. MSC’s Smart Containers can be deployed anywhere in the world and are fully available across our entire UK port network, including Felixstowe, Liverpool and London Gateway. Whether you’re shipping to or from the UK, Smart Containers provide full visibility and protection at every stage of the journey.

Share
Link copied!

How does real-time cargo tracking help my business?

Real-time tracking gives you instant access to your container’s location and condition. This improves supply chain planning, reduces risk, and helps you act quickly if issues arise during transit, saving time and costs.

Share
Link copied!

What types of cargo benefit from Smart Containers?

Smart Containers are ideal for high-value, time-sensitive, or security-sensitive shipments. They're commonly used across industries like retail, automotive, pharma, and consumer goods moving in and out of the UK.

Share
Link copied!

What alerts and insights will I receive from the platform?

You’ll get smart alerts for events like door opening, temperature changes, motion, and route deviations. All data is accessible through MSC’s digital platform and can be shared with your customers or partners.

Share
Link copied!

Is Smart Container support available locally in the UK?

Yes, our UK-based team is here to support you. We offer guidance on setup, data access, and strategic use of Smart Container insights, ensuring you get the most value from the solution.

Share
Link copied!

What if the container loses connectivity while in transit?

No problem. The device stores data while out of range and transmits it as soon as the signal is restored. Your shipment’s data history is never lost - even during ocean crossings or remote inland routes.

How can I request Smart Containers for my UK shipments?

Simply speak with your MSC UK representative or contact our team to discuss availability, pricing, and how Smart Containers can enhance your shipping operations.
