Detention, demurrage, Per Diem and storage charges

What is demurrage?

Demurrage is the charge applicable for the excessive use of container equipment after the free time expires, at the terminal at Port of Discharge and Place of Delivery.

In case of a demurrage dispute, email UZ548-info@msc.com (email subject: Dispute + Invoice Number), describing the reasons for your dispute.

What are storage charges?

Storage charge is applicablefor the use of the landafter the free time expires, for containers left at Port of Discharge and Place of Delivery (destination railway station).

Demurrage and storage: payment policy

Please note that the shipment will be released ONLY after funds clear.The agency does not accept payment order copies or written guarantees to release shipments from Demurrage and/orStoragehold.

Questions about demurrage or storage charges?

Contact our Central Asia team.

Share
Link copied!

SOLAS VGM information

What is VGM?

Verified Gross Mass or VGM refers to the exact, verified weight of a packed container. For safety reasons, vessel operators can only load a container if its weight has been verified.

What do I need to include in my VGM instructions?

The following items are mandatory and must be on all VGM

instructions:

Booking or Bill of Lading number

Container number

VGM + unit

Authorized person’s signatory (submitter of the VGM who may be authorized to act on behalf of shippers)

Responsible party Name and address

Weighing method used (1 or 2)

Unique number of VGM certificate and date of issue

How can I submit my VGM instructions?

myMSC

EDI (via INTTRA; GT NEXUS; Cargo Smart)

E-mails

It is compulsory to submit a scanned copy of VGM certificate by e-mail

Guidelines for submitting your VGM instructions

VGM submission should be done according to Port of Loading requirements on VGM. Port of Loading may vary depending on the shipment routing.

All VGM must be submitted electronically or transmitted to MSC prior loading, failing which containers will not be planned on the

scheduled vessel. All costs, consequences shall be on Shipper's account for any delay in submitting VGM, non-submission of VGM

and/or for any noncompliance to VGM statutory guidelines.

Specific cutoff date and hour for the VGM, will be mentioned on booking stage and vessel schedules provided by the local agency.

Cutoff times may vary according to each Marine terminal’s capacity and regulation.

Questions about VGM?

Contact our Export Customer Service team.

Detention, Demurrage and Port Storage

What is Demurrage and Detention?

Demurrage and detention are charges applicable, after the free time expires from the date of discharge of the container till the empty is returned to carriers facility .Gate pass is issued with valid date for client to pick the cargo from terminal .Customer cannot pick the container with an expired Gate Pass .To extend the validity it is mandatory for client to settle demurrage and validate GP till the date client wishes to clear and return the empty.

For demurrage and related charges or dispute or any inquiries related to free time please contact us on: IRQ-info@msc.com

What is Port Storage?

Port storage charges are  applicable, after the free time expiry, for the use of the carrier’s container (full or empty) inside the marine terminal. (Discharge from vessel till gate out from terminal).
Such charges are payable by consignee directly with terminal and MSC as a carrier is not involved.

What is Detention?

Detention charge is applicable, after the free time expires from the date of empty release till laden unit is delivered to marine terminals cy facility.

Detention and related charges or disputes or inquiries about the free time please reach out for us on: IRQ-info@msc.com

Link copied!

SOLAS VGM information for Iraq

What is VGM?

Verified Gross Mass or VGM refers to the exact, verified weight of a packed container. For safety reasons, vessel operators can only load a container if its weight has been verified.

What are the Iraqi Government Requirements?

As of now no competent authority has made any announcement pertaining to VGM implementation, tolerance limits, penalty, level of control etc.

What to include in your VGM instructions?

Mandatory

Booking or Bill of Lading number

Container number

VGM and Unit

Authorized person’s signatory (submitter of the VGM who may be authorized to act on behalf of shippers

Responsible party Name

How to submit your VGM instructions?

EDI (via INTTRA)

Fax, Emails

Standard Shipping Instruction signed

Deadlines for sending your VGM instructions?

48 hours of ETA as per usual practice otherwise

VGM cut-off different from documentation cut off 24 hrs. prior vessel arrival

Admin Fees and costs

There are no administration charges imposed by MSC for the moment. Should there be any fees we will share with you.

Recommendations

Shipper to maintain the weighment slips issued by the vendor and present the same upon request by carrier, further to check and confirm the VGM details on the final draft confirmed to MSC and to ensure that VGM weight is same as declared in the bl instruction template already duly signed by them.

In case of method 2 of VGM being followed, to clearly specify the verified container weight as per packing method followed, to the carrier.

Detention, Demurrage, Per Diem and Storage charges

What is detention?

Detention charge is applicable, after the free time expires, for the use of the carrier’s full container inside the marine terminal, railroad facilities or container yard. This charge can also apply while the container is undergoing Jordanian customs inspections, or while the cargo inside the container is being reworked for safety reasons.

What is demurrage?

Demurrage is the charge applicable, after the free time expires, inside the terminal for the use of the land.

In case of a demurrage dispute, email jo216-info.amman@msc.com

Make sure to indicate the following in email subject :"Dispute + Invoice Number", describing the reasons for your dispute.

What is Per Diem?

Per Diem is the charge applicable, after the free time expires, for the use of the carrier’s container (full or empty) outside the marine terminal, rail ramp or container yard.

In case of Per Diem disputes, email jo216-info.amman@msc.com mentioning the invoice number in the email subject. Please describe the reasons

What are storage charges?

A storage charge is applicable, after the free time expires, for containers left inside the rail ramp or container yard (for the use of the land).

SOLAS VGM information for Jordan

What is VGM?

Verified Gross Mass or VGM refers to the exact, verified weight of a packed container. For safety reasons, vessel operators can only load a container if its weight has been verified.

In line with SOLAS (Safety of Lives at Sea) regulations, Jordan Maritime Commission  all marine terminals in Jordan are now allowed to use their certified scales to record Verified Gross Mass (VGM) of shipments.

You must include the following on all VGM instructions:

The following items are mandatory and must be on all VGM instructions

Booking or Bill of Lading number

Container number

Weight certificate.

VGM + unit

Authorized person’s signatory (submitter of the VGM who may be authorized to act on behalf of shippers

Detention, Demurrage, Per Diem and Other Information

What is detention?

Detention is the charge applicable, after the free time expires, for the use of the carrier’s full container inside the marine terminal, railroad facilities or container yard.

Demurrage is the charge applicable, after the free time expires, inside the terminal for the use of the land.

Import cargo delivery procedure, weight limitations and restrictions

To collect delivery order, below documents are necessary:

Endorsed OBL/Seaway Bill

Civil ID copy

Any amendment requests after manifest filing will be charged with a fee of KD 10 per amendment.

Container guarantee letter should be provided by customers locally valid for entire calendar year on their official letterhead, stamped and signed by the authorized signatory of the company.

Weight limitation

20ft - 24.0 tons incl tare

40ft - 30.0 tons incl tare

For containers exceeding above weight an overweight THC of KWD 22/20ft & KWD 38/40ft is applied as per port tariff.

Vehicle restrictions

Cars more than 5 years of age cannot be imported by companies

Cars more than 5 years can be imported only by individuals - only one car per individual per year.

An individual can import only one car irrespective of the year of manufacture per year.

Bill of lading must be strictly issued per car, per individual.

Vehicles manufactured before 1975 are allowed to import only by individuals as Antique, one vehicle per year/individual

Year of manufacture, vehicle identification & engine number, vehicle type/model, color, brand is a must for all the car shipments.

Hazardous cargo restrictions

Below IMCO class categories of cargo is only accepted on direct delivery/load basis at Shuwaikh port

IMCO Class 1 (1.1 to 1.5)

IMCO Class 2 (2.1 and 2.3)

IMCO Class 4 (4.1 to 4.3)

IMCO Class 6.1

No hazardous cargo of any IMCO class is accepted at Shuaiba port.

Palletization of Cargo

As per customs regulation, w.e.f 19th October, 2017, all cargoes that can be palletized (no specific list of cargoes to be palletized has been published by the customs)  must arrive / depart Kuwait on pallets.

This is to facilitate smooth inspection for customs and convenient unpacking / repacking should they decide to do so.

Hence all shipments to/ from  Kuwait must be planned in accordance to this new regulation so to avoid any inconvenience and monetary losses ( delays , customs fines , etc) to the parties concerned.

Export booking procedure

Export bookings can be placed through www.mymsc.com till 10 days prior vessel arrival.

Container release note, export order, and seal should be collected from MSC office after booking is confirmed.

Shipping instructions should be submitted 48 hours prior vessel arrival.

Full container should be gate-in 24 hours prior vessel arrival.

Original Bill of Lading/Seaway BL will be issued after vessel sailing and payment settlement.

What is VGM?

Verified Gross Mass or VGM refers to the exact, verified weight of a packed container. For safety reasons, vessel operators can only load a container if its weight has been verified.

Government approval status

• Beirut port authorities will specify at least two weigh bridges in the port for weighing containers.

• They will weigh the truck with the full export container, than weigh the empty truck or vice versa.

• Containers can be accepted to be gated in the port without VGM, but will not be loaded on the vessel.

• No VGM = No loading

• Half of a vehicle rear/front parts for avoiding any welding to be made for local assembling after entering the Lebanese territory.

• all kinds of electronic cigarettes and Nargileh (Hookah)

SOLAS VGM information

What is VGM?

Verified Gross Mass or VGM refers to the exact, verified weight of a packed container. For safety reasons, vessel operators can only load a container if its weight has been verified.

In line with SOLAS (Safety of Lives at Sea) regulations, marine terminal in Hamad is allowing to use their certified scales to record Verified Gross Mass (VGM) of shipments. If found any discrepancy while inspection container will be moved to CCIA (Customs container inspection area) and customer will be forced to remove the excess cargo.

What do I need to include in my VGM instructions?

You must include the following on all VGM instructions:

· Booking or Bill of Lading (BL) number

· Container number

· VGM + weight measurement unit (lbs. or kgs.)

· Responsible Party Name

· Signature of the authorized signatory

How can I submit my VGM instructions?

• VGM (cargo gross weight + cntr tare weight) in MYMSC.COM – SOLAS VGM option

· EDI (via INTTRA)

· Manually (via email ) /tender customers not using MYMSC.COM

Email: qat-cs@msc.com/ qat-docs@msc.com

Guidelines for submitting VGM instructions:

72 to 48 hours prior vessel arrival.

VGM contacts: qat-cs@msc.com/ qat-docs@msc.com

Local Shipping and Dangerous Goods

1.CRO Release Conditions

The Container Release Order (CRO) will only be issued after Dangerous Goods (DG) approval is granted in the system. As per the customer's instructions, any misdeclaration will result in a penalty payable by the customer.

2.Special Requirements for Certain PODs

For specific Ports of Discharge (PODs), such as Algerian PODs, additional approvals are required. (LOE) and (MSDS) must be submitted to the POD for approval before CRO release.

3.Manifest Release and Amendments

The manifest will be released only after DG approval is finalized in the local system. Any amendments may impact the approval process and container loading, which will remain subject to DG approval and finalization.

4.Shipping Instructions (SI) Cut-Off

Shipping Instructions must be submitted no later than 10 working days prior to the Estimated Time of Arrival (ETA) of the nominated vessel.

5.Draft Amendment Deadline

Any amendments to the draft must be made at least 3 working days before the vessel’s ETA to avoid shipment rollover. Shipments are subject to DG approval.

6.Placarding Requirements

Ensure that all containers are properly placarded in accordance with IMDG and ADR regulations to guarantee acceptance at the export terminal.

Export regulations in Saudi Arabia prohibit or restrict the export of certain goods. These rules are enforced to protect national resources, maintain economic stability, and ensure compliance with international agreements. Violations may result in customs duties, penalties, or legal action.

Personal effect and any cargo are rejected by the POD

Restricted Items (Require Prior Approval or Export Licenses from Government):

• Poultry and eggs

• Flour

• Medicines

This information is provided for general guidance only and may be modified or withdrawn by the government at any time without prior notice.

Driving Automotives Trade Forward in Saudi Arabia

As Saudi Arabia drives forward the expansion of its automotive sector, from spare parts distribution to local vehicle manufacturing, the demand for fast and reliable logistics is rising sharply under Vision 2030. In this competitive environment, every shipment counts. Whether transporting critical components or finished vehicles, success relies on precision, speed and consistency.

MSC Saudi is your reliable partner for automotives shipping. From new and used cars to spare parts and raw materials, our integrated solutions meet the high standards with consideration to the timelines and schedules against supply and demand.

Weekly sailings

Fast and reliable transit times

Global coverage

Tailor made approach

Reliable Tailored Solutions

Saudi Arabia is known for decades as significant point in the journey of Automotives. Importing  different types of vehicles, spare parts and consumables is a priority to supply the increasing local and regional demand. MSC Saudi manages high volumes and time-sensitive schedules with tailored solutions.

Under Vision 2030, the Kingdom advances into local vehicle manufacturing and engineering, the automotive sector is emerging as a cornerstone of national industrial growth.

Your Cargo is Delivered Safely

Our team will help you plan an end-to-end cargo journey. We can handle any kind of automotives cargo from spare parts to high-value vehicles, ensuring smooth coordination between ports, depots and your manufacturing site.

The tailored services can include inland transportation via road and rail connecting your cargo with our global shipping network, we guarantee safe, efficient, and reliable delivery every time.

Saudi Customs Clearance Solution

Expert Support Throughout the Process

For importers and exporters, customs can often be a critical bottleneck, where delays translate into rising costs and disrupted supply chains. At MSC Saudi, we manange the challenges by providing tailored customs clearance services designed to keep your cargo moving smoothly while meeting all regulatory requirements.

Our dedicated team in Saudi Arabia is in reach to guide you through every stage of the process, ensuring compliance, efficiency, and peace of mind. We ensure, your goods are cleared quickly and handled with the utmost care, so your business stays on track without unnecessary interruptions.

Easier overall customs clearance

Avoid any unnecessary delays or expense

Deep knowledge of import and export local processes

Designed Services Around your Needs

Partnering with MSC Saudi gives you easy access to our dedicated team of experts who know how to navigate the changes of international trade. As a holder of  customs accreditation, we can optimize operations in lanes and benefit from reduced inspections. The result is faster, more efficient cargo clearance and a significantly lower risk of costly delays, keeping your supply chain moving without interruption.

Outstanding Process Optimization

Our on-site specialists work closely with local port authorities and operators to accelerate clearance and to offer guidance through your cargo's journey.

Beyond clearance support, MSC Saudi employs local expertise, strong network, to optimize operations and flow. This includes container clearance, Port Fassah appointments, and the issuance of clearance certificates for SASO and SFDA requirements.

Efficiency at Every Checkpoint

As an Authorized Economic Operator (AEO), MSC Saudi guarantees that your cargo moves through customs with maximum efficiency and reliability. Whether you are importing or exporting hazardous materials, temperature-controlled shipments, project cargo or general goods, our in-house customs clearance team makes sure every process is handled smoothly, transparently and in full compliance with regulations.

Saudi Digital Solutions

Smarter Digital Shipping Starts Here

Digitalization is transforming the way global trade moves, and MSC Saudi is committed to supporting the Kingdom’s vision for a digitally enabled logistics sector. In line with Saudi Vision 2030 and the National Transport and Logistics Strategy, we deliver digital solutions that simplify shipping processes, enhance supply chain visibility, and improve operational efficiency for our customers.

Our integrated digital services provide a seamless shipping experience, enabling customers to manage bookings, documentation, cargo tracking, and shipment milestones through secure, intuitive MSC platforms.

User-Friendly Digital Interface

Track and Manage Your Shipments

User-Friendly Digital Interface

Stay Connected Throughout the Journey

At MSC Saudi, our dedicated local digital experts help unlock the full value of MSC Smart Containers through direct support and guidance from our three main offices in Dammam, Riyadh, and Jeddah providing coverage and support across the Kingdom.

With year-round container availability and advanced tracking technology, MSC Smart Containers provide enhanced visibility, security, and control through real-time insights into container location and status. Customers can track their cargo from their phones throughout the journey, whether it was road, sea, or rail, to enable faster responses to changing conditions and improved operational efficiency.

Advanced Control for Sensitive Cargo

MSC iReefer provides continuous monitoring and access to real-time container data, helping you maintain optimal conditions for temperature-sensitive cargo, especially during kingdom’s summer season. Benefit from early detection of potential issues, reduced risk of cargo damage, improves operational efficiency, and greater visibility.

With our trusted local partners, MSC Saudi continues to strengthen its' cold chain offering by leveraging advanced cold storage infrastructure, delivering seamless end-to-end refrigerated logistics solutions for our customers across the Kingdom.

Saudi eBL Solution

Smart Shipping : Manage your eBL Shipping Anytime, Anywhere

In an era defined by digital transformation, businesses need seamless, 24/7 access to their most critical trade documents. At MSC Saudi, we are proud to support the Kingdom’s Vision 2030 targets by adopting the Electronic Bill of Lading (eBL) a fully digital, legally recognized alternative to the traditional paper BL.

The eBL revolutionizes how cargo moves across borders. It delivers faster, more secure, and more sustainable document handling, while eliminating the inefficiencies of physical paperwork, courier delays, and costly postage.

Fill in the business form

Activate your account with log in details you will receive by Email

Invite your business partners

Request the eBL in your next shipping instructions

Driving Shipping's Digitalization

To accelerate the growth of digital trade, MSC a member of the Digital Container Shipping Association (DCSA), have co-signed with other members in the association a commitment to the industry to issue 50% of their bills of lading digitally by 2027, and 100% by 2030.

A Secure Blockchain-Powered Platform

With MSC's Electronic Bill of Lading (eBL), transferring documents takes minutes instead of days, helping your business move at the speed of today's digital trade. Giving the Saudi national economic drivers, many buisness owners and investers will benefit from the eBL solutions which can maximize savings by streamlining workflows without disrupting existing processes and by accelerating payment cycles that improve cash flow and efficiency across your supply chain.

Trusted Digital Exchange with Blockchain Security

MSC’s eBL solution is delivered through WAVE BL’s digital courier platform, connecting every party in a decentralized network that enables the secure and instant exchange of documents. Powered by blockchain, all data is encrypted, every transaction is verified, and each document or signature is fully authenticated.

This ensures your trade documents are protected with the highest levels of security and transparency, while supporting Saudi Arabia’s Vision 2030 ambition to lead in digital innovation and smarter global trade.

Smart, Sustainable Trade at Your Fingerprints

With the user-friendly WAVE BL platform, you can amend, endorse, surrender, or transfer your eBL anytime, anywhere. By mirroring the familiar paper-based process in a fully digital format, the eBL minimizes errors, eliminates delays, and brings new levels of efficiency to global trade.

Beyond convenience, this innovation also supports the Saudi Green Initiative by reducing paper consumption and cutting carbon emissions, advancing a more sustainable, paperless future for the Kingdom’s logistics sector.

Saudi Food and Beverages Shipping

Nourishing Saudi Food Supply Chain Efficiently

Saudi Arabia's food and beverage market is a growing market demand. Government efforts are creating programs expanding retail infrastructure to support food security and local production. As a major food importing country in the Gulf region and with the growing domestic supply chain, businesses need reliable shipping partners to ensure  goods are deliver fresh and safe in respect of the timeline. MSC Saudi brings  global markets products to the Kingdom with advanced cold chain logistics, delivering fresh, frozen, poultry and liquid cargo through multimodal solutions by road, rail and sea, ensuring peak quality at every stage.

Dedicated customer service team

Access to 10 million well-maintained, well positioned containers

ISO Certified in food safety systems

Reefer container (20's, 40' high cube) available worldwide to accommodate seasonal fluctuations

Cold Chain Expertise for Saudi Market

Our premium perishable goods are handled with the highest standards of efficiency, using advanced refrigerated transportation and precise temperature control to ensure they arrive in excellent condition. We carefully consider the effect of the climate on products and therefore, careful operations are designed to reserve the status

Even during peak seasons, our teams ensure fast, reliable transport for the most time-sensitive shipments supporting industry's producers and retailers nationwide and beyond.

Reefer Logistics for Saudi Arabia

MSC Saudi is strengthening its cold storage infrastructure to meet the Kingdom’s growing demand for reliable, high-quality food and beverage logistics.
We make sure to plan and adapt all measures to ensure reserving perishable goods in Saudi Arabia's climate conditions.

Smart Tracking for Smarter Logistics

MSC Saudi offers the iReefer solution, a remote container monitoring system that provides customers with real-time data on temperature, humidity, and location for all temperature-controlled shipments. Available in Saudi Arabia and worldwide through the myMSC platform or API integration.

Using both cellular and satellite communication, the system delivers continuous data flow, even in the most remote areas.

From Start to Finish: Solutions Made to Fit

Whether you are shipping chilled foods, beverages, or fresh fruits and vegetables, MSC Saudi’s local experts understand the unique demands of the Kingdom’s market. We work closely with you to ensure your cargo moves seamlessly and efficiently,  from port and depot to rail, truck, and final delivery.

Saudi Inland Solutions

Go Further with MSC Saudi

Shipping your cargo across the ocean is just the beginning. With nearly 30 years of experience in the Saudi market and an extensive inland transportation network, we ensure smooth delivery from port to destination. We offer reliable road and rail connections, secure warehousing and professional ISO tank handling, covering everything from major trade hub to remote industrial areas.

Whether importing or exporting, our end-to end solutions provide the flexibility, care and efficiency your business needs, with tailored storage and complete door-to-door support across the Kingdom and beyond.

Outstanding port coverage

Warehousing and storage

Road

Rail

Connecting your Supply Chain Throughout the Kingdom

Streamlined Solutions for Your Supply Chain

MSC Saudi offers specialized equipment and services to meet your cargo needs. From side-loaders, tipper trailers, breakbulk and out-of-gauge cargo, to refrigerated reefer containers and liquid cargo solutions, we provide the flexibility to handle even the most complex shipments.

With more than 350,000 sqm of depot facilities across the Kingdom, combined with expert stand trailer operations, warehousing, and distribution, MSC Saudi delivers end-to-end solutions from port to warehouse.

Strategic Rail Connections

MSC Saudi provides efficient rail transport connections between Dammam and Riyadh, offering a faster and more sustainable alternative for inland cargo movement. Integrated with our terminal and depot operations, this service simplifies the process of empty container returns and streamlines your logistics flow. In coordination with different parties, we ensure reliable scheduling and smooth delivery.

Customer Service Excellence

Our dedicated team is committed to execute in smooth and efficient operations to ensure service excellence and garuntee a satisfying experience from the first steps to final delivery. By ensuring streamlined document processing and simplified gate in/out procedures at depots, we reduce the risk of unnecessary delays and keep your cargo moving. with three main offices across Saudi Arabia, we are positioned to respond quickly and effectively to your needs.

Seamless Door-to-Door Delivery

MSC Saudi's inland solutions support your cargo from start to finish. Our team will ensure handling operations throughout the journey. From customs clearance, documentation, SABER product registration (COC) to inland collection, fleet tracking and delivery, we provide you with the best reliable service. Our local expertise maintaining global standards, we make your cargo management simple and hassle-free.

Saudi Mining and Minerals Shipping

Connecting Saudi's Mineral Resources to the World

MSC Saudi delivers specialized expertise in moving heavy and oversized cargo, giving you the confidence that your mining and mineral shipments are in safe hands. Our teams are experienced in managing the sensitivity of transporting Minning and Minerals resources with precision and care, as  Saudi Arabia has a growing minning and minerals market.

By working with some of the world leaders in mining and minerals industry, we have built unique, and customized solutions designed to meet the specific demands of the business and keep the supply chain flow seamlessly.

Reliable and well-positioned equipment

Outstanding port coverage

Fast & reliable transit times

Reliable Assets to Support your Supply Chain Flow

Every shipment has a set of unique requirements, and at MSC Saudi we recognize the vital importance of the 20 ft container in moving heavy cargo safely and efficiently. With a wide availability of these containers, we can respond quickly to adjust operations to fit your supply chain needs and deliver solutions tailored for your business.

From Origin to Destination, With Care

We deliver reliable door-to-door logistics, including intermodal solutions, designed to meet the specific needs of the mining and minerals sector. With customized solutions and industry expertise, MSC Saudi ensures secure, compliant, and efficient transport by managing every stage of the journey.

Supported by strategically located depots and our own fleet of trucks, we provide direct delivery from port to your warehouse or final destination.

Minning and Minerals Resource Logistics

MSC Saudi delivers specialized expertise in moving heavy and oversized cargo, giving you confidence that your mining and mineral shipments are in safe hands. Our teams are experienced in managing the complexities of transporting difficult loads with precision and care. By working with some of the world leaders in minning and minerals resource industry, we have built the experience needed to provide customized solutions designed to meet the unique needs.

The Specifics of Shipping Minerals

Shipping minerals such as copper, bauxite, or phosphate from Saudi Arabia often requires navigating multiple transport modes, regulatory requirements, and storage needs. At MSC Saudi, we simplify this process through comprehensive inland logistics and storage solutions across the Kingdom, all supported by our global port network and advanced digital tools to keep your cargo moving quickly and efficiently.

Saudi Petrochemicals and Chemicals Shipping

Driving Growth of Saudi Arabia's Petrochemicals & Chemical Trade

Saudi Arabia is positioned at the heart of the global energy and petrochemical landscape. With its massive production capacity, integrated refineries, and export infrastructure, the Kingdom is uniquely positioned to advance the chemical and petrochemical sector with speed and expertise.

With one of the largest and most diverse fleets at MSC's disposal, our local Saudi experts will ensure capacity and space flexibility required to meet the evolving needs of the petrochemical industry meeting international standards to deliver a seamless, compliant, and high-value shipping service for the industry.

Project cargo

Global coverage

Specially trained experts

Wide range of equipment and transport methods

Door-to-door delivery solutions

Integrated Solutions Across Your Supply Chain

With weekly services and multi-modal transport by land and sea, MSC Saudi offers complete, one-stop solutions for petrochemical cargo, ensuring the highest level of care.

Handling the diversity of petrochemical products requires precision, and we provide differnt container types while working closely with you to select the optimal size and configuration ensuring you cargo is transported safely and in full compliance with international standards.

Tailored-Solutions to Suit Your Needs

Beyond shipping and logistics, MSC Saudi supports customers with innovative digital and value-added solutions such as myMSC, trackable smart containers, and the MSC Extended Cargo Protection program. These services enable seamless digitalization, real-time visibility, and enhanced security, for greater control.

Comprehensive door-to-door Coverage

MSC Saudi delivers reliable door-to-door logistics solutions tailored to the sensitive requirements of the petrochemical and chemical industry. Our services include inland haulage, container stuffing, loading, and packaging.

With customized logistics, industry expertise, and strategically located depot facilities, we guarantee secure delivery for hazardous cargo allowing our customers to focus on their core business while we manage the complexity of their supply chains.

From Saudi Arabia to The World

Our comprehensive, end-to-end shipping solutions ensure precise handling, accurate documentation, and expert support at every stage, from loading and transshipment to final delivery.

What sets us apart is our ability to connect Saudi Arabia’s world-leading chemical and petrochemical production hubs directly to more than 150 global markets. Through local expertise with MSC’s global network and digital innovations, we deliver not just cargo but confidence enabling Saudi exporters to strengthen their role as key drivers of global industry.

Saudi Pharmaceuticals Shipping

Connecting Saudi's Market with Global Pharmaceutical Leaders

Reliable pharmaceutical logistics are essential for maintaining the integrity of sensitive products like medications and vaccines. From temperature control to regulatory compliance, MSC Saudi ensures that our operations supports the safe and timely delivery of critical healthcare goods.

With GDP-compliant processes, the intensitve market knowledgeand the  international requirements, we offer secure and efficient shipping solutions across Saudi Arabia and beyond. Through our global network, our services create a strong supply line between producers and consumers to provide best support to the healthcare sector.

Global coverage

GDP Compliant & certified

Cutting edge reefer technology

Wide range of equipment and transport methods

Shipping Sensitive Goods

Pharmaceutical cargo is transported in temperature-controlled reefer containers which allow the consistent management of conditions throughout transportation.

MSC Saudi uses the most advanced cooling systems in reefer containers, ensuring you pharmaceutical product are kept under the required temperature during transit:

• Primeline®

• Naturaline®

• Star Cool SA

Integrated Supply Chain Solutions

Through our robust door-to-door intermodal network, MSC Saudi connects sea, rail, and road to move your phrarmaceuticals smoothly safely the Kingdom.
Benefit from our direct rail access to two major ports: King Abdulaziz port & Riyadh dry port, ensuring faster, cost-effective inland transportation. Whether you're shipping from/to any of the six main ports in Saudi Arabia, our integrated services ensure your cargo reaches its destination moving your refrigerated cargo efficiently.

Compliance & Regulation

At MSC Saudi, we adhere to Saudi Port Authority's shipping regulations, ensuring full compliance with the local requirements. Our GDP certification reflects our commitment to following global best practices in handling temperature-sensitive and high-value medical products.

Our Local dedicated experts are well trained to provide the right support to your needs

Healthcare Logistics

Pharmaceutical Logistics require high standards and compliance, with precise temperature management to ensure sensitive commodities such as vaccines, medication and medical equipments integrity, delivering it without spoilage and complete legislative compliance. In addition, we have the capability to design solutions and plan transport of heavy medical machinery across the kingdom.

Depending on your operational needs, MSC Saudi will serve as your trusted 2PL, 3PL or 4PL partner to ensure safe, efficient and compliant delivery every step of the way.

A Strategic Hub Connecting Global Trade Routes

Hazardous Cargo Handling

To export hazardous cargo from the UAE, please ensure full completion of required documentation, including the Dangerous Goods Notice (DGN). The container must have appropriate placards as per IMDG and ADR regulations to be accepted at UAE terminals.

Shipping Instruction Cut-offs for UAE Ports

To comply with advanced security and operational mandates, MSC requires final shipping instructions well before vessel arrival at UAE ports:

Shipping instructions must be received at least 6 hours prior to vessel arrival.

For destination amendments to USA, Canada, China, Japan, and South Africa, changes must be submitted 36 hours before vessel arrival.

For other destinations, amendments are due 24 hours prior to vessel departure.

Late shipment instructions may result in additional charges or shipment delays.

Cancellations are free when made 24 hours prior; late cancellations may incur fees.

Detention, demurrage, Per Diem, storage charges & DO documents

What is detention?

Detention is the charge applicable, after the free time expires, for the use of the carrier’s full container inside the marine terminal, railroad facilities or container yard/customer warehouse. This charge can also apply while the container is undergoing UAE customs inspections, or while the cargo inside the container is being reworked for safety reasons.

SOLAS VGM information

SOLAS &VGM REQUIREMENT UAE- DUBAI

What is VGM?

Verified Gross Mass or VGM refers to the exact, verified weight of a packed container. For safety reasons, vessel operators can only load a container if its weight has been verified.

In line with SOLAS (Safety of Lives at Sea) regulations, all marine terminals in the USA are now allowed to use their certified scales to record Verified Gross Mass (VGM) of shipments. Download our USA VGM policy and terminal guidelines for more information.

What do I need to include in my VGM instructions?

Government approval status

Federal Transport Authority has approved the VGM regulation to be in effect from 01st July,2016

Tolerance level is up to the container payload and AED 1300 (USD 354) will be applied as penalty in case of container exceeding payload.

Level of control expected is however not yet announced

DPW is entitled to weigh all laden containers earmarked for loading and no container will be loaded without the VGM

What to include in your VGM instructions

The following items are mandatory and must be on all VGM instructions

Booking or Bill of Lading number

Container number

VGM + unit

Authorized person’s signatory (submitter of the VGM who may be authorized to act on behalf of shippers

Responsible party Name

How to submit your VGM instructions

Since DP world is the sole authority to weigh the packed container at the port, VGM submission from shippers is not mandatory as the document issued by DP world Jebel Ali would serve the purpose.

Deadlines for sending your VGM instructions

VGM data should be submitted to us 24 hours prior to the ETA of the vessel. However the cut off for documentation remains unchanged at 48 hours.

VGM cut-off different from Documentation cut off

Admin Fees and costs

There are no administration charges imposed by MSC for the moment. Should there be any fees we will share with you.

Recommendations:

MSC recommends shippers to retain the VGM slips issued by the terminal in file for future reference and to produce if needed by authorities.

LOI (Letter of indemnity) for lost or destroyed OBLs (Original Bills of Lading)

What is an LOI?

An LOI (Letter of Indeminity) is required when an original Bill of Lading is lost or destroyed. It can be completed by shipper at the Port of Loading, or by the consignee at the Port of Discharge.

The LOI requires 200% of the commercial value of the cargo plus Ocean Freight to be guaranteed either through bank or MSC’s Insurance company.

MSC’s global LOI requirements are set out by our Geneva headquarters. The LOI must be completed as per these instructions in order for a duplicate Bill of Lading to be issued.

Emergency Equipment Charge

14 August 2026

Dear Valued Customer,

Please be advised that MSC will implement an Emergency Equipment Charge (EEC) for certain import cargo destined for the UAE.

Details

Information

Direction

Imports to UAE

Scope

Cargo destined for Sharjah (including all ports, terminals and ICDs within the emirate), Ajman, Ras Al Khaimah, Umm Al Quwain, and Fujairah

Amount

USD 200 per container/unit

Charge Type

Local Charge

Purpose

To recover extraordinary costs associated with the prolonged immobilization of container equipment in the region resulting from exceptional market conditions and equipment imbalances

Effective Date:

16 August 2026 (based on arrival date) for all trades except USA and Ecuador

7 September 2026 (based on arrival date) for USA and Ecuador

UAE at the Center of Global Automotive Trade

The United Arab Emirates stands as a pivotal junction in the global automotive landscape, serving as the primary gateway for vehicle imports, spare parts distribution, and strategic re-exports across the Middle East, Africa, and Asia. As the sector evolves, the demand for precise, high-velocity logistics has never been more critical. MSC supports this dynamic industry with tailored, scalable logistics solutions designed to enhance operational excellence and drive strategic growth.
By combining local infrastructure with a vast global network, we ensure that automotive supply chains move with speed, reliability, and full regulatory compliance.

UAE Automotive

Expertise

Unparalleled

Customer Care

Comprehensive

UAE Port Coverage

Door-to-door Automotive Supply Chain Support

MSC UAE provides comprehensive, door-to-door automotive logistics solutions engineered for Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs), Tier 1 suppliers, and aftermarket distributors. Our services are structured to manage the entire supply chain with precision, ensuring operational excellence from origin to destination. We support the demands of the automotive sector by integrating secure transport, flexible scheduling, and expert regulatory navigation.

Tailored Logistics for a Dynamic Landscape

Success in the UAE market requires more than just transportation; it demands a partner who understands the nuances of local commerce. MSC offers a suite of specialized services that go beyond simple first-mile and last-mile delivery, focusing instead on adding value at every stage of the supply chain.

Where Global Automotive Trade Connects

The UAE’s strategic geographical position allows it to function as a redistribution hub for the entire Middle East, Africa, and parts of Asia. This central role drives immense trade volumes, particularly in the used car sector, where the country leads globally in import numbers.

This leadership is supported by world-class infrastructure, including advanced ports and free zones that facilitate seamless re-export activities.

eBL UAE

OVERVIEW

PROCEDURE

Go Paperless with MSC eBL

With shipping carriers pledging a 100% eBL adoption by 2030, MSC UAE’s eBL solution places your business at the forefront of this transformation, offering a secure and efficient way to manage shipping documents while advancing the UAE's digital trade ambitions. Built on blockchain and aligned with global standards, MSC eBL enables instant transfers, reduces operational risk, and streamlines processes across the UAE’s major logistics hubs and free zones. By ensuring compliance and reliability, it keeps cargo moving seamlessly within the Emirates and to global markets.

Convenience & Accessibility

Cost Savings

Reduced Carbon Footprint

Digital Transformation Shipping

The United Arab Emirates is a recognized regional leader in adopting digital transformation approach in classic style business. MSC  focuses on a digital-first solution strategy, and eBL is at the core of this shift by offering instant document exchange without courier delays. Blockchain-based security safeguards against fraud, loss, or tampering, while digital document flows meet the needs of UAE free zones, customs processes, and regulatory frameworks.

Streamlined Operations for Business Convenience

eBL is designed to support a wide range of logistics professionals, including freight forwarders, importers, exporters, customs brokers, and companies operating within free zones across the UAE. Our solution directly aligns with the UAE’s economic vision. This digital approach delivers significant advantages to companies located in major economic zones such as JAFZA, KIZAD, Dubai South, and the SAIF Zone.

Want to start using MSC eBL?

Understand the Process

No Waiting to Transfer your Bill of Lading

The UAE is pushing for digital trade facilitation under initiatives like the UAE Trade Connect and Paperless Trade Strategy, making eBLs highly advantageous.

In the digital world of electronic Bills of Lading (eBLs), each transaction takes a maximum of 8 minutes. This means the eBL can be issued at the origin, passed through the necessary parties, and surrendered at the destination in less than one hour.

Food & Beverage UAE

Trusted Food and Beverage Logistics Solutions

The United Arab Emirates serves as a critical hub for global food and beverage trade, supporting a rapidly expanding population and a world-class hospitality sector. The nation's strategic vision is formalized in the National Food Security Strategy 2051, which aims to establish the UAE as a leading country in food security through diversified import sources, enhanced local production, and sophisticated logistics infrastructure. MSC supports this vital industry with specialized logistics solutions that ensure food and beverage cargo arrives fresh, safe, and on time, bolstering the nation's ambitious goals.

Reefer container (20’, 40’ High Cube) availability

Food-grade containers

Direct calls and frequent sailings

Controlled atmosphere

Nationwide Food Reliable Logistics

MSC UAE possesses extensive experience in managing a diverse range of food and beverage cargo. Our capabilities cover the entire spectrum of the industry, from perishable goods requiring strict temperature control to durable packaged products. We handle fresh produce, dairy, meat, packaged foods, beverages, confectionery, frozen goods, and bulk ingredients with tailored solutions for each category.

Reefer Expertise

Protecting the integrity of temperature-sensitive cargo is a cornerstone of food logistics. MSC UAE employs advanced reefer technology to provide precise environmental control for shipments moving across the Emirates and beyond. Our reefers are designed to handle frozen, chilled, and perishable goods with exceptional accuracy. We handle frozen, chilled, and perishable goods with precision, while iReefer technology provides real-time monitoring and control of temperature, humidity, and ventilation throughout the journey.

Quality Compliance and Safety

Navigating the stringent regulatory landscape of the food and beverage industry is essential for avoiding costly delays and ensuring market access. MSC UAE guarantees full compliance with all local and international food safety standards. Our services are supported by in-house customs expertise and advanced digital tools that facilitate real-time tracking and seamless documentation management.

Fresh products can’t wait

Shipping chilled foods, beverages, or fresh produce? MSC UAE’s experts understand the unique demands of the Emirates’ market. We ensure your cargo moves seamlessly and efficiently with secure, cost-effective solutions

Inland Solutions UAE

From the UAE’s Inland Hubs to Global Markets

MSC UAE delivers reliable inland transport solutions connecting major ports like Jebel Ali and Khalifa to key industrial areas, free zones, and commercial hubs across all seven Emirates. Our services are designed to streamline door-to-door delivery, support customs coordination, and ensure smooth first-mile and last-mile logistics. With dedicated trucking capacity, access to major free zones, and real-time digital visibility, we provide businesses with efficient, flexible, and compliant inland transport options.

Rail

Road

Real-time traceability

Door-to-door delivery solutions for businesses of all sizes

Reliable Coverage

Leading a wide reliable road haulage network covering all seven Emirates, our inland fleet supports different cargo requirements, this includes full container loads (FCL), reefer units, and bonded transport for free-zone movements. Navigating UAE’s extensive inland network is made easy by our local team of experts who provide tailored routing and scheduling that aligns with your operational needs.

Connectivity through Rail

The national rail network, Etihad Rail, connects major industrial centers and ports in the UAE, including those in and around Abu Dhabi. With the Khalifa port to Fujairah network currently operational, the completed extensive rail network will span across the UAE.

Real-Time Tracking Visibility

Through MSC’s digital platforms, customers gain real-time visibility of their shipments, including inland and ocean legs where available. Features like automated notifications, live tracking, and digital documentation enhance transparency and support proactive planning. These tools help improve supply chain control and provide oversight across the entire journey.

Mining and Minerals UAE

Connecting UAE Mining and Minerals to Global Markets

The United Arab Emirates has established itself as a global powerhouse in the metals and minerals sector, recognized specifically as a leader in aluminum production and a strategic nexus for the steel trade across the Middle East, Africa, and Asia. As the region continues to diversify its economy, the efficient movement of these heavy, high-volume commodities becomes a critical driver of strategic growth. MSC UAE supports this vital industry with specialized logistics solutions designed to handle sensitive metal cargo with precision, ensuring that the nation's mineral potential reaches international markets seamlessly.

Serving Key Industrial Zones

Regulatory Know-How

Wide range of equipment and transport methods

Powering UAE’s Metals Supply Chain

The logistics of mining and minerals requires more than standard transport; it demands a strategic connection between production hubs and global demand. MSC UAE provides tailored logistics services that integrate the country's key industrial zones  including KEZAD, Jebel Ali, and Hamriyah Free Zone directly with international trade routes.

Cargo Safety from Origin to Destination

In the metals trade, product quality is paramount. The UAE’s unique climate and industrial environment present specific challenges, including high humidity and temperature fluctuations, which can pose risks such as corrosion, deformation, or contamination. MSC UAE implements rigorous cargo integrity measures to mitigate these risks effectively.

Confidently Moving Your Metals

MSC UAE plays a pivotal role in connecting the country’s thriving mineral and metal industries including aluminum, copper, and steel to global markets across 150 countries. We provide secure, timely, and cost-effective shipping powered by digital tracking and optimized routes.

Petrochemicals and Chemicals UAE

Logistics Expertise For Petrochemical & Plastics

The global demand for petrochemicals and plastics continues to drive industrial growth, serving as the backbone for essential sectors ranging from automotive and construction to packaging and consumer goods. In this high-stakes environment, the United Arab Emirates has emerged as a premier global hub for petrochemical trade, leveraging its geographic advantage to connect Eastern and Western markets. MSC UAE supports this dynamic industry with comprehensive, end-to-end logistics expertise. By utilizing direct access to key gateways including Jebel Ali, Khalifa Port, and Sharjah, we connect your chemical cargo to over 150 destinations worldwide, ensuring strategic growth and operational excellence for your supply chain.

Managing your sensitive cargo

Transporting hazardous & non-hazardous chemicals

Liquid cargo solutions

Coverage to Support Your Supply Chain

For decision-makers in the petrochemical sector, supply chain continuity is paramount. MSC UAE offers a robust framework of weekly services and multimodal transport solutions designed to move cargo safely and efficiently across the Emirates and beyond. Our approach is tailored to mitigate risk and optimize logistics for a diverse range of products.

Reliable Transport for Hazardous Cargo

Transporting hazardous and critical chemical cargo requires a partner committed to the highest standards of safety and regulatory compliance. MSC UAE provides a suite of specialized equipment—including ISO tanks, flexitanks, and advanced reefer units—to handle hazardous or temperature-controlled shipments with care.

Compliance Expertise

MSC UAE’s dedicated teams support local and international manufacturers, traders, and distributors with solutions engineered around their specific production cycles. Success in the petrochemical trade requires a logistics partner who understands both local nuances and international trade flows.

At MSC UAE, we are proud to being a trusted partner for  petrochemical and chemical industry. With specialized equipments, certified adherence to IMDG Code and UAE port safety standards, we ensure your cargo is handled with precision and care.

Project Cargo UAE

UAE Specialized Solutions for Project Cargo

The United Arab Emirates stands at the forefront of large-scale infrastructure, energy, and industrial development in the region. In response to the evolving needs of these dynamic sectors, MSC delivers project cargo solutions engineered for complexity, scale, and precision. Our expertise ensures the safe, efficient, and compliant transportation of heavy, oversized, and specialized cargo, making us a trusted partner for ambitious projects across the country.
Through these tailored, professional services, MSC empowers the UAE’s leading companies to execute large-scale projects with confidence, reinforcing the nation’s position as a center for industrial and economic growth.

Complex Cargo Requirements

MSC UAE provides unparalleled connectivity for project cargo, linking businesses to global markets through the country’s strategic ports and advanced free zones. Our extensive network and local expertise ensure that even the most complex shipments are managed with precision and efficiency. We offer comprehensive, door-to-door support designed to facilitate the seamless movement of heavy and oversized goods.

Operating with Heavy Equipment

Equipment is only as effective as the team managing it. In Dubai and Abu Dhabi, MSC’s dedicated project cargo specialists bring years of experience to every operation. These experts understand the specific regulatory and logistical nuances of the Emirates, from customs compliance to road weight restrictions for inland transport.

Project Cargo Safety

MSC UAE ensures full compliance with local port regulations, customs procedures, and international safety standards which minimize risk and delays for high-value cargo.

From factory to foundation, we deliver tailored project cargo solutions, including oversized shipments, backed by local expertise and global reach.

MSC uses specialized equipment like flat racks and floating cranes and even employs 3D modeling for stowage and lashing plans to ensure compliance with IMO standards.

Smart Containers UAE

Real-Time Intelligence for UAE Logistics

In the fast-paced logistics landscape of the United Arab Emirates, precision and visibility are not just advantages they are requirements.
MSC UAE Smart Containers deliver a sophisticated solution for businesses demanding absolute control over their supply chain. By integrating advanced sensor technology directly into our equipment, we provide continuous, real-time data flow that transforms how cargo is monitored across the Emirates and beyond.
Whether cargo is at sea, in storage, or moving across the UAE, smart data ensures proactive decision-making and uninterrupted supply chain flow.

24/7 Visibility

Security Alerts

Temperature Monitoring

Uninterrupted Tracking

MSC Smart Containers are equipped with advanced Internet of Things (IoT) sensors that provide comprehensive, real-time data on your cargo's condition and journey. These devices monitor critical parameters including location, temperature, humidity, door status, and shock events. This capability offers businesses complete situational awareness across every stage of the logistics process, from port operations and inland transport to warehouse handling and final delivery, whether for regional or global movements.

Safe Delivery for Perishable Cargo

MSC Smart Containers provide essential support for critical sectors across the United Arab Emirates, including pharmaceuticals, healthcare, petrochemicals, plastics, retail, and Fast-Moving Consumer Goods (FMCG). The technology is engineered to address the specific challenges of transporting sensitive and high-value products within this demanding market.

Efficiency for Net Zero 2050

In line with the UAE Net Zero 2050 initiative, MSC UAE is contributing to this vision by reducing waste, spoilage, and unnecessary inspections through data-driven cargo management.

Smart Container insights optimize routes, boost delivery accuracy, and cut environmental impact to driving efficient, sustainable logistics across key inland corridors in the Emirates.

Did you know?

The technology powering our Smart Containers complies with the Digital Container Shipping Association (DCSA) IoT standards

Detention, demurrage, Per Diem and storage charges

What is detention?

Detention is the charge applicable, after the free time expires, for the use of the carrier’s full container inside the marine terminal, railroad facilities or container yard

What is demurrage?

Demurrage is the charge applicable, after the free time expires, inside the terminal for the use of the land.

In case of a demurrage dispute, please contact us on email Abilash@sabaint.net   write the following in the email subject: Dispute + Invoice Number), describing the reasons for your dispute in your email.

What is Per Diem?

Per Diem is the charge applicable, after the free time expires, for the use of the carrier’s container (full or empty) outside the marine terminal, rail ramp or container yard.

In case of Per Diem disputes, email Abilash@sabaint.net , mentioning the invoice number in the email subject. Please describe the reasons for your

What are storage charges?

A storage charge is applicable, after the free time expires, for containers left inside the rail ramp or container yard (for the use of the land).

SOLAS VGM information for Yemen

What is VGM?

Verified Gross Mass or VGM refers to the exact, verified weight of a packed container. For safety reasons, vessel operators can only load a container if its weight has been verified.

What do I need to include in my VGM instructions?

You must include the following on all VGM instructions:

Booking or Bill of Lading (BL) number

Container number

VGM + weight measurement unit (lbs. or kgs.)

Responsible Party Name

Digital signature of the authorised signatory in all CAPITAL LETTERS.

How can I submit my VGM instructions?

myMSC (Free of Charge)

EDI (via INTTRA; GT NEXUS; Cargo Smart)

Manually (via INTTRA; GT NEXUS; Cargo Smart)

Email: Abilash@sabaint.net (note: the email will only be monitored for VGM declarations)

Guidelines for submitting your VGM instructions

MSC prefers to receive a Shipper-Verified Gross Mass (VGM) before cargo is delivered. This helps to avoid any unexpected weighing charges being levied against the cargo at the US Port of Loading, which will be billed to the Shipper of Record.

Any Shipper of Record-signed VGM will override any VGM derived at or by the terminal.

For truck delivery, the ultimate deadline for VGM submission will be 12:00 noon local time on the day of the cargo cut-off.

There are currently no US terminals with a “NO VGM – No GATE” policy.

All rail shipments must have the VGM submitted within 24 hours of the container gating in at the origin rail ramp, to avoid any extra fees levied by the terminal for weighing services. Late gates will only be considered for approval when a VGM is submitted by the Shipper of Record before 12:00 noon, local time, on the day of the cargo cut-off.

MSC admin fees and costs

Manual VGM Submission Fee (applies to email, fax, and inclusion on standard shipping instructions): 25 USD per container. Late VGM Submission Fee: 25 USD per container. VGM Misdeclaration Fee: 300 USD per misdeclaration, per container.
