Find out More About our Integration Suite

Answers to frequently asked questions about the MSC Integration Suite.

What are the steps to establish integration with MSC?

Integration Request: The integration request must be submitted to MSC via the request form.

MSC Internal Assessment: MSC’s integration team evaluates the request details and contacts the requestor to propose a suitable solution aligned with their needs.

Data Sharing Agreement: As part of the onboarding process, a Data Sharing Agreement must be signed to secure the integration and confirm alignment with MSC’s terms and conditions.

Connection Setup: MSC technical experts work with the requestor’s technical team to set up the connection and complete the required development activities.

Testing: MSC supports the requestor during UAT testing to ensure quality and validate all scenarios before production deployment.

Go-Live: Once testing is completed and the scope and timelines are agreed, the integration goes live with support from MSC’s technical and integration teams.

Support: After go-live, MSC provides dedicated support, to address and resolve any integration-related issues as quickly as possible.

Share
Link copied!

What documentation is required to proceed with an integration?

To proceed with an integration, a Data Sharing Agreement must be signed between the parties. In the case of an integration via a Solution Provider, a Letter of Authorization (LOA) is required for each customer.

Share
Link copied!

Are there any fees associated with the Integration Suite?

Integrations via third party vendors are subject to fees depending on the setup and on the Integration Package selected. Customers connecting directly to MSC are not charged.

Share
Link copied!

How can I follow up on the status of my request?

Once your request has been submitted, our team will keep you informed about its status and will contact you if any additional information is required.

Share
Link copied!

Where can I find the technical implementation guidelines supported by MSC?

All EDI and API implementation guidelines as well as sample data are available in our Developer Portal for reference. API credentials for both UAT and Production environments are provided only after the onboarding process has been completed.

Share
Link copied!

Can I have multiple connections for the same company?

No, we provide one connection per customer, that can support multiple message types. Multiple connections per region are not supported.

Share
Link copied!

Can I customize the message format for the EDI?

Our solutions are designed to address your needs while complying with the standardization best practices. As such, we do not recommend customized or non-standardized integrations.

Share
Link copied!

How many API calls are supported?

API usage is limited to 100,000 calls per day and up to 4 calls per second. These limits cannot be increased.

Share
Link copied!

Is it possible to have hybrid integration (API and EDI)?

Yes, a hybrid setup combining API and EDI is possible. However, it is generally recommended to go for API integrations, as they are faster to implement, more flexible, and provide data availability closer to real time.

Share
Link copied!

How’s the data availability across the EDI and API connections?

With API connections, data is available close to real time. As soon as the data is received in our systems, it becomes available.

For EDI integrations, data is processed in batch mode, meaning it becomes available according to the defined batch processing schedule.

Share
Link copied!

Is there a Spot Quotes integration available?

Spot quotes are currently available only via myMSC. At this time, no API or EDI solutions are available for spot quotes.

Share
Link copied!

Is there a global solution available for invoices?

At present, no global invoicing solution is available. For invoice-related matters, please contact the local MSC agency.

Share
Link copied!

What if I’m using the older RSS Feed?

Please indicate that you’re a current RSS Feed (web services) customer when submitting the Integration Request Form, including the URL you use to access the information. This will help us to migrate the technical component for your new API connection.

Share
Link copied!

Why can’t I find integration formats from my local office in the MSC catalogue?

The portfolio of integration formats shown in the MSC catalogue is available at global level. The MSC API and EDI solutions share information on all shipments, from different locations following the same message standards and harmonized process. Integration formats, that are managed locally, are not included in this process yet.

Manage your eBills of Lading in a Matter of Clicks!

In an increasing digitalized world, everyone wants access to data and documents online, 24/7 and from anywhere. The electronic bill of lading is an original electronic document which offers a more efficient, secure, and sustainable alternative to a complex and costly process. It has the same legal value and replicates the functions of an original BL in paper, but electronically.  No more paperwork, postage costs, delays or disruptions to move physically important trade documents between exporters, shipping agents, banks, importers and other parties.

Did you know?

Enabling paperless trade with 100% eBL adoption could save 28,000 trees per year and $6.5 billion in direct costs for stakeholders.

Why Choose eBill of Lading?

More Efficient

Transfer your eBL in minutes instead of weeks with MSC's eBL

Maximize your savings by:

Streamlining your workflows, without disrupting existing processes

Accelerating payment times

Reducing administrative workload and eliminating courier or postage fees

Safer

Our eBL solution is offered via WAVE BL's digital courier platform where all parties involved on the eBL are connected in a decentralized network, which allows them to securely exchange documents. All data is secured and encrypted by blockchain technology, and every document or signature is verified and authenticated.

This means that the risk of document loss, forgery or fraud is eliminated.

Simpler & Sustainable

Amend, endorse, surrender or transfer your eBL at any time, from anywhere, via the WAVE BL user-friendly platform. Mirroring the traditional paper-based process, electronic Bill of Lading helps reduce human errors and time-consuming processes.

With eBL you can also reduce your carbon footprint with paperless process.

The Most Advanced Reefer Container Monitoring System

Tracking your cargo's location is essential, but understanding and monitoring its condition is invaluable. With MSC iReefer, you get real-time visibility into your shipment’s position, temperature, humidity, and overall journey, helping you prevent losses and optimize efficiency.

Designed to enhance your supply chain operations, MSC iReefer empowers you to make faster, smarter decisions and boost customer satisfaction—all from one intuitive platform. Available via myMSC and API, our remote tracking and monitoring solution puts you in full control of your refrigerated cargo shipment!

Stay in control anytime, anywhere. Log in to myMSC and experience the power MSC iReefer has to transform your shipping experience!

Real-time monitoring

Track cargo in real-time to reduce risks and ensure quick responses.

Temperature control

Maintain the right temperature for perishable goods.

How it Works

Choose the MSC iReefer Package that

Best Fits your Needs

Find the perfect level of container monitoring, analytics, and tracking for your cargo with our tailored MSC iReefer packages. Whether you’re looking for essential features or advanced, full-scale insights, we can offer a solution that matches your operational needs.

Give your Container Monitoring an Upgrade with MSC iReefer PRO!

Upgrade effortlessly to MSC iReefer Pro and gain access to a premium package that offers even greater control over your refrigerated cargo. Experience the simplicity of the upgrade process firsthand with our demo—designed for illustration purposes and completely free of customer data.

With MSC iReefer Pro, you get everything included in the essentials package, plus some additional enhanced features such as:

Detailed container logs including relative humidity, ambient temperature readings, and a record of key milestone events.

Real-time container GPS location tracking for improved visibility.

A Controlled Atmosphere (CA) overview for monitoring modified storage conditions.

A Cold Treatment (CT) overview to ensure compliance with cold chain protocol.

Off-power and defrost period tracking to identify potential disruptions.

Unlimited datalog downloads for comprehensive reporting and analysis.

shipments with MSC iReefer.

Get Started

MSC iReefer FAQs?

We've got you covered with some of the most frequently asked questions about MSC iReefer!

What is MSC iReefer?

MSC iReefer is a reefer container equipped with an IoT (Internet of Things) device that collects and transmit data about your shipment condition and location in real-time.

Download our brochure and learn more!

Share
Link copied!

How does MSC iReefer work?

The IoT device on the reefer unit transmits telemetry data (e.g. temperature inside the container) and GPS position via cellular networks or satellite when out of range. This ensures continuous, real-time visibility of your refrigerated cargo anywhere in the world.

Share
Link copied!

What are the benefits of MSC iReefer?

MSC iReefer provides real-time visibility into your shipment’s position, temperature, humidity and journey – reducing the risk of cargo damage or loss. It enables smarter decision-making and greater supply chain efficiency, all from one easy-to-use platform, accessible via myMSC or API.

Share
Link copied!

Is the data shown in real-time?

Yes. For our connected vessels, when powered and in range of a cellular or satellite network, the MSC iReefer units will transmit updates in near-real time, typically every hour.

Share
Link copied!

How can I purchase MSC iReefer?

You can access the MSC iReefer Essential and Pro packages through our myMSC eBusiness platform. If you already have an account, simply log in. If not, you’ll need to create one. For existing bookings, the Essentials package is free and automatically visible in your dashboard if a compatible iReefer is assigned; from there, you can upgrade to Pro.

For future shipments, contact your booking agency via your usual booking channel and request MSC iReefer. For MSC iReefer Ultimate, please contact your MSC commercial representative to discuss the implementation.

European & Short Sea Network

Leverage on Europe's Most
Extensive Network

Offer your business unparalleled connectivity with our expansive port and services network and ensure your cargo reaches its destination seamlessly. By seamlessly merging frequent shipping services with intermodal services, we provide safe, reliable, and cost-effective door-to-door delivery solutions for businesses of all sizes. Our comprehensive intermodal solutions prioritize efficiency but also sustainability, paving the way for a greener shipping industry.

Whether importing or exporting enjoy a personalised services across the European continent, with experts at hand catering to the unique needs of your cargo. From frozen food, pharmaceuticals, chemicals to cars, we guarantee the safe and timely delivery of cargo, regardless of shape, size, or shelf-life, straight to its destination.

Trust MSC as your partner in shipping and logistics and experience a smooth and efficient cargo transportation journey, every step of the way.

Quick and easy quotes

Competitive prices

Flexible delivery options

(door-to-door, door-to-port or port-to-door)

All your Export and Import Needs Met

Embracing sea transport offers a multitude of competitive advantages for your business. With expert support at your fingertips, and the flexibility to design your cargo transportation according to your needs, navigating the complexities of shipping becomes more manageable. While switching from road to sea significantly reduces your carbon footprint, it also decreases your logistical costs and provides a secure and reliable option. Opting for sea shipping expanded capabilities becomes feasible, unlocking new opportunities for growth and expansion.

Safe & Simple Loading

Whether you are moving oranges, engine parts or medicines, packing your cargo into our containers is quick and easy. Load your goods through the back doors of the container using a pallet truck or forklift. The container will remain safely sealed and locked until it reaches its final destination.

Equipment to Meet

your Transport Needs

Our experienced team will advise you on the best equipment to use, depending on the type and volume of cargo you are shipping. We provide access to a wide selection of standard containers and special equipment, including food-grade and reefer (refrigerated) units for temperature-sensitive goods.

You Will Sea: Debunking Short Sea Shipping Myths

7 Reasons to Choose Short Sea

Hear directly from our short sea experts in an exclusive 7-video series, where we dive into the invaluable benefits of short sea shipping for your cargo transportation needs. Join us on this enlightening journey as we unravel the transformative power of short sea shipping for your supply chain.

European & Short Sea Network

Belgium

Direct Connections from Belgium to Everywhere in Europe

As a leading hub in MSC's global network, Antwerp plays a vital role in our short sea operations. Strategically positioned in the heart of Europe, the port of Antwerp connects businesses across Belgium to key markets throughout the continent.

Our Short Sea shipping network provide seamless, sustainable, and cost-effective solutions, linking Antwerp to neighboring countries such as the UK, Germany, and France, as well as the Nordics, the Mediterranean, and beyond. With frequent departures and efficient intermodal options, MSC ensures swift and reliable transport for all types of cargo, supporting Belgium's position as a gateway to international trade.

Benefit from

Access to Local Short Sea Experts

Our dedicated Belgian team is here to support you every step of the way, ensuring that your cargo has a safe and smooth journey, from loading to delivery.

Wide Equipment Availability

As a global shipping line, we can quickly provide different container types to meet your transport needs.

Complete Flexibility and Control

Our established network of ports, haulage network, storage facilities and services provide you with complete flexibility and control over where and when we collect and deliver your cargo.

Quick and Efficient Customs Clearance

As an Authorized Economic Operator (AEO) partner, our local team can provide you with quick and efficient customs clearance processing and expert guidance on Belgian customs processes and regulations.

Reduce your Carbon Footprint
Our integrated international intermodal service enables you to move your cargo more efficiently, saving unnecessary road miles while reducing your carbon footprint.

A Full Portfolio of Solutions

MSC’s Short Sea shipping network not only connects your cargo from Antwerp to Europe—it also offers the flexibility to integrate our additional solutions, ensuring your goods are handled with the utmost care. These include:

Fumigation

Protect your shipments with certified fumigation, ideal for cargo requiring strict pest control.

Liquid Cargo Solutions

Benefit from specialized handling and transport for liquid goods, ensuring safety and efficiency at every step.

And our Extensive Intermodal Network

Germany

Tailor-made Logistics Solutions in the Heart of Europe

Our central location, unrivalled European port coverage and national road and rail network enable us to provide a seamless connection for your cargo to anywhere in Europe. At MSC, we are committed to building long-standing personal relationships with customers. Contact us to discuss your German and European cargo delivery needs. We are happy to help.

Benefit from

Access to Local Short Sea Experts

Our highly professional team is here to support you every step of the way, ensuring that your cargo has a safe and smooth journey, from loading to delivery.

Reduce your Carbon Footprint

Move your cargo more efficiently, save unnecessary road miles and reduce your carbon footprint by using our market-leading ports and depots range in Germany and integrated national intermodal service.

Complete Flexibility and Control

Our well-established network of ports, road, barge and rail resources provides you with complete flexibility and control over where and when we collect and deliver your cargo.

Gateway to Central Europe

Through frequent rail connections from NWC ports and South port (Trieste), we can offer the shortest route for your cargo to relevant locations in Austria, Belgium, Czech Republic, France, Hungary, Netherlands, Slovakia and Poland.

Extensive Inland Depots Network

The convenient positioning of our inland terminals across Germany offers you the flexibility to pick up and deliver containers within your local region.

Learn more about our dedicated service.

Hungary

A Leading and Efficient Logistics Partner in Hungary with an Excellent  Rail Network

Our unrivalled rail network in Hungary connects with major North and South European sea ports 23 times a week. We can support your last-minute bookings by enabling late MRN presentations (only required before vessel sailing) to provide that extra flexibility that European cargo deliveries need. Thanks to our environmentally-friendly logistics solutions, MSC ensures a seamless connection for your European cargo – delivering fast and secure door-to-door logistics.

Benefit from

Access to Local Short Sea Experts

Our highly professional local team is here to support you every step of the way, ensuring that your cargo has a safe and smooth journey, from loading to delivery.

Streamlined Train Planning

MSC’s logistics experts coordinate the weekly train planning from Budapest to Koper and Trieste to connect your cargo with MSC vessels smoothly and quickly without any extra fees or storage costs.

Complete Flexibility and Control

Our established Hungarian network of depots, road and rail resources provides you with flexibility and control over where and when we collect and deliver your cargo.

Container Yard Service in Budapest

Benefit from the comfort of dry port services in Budapest. We can arrange customs clearance, inspections, weighing of the container, storage, re-loading of cargo, etc.

Leading Container Carrier for your European Cargo in Latvia and Beyond

Benefit from

Access to Local Short Sea Experts

Building on more than 20 years of serving the Baltic region, our local dedicated team is here to support you every step of the way, ensuring that your cargo has a safe and smooth journey from loading to delivery.

Seamless and Flexible Services

From customs processes to schedule searches on msc.com and digital solutions such as Smart Containers, you can benefit from an efficient and streamlined service.

End-to-End Transport Solutions

We offer a full-service package including all necessary procedures and insurance. By combining shipping services with our cost-efficient European inland operations, we ensure a smooth journey for your shipments.

Sustainable Partner

As a contributor to Sustainable Environmental Development, MSC promotes cleaner seas and land through investments in low-carbon technology, energy efficiency and operational effectiveness.

Netherlands

Netherlands: The gateway to North and Central Europe

Supported by our dedicated local team, MSC offers smooth weekly connections via Rotterdam and Antwerp from any Dutch and hinterland destination to anywhere in Europe.

Our extensive port coverage and unrivalled international road, rail and barge network enable us to provide fast, secure and environmentally-friendly door-to-door transport solutions and seamless logistics for your European cargo.

Benefit from

Access to Local Short Sea Experts

Our dedicated dry and reefer cargo teams in the Netherlands are here to support you every step of the way, ensuring that your cargo has a safe and smooth journey, from loading to delivery.

Quick and Efficient Customs Clearance

As an Authorized Economic Operator (AEO) partner, our local team can provide you with quick and efficient customs clearance processing and expert guidance on Dutch customs processes and regulations.

Inland Terminal Network

The convenient positioning of our inland terminals offers you the flexibility to pick up and deliver containers within your local region.

Reduce your Carbon Footprint

Move your cargo more efficiently, save unnecessary road miles and reduce your carbon footprint by using our extensive and market-leading range of Dutch ports and integrated national intermodal services.

Norway

Connecting Norway with Europe: A Trusted Partner to Ship your Cargo

Our market-leading port coverage in Norway and superior road and rail solutions enable us to provide fast, secure and environmentally-friendly door-to-door transport solutions that connect your cargo seamlessly to Europe. Through MSC’S transshipment hubs in Antwerp, Rotterdam and Bremerhaven, we connect your cargo to everywhere in Europe, from the UK to Turkey and from the Netherlands to Portugal.

Benefit from

Access to Local Short Sea Experts

Our dedicated local sales and customer service teams in Norway are here to support you every step of the way, ensuring your cargo has a safe and smooth journey, from loading to delivery.

Reduce your Carbon Footprint

Move your cargo more efficiently, save unnecessary road miles and reduce your carbon footprint by using our extensive port coverage in Norway combined with our intermodal services from/to your premises.

Reliable MSC Feeder Service

Our reliable weekly MSC feeder calls at the ports of Oslo, Larvik, Brevik and Kristiansand. This service quickly connects your Norwegian cargo to MSC’s dedicated transshipment hub in Antwerp, from where we offer direct routes to everywhere in Europe.

Covering the West Coast

We serve the West Coast of Norway through close cooperation with commercial feeder operators to ensure a wide port range and quick connections to Rotterdam and Bremerhaven for European deliveries.

Wide Equipment Availability

As a global shipping line, we can provide different container types quickly in ports and depots across Norway covering all your transport and logistics requirements.

Always Available for You

We offer a wide range of digital solutions, but to ensure that extra level of comfort, we are also easy to reach by email or phone.

The Protection your Cargo Deserves

Protecting your cargo against financial losses is crucial, in events such as rough weather, fire, theft, and many other occurrences.

Available globally for a wide range of cargo including dry and refrigerated commodities, MSC Extended Protection offers you the extra level of protection you need for your cargo’s partial or full value *. Shipping fresh produce? We’ve got you covered with a dedicated cargo cover solution.

With a simple, fast-tracked claim’s resolution process and one-stop-shop approach aiming to solve claims in 30 working days from the submission of all necessary documents, protecting your cargo has never been easier. Add extended protection to your booking in a few clicks and enjoy seamless protection of your cargo’s value and the support of a dedicated team at every step of your cargo’s protection journey.

*full value is calculated based on 110% of the shipment CIF value.

One-stop-shop approach

Widest possible cargo protection

Easy pricing procedure

Unique point of contact for your claims

Why Choose MSC Extended Protection?

One-stop-shop Approach to Shipping Protection

We are always by your side. This is why we designed our Extended Protection solution as a one stop shop approach that offers the benefit of a sole interlocutor throughout your journey with MSC. This approach ensures a more efficient and simpler process.

Wide Scope

Our solution is available for both spot shipments and volume contracts, worldwide. MSC Extended Protection supports a broad range of transportation solutions, including warehouse-to-warehouse and anything else in between enabling you to protect your cargo on a door-to-door basis, subject to carrier haulage.

Easy Pricing Procedure

The tariff charged for MSC Extended Protection is easily calculated, based on your cargo value and specificities. There is also the option to select partial value protection. The applicable tariff will be displayed on your freight invoice to help ensure you receive the protection your cargo deserves.

Simple Claims Process

We aim to conclude all Extended Protection claims within a 30 working-day average period, running from the submission of your completed file. To minimize the impact of the claim process we offer a straightforward procedure requiring fewer documents, with surveys conducted by MSC-appointed independent experts, a local point of contact, and dedicated support from our specialist claims team.

A Fast-tracked Claims Procedure

The handling of your cargo claims will be taken care of by MSC directly through a fast-track procedure relying on three main elements:

Easy processing

The support of a dedicated Claims team

Surveys conducted by a surveyor appointed by MSC

What is Covered with the MSC Extended Protection Solution

MSC Extended Protection covers a wide range of cargoes and offers a supplemental layer of protection for your cargo for accidental damage, loss, or theft during its journey with us.

Our extended cargo protection covers loss or damage to cargo due to:

● Fire.

● Stranding, grounding, sinking, collision.

● Heavy weather events.

● Acts of God/natural events.

● Wetting damage (hole in container roof allowing water infiltration).

● Stevedore mishandling.

● Thefts & pilferage.

● Reefers’ temperature variation (from 24 consecutive hours).

● Geopolitical events (riots; strikes; warlike operations at sea; terrorism and weapons).

Share
Link copied!

MSC Extended Protection Solution Does not Cover

Please be aware, that our cargo protection systems do not cover loss or damage to cargo due to:

● Delays.

● Insufficient or improper packaging.

● Loss or damage attributable to the willful misconduct of the shipper, consignee, or other merchant.

● Ordinary leakage, loss in weight, wear, and tear.

● Inherent defect, quality, or vice.

● Temperature or atmospheric pressure changes.

● Other events (sanctioned countries; persons or goods; seizures or arrests; cyber-risks, and similar events).

Add Extended Protection to your Booking in myMSC in a few Simple Steps

Step 1: Log in to myMSC

Enter your credentials and log in to your account. If you do not have one, you can create it in a few simple steps!

Step 2: Create your eBooking

Click on the eBooking option on the menu and insert the information for your desired shipment.

Step 3: Add EPR to your Cargo at the Summary Stage

At the summary stage of your eBooking, you can find the option to include MSC Extended Protection in the additional services section. Simply click on "Add to eBooking" to start configuring the solution to your needs.

Step 4: Select the Cargo Value you Wish to Protect and Accept the Corresponding EPR Tariff

Select the value range of the cargo you wish to protect. Then accept the EPR tariff and the EPR terms and conditions by ticking the corresponding box.

Step 5: Confirm and Finalise your Cargo Protection Plan

Click “Add to eBooking” on the pop-up window to finalise your request. Your cargo protection is now all set and you may proceed with arranging your cargo for shipping.

FAQs about MSC’s Extended Cargo Protection Services

Discover more about how MSC’s Extended Protection service ensures a seamless protection experience for your cargo.

How does MSC Extended Protection Process Work in Case of Damage to your Cargo?

For any compensation request under the MSC EPR, the Merchant must follow the steps below:

1. Notify MSC on Time

Visible loss or damage: Notify MSC immediately at delivery.

Hidden loss or damage: Notify MSC within maximum 3 days after delivery.

2. Inspect the Container at Delivery

Check the container and seals immediately upon delivery.

If the container is damaged, or seals are missing, broken, or incorrect:

Note this clearly on the delivery receipt

Keep all damaged or irregular seals and locks

3. Document the Loss or Damage

If damage is visible at delivery:

Record it immediately on the delivery receipt

Keep all packing materials

Take clear photos of damaged items

If damage is discovered later:

Document it immediately upon discovery

Notify MSC with details, including missing items and estimated claim amount

Do not discard packing or damaged goods

4. Survey by Expert

Inform MSC immediately so a survey can be arranged

Allow access to the cargo and container for inspection

MSC will cover expert fees for suspected damage above USD 5,000

5. Submit a Complete Compensation Request

Within 30 days of delivery (or expected delivery for lost cargo), submit your claim and all supporting documents to MSC, including:

MSC Bill of Lading / Sea Waybill or contract of carriage

Commercial invoice

Packing list

Claim cover letter with itemized amounts (on company letterhead)

Delivery receipt showing any exceptions

Destruction certificate or salvage sale receipt (if applicable)

MSC may request additional documents if needed.

6. Where to Submit

Send all claims and documents to:

EPR.claims@msc.com

Or to your dedicated point of contact with the local agency.

What is the Difference Between Extended Protection and Cargo Insurance?

Although MSC Extended Protection service is not an insurance product, it provides an additional layer of security in the event of loss or damage to your cargo while under MSC’s care. As a premium service ancillary to our Bill of lading, MSC Extended Protection offers enhanced liability coverage by widening the carriage terms of the standard MSC bill of lading.

Share
Link copied!

Can I Combine Marine Cargo Insurance and Extended Protection?

The Extended Protection services works perfectly alongside your existing cargo insurance solution. Extended Protection is the perfect addition to your marine insurance, and covers your deductible, making it a valuable investment.

Share
Link copied!

Is the Extended Protection Services Available for Spot and Volume Shipments?

MSC Extended Protection is suitable for both types of shipments and all volumes.

Share
Link copied!

Does MSC’s Cargo Protection Solutions Apply to all Cargo and Equipment Types?

Currently, MSC Extended Protection is available for shipments carried in dry and reefer containers (for frozen cargo only). If you have fresh cargo to protect, please check our dedicated solutions page.

Some cargo has a narrower scope of protection, classifying it as ‘Restricted Cargo’, either due to specific packing standards or risks. Other cargo is fully excluded from protection under our EPR Terms and Conditions. Please check our cargo exclusion list within our terms and conditions to verify if your shipment is eligible for our Extended Protection solution.

How to Add Extended Protection to your Booking in myMSC

Step 1: Log in to myMSC

Enter your credentials and log in to your account. If you do not have one, you can create it in a few simple steps!

Step 2: Create your eBooking

Click on the eBooking option on the menu and insert the information for your desired shipment.

Step 3: Add EPR to your Cargo at the Summary Stage

At the summary stage of your eBooking, you can find the option to include MSC Extended Protection in the additional services section. Simply click on "Add to eBooking" to start configuring the solution to your needs.

Step 4: Select the Cargo Value you Wish to Protect and Accept the Corresponding EPR Tariff

Select the value range of the cargo you wish to protect. Then accept the EPR tariff and the EPR terms and conditions by ticking the corresponding box.

Step 5: Confirm and Finalize your Cargo Protection Plan

Click “Add to eBooking” on the pop-up window to finalize your request. Your cargo protection is now all set and you may proceed with arranging your cargo for shipping.

What Do we Mean by Inland Transportation?

Inland transportation refers to the movement of cargo within a country’s transport infrastructure, by road, rail, river or other inland waterway networks. It’s a key part of the supply chain, connecting ports with factories, warehouses, and final destinations. MSC’s inland logistics solutions simplify this journey. Our intermodal network is built to move your cargo seamlessly, reducing delays, handovers, and admin.

Global Network of Warehousing Facilities

We understand that the ability to store cargo and containers, whether it’s short-term container space at the port or longer-term warehousing inland, is crucial for your supply chain. That’s why we continue to invest in a global network of flexible, secure warehousing and distribution hubs. Strategically located near major ports and inland transport hubs, our facilities enable a faster turnaround, value-added services, and comprehensive cargo visibility.

Compare Our Inland Transport Options

Our inland freight solutions are built around three key pillars: flexibility, reliability, and global coverage. Whether you're moving containers across borders or need storage for your cargo, we provide a full portfolio of shipping and logistics solutions that seamlessly connect you across sea and land.

A Growing Network for
Global Coverage

From South America to India, our cold stores are strategically located near key ports to facilitate import and export flows of temperature-controlled cargo. We continue to invest in new facilities to support customers around the world and help you keep up with global demand.

State-of-the-art Cold Storage Facilities

Our cold storage solutions utilize the latest technology to preserve the quality of your cargo. For instance, at our Savannah cold store, we use blast-freezing technology to rapidly reduce the temperature of meat and preserve quality, texture and nutritional value. We also offer cutting-edge ripening systems to allow fruits such as bananas, mangoes and avocados to mature within 3-5 days, ensuring the best quality for your cargo upon arrival.

Smart Operations Focused on Safety and Efficiency

Our advanced cold chain logistics capabilities include intelligent cold storage, automated temperature control, and data-driven warehouse management systems, ensuring efficiency and product safety.

We also place a special emphasis on smart operations, such as automated handling and secure tracking, and on full compliance with customer and customs requirements to maintain effective cold chain management across your supply chain.

Because You Need More than Port-to-Port Solutions

Complementing our shipping, inland and digital solutions, our Cold Storage Solutions are designed to keep your refrigerated and frozen cargo in optimal condition throughout the supply chain.

More than just storage, our facilities offer a range of value-added services, including customs clearance, labelling and inspections, helping simplify your logistics. Benefit from greater efficiency, visibility and convenience at every stage of your shipment.

Contact your local MSC team to learn more about our Cold Storage Solutions.

FAQs

What are cold storage solutions?

Cold storage solutions are temperature-controlled storage services designed to keep perishable or sensitive goods within a specific temperature range. They are commonly used for food, pharmaceuticals, and other products that require consistent conditions to maintain quality and safety.

What types of goods require cold storage?

Cold storage is essential for products that are sensitive to temperature changes, including fresh and frozen food, dairy products, pharmaceuticals, vaccines, and certain chemicals. These solutions help preserve product integrity and extend shelf, , life throughout storage and distribution.

How do cold storage solutions support the supply chain?

Cold storage solutions support the supply chain by maintaining consistent temperature conditions, reducing the risk of spoilage or damage, and ensuring compliance with industry regulations. When integrated with transport and logistics services, they help improve efficiency, product quality, and delivery reliability.

Our Trade Services

Our Global Shipping Network

At MSC, we prioritize your shipping needs with our customer-first approach offering you smoother, more responsive solutions tailored to your supply chain.

Operating one of the world’s largest shipping networks, with more than 1,000 vessels, the ability to carry over 30 million TEUs annually, and local offices along 300 key global routes, we combine international reach with personalized, local, expert support.

Discover our range of comprehensive shipping solutions, from ocean freight, and intermodal transportation, to warehousing and digital solutions and connect your business to the world.

Direct port calls with competitive transit times

Independent, responsive services with faster decision-making

Largest availability of space and equipment

Global reach, local support offering local expertise and communication in your language

MSC’s Key Global Trade Routes

Our global trade services connect all international shipping routes, enabling efficient cargo transport between key regions, helping your business access any market in the world.

Whether it's Transatlantic, Transpacific, East/West routes, or beyond, just let us know where your cargo needs to go, and we’ll handle the rest.

OVERVIEW

FAQS

Why Choose MSC’s Trade Services

Independent, Flexible Network

Our standalone network allows us to swiftly adapt to market changes, ensuring your shipping as usual, always meeting your dynamic transportation requirements.

By operating independently, we can offer you a smoother, more responsive service tailored to your needs, with faster decision-making and greater control over our space availability and vessel fleet.

Global Reach with Local Expertise

Ship cargo to anywhere in the world with confidence, knowing you will have dedicated shipping experts by your side and support in your language.

Our extensive global trade network and local teams make importing and exporting to any market seamless and efficient.

Largest Availability of Space and Equipment

Equipped with 1,000 vessels, 6.1 million TEUs of estimated capacity, and local offices in more than 155 countries, we are ready to support your business, delivering a smoother, more responsive service customized to your unique needs.

Optimized Transit Times and

Shipping Schedules

Time is critical when shipping cargo, which is why we have designed our ocean service network to provide the largest number of direct port calls. This gives you exceptional connectivity and a variety of sailing options.

With our competitive transit times, supported by frequent sailing schedules and reliable service planning, your cargo reaches its destination quickly, streamlining your shipping process for greater efficiency and reliability.

We also offer a full suite of digital solutions, including online booking, real-time tracking, and comprehensive warehousing, streamlining your logistics process for maximum efficiency.

Frequently Asked Questions

What are global trade services in shipping?

Shipping routes are established, efficient, and often regulated maritime paths used by vessels to transport goods between ports, acting as the backbone of global trade.

Shipping routes directly influence efficiency, costs, and delivery reliability, all of which have an impact on the supply chain. Well-optimized routes ensure on-time delivery, helping businesses meet customer KPIs. Efficient routes also minimize transit time, which reduces inventory holding costs and accelerates the flow of goods.

What trade routes does MSC operate?

MSC offers multiple services connecting markets worldwide. Our global network of efficient shipping services connect customers to all corners of the world, while helping to protect our oceans and respect the environment.

What types of cargo can be shipped via MSC trade services?

A plethora of commodities can and are shipped using the appropriate shipping solution from dry cargo like cocoa and furniture to frozen meat, liquid cargo and out-of-gauze project cargo.

How do I choose the best shipping route?

This does depend on the market you are trying to reach and the services offered by the carriers. However, visit our Search a Schedule page to find your ideal shipping route based on the port you want to ship to and from.

Our Trade Services

East-West Network

The MSC Standalone
East / West Network

MSC provides an independent, competitive, and complete network for East/West trades. MSC’s standalone network replaces the 2M VSA agreement that MSC had with Maersk.

As MSC assumed full operational control of its network, we offer our clients routing options both via Suez and the Cape of Good Hope, featuring a total of 34 loops across 5 key trades.

East / West: MSC’s Key Offerings

Benefit from MSC’s unmatched connectivity and direct corridors. Expertise and industry knowledge play a pivotal role in the shipping sector, and at MSC, our experts can advise you on the best option for your cargo, depending on the type and volume of goods you are shipping.

Door-to-Door Supply Chain Support

Regardless of whether you’re shipping dry, reefer, or liquid cargo, having excellent door-to-door supply chain support is a crucial part of any business.

From the initial booking process to final delivery, working with MSC means you’ll be able to fully utilize our full portfolio of supply chain solutions. Our team of industry experts are on-hand to help optimize your overall shipping experience in various ways, including:

Extensive Network Coverage

Our network ensures extensive global coverage with a total of 34 loops across 5 major trades, which include 7 loops for Asia-North Europe, 6 loops for Asia-Mediterranean, 4 loops for Asia-North America West Coast, 6 loops for Asia-North America East Coast, and 11 loops for the Transatlantic Network, offering weekly services via both Suez and the Cape of Good Hope.

Local and Global Expertise

Both our local and global teams are on-hand to offer advice to mitigate any potential risks, but also to ensure smooth operations and optimal efficiency during the transportation of your cargo. We stay ahead of any technological advancements that can be used to streamline processes and enhance decision-making to ultimately ensure that your cargo arrive at their final destination as quickly and smoothly as possible.

Customized Solutions

Our team has decades of experience across various industries. From shipping automotives, fruits, food and beverages to consumer goods, we will work with you to understand the specific needs of your business and design personalized shipping solutions.

Whether your cargo requires specialized handling, logistics, or packaging we are on-hand to find the best services for your cargo.

Solutions

Cargo Cover Solutions

Discover the Right Cargo Cover Solution

Loss or damage to your cargo can cause understandable financial and emotional stress — that is why you can always count on MSC. Our cargo cover solutions are designed to protect your cargo against maritime and inland transportation risks, giving you peace of mind.

MSC Extended Protection

Read more

Marine Cargo Insurance

Read more

Cargo Cover to Meet Your Needs

Whatever your business needs, our team at MSC is on hand to help find the right cargo protection solution for you.

Our extended protection solution (EPR) is an extended liability product which expands the terms of our standard bill of lading. It effectively provides your cargo with an extra layer of security against transportation risks occurring under MSC’s custody.

Alternatively, our marine cargo insurance solution provides you with a full, comprehensive policy and a certificate of insurance.

Seamless and Flexible Extended Protection

MSC Extended Protection gives you the extra level of protection you need — and the option to protect your cargo’s partial or full value.

Enjoy fast quotes, fully digitalized subscription, transparent service, and claims resolved within 30 working days, all thanks to our seamless one-stop-shop approach.

Read more

First Class Marine Cargo Insurance

Whether your shipment involves a letter of credit, the need for a certificate of insurance, or perishable cargo like fruits, dairy, or chilled goods, our Marine Cargo Insurance solution has you covered. In partnership with trusted insurers, we offer you access to full cover policies (all risks, ICC A terms).

*Subject to territorial availability.

Read more

Because you Need More than
Port-to-Port Services

As one of the most reliable carriers in the world, with outstanding global schedule reliability, at MSC we provide a range of solutions and services designed to meet the individual needs of our customers.

Whether you need full or partial cargo protection, MSC’s cargo cover solutions have been designed with your business in mind. We understand the importance of protecting your cargo across your supply chain and we work with your team to provide tailor-made solutions and to ensure that you have the right protection for your goods wherever they are in the world.

FAQs?

We are here for you!

When should I choose MSC Extended Protection instead of Marine Cargo Insurance?

Why choose when you can have both? Our Extended Protection solution may be used alongside your existing Marine Cargo Insurance solution to cover the value of your insurance deductible. By offering an additional layer of protection against cargo losses, thefts or damages, our Extended Protection services could be a valuable investment.

How long does it take to settle a claim?

With our Extended Protection solution, our dedicated claims team will process your claim in as little as 30 working days from the time your documentation is received! For our Marine Cargo Insurance solution, the claim is processed on the insurer’s timeline and requirements, but our teams will support you at every stage.

Is my cargo covered only during sea transport or also during inland transportation?

Both solutions are designed to protect your cargo door-to-door. Marine Cargo Insurance protects the inland portion whether performed by MSC or your own suppliers. MSC Extended Protection protects the inland portion only if arranged by MSC/Medlog or a subcontractor of MSC.

Discover MSC Thermal Liner Solution

Made from a blend of aluminium and polyethylene, our insulated container liners are specially designed to fit in a 20’ or 40’ container. Once installed, moisture absorbers are placed inside the thermal liners before the cargo is added to ensure that all moisture remnants are absorbed.

Weather Protection

Alongside maintaining a stable temperature, MSC’s thermal container liners also offer weather protection. By shielding your cargo from direct exposure to the elements and creating a consistent internal environment, your cargo is protected from any conditions that may impact its quality.

Did You Know? The temperature inside a container can fluctuate from -25°C to +60°C.

Reduced Condensation

During the vacuum sealing process of thermal liner installation, an ‘air gap’ is created between the container walls and your cargo. This lowers any potential condensation occurring during transportation, which in turn reduces the risk of moisture damaging your cargo while in transit.

Air Removal

Beyond this, MSC’s thermal container liners are also fitted with a special valve that is designed to remove the air between your cargo and our thermal liners. Particularly useful when shipping food or other sensitive goods, the removal of air helps eliminate moisture within the container and keeps your cargo fresh for longer.

Learn More
Download our Brochure

Benefits of MSC Thermal Liner Solutions

Aside from protecting and preserving your cargo, there are numerous benefits to working with MSC for your thermal liner shipping solutions, including:

Easy installation services and remote removal solutions. As an additional service at MSC we can also deliver your container with the thermal liner pre-installed.

Additional safety when shipping self-heating commodities like charcoal. The reflective properties of our thermal container liners, combined with the reduction in oxygen, makes shipping your cargo safer.

Expert support. Not only do we specialize in keeping your cargo safe and stable, but with MSC you’ll be working with a dedicated team of local experts who will guide you every step of the way.

Because you Need More than
Ocean Shipping Services

MSC thermal liner solution can also be combined with our Extended Protection (EPR) solution. This provides you with competitive pricing, comprehensive cargo protection, and expedited processing from our specialized team.

Whether you’re shipping charcoal or cocoa, utilizing our thermal liner shipping solutions helps preserve and protect your cargo every step of the way. When working with MSC, you’ll be supported by our team of experts, dedicated to working tirelessly to find the best shipping solutions for your business.

Warehousing and Storage with MSC:
The Benefits

Pauses and delays (either planned or unplanned) are a natural part of any international supply chain. Managing them effectively by using warehousing and storage services is critical.

Ensuring your goods (particularly perishables like food, beverages, or agriculture) are stored safely and in optimal conditions, helps you avoid damaging your cargo during transport. To optimize your supply chain even further, our warehousing and storage solutions are designed to easily be combined with our sea and inland transportation services, helping save you time and money.

Dry Storage Warehousing

Available around the world, our dry store warehousing network helps keep your supply chain fast, flexible, and efficient. As well as offering empty container depot solutions and off/on-dock container freight stations, in certain locations, we also offer repacking and relabelling options to help make your final delivery even easier.

To learn more, please contact your local MSC agency for further details and availability of this solution.

Cold Storage Solutions

When you’re using reefer cargo to ship temperature-sensitive cargo, our cold storage facilities help to maintain the quality and integrity of your goods even when they’re static. Not only do our temperature-controlled warehouses meet the highest standards of quality and certification, but they also offer full traceability, so you can rest assured that your cargo is in safe hands.

Contact your local agent to check availability.

Learn more

Value-added Storage and Warehousing Solutions

Our warehouse and storage solutions go beyond providing safety and security for your cargo. Other key services include picking, packing, unloading, labelling, palletization, and bulk stacking, along with cargo reception, re-packaging, and assembling. This allows us to support not just transport, but also the coordination of your distribution network.

Because Shipping is more than Just Ships

Our focus on customer care and creating bespoke solutions for your business means MSC’s warehousing and storage facilities can help you enhance your supply chain and simplify your global logistics approach.

Speak to a member of our team today about how to integrate our warehousing solutions into your existing shipping strategy.

FAQs About Warehousing

Why Warehousing
is Important?

Warehousing plays a vital role in the logistics network. It enables goods to be kept at their best while there are pauses in the transportation process – for example, at the port of departure or reception. There may be delays in shipping, whether planned or unplanned, and high-quality warehousing needs to be integrated into any flexible supply chain.

Using warehouses with the right features and technology is critical for perishable goods, food, beverages or agricultural produce that require specific conditions.

What are the three basic functions of a warehouse?

• Storage – a place to store goods

• Traceability – ensuring cargo being stored can be quickly located

• Movement – measures for shipping goods out of the warehouse needs to be quick and efficient

What features should be looked for in a warehouse?

Warehouses should be geographically convenient for your supply chain. There should be sufficient space for the volume of goods to be stored. The warehouse should have adequate integrated technology for the type of products in storage. There should be an effective management system, clear safety measures and good accessibility for traffic.

Do you Have a Concern you’d Like to Raise?

At MSC, developing authentic relationships built on ethics, respect and team spirit is a core part of how we do business. We care about our people and want to create an open and accountable culture where everyone feels safe and supported to speak up about concerns.

The MSC Speak-Up Line is our simple, secure and confidential tool that allows anonymous reporting of potential misconduct such as fraud, bribery and harassment and other unethical behaviour that doesn’t reflect the MSC Group Values. It is available to MSC employees, clients and partners. Reports can be made online or by phone.

All concerns raised to the MSC Speak-Up Line are treated confidentially and in many countries, you can report anonymously, unless you decide to disclose your identity. The MSC Speak-Up Line is operated by EQS Integrity Line, which is an independent global provider of a whistleblowing hotline.

MSC takes any type of misconduct very seriously. We are committed to dealing responsibly with any concerns about possible misconduct and ensuring there is no retaliation against anyone reporting a concern in good faith. Every concern is investigated thoroughly to make sure that we address issues and continue to build a more transparent working environment.

The MSC Speak-Up Line is available here: mscspeakupline.com

Addressing Social Challenges

Our People: The Source of our Success

We live in an interconnected world where the business of global companies connects and brings prosperity to people and societies. Advancing human rights and ensuring a just transition to a zero-carbon economy are at the heart of MSC business. Our social impact extends beyond our diverse workforce and includes our business partners with whom we work to build a sustainable supply network.

We address social challenges by advancing human rights; promoting diversity, equity and inclusion; and engaging our supply chain.

Our Precious Asset Growing From Strength To Strength

Advancing the international business and human rights agenda is a part of our efforts to tackle the social challenges impacting our operations.

MSC people are a central part of our success and through them we can achieve our Purpose. At MSC, we seek to provide a working environment that offers meaningful and fulfilling employment, offering employees the opportunity to thrive both personally and professionally.

Our focus is on empowering employees in their professional paths, prioritizing their development while building a workforce that can both contribute and benefit from our industry’s ongoing transformation.

Equipping Our Workforce For The Future

Decarbonization requires a safe and just energy transition for workers, their families and communities.

A collective effort is needed for the training of seafarers, dock workers, truck and train drivers, pilots and aircrew in our decarbonization pathway, including upskilling programmes and equipping our workers with the technical knowledge and skills for the safe handling of alternative fuels.

We have developed a range of learning pathways to prepare our seagoing workforce for a decarbonized shipping industry as well as employees across our inland logistics, terminal and air operations.

Promoting a Healthy, Safety and Security Culture Across Our Business

At MSC, the health, safety and well-being of our people, as well as the security of our people, assets, infrastructure and customers’ cargo, are top priorities. We have implemented policies, procedures and control protocols to navigate the often-challenging environments of our global operations at sea, on land and in the air. Our commitment is to foster a culture of prevention, promoting a safe working environment for our employees and business partners.

Protecting Whales

Why Whales Matter

Whales are vital to ocean health, biodiversity and our climate. Whales support biodiversity and help ensure the long-term balance of marine ecosystems. They also play a key role in combating climate change, capturing carbon dioxide from the atmosphere and storing it within the ocean floor at end-of-life.

Protecting whales requires collective effort. MSC collaborates with whale experts, governments and industry peers, collectively advocating for the adoption of proven measures to prevent collisions and reduce underwater noise. By working together, the industry can deliver meaningful, lasting results.

Whales are essential to ocean health and biodiversity.

Through their movement and feeding patterns, they fertilize the ocean and circulate nutrients that boost production of phytoplankton (microscopic algae that produce around 50 percent of the Earth’s oxygen and help combat climate change by absorbing CO2 from the atmosphere).

Even at the end of their lives, whales help sustain deep-sea ecosystems. Their bodies provide vital nutrients for other marine species, while the carbon they store remains on the ocean floor for centuries.

We Lead with Tangible and Measurable Actions

As part of our fundamental sustainability priority ‘Protecting our blue planet,’ MSC is dedicated to ‘Protecting biodiversity and life below water and on land.’ This deep commitment is rooted in our nautical heritage and genuine passion for the sea. We recognize the environmental impact ocean freight can have and we are dedicated to minimizing our impact on all marine wildlife, including whales. That’s why MSC is leading efforts within the maritime industry to reduce the risk of whale strikes. Please find below some examples of key projects and partnerships.

Rerouting Initiatives

MSC was the first in the industry to reroute ships off critical whale habitats off the coasts of Greece and Sri Lanka. In 2024 alone, 570 vessel routes were adjusted.

Reducing speed

MSC actively participates in both mandatory and voluntary speed reduction programmes, significantly lowering underwater noise and reducing our impact on whales.

Reducing noise emissions

MSC minimizes underwater noise by optimizing the design of newbuildings and retrofitting of existing ships through the installation of propellers that improve the flow of water around the ship.

Crew training

Training and awareness-raising of our crew enhances detection of whales at sea.

So, safeguarding whales is not just about protecting a single endangered species – it’s about ensuring the health of our oceans and the vital ecosystems they support.

Our Rerouting Initiatives

MSC was the first major container shipping line to voluntarily reroute off the western coast of Greece to protect endangered sperm whales.

Read more

In Sri Lanka, we ordered a navigational rerouting to 15 nautical miles south of the official shipping lane to protect blue whales.

Read more

A Collective Effort

In 2023, MSC hosted the International Whale Protection Workshop and in 2024 we hosted the International Fund for Animal Welfare (IFAW)’s first roundtable on the topic of underwater noise and ship strikes.

As part of the WSC Whale Navigation Group, we also support the WSC Whale Chart: a navigational aid for seafarers mapping all mandatory and voluntary governmental measures to reduce risk of collisions.

WSC Whale Chart

Read more

Protecting Marine Life

In 2025, for the seventh consecutive year, MSC received the highest Sapphire Award (>85 percent compliance) for voluntarily reducing speed to less than 10 knots as part of the Protecting Blue Whales and Blue Skies programme in the San Francisco and Monterey Bay region and the southern California region.

Our participation in the 2024–2025 Quiet Sound initiative in Admiralty Inlet and north Puget Sound (USA) had a 94% compliance rate, lowering underwater noise and protecting the remaining Southern Resident killer whale populations. We were also awarded grade A by Whale Safe for 93.3% compliance with the US National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration’s (NOAA) 2024 voluntary speed restriction season in the Santa Barbara Channel and the San Francisco region.

From Ambition to Action

Enabling Logistics Decarbonization

MSC Biofuel Solution

For Zero Impact on the Atmosphere

MSC Biofuel Solution is MSC's first certified carbon insetting programme designed to reduce CO2 emissions along your supply chain and within our own operations. The programme contributes to accelerating decarbonization in the shipping industry. Moving from ambition to concrete action is a “win-win” approach: we bunker sustainable biofuel, and our customers reap the CO2 savings.

As part of our journey to net-zero by 2050, we invite you to join forces to decarbonize your supply chain and achieve your sustainability targets.

Our destination is clear. Let’s navigate our journey to net zero, together.

MSC Biofuel Solution is a carbon insetting programme that delivers CO2 savings achieved within the shipping value chain. Carbon insetting is different to carbon offsetting, which focuses on future emission reductions outside of shipping.

Work with us to reduce the carbon footprint of your supply chain. Together we can play our part in the global energy transition and create more sustainable supply chains.

MSC CARBON CALCULATOR

Understand the carbon footprint of your supply chain

Discover the new tool now

Enabling Sustainable Supply Chains Using Biofuel

MSC Biofuel Solution delivers CO2 savings by replacing conventional fossil-based fuel with a second-generation biocomponent derived from used cooking oil (UCO).

MSC has adopted biofuel as a transition fuel in its ocean operations, as it is much more environmentally friendly. We only use biofuel that is responsibly sourced and accompanied by a Proof of Sustainability certification issued by internationally recognized bodies.

MSC Bunkers only Responsibly Sourced and Certified Second-Generation Biofuel.

Download brochure for more

How Does it Work

When you choose MSC Biofuel Solution – regardless of the cargo’s port of origin or destination – MSC purchases biofuel for use along your journey.

While biofuel is not currently available at all ports, we can still offer CO2 savings along any trade lane or route, as biofuel is bunkered and used across MSC’s network. This is known as “Mass Balance Concept” and allows us to deliver emissions savings to customers regardless of the bunkering port, trade lane or route; we simply use the biofuel available within our global maritime network.

The CO2 calculations used for MSC Biofuel Solution are based on latest global emissions guidelines.

The carbon insetting process is externally verified by a third-party provider, DNV, to ensure the accuracy of the CO2 savings transferred to you.

MSC also issues a Retirement Statement with the following information, that can be used for reporting on the carbon footprint of your supply chain (Scope 3 CO2 emissions):

• CO2 savings transferred to the customer (in tonnes), based on:

o Baseline CO2e emissions for the requested service using conventional marine fuel

o CO2e emissions for the requested service using sustainable biofuel

o WTWeq methodology (full CO2e cycle)

• Biofuel specifications and certification

• Proof of Sustainability issued by the bunker supplier

• External verification statement (carbon insetting process)

INCLUSIVE TRADE

Fostering Inclusive trade

Supporting Economic Growth and Building Resilience

The global economy relies on transport and logistics to enable trade, generating growth and social prosperity. MSC is in a unique position to create value by connecting local communities, facilitating access to a global market and supporting customers through resilient and disruption-free supply chains.

We foster inclusive trade by contributing to economic growth; building resilience across the global value chain; and developing local capacity and know-how.

Creating Value By Connecting The World

Shipping and logistics are the backbone of global trade. By creating connections MSC touches communities around the world, contributing to economic growth, enhancing employability and creating jobs that open up new opportunities for people and societies. Our commitment is to enabling global trade through resilient and efficient supply chains, creating value and fostering inclusive, sustainable growth and social prosperity.

We remain focused on maintaining connectivity for our customers, anticipating and addressing disruptions to facilitate the safe and timely delivery of essential goods – particularly at times of crisis.

Enhancing Local Industry Through Logistics Ecosystems

The global economy depends on supply chains to maintain an international trade system capable of withstanding and addressing disruptions arising from ongoing geopolitical tensions, evolving demographics, varying export/import flows and extreme weather events.

We are committed to continuously adapt, innovate and invest in solutions to facilitate evolving trade flows potentially impacting trade access for small- and medium-sized enterprises in emerging markets.

Our standalone network provides flexible routing options, direct corridors and port calls, helping to boost resilience and create value for local communities. Our focus is on ensuring secure and reliable links to ports through intermodal solutions and logistics hubs to address today’s increasingly complex supply chains.

The Code of Business Conduct complies with international and national applicable regulations and standards, including the United Nations Global Compact Ten Principles.

MSC Modern Slavery Transparency Statement

MSC’s Modern Slavery Transparency Statement

At MSC, people are at the centre of everything we do. Our commitment to respecting and promoting human rights and labour standards is about protecting our people on land and at sea, those with whom we work across global maritime supply chains as well as local communities, wherever we operate.

MSC’s Modern Slavery Transparency Statements provide an overview of key practices and processes aimed to identify, prevent, and mitigate the risk of modern slavery, slavery-like practices and human trafficking in business activities, operations and supply chains as part of the broader MSC’s Cargo Division Human Rights Due Diligence Process, in accordance with Section 54 of the UK Modern Slavery Act 2015 and analogous legislations on the subject matter.

For more information about Human Rights at MSC, please visit Addressing Social Challenges  or read our latest Sustainability Report.

Read more in our latest  Modern Slavery Transparency Statement

MSC has submitted a Modern Slavery Transparency Statement every year since 2016.

MSC SHIP
RECYCLING POLICY

Watch the video

Schedules

Sustainability

MSC Ship Recycling Policy

At MSC, we Have a Strong Commitment to Ensure the Safe, Sustainable and Responsible Recycling of our Ships at the End of their Operational Life.

We recognize our industry’s end-of-life challenges and are committed to promoting the respect for labour and human rights and supporting the welfare of our supply chain partners, including those working at the yards where MSC ships are recycled. We take recycling into consideration throughout all stages of a ship’s lifecycle – from newbuildings to operations to dismantling – and incorporate circular economy principles wherever possible.

When an MSC-owned ship reaches the end of its operational life, we seek to make a positive contribution by supporting the local ship recycling industry. In addition to enabling the livelihoods of people working at shipyards, ship recycling-related activities generate local economic growth, with surrounding communities benefiting from local business activity related to the sale of recycled materials. We are also engaging with other stakeholders to improve conditions at shipyards to promote a safe and responsible ship recycling industry, including participation in European Union delegation visits to Alang, India.

We monitor our ships throughout their operational life and conduct annual audits and vetting of shipyards to inform decision-making as our ships approach end-of-life. During the dismantling process, MSC receives regular reports from the shipyard to ensure safe working conditions and practices, as well as proper waste management and handling of all hazardous materials.

When we recycle, the process is conducted in accordance with the MSC Ship Recycling Policy, which stipulates the selection of shipyards that are certified compliant with the technical provisions of the Hong Kong Convention for the Safe and Environmentally Sound Recycling of Ships. In cases where an MSC vessel is sold for further trading, we require that the buyer undertakes safe and environmentally sound recycling practices according to the standards of the Hong Kong Convention.

MSC Supplier Code of Conduct

As part of our commitment to conduct business in a fair and responsible manner, as set out in our Code of Business Conduct, MSC expects all its partners (suppliers, distributors, subcontractors, etc., the “Suppliers”) to conduct their business under the same ethical standards.

MSC Supplier Code of Conduct, issued in June 2023, reflects these expectations, and sets forth the common principles in the areas of, among others, health and safety, anti-corruption, human rights, and environment that should guide MSC Suppliers’ conduct in their activities worldwide.

Should you have any questions or you would like more information, do not hesitate to contact us.

MSC Supplier Code of Conduct 07.06.2024 (pdf)

Partnerships

MSC Collaborates with a Range of Partners, Building Strong Relationships and Creating Alliances to Innovate, Find Solutions and Maximize our Collective Value

We work with private and public stakeholders, industry associations, fuel-specific partnerships, governments, non-governmental organizations and others to address our material topics and deliver our sustainability roadmap, in line with SDG 17: Partnership for the Goals. We are also collaborating with our customers through a range of initiatives to decarbonize supply chains, enable trade and build resilience, protect oceans and biodiversity and promote the business and human rights agenda, among other topics.

In addition to pooling complementary knowledge, technical expertise and resources as well as sharing risk, our partnerships help us prepare for and adapt to an evolving sustainability landscape and are an opportunity to align interests around a common vision.

Import Security Filing (ISF)

Import Security Filing (ISF)

Get easy access to Bill of Lading Number information to complete ISF filings with US Customs.

Preliminary ISF booking information:

Bill of Lading

Containers

The information provided is to allow our Customers to have an easy access to Bill of Lading Number information to complete their ISF filings with US Customs in a timely manner and in accordance to the guidelines for the ISF regulations. You will find the BL number and container numbers assigned at the time of booking from the foreign party.

This information is subject to change at any time in accordance to the requirements asked by the BOOKING PARTY.

This is to advise you that MSC is fully aware that many of our Non-AMS NVOCC's intend to start making, or have started to make, their own Importer Security Filing (ISF). According to the ISF Rule, the ISF filing must be done at the lowest House Bill of Lading number level, but referencing the MSC bill lading number(s) as Carrier. Therefore, it is our aim to provide you with the MSC Bill of Lading  number(s) when the booking is confirmed by MSC, in order to facilitate a sooth ISF filing for you.

The information is provided only to ensure our Partners have the same EU Customs filing information as MSC, in order to avoid filing discrepancies. This information has been locked as the unique reference for Entry Key Filings and Entry Summary Declarations.

For further information or assistance please contact: eucustmsgs@mscgva.ch

Party Responsible for Entry Summary Declaration (ENS) Filings.

The EU legislation requires that the ENS shall be lodged by the person who brings the goods, or who assumes responsibility for the carriage of the goods into the customs territory of the Community. This means the operator of the active means of transport on or in which the goods are brought into the customs territory of the Community – "the carrier" - is responsible for the filing of an ENS. In the deep sea container context, this is held to be the ocean carrier that issues bill of lading for the carriage of the goods into the EU.

However, in the case of Vessel Sharing Agreement (VSA) or similar contracting arrangements, e.g. slot or space charters, the obligation to file an ENS lies with that carrier who has contracted, and issued a bill of lading, for the carriage of the goods into the EU on the vessel subject to the arrangement. So, each party which issues bill of lading for carriage of goods on the vessel is deemed to be the ocean carrier and must file the ENS for the containers it is having carried on the vessel.

In order to comply with the above we are providing the required information to our Partners.

Entry Key Filing information provided for MSC’s VSA & Slot Partners for compliance with EU Customs Regulations.

The information above is provided only to ensure our Partners have the same EU Customs filing information as MSC, in order to avoid filing discrepancies. This information has been locked as the unique reference for Entry Key Filings and Entry Summary Declarations.

It is the responsibility of the Filer of the ENS to inform to MSC , prior loading on board our vessels, of any Risk Assessment given on Partner Cargo.
